en: 3593 geolocated postcards from Europeana. Data retrieved from Europeana. Geolocation process done at EPFL.

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a grand city square with a monumental triumphal arch and an equestrian statue. The square is surrounded by classical buildings. The arch is richly decorated with sculptural elements, and the statue depicts a man on horseback atop an ornate pedestal. There is text printed at the top of the postcard.

The image shows a sepia-toned historical street scene viewed through a large stone archway with a decorative crest above it. People in early 20th-century attire are seen walking and standing along the cobblestone street. The architecture is distinctly Northern European, with gabled rooftops and stone facades. The text 'REVAL. GROSSE STRANDPFORTE.' is printed on the lower part of the image, and there is also vertical text on the right-hand side.

The image shows an ornate fountain surrounded by highly decorative wrought-iron gates set in a public square. The centerpiece is a sculptural group with classical figures and flowing water, framed by elaborate gilded gates with intricate designs and crests. The scene is surrounded by trees, suggesting it is outdoors. The postcard has a sepia tone, indicating it is likely vintage.

A vintage black-and-white postcard image depicting a grand neoclassical theater building, titled 'Le Grand Théâtre' in Bruges. The structure has prominent columns, arched windows, and elaborate architectural detailing. There is text printed in red in the upper left corner and lower left, as well as a handwritten name 'Jeanne' at the bottom.

The postcard depicts a picturesque town nestled at the base of a steep, rocky hill. Atop the hill is a prominent castle or fortress, surrounded by trees. The town below features a number of buildings with red roofs and a notable church with a bell tower. The setting is mountainous and lush, suggesting a location in southern Europe. The image is colorized in a vintage style, typical of early 20th-century postcards. The word 'Arco' is printed on the top right, and there is a publisher's mark along the left edge.

The image shows an old black-and-white photograph of a fortified building with multiple levels of wooden walkways and staircases attached to whitewashed stone walls. The roof is steep and covered with wooden shingles. The photo has a handwritten caption at the bottom left: 'Prejmer-Tartlau'.

A black and white photograph showing a historical street parade or religious procession. The participants are dressed in period costumes, some resembling Roman soldiers and others in robes, reenacting a biblical scene (likely the Passion of Christ, with a central figure carrying a cross). Crowds line both sides of a bustling city street, and there are many flags hanging from the buildings. In the background, a tall, recognizable medieval bell tower rises above the rooftops.

This is a colorized vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a prominent hill topped by a fortress or castle. The foreground includes green fields and a winding river flowing through the city. There is a bridge crossing the river, and the city is densely built around the hill. At the top, the text reads 'Graz von der Kanzel.'

The image shows a grand neoclassical building with a large dome and several smaller domes, adorned with statues and columns. The area in front is a landscaped public square with people walking and flowerbeds. The surrounding architecture is also historic, with another prominent building and a church spire visible to the left.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a tree-lined street with tram tracks and a pedestrian promenade. On the right, there is a statue on a pedestal surrounded by a small plaza. The surrounding buildings appear to be from the late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Hirschberg.' and 'Promenade.' is printed at the top.

A black-and-white illustrated postcard depicting an ancient stone gate and surrounding buildings, with people gathered and walking in a lively square. The architecture is Romanesque, and the scene features a central arched gateway, known as 'Porta ferrea,' with several smaller structures and a columned kiosk in the foreground. The text at the bottom is in both Italian and Croatian, indicating the name of the city and the monument.

A sepia-toned, vintage postcard depicting the Brandenburg Gate, a neoclassical monument in Berlin. The image shows the gate with its iconic columns and the Quadriga statue on top. There are people and horse-drawn carriages visible in the foreground, and an old-style street lamp on the left. The postcard has text in the upper left corner.

The image shows a historic, ornate building with steep gabled roofs, brick walls, and multiple windows. There is a prominent exterior staircase leading up to an elevated entrance. The photo has a vintage, colorized appearance typical of early 20th-century postcards. At the bottom, 'Waaggebouw Nijmegen' is printed, identifying the location.

A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a picturesque canal scene in Bruges, Belgium. On the right is a large, ornate Gothic-style building with pointed towers and elaborate decorations, likely the Palais du Franc. The left side of the image shows a tree-lined street with two children standing near the water’s edge. Two swans are swimming in the canal. In the background, a small stone bridge crosses the water. The postcard includes French text at the top and along the left margin.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a public square in Bruges, Belgium. The foreground shows people in early 20th-century attire walking and socializing. On the left, there is a building with a sign reading 'MERCERIES'. In the background, a prominent medieval tower (the Belfry of Bruges) is visible. On the right, there is a grand, ornate building, labeled as the 'Hôtel du Gouvernement'. The postcard is captioned in French at the bottom.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a park with tall trees framing a view of a stone fortress wall and tower in the background. There is a circular feature (possibly a fountain or a garden bed) in the foreground. The postcard has text written in a white script at the bottom: 'Dubrovnik - Park Gradac.' and 'FOTO-BERNER 46.'

This is an illustrated postcard showing a scenic view of a city with a prominent hill in the background, topped by a tower or fortification. In the foreground, there is a large tree with spring foliage and wildflowers. The cityscape is depicted in soft pastel colors. The right edge of the postcard contains the printed text 'Vom Hofenhain' and 'Graz.'

A black-and-white photograph of a large, ornate church with a tall clock tower and spire, surrounded by trees and a white picket fence in the foreground. The architecture is neo-Gothic, and the church appears to be a significant religious building. The text at the bottom reads: 'Palanga. Kat. bažnyčia.'

A black and white image featuring a grand Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, arched windows, and intricate stone details. There are statues along the upper façade, and the building is framed by leafy trees. In the foreground, people are sitting on benches in a garden or park area.

A black-and-white postcard image showing the entrance to a cobblestone street, viewed through an arched gateway. On the left side, there is a wall with a plaque and a bench. The street opens to a view of traditional Flemish-style buildings with steep gabled roofs, whitewashed walls, and some trees in the background. The postcard has printed text along the right edge.

A black-and-white historic postcard showing an interior hall with large columns, vaulted arches, and a beamed ceiling. On the right wall are several notice boards and framed documents. The hall is spacious and appears to be part of a significant municipal or historical building. The caption at the bottom reads 'Bruges -- La Salle des Pas Perdus de l'Hôtel de Ville.'

A black-and-white photograph showing a baroque church tower with a clock, looking out over a European cityscape with ornate buildings and a tree-lined street. The church's steeple is highly decorative and topped with a cross. At the bottom of the image, the text reads '33. GRAZ, STADTPFARRKIRCHE'.

The image is a colorized view of a city with a river winding through green fields and urban areas. A prominent hill rises in the center, topped with a fortress-like structure. The background shows low mountains or hills. The landscape is lush and developed, with a combination of older and more modern buildings. The word 'Graz.' appears in the top left corner.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a square with a prominent multi-story building, a clock tower on a hill in the background, and some hand-drawn red markings. The foreground includes a street scene with a horse-drawn carriage. There is handwriting along the borders and a printed caption at the bottom.

A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a natural grotto surrounded by lush vegetation and trees. In the center, there is a stone structure framed by large rocks. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th-century design. Text in both Portuguese and French is present, identifying the site as Camões Grotto. The bottom of the postcard contains additional printed information including references to Macau and colonial Portugal.

The image shows a colorized photograph of a grand Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, lush greenery, a decorative street lamp, and people sitting on benches in a well-maintained park area in the foreground. The cathedral features arched windows and detailed stonework typical of medieval European architecture.

A historic black and white photograph postcard depicting a large crowd gathered in front of an ornate building, likely during a public event or parade. The architecture features classical columns and statues. The crowd is dense, with many people wearing hats typical of the early 20th century. The printed text at the bottom provides context about the event, mentioning Strasbourg, General Gouraud, and the date November 22, 1918.

The image shows a historic street scene with early automobiles and bicycles, pedestrians, and a prominent clock tower in the center background. The buildings lining the street have signage in German. The postcard has a sepia tone, suggesting it is from the early 20th century. The text at the top reads 'Löwenberg i. Schl. - Markt.'

A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a large, ornate building with a prominent dome and classical architectural elements. The foreground shows a neatly landscaped area with stairs leading up to the building's entrance. The top right corner reads 'Zagreb' in red, with a handwritten date next to it. The lower left features the printed label 'Umjetnički pavillon,' and additional handwritten text is visible across the bottom.

The image is a black-and-white postcard showing the interior of a historical building with classical columns, display cases containing anatomical specimens, and ornate architectural details. The postcard appears to capture a museum-like gallery or conservatory.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a large, ornate church with a central dome and two tall clock towers with spires. The architecture is predominantly neo-Romanesque, and the building is surrounded by trees. The text 'ĐAKOVO' appears in the lower left corner.

The image shows a historical town square with a large church featuring a tall bell tower at the center. The square is busy with people and market stalls, indicating a lively marketplace. The architecture is typical of Central or Eastern European towns, with multi-story buildings surrounding the square. The postcard has multi-lingual text at the bottom, including Cyrillic, Latin, German, and Hungarian scripts.

The image shows a postcard styled as a front page of a historical newspaper called 'Diario de Noticias.' The content is in Portuguese, and the date at the top is '1903.' There is an illustration of a grand gothic building, likely a famous landmark, in the center, and a portrait of a man is overlaid on the right side of the card.

A vintage black and white postcard featuring a public square with a prominent statue at the center, surrounded by elaborate flowerbeds and historical buildings with stepped gables. The postcard references a horticultural exposition that took place in the square. Text is printed in French, giving details of the event and location.

A vintage postcard depicting a lively European town square filled with market stalls and umbrellas. The square is surrounded by multi-story classical buildings with shops on the ground floor. In the middle of the square stands a prominent statue or monument with several figures. In the background, on a hill, there is a large clock tower (Uhrturm) overlooking the town. The postcard has the text 'Graz - Hauptplatz' printed on it.

The image depicts a vintage, black and white postcard showing the facade of a large Gothic-style church with prominent pointed arches and high windows. The street in front is cobblestone, and a small cart is visible to the left. The church dominates the scene with its symmetrical towers and ornate architecture. The top of the card has the printed caption 'Bruges — L’Eglise St-Jacques.'

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a street scene with people walking and horse-drawn wagons. The central focus is on a large church with a distinct baroque-style dome and tower. To the right are grand, ornate buildings with statues on the roofline. The street is lined with trees and appears to be a quiet, possibly small-town area. The text at the top is in German and reads: 'Lobositz a. d. Elbe Kirche zu St. Wenzel.'

The postcard features a black-and-white image of a historical tower with a domed roof and small cupola, set amidst trees and above stone ruins or fortifications. The text at the bottom includes printed German phrases and handwritten notes. The printed captions read 'Gruß aus Graz.' and 'Liesl am Schloßberg.'

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a formal garden with trimmed bushes and a white picket fence in the foreground. Behind the garden, there are large historic buildings with ornate windows, typical of European architecture. There is handwritten text at the top and bottom of the postcard. The printed text at the bottom references an exposition in 1901.

The image shows an old black-and-white postcard featuring a city park scene with horse-drawn carriages, a tall ornamental clock column, a small gazebo or kiosk, and a bandstand. The park is lined with trees and appears to be a lively public space. The postcard is captioned 'No. 20. La Coruña — Parque de Mendez Nuñez,' with additional text indicating the publisher and photographer.

The image shows a black-and-white, vintage-style postcard featuring a large, ornate brick building with pointed towers and decorative elements, situated alongside a canal. The left side of the image shows a row of trees along a cobbled street, and a small stone bridge crossing the canal in the background. The top of the postcard has printed text.

The image is a sepia-toned or black-and-white photograph of a historic fortified city gate with robust stone walls, a circular tower, and lush vegetation in the foreground. There is a bridge with a railing leading up to the main entrance. Above the arched gate, there is a small statue set in a niche. The word 'DUBROVNIK' is printed in block letters in the bottom right corner.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a historical building's courtyard, likely from a cloister or college. The view is framed by a large archway, looking onto a lush garden surrounded by a two-story arcade with arches and windows. In the background, elaborate towers and a clock tower are visible, indicating a significant and monumental structure. The text at the bottom references Santiago de Compostela and the Colegio Fonseca (Faculty of Medicine).

The image shows a sepia-toned view of a historical European square with a prominent Dutch Renaissance-style building with ornate gables and a staircase leading up to the first floor on the right. On the left, there are several traditional narrow houses with stepped gables. The caption under the image reads 'De Waag — Nijmegen.'

The image is a vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, neoclassical building with a prominent clock tower and arched windows, located on the bank of a river. The building is connected to a multi-arched stone bridge with people walking across it. In the background, there are hills and early 20th-century urban buildings. The bottom of the postcard contains text in Cyrillic and Latin letters.

The image depicts a stylized monument with a statue of a knight or warrior in armor holding a sword, standing atop a pedestal. The monument is flanked by two other statues and features a prominent double-headed eagle with a shield and insignia. Below the monument, there is text in a Slavic script and a date. The background includes architectural elements, such as a clock tower and classical buildings, rendered in an art-deco style.

The image shows a colorized, vintage postcard depicting a scenic view with two people standing on a path surrounded by greenery. In the background, there is a prominent building with two towers and a dome, likely a religious structure, set against a pale blue sky. Printed text at the top of the card reads: 'Omstr. Nijmegen. Heilige Landstichting.'

The image shows an old monochrome postcard with a photograph of a grand Gothic-style cathedral with two tall spires, rising above traditional rooftops and round defensive towers. The postcard features handwritten script across its surface. The printed text on the top left reads 'Zagreb (Croatie)' and on the right 'Prvostolna crkva – La Cathédrale'. The date '6.6.1904.' is handwritten in the lower right corner.

The image shows the interior of a church with prominent Moorish Revival architectural features, such as horseshoe arches decorated with alternating red and white voussoirs. There are Christian statues, wooden pews, a central altar, and a religious mural above the main arch. The lighting is warm, and there is visible text on the walls near the altar.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph showing an old, large, and ornate building, likely of historical significance. The building has arched windows, a prominent archway, and a turret-like roof section, with bare trees lining the street. Several people are walking or standing on what appears to be a quiet road. The top right of the image includes multi-lingual text indicating it is an old-time view of Zagreb.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a public square with a statue in the center surrounded by trees and several people walking or standing around. Historical buildings are visible on the right side. The text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

The image is a vintage postcard showing a waterfront scene with several boats on a river or canal, traditional Ottoman-era houses with red-tiled roofs, and a large historic fortress/castle in the background. People in period clothing, some wearing fez hats, are visible along the water's edge and in boats. There is a small bridge and a flag flying on the fortress. The postcard is colorized and has a nostalgic, early 20th-century aesthetic. The text on the postcard is in French and partially in another language.

A black-and-white postcard depicting the courtyard of a historic hospital complex. The architecture is medieval with pointed arches, brickwork, and steeply pitched roofs. There are people in period dress, including a nun or nurse, standing in the courtyard. The text at the top reads 'Bruges – La Cour de l'Hôpital St. Jean.'

The image shows a vintage black-and-white photograph, likely from the early 20th century, depicting a steam-powered boat docked by a waterfront. In the background, there is a large, ornate building with onion domes and a cross on top, which visually resembles Orthodox Christian church architecture. There are also other historic buildings and a figure walking along the shore. The boat bears the visible name 'S/S ARANDA YHTEYSALUS'.

The image is a vintage, sepia-toned postcard depicting a large Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers, each featuring a bell. There is a clock on the right tower. In front of the cathedral, a few people are seen walking in an open square. The text at the bottom identifies the building as 'A Sé (La Cathédrale)' in Lisbon (Lisboa), and there is additional publication information in French and Portuguese.

A black and white vintage postcard depicting a grand Gothic-style building complex with ornate stonework, pointed arches, and towers. The scene is framed by a wrought iron fence, and a man stands on the sidewalk in front. The left side shows a smaller, simpler building covered in vegetation, while the right side features an elaborate structure with arched windows and intricate details. The text at the top identifies the location as 'Le Musée de Dentelles (Gruuthuse)' in Bruges.

The postcard features a monochrome illustration of a tall, ornate gate tower with a pointed roof and clock face, flanked by leafless trees and some surrounding buildings. The left side of the card contains the illustration, and the right side is blank, likely for a message. The text 'St. Johannsthor in Basel' is visible beneath the illustration, and the word 'SEIDENGEWEBE' is printed below that.

A vintage postcard showing a large, open public square surrounded by historic buildings. In the center background is a prominent domed structure with a tower, likely a former mosque or religious building, now with Christian elements. The square is lined with trees, people, and horse-drawn carriages, suggesting an early 20th-century scene. The text in Hungarian at the bottom reads 'Széchenyi-tér, Pécs.' There is also publisher information in Hungarian along the left margin.

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a grand, ornate building in an urban square. The text is in Hungarian and German, suggesting a bilingual region. The building is labeled as 'Pécsi Takarékpénztár palotája,' which translates to the Savings Bank Palace of Pécs. The architecture is elaborate, with classical details and a prominent roofline, indicating a late 19th or early 20th-century style. There is additional printed text on the left and top right sides in red ink.

The image shows an old black-and-white drawing of a historical building complex with arched windows and a round apse. The architecture includes Romanesque features, such as semi-circular arches and thick walls. There is a courtyard with a couple of figures in old-fashioned dress. The bottom of the image has handwritten or stylized text.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a busy train station platform with people walking and gathering around trains. The architecture in the background has a Northern European look, and the postcard features the printed text 'Hamar Station' at the top.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a statue of Albert Schweitzer in a small European square. The statue is set on a stone plinth inscribed with the words 'Eerbied voor het leven' and 'Albert Schweitzer'. The background features a decorative historical building with ornate details and gabled roofs, surrounded by other classical European-style buildings.

A black-and-white postcard depicting an industrial riverside scene with a tram depot (remise) and a prominent smokestack in the foreground. Several gabled buildings line the water, and railway tracks are visible. In the background, a city skyline with notable church towers rises above the buildings. The card features printed text at the top indicating the location and subject.

A multi-view postcard featuring four prominent historical landmarks. The top left image shows a large domed building in a city square with a fountain; the top right image features a Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a statue in front; the bottom left image includes a mosque with a minaret next to a pink building; the bottom right image shows a medieval stone castle wall with a round tower. At the center of the postcard is a coat of arms featuring a star and fortress motif.

A black-and-white postcard image featuring a panoramic view of a walled city by the sea, with stone buildings, a prominent dome, and fortifications. There are trees and a winding road in the foreground, and smoke rising in the background, possibly indicating an event or conflict. The lower left corner contains the caption 'Dubrovnik (Ragusa)'.

The image is a vintage, illustrated postcard with four main vignettes, each depicting a different landmark. The landmarks are labeled as 'KRONENBURGER PARK,' 'STADHUIS,' 'BELVEDERE,' and 'VALKENHOF.' The postcard has decorative pink flowers and a coat of arms. Prominently displayed is the text 'GROETE uit NIJMEGEN,' which means 'Greetings from Nijmegen.'

The image shows a sepia-toned, vintage-style postcard framed in gold. The postcard features several small vignettes of buildings and a larger central panorama of a town or city, possibly drawn or lithographed. There appears to be a lighthouse or tall tower in some vignettes, and the overall style suggests a 19th-century European setting. At the bottom of the postcard, faint text is visible, and below the frame is a label with the number 21.588.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting the ornate interior of a mosque, with a row of columns and arches and intricate decorative panels. A group of people is seated on the ground in the left background, likely engaged in prayer or discussion. There is also a staircase (minbar) visible, which is typical in mosques.

A vintage postcard depicting a public square with the German Fountain (La fontaine de l'Empereur Guillaume II) prominently in the center. The fountain is a domed, octagonal structure with columns. In the background, there are visible minarets and the large domed structure of the Hagia Sophia, indicating a significant historical and architectural area. People in historical attire are seen walking in the square. The postcard has a tinted colorization typical of early 20th-century postcards, and French text at the top.

The image shows a vintage-style postcard featuring a prominent baroque monument with several statues, likely religious, in a public square. There are people gathered around the monument, and a large building with green window shutters and a reddish roof stands in the background. The sky is blue with some clouds. The text at the top reads: 'Pécs. Szentháromszágszobor a főgymnasiummal.'

A sepia-toned postcard image depicting an old European street scene. Prominently featured is an ornate baroque building with a dome and statues, likely a historic church or religious building. The street has several people walking and there are old-style streetlamps. The background shows more domed architecture. The word 'Dubrovnik.' is printed at the top left, and a small number '724' appears at the bottom left.

The image is a black-and-white photograph showing a large, ornate building with domes and classical architectural features. There is a prominent clock tower in front of the building, with advertising for 'ELIDA.' A uniformed man stands in the foreground, and there are a few people walking around. The word 'ZAGREB' is printed in the upper left corner.

The image is a sepia-toned photograph featuring a grand building partially obscured by trees, with a flag atop the building. There is a person walking along a path beside a balustrade in the foreground. The structure is surrounded by lush parkland. In the upper right corner, printed text reads 'Bad Pyrmont Schloß'.

The image shows two male wrestlers in the midst of a wrestling match, with one athlete lifting and grappling the other. Both wear vintage wrestling attire: one in a light-colored singlet, the other in a dark one. The scene is set in an outdoor stadium with tiered seating in the background, sparsely occupied by spectators. There is a man in a hat and suit, likely an official or referee, moving towards the wrestlers. A sign marked 'C18' is visible near the center.

The image is of a decorated vintage postcard featuring an ornate floral Art Nouveau border with pink roses and heart-shaped leaves. Within the border, there is a black-and-white photograph of a square with a prominent domed building with a cross on top and a tall tower beside it. The square also contains a fountain or monument and several surrounding historic buildings. Hills are visible in the background. There is printed text in Hungarian on the left side and at the bottom of the photograph.

The image depicts a grand, ornate palace set in formal gardens with wide paths and symmetrical landscaping. The building has a distinct European architectural style, with a tall, tower-like corner and mansard roofs. The postcard includes multilingual text in French, Bulgarian (Cyrillic), and a Latin transliteration, indicating the name and location of the palace: 'Le Palais Princier d’Euxinograd' in Varna.

The postcard displays an old sepia-toned illustration of a cityscape dominated by a prominent hilltop fortress or castle, with a river and bridge in the foreground. The lower part of the postcard features handwritten script and printed text in German, reading 'Gratz im Jahre 1800.' The edges of the card are irregular and aged, suggesting historical value.

A black-and-white postcard image showing a large Gothic church with a prominent tower in the foreground, surrounded by a dense cluster of historic rooftops. In the background, a wide river flows through the town, with a multi-arched stone bridge visible crossing it. The opposite riverbank is lined with more buildings and greenery. The text on the postcard reads 'Pirna a.d. Elbe – Blick vom Sonnenstein.'

The image is a vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall towers and a central nave. In the foreground, there is a statue of a man standing on a pedestal in a garden square, with benches and flower beds. The caption at the bottom is in Hungarian and refers to the location and the statue.

The postcard consists of three black-and-white photographic views. The top image shows a riverbank promenade with people walking and a covered wooden pavilion by the water. The middle image depicts a grand historic building, labeled as 'Realka - Realschule,' likely an educational institution. The bottom image shows a street scene with old buildings and a prominent tower, labeled as 'Bezanijska ulica.' The captions are provided in multiple languages: Serbian (Latin script), German, and Hungarian.

A sepia-toned image showing part of a historic coastal city with stone fortifications, a prominent round bastion, and a harbor filled with old wooden sailing ships. The foreground features leaves hanging from a tree, and a stone jetty extends into the water. The architecture in the background includes classical domes and stone buildings. The bottom left contains the printed text 'Dubrovnik (Ragusa)'.

The image is a black and white postcard depicting a canal lined with historic buildings on either side, with a church featuring a tall spire in the background. The architecture is characterized by stepped gables, typical of the Flemish region. There is some printed text in the upper left and right corners.

This is a vintage illustrated postcard depicting a large train station with a neoclassical facade, labeled 'GRAZ Bahnhof.' The scene includes two trams or streetcars on tracks approaching the station, carriages, and people walking or standing in front of the building. There is handwritten text in ink and pencil across the postcard, including a visible date '3.4.1901.' The bottom of the card credits 'Kunstverlag Rafael Neuber Wien.'

The image shows a black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a central street scene in a historic European city. Prominent is a stone bell tower on the left, with a view down a wide pedestrian street lined with old stone buildings and people walking. Hills rise in the background. The upper right contains printed text indicating the city and the name of the street, both in a Slavic language.

The image shows a vintage, colorized postcard depicting a grand neoclassical building with large windows, columns, and a prominent domed roof. Several people in early 20th-century attire are visible walking or standing near the building. The text at the top is in Croatian and reads 'Zagreb. Kr. sveučilišna biblioteka.' The setting suggests an urban environment.

The image depicts a cloister with pointed Gothic arches, stone columns, and an open courtyard with potted plants and tiled features. The architecture suggests a historical and religious building. The postcard is monochrome, indicating it is likely from the early 20th century. The text at the bottom identifies the location as 'THOMAR — Claustro D. Henrique.'

A vintage postcard featuring a monochrome (likely blue-toned) illustration of a large church with two prominent spires. The church is surrounded by trees and other buildings, and sits atop a raised area with a wall in the foreground. Below the illustration, there is printed text.

A vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a coastal city with a notable round tower on the right side, several buildings along the waterfront, and mountains in the background. The sky is tinted in pastel hues. The text is in French, and the image has a nostalgic, early 20th-century feel.

The image depicts a painted or illustrated rural European village set in a mountainous landscape. There is a prominent church with a tall steeple in the center of the village, surrounded by traditional houses with red and white facades. In the foreground, a river runs along the bottom edge, and a stone bridge or viaduct with several arches crosses the scene. The background is dominated by green hills and forested mountains.

A vintage postcard featuring a detailed black-and-white illustration of an ornate building with towers and domes, labeled 'Tonhalle' at the bottom. The word 'Zürich' appears in the lower left, indicating the city. The card has handwritten text in German along the borders and within a dedicated space on the right side. The building is surrounded by a fence and trees, with a few people and a cyclist visible in the foreground.

Color postcard showing a manicured central square with lawns, flowerbeds and a slender obelisk/clock column. Along the edge stands a long red‑brick historic building with two small domed pavilions (the main university building), while twin baroque church towers rise in the background. A rooftop neon reads "ECONOMISITI LA CEC." The reverse has Romanian preprinted address lines and a multilingual caption identifying Cluj‑Napoca and Victory Square.

Color postcard showing a neobaroque theatre with twin corner towers crowned by statues and a grand arched entrance, set by a landscaped roundabout at a busy intersection with 1960s–1970s cars and a blue city bus. The reverse has Romanian text and address lines, a blue 40 Bani POSTA ROMANA stamp, and a caption identifying the scene as the National Theatre in Cluj.

The postcard shows a black and white photograph of a cobblestone street flanked by old stone buildings with sloped tiled roofs. One of the most striking features is the medieval-looking gatehouse or fortified city gate at the end of the street. There are a few people walking or standing on the street, and the architectural style suggests Central or Eastern Europe, with distinctively Gothic and Baroque influences. The only text visible on the postcard is a handwritten number '4470' at the top.

The postcard displays a sepia-toned photograph of a well-preserved, ancient octagonal tower made of stone blocks. The upper frieze features sculpted figures, and the structure is partly surrounded by some ruins and neighboring houses. There is trilingual text at the bottom, identifying the monument and its location in French, Greek, and English letters.

The postcard shows an old, sepia-toned photograph of a large gravestone or memorial stone in a park or cemetery. The stone is tall, rough-hewn, and oval-shaped, featuring an inscription plaque dedicated to 'Wilh. von Braun.' The scene is surrounded by leafless trees, suggesting early spring or late autumn. There is some decorative greenery at the base of the stone and more stone structures nearby. Handwritten or printed text appears at the bottom of the card.

The image depicts an old railway station building with a steam locomotive on the left and several people, including women and children, standing and walking outside. The building is set against a rural landscape with a castle visible on a distant hill. The postcard has colorized elements and a clean, historical appearance. There is German text at the top, and the setting features benches and a cart, suggesting early 20th-century European rural life.

The image shows a black-and-white panoramic view of a European town, featuring a prominent church with a tall spire and a large medieval castle or fortress on a hill, with smaller houses clustered around the base. The foreground includes trees, open fields, and farmland, suggesting a rural setting.

A vintage postcard featuring the National Archaeological Museum in Athens, Greece. The museum is depicted in a neoclassical architectural style with columns across the front facade. In the background, the hills of Athens are visible. There is printed text in Greek and French at the bottom identifying the location, along with handwritten text below the main image.

The postcard features a picturesque scene of a bridge over a canal or river, with a wooden footbridge crossing above it. There is a tall, medieval stone tower (Torre Vanga) with crenellated top in the background and some classical styled buildings, possibly residential or public, nearby. The area is lush and green with trees and grass along the banks, and cows drinking from the water at the bottom left. The top of the postcard has the printed text 'Trento, Passerella e Torre Vanga.'

The image depicts a grand Baroque building with a tall, ornate tower capped with a green dome, likely copper or oxidized bronze, which is typical in Central European architecture. In the foreground, an arched stone bridge crosses a river, and there are leafy green trees framing part of the scene. The word 'Dresden' is prominently featured at the bottom in white font. The postcard is bordered with a simple white frame.

The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a tall, modernist water tower with a unique architectural design. The tower has a round body, topped with a smaller cylindrical section which has large clocks on four sides. There are structural supports and small windows around the main structure. At the bottom, there are a few people, a car and utility poles, indicating a mid-20th century time period. The sky is partly cloudy and the landscape is open and slightly rocky. Text in a Scandinavian-style script is present at the bottom left.

The image shows a picturesque hilltop fortress or castle, accessed by a funicular railway that climbs steeply up a wooded hill. On top of the hill is a baroque-style chapel with a distinct onion dome, stone fortifications, and several historic-looking buildings. The postcard contains handwritten text along the top and upper left, and printed text in red at the top left that reads: 'Graz Schlossbergbahn.'

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a baroque entrance façade with a grand semicircular staircase leading up to three arches. In the central arch is an ornate niche with a statue. Decorative railings flank the steps, and the building features a tiled roof and sculpted pediment. Trees frame the view. Printed caption text runs vertically along the right side; the right half of the card is blank for writing and address.

A vintage black-and-white postcard view of a hilltop castle complex rising above a town with pitched-roof houses and trees in the foreground. The large Gothic and Renaissance-style building complex is prominently featured on the ridge, with towers and spires visible. The lower margin has printed red script text identifying the site and city, and there is a small vertical printer's credit on the left side.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a riverside view of a large church with a tall clock tower and adjoining episcopal residence on a hill above the Elbe River. Below the buildings are terraced gardens, trees, small houses and people near the riverbank. Printed captions in German identify the location as Leitmeritz on the Elbe and describe the cathedral and bishop's residence.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a historic European town nestled in a valley, with dense trees in the foreground. Prominently on a hill stand a church with a tall tower and an adjacent castle-like complex with towers and fortified buildings. The background shows rolling hills or low mountains. At the top left of the image is printed German text identifying the place.

Colored postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city. The tower has a steep tiled roof, timbered upper structure, and a massive clock face with Roman numerals on a stone base. Trees frame the left side, and at the bottom right a person in early-20th-century clothing stands by a path and railing, looking out over the rooftops and distant hills. Printed text at the top identifies the location in German.

Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view over the rooftops of a historic European town. Dominating the scene is a large church with two baroque-style towers (the cathedral), and beside it a fortified complex with round towers and a large building (a castle and courthouse). The foreground is filled with smaller townhouses and industrial chimneys. At the top in red Gothic-style script are printed captions identifying the location and buildings.

Stylized Art-Nouveau/early Modernist illustration of a pavilion-like building with a steep, multi-peaked green roof, three front bays with statues in niches, vertical decorative panels, and flower arrangements flanking the entrance. In the foreground is a patterned plaza and red-railed walkway. To the right, a flagpole flies a checkered red, white, yellow and black flag. Decorative text in a geometric type appears on the left side of the building.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a seaside view of old stone fortification walls and towers along the shore, with rough water in the foreground and a sailing ship at left. The text below the image, in French and English, identifies the scene as the old walls of Constantinople seen from the Sea of Marmara.

Color printed postcard showing a hilltop baroque pilgrimage church complex surrounded by green fields and scattered houses, with distant low mountains under a blue sky. At the bottom is the printed German caption "Gruss aus Maria Trost b. Graz," and there is cursive handwriting across the borders and sky area. Along the left edge is the printer's imprint mentioning Karl Braun & Co., München.

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a historic European town built along a river with a small arched bridge. Dominating the scene are a massive round stone tower with crenellations and a large church or fortified building with a tall, pointed spire. Traditional pitched‑roof houses cluster on the riverbank and up the hillside, with open farmland stretching into the distance. The style suggests an early 20th‑century photograph used as a postcard. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a park landscape with a waterway curving through the foreground, dense trees, and on the left a prominent medieval round brick tower with crenellations. Behind the trees a large historic building with a steep roof is visible. The caption beneath the image identifies the scene as Kronenburgerpark in Nijmegen. At the bottom left there is a small publisher's line and a card number.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European urban square with ornate late‑19th‑century buildings. The central façade is long and baroque‑style, with a tiled roof, dormer windows and detailed window frames. On the right side stands a corner building with two onion-domed towers and cupolas. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians are visible in the square in front. The lower part of the image and right side margin are heavily covered with handwritten cursive text. Printed caption text is faint but runs vertically along the right edge and horizontally near the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, crenellated medieval brick tower standing in an open square with a few people in early 20th‑century clothing. Mountains rise in the background, and surrounding the tower are several multi‑story buildings. Printed red text in the upper right names the location, and publisher information appears in small red type at the lower right border.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Italian square. On the right stands a large Romanesque cathedral with an octagonal dome, rose window, arched colonnade, and side portico. To the left are old palazzi and a crenellated civic tower. In the foreground is an ornate fountain topped by a Neptune statue. A few people are seen walking in the square with mountains in the distant background. Caption text is printed along the bottom border.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large baroque-style castle on a rocky hill above a river. In the foreground a side‑wheel steamship travels along the water. Trees and a stone bridge or gate are visible to the right of the castle. Printed red text at the top identifies the site, and a small vertical imprint at the left edge names the publisher.

Black‑and‑white historical photograph showing a formal procession in front of a monumental colonnaded building. In the foreground is an open horse‑drawn or motorized carriage with uniformed officers in long capes and peaked caps; one elderly man sits wrapped in a cloak. To the left a uniformed rider or motor officer passes close to the camera. Behind them, dense crowds of civilians and officials in early‑20th‑century dress stand on steps between tall classical columns; a period streetlamp rises at the right.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad town square with young trees planted in orderly rows, a circular fountain or monument in the center, and a bandstand or pavilion. Behind the square stands a row of colonial-style buildings with tiled roofs and arched windows. The caption in red at the top reads: "Cabo Verde – S. Thiago – Praça do Albuquerque."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a riverside cityscape with three bridges crossing a river. On the right, a steep hill with fortifications and a prominent clock tower rises above the town. Church towers and dense historic buildings line both banks. At the bottom margin, there is printed German text and a handwritten date.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Gothic cathedral with a tall central spire and multiple smaller spires, surrounded by bare trees. In the foreground, a long procession of boys in choir robes with crosses on the chest walks toward the camera. Printed Norwegian text appears in the lower left corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of the Elbe riverfront in Dresden, showing a busy steamboat landing with docks, small boats and people working along the quay. In the background rise prominent historic buildings and church towers of Dresden's old town, with a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing the river. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German, along with a publisher credit and number.

Black‑and‑white image showing an old suspension bridge with massive stone pylons spanning a wide river. A tram runs along the embankment in the foreground, and ornate lampposts and railings line the riverside. On the bridge towers there is a coat of arms, and on both the bridge and the riverbank there are signs reading "VÁMHÁZ." Historic multi‑storey buildings with towers are visible on the far bank.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic town hall on a cobbled square. The building has several stories, a steep tiled roof, and a tall central clock tower with an ornate baroque spire and weather vane. Two large clock faces are visible on the tower. The façade includes many rectangular windows, decorative gables, and an elaborate main portal at ground level. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the open square; small carts stand at the left edge. The sky is blank and white, emphasizing the architecture.

Black‑and‑white night photograph of a large Baroque/Baroque‑Revival church with an ornate tower and statues along the roofline, dramatically illuminated by streetlights. Light trails from passing vehicles curve along a cobblestone street or bridge in the foreground, emphasizing long‑exposure photography. The scene has no visible printed caption or writing on the front.

Illustrated postcard combining a lively fairground scene with a small colored inset view of a European town square. The main illustration, mostly in monochrome, shows people at a fair with a puppet booth labeled "Kasperl-Theater," children and adults walking, and people sitting at tables. The inset image is a colored view of a central square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with red roofs, a fountain or monument in the middle, market stalls with umbrellas, and a hill in the background topped by a clock tower and fortification. German text at the top and on the inset identifies the scene as Graz and mentions the autumn fair.

A colorized aerial view of a European city with a river running through the center, lined by dense rows of red‑roofed buildings and several bridges. The vantage point is from an elevated hill covered with trees, looking across the old town toward flat countryside and low hills in the distance. Printed text at the top reads in German, identifying the scene as a view from the Schlossberg hill looking south over Graz.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic railway station complex with a tall clock tower and arched train hall. Horse‑drawn carriages and people stand in front on a cobbled square. On the right is a smaller building marked 'TELEGRAAF-TELEGRAPHE'. Printed caption text in French at the bottom identifies the scene as the station of Bruges.

Colorized postcard-style image showing a boy in traditional Alpine clothing holding a chalkboard with cursive German text, standing in front of a picturesque river city. Across the river are grand historic buildings and a bridge, with a steep, wooded hill rising behind them crowned by a fortified complex and a clock/bell tower, under a clear sky.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard view across a river toward a large hilltop castle complex with towers and steep roofs, above a row of townhouses along the waterfront. At the top left in red lettering it reads "Meissen. Kgl. Albrechtsburg." At the bottom left in smaller red text it credits a publisher and date. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.

Color postcard showing a solitary round stone tower with a conical red‑tile roof. Around the upper part of the tower there is a wooden overhanging gallery with windows. The tower stands beside a dirt road lined with leafless or early‑spring trees; a single person is walking in the distance. The scene is rural and calm under a clear blue sky. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

A vintage colored postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple green onion domes and ornate façades. The sky has a gradient from light tan near the horizon to blue at the top. In the upper left corner, German text reads "Libau. Kathedrale." The lower right corner has small text identifying the source. The style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside covered with the ruins and remaining buildings of the medieval town of Mystras. The structures climb up the slope beneath a fortress at the summit, with some trees and branches framing the scene. A white margin at the bottom contains printed captions in Greek and French and a publisher credit.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a historic European town street with a church tower in the foreground and a large castle-like complex rising behind the townhouses. In the lower part of the image there are gardens and trees along a wall, and a narrow street with a few people walking. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view framed by a stone archway, showing a cobbled square with horse‑drawn carts and people in early 20th‑century dress in front of a church wall with a large round clock. The church has a steep tiled roof and Gothic arched doorway. In the background are old town buildings with German signage. At the bottom margin is German caption text identifying the scene.

Colorized vintage view of a grand neo‑Renaissance town hall building dominating a central square. In front of it is a market scene with stalls, umbrellas, people walking, and a tram on tracks running through the cobbled square. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors. Printed text at the top identifies the location.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the façade and bell tower of a large church integrated into a row of urban buildings. People stand and walk in front of the entrance on a city street. The lower margin of the image bears printed caption text identifying the scene as the cathedral of Grenoble.

A black‑and‑white photograph of a large Renaissance-style castle or manor complex situated by a wide, curving river in open countryside. The ensemble includes tall rectangular towers with stepped gables and small cupolas, long residential wings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows, and farm or garden buildings in the foreground. Trees and formal gardens surround the buildings, with expansive agricultural fields and a tree line along the distant riverbank.

Color-tinted historic postcard showing a Byzantine church converted into a mosque, with a prominent dome and smaller domes, arched windows, and an added Ottoman minaret. A long, low tiled-roof building stands in front, with a person visible near the entrance. Printed captions in French and another script (Ottoman Turkish/Arabic) identify the site and indicate it is a souvenir from Salonika.

Vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a riverside cityscape with a bridge in the foreground and a church tower with an onion dome on the right. A hill with fortifications rises behind the town. Pedestrians walk along the embankment, and the river runs through the scene. On the bottom left is printed the caption "GRAZ von der Albrechtsbrücke." There is vertical publisher text on the left margin and handwritten cursive text on the right side, plus a circular postal cancellation mark overlapping the image.

A vintage, surreal black‑and‑white illustration of a distorted city square. Tall townhouses and a central clocktower lean and twist as if melting or swaying. A park with a fountain or geyser sends ribbon‑like streams of water into the air on the left. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll, dance, and gesture animatedly in the square. The word "GRAZ" is printed in bold letters in the upper right corner.

Black-and-white photograph of a historic hilltop complex overlooking a river, showing a large castle-like structure with multiple steep roofs and towers alongside a Gothic cathedral with tall spires. Below, a town with densely packed houses and trees spreads down to the waterfront. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage cityscape showing a busy European urban square with tram tracks and an electric streetcar in the foreground, pedestrians crossing the cobblestone streets, horse‑drawn carts, ornate multi‑story buildings with elaborate façades, and domed and towered structures in the background. The scene is labeled at the top with printed captions indicating the city and the specific square.

A sepia-toned vintage street scene titled "Riga Theaterboulevard." It shows a broad cobblestone boulevard with early electric trams, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians. Multi‑story classical buildings line both sides of the street, including a domed structure on the right. Trees and a large building appear in the background, suggesting a central urban avenue near a theater district.

Black‑and‑white/sepia street view showing a broad cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and in the distance church spires rise above the rooftops. At the top in red Gothic-style script is the caption 'Oschatz. Lutherstraße.'

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a hilltop with a tall cylindrical stone tower capped by a lantern-like lookout and pointed roof. The tower stands beside a small building partly hidden by dense trees. Winding footpaths and a narrow road climb the hillside, with a few telegraph poles and scattered houses lower down. In the distance are rolling hills or low mountains; the overall scene suggests a Central European hill town and an old watchtower or lookout tower.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a wooden church with a central tower topped by a cross and star finial. The building has a metal roof, tall arched windows, classical details on the tower cornice, and is partly obscured by trees and a small fenced area with a monument. The sky is mostly clear with scattered clouds. Printed captions on the image identify the church and the publisher/photographer.

Black-and-white aerial photograph depicting a dense waterfront city with many islands and inlets. At the top center, white text reads "Stockholm från aeroplan". At the bottom left are small publisher credits, and at the bottom right a round photographer's mark. The overall layout and typography strongly resemble an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

A black‑and‑white image shows a stone suspension bridge crossing a deep, wooded valley. Massive masonry pylons support the bridge, whose deck is carried by a lattice of vertical hangers and cables. Behind and above the bridge on a hill stands a large medieval stone castle complex with multiple towers and steep roofs. To the right of the castle is a baroque‑style church with a tall spire and cross, and several multi‑storey town buildings. Forested hills form the distant background.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated stone entrance gate with an arched doorway and heavy wooden doors, adorned with carved floral and martial motifs. Above the arch is a triangular pediment with sculpted cannons and a central coat of arms. Through the gate a small courtyard and part of another building façade are visible. At the bottom edge of the image there is printed caption text indicating the location.

A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view over a European city with dense tiled rooftops along a river with several bridges. In the left foreground there is a wooded hillside with a path and a pavilion-like structure. The bottom margin contains handwritten cursive text, and in printed red type the word "Graz" appears. The publisher credit "L. Strohschnedler, Graz" is printed in small red type at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large fortified complex on a hill above trees. The ensemble includes a long, steep‑roofed Gothic‑style building with many small gabled dormers and pointed arch windows, a tall church spire, a richly ornamented central roof with pinnacles, and curtain walls with battlements and a prominent square gate tower on the right. The foreground is a rough, cultivated field and dense trees; the sky is blank and overexposed. No printed captions or handwriting are visible on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city with many red-tiled roofs, tree‑lined streets and a few larger light‑colored buildings in the foreground. In the distance are green hills with scattered structures on the ridgelines. The caption in the upper left reads in German "Graz von der Roseggerwarte." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Black‑and‑white night view of a snowy European square with a large baroque fountain in the foreground. The multi‑tiered fountain is topped by a trident‑holding figure and surrounded by statues at its base, all covered with snow. Behind it stand several multi‑story historic buildings with shuttered windows and arcades at street level. Leafless tree branches frame the upper edge of the image, and shopfronts with illuminated signs are visible along the ground floor.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a painting or mural framed by a steep Gothic arch. The scene depicts several men in an alchemical laboratory with glass vessels, furnaces and equipment; one central figure sits wearily while others work around him. At the bottom, white printed German text identifies the scene and location.

Sepia-toned aerial photograph of a large mosque complex with an inner courtyard and a tall square minaret rising above surrounding low-rise traditional buildings. The view shows the dense urban fabric of the old city around the mosque. Captions in French, English, and Arabic are printed beneath the image, identifying it as a view of the great mosque of Marrakech taken from an airplane.

A black‑and‑white night view of an illuminated grand theater building beside a river, with its lights reflecting in the water. The building is prominently lit along the roofline and façade, and there are street lamps and another large building visible in the background. A white border surrounds the image and a caption is printed at the bottom left.

A multi-image postcard showing three landscape scenes. The upper-left image depicts a river with lush green vegetation in the foreground and a city skyline behind it, including a tall church tower and an arched bridge crossing the river. The upper-right image shows a wintery riverside meadow with patches of snow, leafless trees, and a herd of grazing horses. The bottom image captures a rural dike road at dusk with a cyclist riding along it, silhouettes of people cut-out figures near the roadside, and wide flat fields under a dramatic dark-blue sky. At the bottom right, partially visible text reads "NIJMEGEN EN OOIJPOLDER".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a waterfront area with trees, small pavilions and boats, and a few prominent towers in the distance. In the foreground there is a villa among trees; across the water appear exhibition buildings and flagpoles. The caption in white script at the bottom names the scene as being in Stockholm and related to an industrial arts exhibition.

A sepia-toned postcard showing an inner courtyard and arcaded corridor of a Renaissance-style building. On the left is a small domed tower and ornate facades with gabled roofs and windows; in the background are multi-story arcades with staircases. On the right, a long vaulted colonnade casts strong shadows along the walkway. The card has printed captions at the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned postcard with scalloped edges showing a view across a river toward a small town dominated by a church with a tall white tower and dark roof. In the foreground are trees and the riverbank with logs or wooden platforms in the water; behind the river are several houses and the prominent church. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in Latvian.

Black-and-white postcard view of a historic hill with densely packed old houses in the foreground and a large Gothic church with two tall spires dominating the skyline. A narrow lane and stone walls lead up toward the hill. At the bottom border of the image there is a caption in German.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow European street with tall, closely packed buildings on both sides. At the end of the street stands a large medieval-looking building with pointed-arch windows and a tall, slender tower or spire rising into a cloudy sky. Early 20th‑century automobiles and a few pedestrians are visible in the street, suggesting an interwar period scene.

Colorized panoramic view of a historic coastal city with medieval stone walls, towers, church spires and a harbor with ships in the background. A large round tower with a green spire rises on the left, and another tall church with a pointed spire stands to the right. Trees and park-like areas surround the old city walls. The image has printed captions in Latin and Cyrillic scripts at the top.

A black-and-white postcard view of a landscaped city park with a pond in the foreground. On the central lawn stands an ornate bandstand or pavilion surrounded by tall trees. In the distant background a tall church spire rises above the treeline. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene as a park in Bruges and credit the photo collection.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a view from a village street with small half-timbered houses in the foreground and the large Gothic-style Albrechtsburg castle complex rising above a wooded hillside in the background. German caption text is printed at the top, with a red handwritten number along the right margin.

A colorized panoramic view over a European city surrounded by green hills and fields. In the foreground are dense trees; in the middle distance a compact old town with multi‑story buildings and church spires stretches along a river. A prominent, steep, wooded hill with a fortification or structure on its top rises near the center of the image. At the top of the card, printed in red German text, it reads: "Graz vom Rainerkogel." The overall style and tinting suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large church with a tall central spire and two smaller flanking spires, each with clocks, rising above a small town. In front of the church are early 20th‑century detached houses and civic buildings on a gentle slope, with a field or reeds in the foreground. The style suggests a northern European townscape. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a suspension bridge with stone towers spanning a river, with a large medieval hilltop castle complex and a church rising above a wooded slope and small town buildings. The caption "Elbogen." appears in red at the lower left, and the publisher credit is printed in small red text along the bottom edge.

Night view of an illuminated Moorish-style building with multiple domes and minarets, reflected in a pond with colorful fountain jets in the foreground. A small arched bridge crosses the water. The scene is lit with many small lights outlining the architecture. Text is printed near the bottom edge.

Colorized vintage view over rooftops toward a busy harbor with sailing ships and steamers. In the foreground stands a church with a tall pointed steeple among dense urban buildings. Across the water is a tree‑covered promontory with large monumental buildings. The lower front margin contains printed French text identifying the scene, a series number, publisher information, and handwritten inscriptions and date.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large European city square showing a military parade. Hundreds of soldiers with rifles and bayonets march in formation across a broad cobbled plaza with tram tracks in the foreground. On the right stands a large, ornate civic building with columns, arches, and a steep roof, while on the left and in the background are multi‑story 19th‑century townhouses and commercial buildings lining the square.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a bustling scene in Piazza San Marco. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and feed pigeons in the square. On the right is the ornate facade and domes of the Basilica di San Marco, while on the left are the surrounding historic buildings and the clock tower. Large flags hang prominently in the foreground. Printed text in Italian appears at the top describing the view.

A color postcard showing a panoramic view of the city of Graz with a prominent green hill (the Schlossberg) rising above the historic center. Buildings with red-tiled roofs surround the hill, and a river with embankments and bridges runs through the city to the right. In the background are distant mountains and a broad valley. Printed text at the top left reads "Graz, vom Rainerkogel," and there is cursive handwriting across the upper right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone square framed by historic buildings. At the back stands a large Baroque-style building with an arched passageway. On the left is a tall spiraling Marian column. In the background, on a wooded hill, a clock tower rises prominently. The printed caption at the top left reads in red letters "Graz - Karmeliterplatz".

A vintage sepia-toned postcard view over a park and waterfront street with trams, cars, and boats. Large multi‑story buildings line the left side, while a harbor or river with several docked vessels appears on the right. The image is titled at the top in Swedish: "Stockholm – Utsikt från Operaterrassen" (Stockholm – View from the Opera Terrace). The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century cityscape.

Black‑and‑white view of a European riverside town with a large hilltop cathedral complex and adjacent castle-like buildings dominating the skyline. A black‑and‑white view along a wide stone walkway lined with white balustrades and potted plants leading toward a traditional Chinese gate with a tiled roof. An old, colorized postcard depicting a large medieval castle complex on a hill with high stone walls and a prominent round tower on the right. A monochrome postcard view of a medieval castle complex with a prominent cylindrical tower and surrounding walls, set against a mountainous backdrop. A sepia-toned postcard showing a large Neo-Gothic city hall building with a tall central clock tower and multiple pinnacles. Sepia street view postcard showing Strada Mitropoliei in Sibiu with pedestrians, shop signs and, in the distance, the twin-towered church. Vintage multiview lithographic postcard with vignettes of the city and surroundings: a panoramic view of Hermannstadt (Sibiu), the Großer Ring (Grand Square), the Natural History Museum, Michelsberg (Cisnădioara) hill/fort, and Salzburg (Ocna Sibiului). Black‑and‑white winter scene of an outdoor market in a large European square. Snow covers the roofs of Baroque townhouses. Tinted black‑and‑white view of a central square with the old town hall and clock tower, people walking, and an ornate streetlamp in the foreground. Handwritten message appears across the lower margin on the front; the reverse has an address area, a red postage stamp, and a long handwritten note.

Vintage sepia postcard showing the ornate interior of the Orthodox cathedral in Sibiu, with a large central dome, a massive chandelier, colonnades and galleries. A printed caption appears below the image. The reverse reads "România — Cartă Postală" and lists the Sibiu/Hermannstadt publisher.

Sepia panoramic view of a historic town with multiple church towers and domes, backed by snow‑covered mountains. Printed Hungarian captions on the front read "Nagyszeben" and "Látkép." Sepia photograph of a church with multiple spires and a clock tower behind a gated arch and tile‑roofed houses, set against wooded hills. Sepia real-photo postcard showing a large Gothic hall church dominating a historic townscape. Black-and-white postcard showing a grand Neo-Baroque/Beaux-Arts courthouse with a large central dome and symmetrical wings. A sign above the main entrance reads "PALATUL JUSTITIEI." Vintage monochrome street scene labeled in Hungarian and German, showing a bustling avenue with shops, pedestrians, and horse‑drawn carts. Colorized early-20th‑century view of a large Gothic church with a tall central clock tower and steep spire, flanked by multiple gabled roofs and lancet windows. The reverse bears multilingual captions identifying the place and a Romanian 'CARTĂ POSTALĂ' header.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the Black Church of Brașov in the foreground with the forested Tâmpa Mountain rising behind. The caption in Romanian is printed along the lower front margin. Monochrome vintage postcard showing the tall spires of Saint Nicholas Church rising above trees and old tile‑roofed houses, with wooded mountains in the background. Sepia photograph of a grand Baroque palace with a steep tiled roof and ornate façade on a city square. Ground-floor shops include a sign reading "C. MULLER" and "APOTHEKE." Sepia postcard view of a bustling central square with many horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. Vintage postcard with a monochrome panoramic view of a city nestled among hills. A hilltop citadel/fortified complex appears on the right, with dense rooftops and a large open square in the center. Colorized panoramic view of Brașov taken from a hillside lookout with a wooden fence in the foreground. Tinted vintage postcard showing the Baroque Brukenthal Palace on a square, with shops at street level and a sign reading APOTHEKE. Hand-tinted panoramic view of a town nestled among wooded hills. A large Gothic church with a tall tower dominates the center, and red-roofed houses spread across the valley. Printed title at top reads "Brașov Vedere generală — Látkép."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Gothic church with a clocktower dominating a square. Caption at the bottom reads 'Brașov - Brassó - Kronstadt'. The reverse side carries multilingual captions naming the Black Church and mentions Romania with address lines.

Antique divided‑back postcard with a monochrome drawing of a fortified town surrounded by walls and mountains. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a bustling market square with many horse‑drawn carriages and townspeople. Divided-image postcard. Collage-style, green-tinted postcard with three vignette views labeled in German: the city Concert House facade, St. Nicholas Church with a dome and spires, and the ornate Villa Schuller. Colorized vintage street view captioned "Hermannstadt – Harteneckgasse (Stadttheater)". Colorized panoramic postcard showing Brașov seen from the hill, with Parcul Ferdinand and its promenade fountain in the foreground. Caption appears in Romanian and Hungarian. The reverse has Romanian postage stamps and a Brașov postmark, addressed to Făgăraș.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a church with multiple spires and a clock tower at the foot of a mountain, with tiled-roof houses, a gate, and a couple of figures and a cart in the foreground. Vintage divided card showing a large open square with horse-drawn carts, a long public building and a distant church spire. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a huge crowd gathered around the equestrian Matthias Corvinus Monument in a central square, with the Gothic façade of St. Michael's Church to the left and a domed corner building to the right. Sepia photographic postcard showing a busy market in a small historic square surrounded by old houses; in the background rises a tall Gothic church tower with a clock. Colorized view of a central square in Brașov showing the historic city hall with a tall clock tower and red roofs. People and an early streetcar are visible on the square. Color view of a grand neo‑classical building with a pediment labeled "PALATUL CULTURAL," flanked by turrets and set beside a river with a bridge in the background. Color postcard showing the grand neoclassical Cultural Palace (Palatul Cultural) in Arad with its central tower, columned portico, and red-tiled wings, set beside a river and a small bridge amid greenery. The reverse has Romanian text and a printed Romanian stamp.

Color postcard showing a panoramic cityscape of Arad, Romania, with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings along a broad boulevard and a distinctive onion‑domed corner turret in the foreground. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing people on a seaside promenade looking toward the art‑nouveau casino building on a rocky pier by the Black Sea. Color postcard showing a formal park with long striped flowerbeds, stone balustrade and an urn planter in the foreground. In the background stands a historic civic building with a tall clock tower, consistent with Arad City Hall. Reverse side has Romanian postcard layout printed in blue.

Color postcard showing a large European square with tram tracks, cars and buses from the 1960s. Colorized historic street scene showing a grand neorenaissance theater building on a central square with an early electric tram and horse-drawn carriages. The image is framed by an orange border. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a hilltop fortress with towers and walls, identified by the caption as Castelul Bran. The foreground has trees and grazing sheep. The reverse has Romanian text, a purple airmail stamp, a Bucharest postmark, and address lines.

Color postcard showing the Cozia Monastery church with an arcaded porch and domed roof topped with crosses, set in a rose garden within a monastic courtyard against forested hills. The reverse has a multilingual caption identifying the site and a handwritten date, with a divided back for address.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ruins of a medieval stone fortress, including broken curtain walls and a tall fragmented tower, viewed through a rocky archway. The reverse is printed in Romanian with pricing and publisher details.

Color photo view over a green, hilly city framed by the Carpathian Mountains. Color postcard showing the fortified Moldovița Monastery: a painted exterior church within stone defensive walls and towers, on a grassy enclosure with hills and blue sky. The reverse side is a Romanian divided-back postcard with multilingual caption and publisher details.

A black and white postcard depicting a large building, possibly a manor or palace, situated on a hill and surrounded by dense forest. There is minimal writing on the postcard besides the word 'Oru' in the bottom left corner. A ruler for scale is visible on the left side of the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a cobblestone street and stone balustrade in the foreground. On the left stands an equestrian statue on a high pedestal. Black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated view of a large central square with a monumental column in the foreground and a domed church/mosque-like building with a tower in the center-right. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large European-style public square with formal gardens, benches and a central columnar monument surrounded by a fountain or plinth. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, symmetrical historic building with arched windows and a stone lower level, fronted by a garden or small park with people sitting and children playing. The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, printed location text, a Hungarian stamp, address lines, and a pencilled year "1965".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy town square with tram tracks, horse‑drawn carts, pedestrians and trees. Dominating the scene is a large domed church with a cross on top and an attached bell tower, along with a tall column or monument in the center of the square. The caption at the bottom names the place and the church.
