They look toward a lakeshore town in the distance. On the far shore, slightly left of center, rises a prominent church or monastery complex with a tall tower and dome above clustered buildings, surrounded by trees. The lake is calm and stretches across the foreground under a clear sky. There is a small handwritten mark or number in the upper left corner, but no printed caption is visible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing ancient stone ruins on a hillside, with a retaining wall to the left and scattered blocks and columns in the foreground and background. Mountains and a hazy valley are visible in the distance. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the site as the gymnasium of Delphi.

A colorized postcard view of sailboats racing on the water in the foreground. Two large sailing yachts dominate the left and right sides, with smaller boats and a red marker buoy between them. In the background stands a large seaside resort complex with red roofs and a prominent conical-roofed tower, identified as the Coronado Hotel. The sky is lightly clouded, and printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand historic opera house in a large open square. The building has richly ornamented Neo-Renaissance architecture with arched windows, heavy rusticated stone on the lower level, statues along the roofline, and a prominent portal crowned by a quadriga sculpture. Several people are walking or standing in the foreground and a few cars are visible in the distance. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Sepia-toned image of a grand historicist university building with ornate facades, arched ground floor, statues in niches, and a balustraded roofline with decorative railings. In the foreground, two men stand by a low wall and hedge along a street. At the bottom of the image, a caption identifies the location.

Vintage illustrated postcard framed by a stylized stone arch and crenellated wall. At the top are two circular crests: one with a silver lion on a green background, the other with red, black, and yellow fields, a rising sun, and plants, encircled by German text. Below, in the arch opening, is a monochrome view of a grand historicist building with a central dome and two corner towers, labeled 'Rathaus'. A square with market stalls, umbrellas, pedestrians, and a tram is in front of the building. At the bottom, the word 'GRAZ' is printed.

A black‑and‑white view through a large stone archway toward a historic European building complex. In the distance stands a church or chapel with a tall, slender spire and bulbous baroque-style roof. To its left are long steep‑roofed buildings with rows of Gothic-style windows and dormers. The foreground shows a rough stone wall and ground framed by the darker interior of the arch. At the very bottom, faint, mirrored handwriting appears on the negative.

A black‑and‑white night view of an illuminated grand historic building with a dome, behind an equestrian statue and several standing figures on a pedestal. The photograph is vertically oriented with a white border, and printed caption text appears at the bottom in Czech, identifying the scene as Prague's National Museum with the statue of St. Wenceslas.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a historic European city. On the left is the corner of a building with a bay window and iron balcony. A curved street runs downhill along a wall, leading toward a dense cluster of old rooftops. In the distance a large medieval church with a very tall, slender spire dominates the skyline. There is a printed caption at the bottom and a red postage stamp with a circular postmark at the upper right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Gothic-Renaissance castle complex on a hill above trees. One of the central towers is surrounded by extensive scaffolding, indicating construction or restoration work. The caption at the top left reads "Meissen.  Kgl. Albrechtsburg." and a small vertical imprint with publisher information appears on the right edge.

A colorized historic postcard view of a busy bridge over a river leading into a city square. The ornate iron bridge is crowded with pedestrians and an early electric tram. On the far side stand multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs, one bearing the sign 'CAFÉ MERAN'. There are lampposts and statues on the bridge and in the square, with trees and more buildings behind. A church tower with a clock rises in the background. The caption at the top reads 'Graz. Franz Karl-Brücke.'

Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square in front of 3–4 story historicist buildings with shops on the ground floor. A tall Marian or plague column with a statue stands on a stepped base surrounded by trees in the middle of the square. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand around, and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. A church with a tower and cross is in the background on the right. The architecture and signage suggest a Central European city.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard with three photographs of stone ruins on a hillside. The images show crumbling walls, arches, and fortifications surrounded by rocky terrain and sparse vegetation. On the right side, printed text in French reads "GRÈCE – Péloponèse – MISTRA" and each photo is captioned with a small number and the word "Mistra." A faint circular stamp and a printed URL watermark (elia.org.gr) also appear.

Vintage monochrome postcard view over dense trees toward a historic European townscape. Church towers and a large castle-like complex dominate the skyline on the right. Printed German text at the bottom identifies the view as Torgau from the south, with additional printed publisher information and red handwritten script across the lower margin.

Black-and-white vintage postcard view taken from under a large brick viaduct arch, looking onto a broad tree‑lined street with people walking. In the background rises a tall church tower above the surrounding buildings. Printed captions identify the scene as a viaduct in Nijmegen. Marginal text at the left names the editor/publisher from Amsterdam, and there is a handwritten-style signature at the bottom right.

A colorized historical postcard depicting a bustling market square surrounded by ornate Dutch-style buildings with stepped and ornate gables. A tall tower with a decorative spire rises behind the square. Numerous stalls, carts, and people fill the foreground, suggesting an open-air market day. The caption on the upper left reads 'NIJMEGEN. Markt'. Additional commercial signage is visible on one of the buildings.

Colorized postcard view of a neo‑Romanesque bastion with round towers and conical spires overlooking a city and the Danube. In the foreground are terraced gardens and a path; in the distance a church with twin towers is visible. Red printed text at the top left identifies the scene in Hungarian and German.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town. In the background stands a large historic castle-like building with a central tower and red roofs on a hill above the riverbank. Boats and small wooden barges lie along the shore and on the water in the foreground, with people sitting in one of the boats. Trees line the left side, and a bridge over the river is visible in the distance to the right. The sky is softly colored from yellow to blue. Red printed text at the top reads "Torgau." on the left and "Blick von der Elbe." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a church complex with a central baroque-style tower and arched entrance, flanked by tall trees and adjacent buildings. In the background to the left, three crosses stand on a hill, reinforcing the Calvary theme. There are a few people in period clothing in front of the gate. The lower margin of the image is printed with the caption identifying the church and the city, and the left margin lists the publisher. Handwritten notes appear along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a cobblestoned town square with a large stone church or chapel on the left, an adjacent civic-looking building with a small tower in the center, and lower townhouses on either side. In front of the church stands an elaborate Baroque Marian or plague column with statues around a tall obelisk-like shaft. People in late‑19th or early‑20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square; a horse‑drawn cart is at the left edge. German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

Sepia-toned vintage aerial view of a European town dominated by a tall central tower with a clock and spire, surrounded by dense rows of tiled-roof houses. In the background are industrial buildings with tall chimneys emitting smoke, and in the foreground a large classical-style multi-story building. The upper left corner bears the printed title 'Wurzen'.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an old stone and brick chapel with arched doorway and small leaded-glass window, topped by a steep, gray, pyramid-shaped roof. The structure appears medieval and somewhat ruinous. Surrounding trees are visible in the background. At the bottom, in decorative red script, is a caption identifying the site.

Colorized historic postcard view of a European city square with a tall brick clock tower (town hall) on the left and a row of gabled houses lining a broad street or market square with trees and a fountain. In the background stands a massive brick Gothic church with a large central tower and multiple slender spires. The caption at the bottom reads "Danzig. Langenmarkt und Rathhaus." and printing information appears vertically along the left edge. The number 365 is handwritten in red in the upper right corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a landscaped circular park in the foreground, benches, gas lamps, and several people sitting or standing. At the center stands a cylindrical monument or fountain with reliefs and a large statue of a figure on top, encircled by an iron fence. Behind it is a row of 3‑story gabled houses with shopfronts at street level, and in the background rises a church tower with a tall, narrow spire. Some German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, clipped shrubs and flowerbeds along paths, and a large historic complex with church-like buildings, towers and spires in the background. On the right is a manor-style building. Printed German captions appear at the bottom, and the number 382 is written in red at the top right.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a small European town. In the foreground are fenced fields and modest houses with pitched roofs. In the middle stands an ornate Orthodox-style church with onion domes. Behind it, on a wooded hill, are the ruins of a medieval castle with a round keep or tower. On the far right is a tall Lutheran-style church with a slender spire. The image is bordered like an old photographic postcard; no clear caption is visible within the picture area.

A monochrome vintage image showing a calm river curving through a rural landscape. On the left bank stand several two‑storey houses with steep roofs and simple facades, followed further back by more small buildings partly obscured by dense trees. A forested hill rises behind the settlement, and a flagpole with a faint flag can be seen near the central building complex. On the right side of the river a small boat with a few people is visible. The overall style and tonality suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard of a small European riverside town.

Monochrome vintage view of a fast‑flowing river or rapids in the foreground, with rocky banks and forested hills. On the right, a tall multi‑story building stands prominently on the cliffside. Further back on the ridge, a church with a slender spire rises above the trees. The overall print style and wide blank margin at the bottom suggest an early 20th‑century postcard. No printed caption or text is visible on the front.

A vintage, sepia-toned panoramic view of a city at the foot of a large mountain range. The urban landscape is dense with domed buildings and multiple slender minarets rising above traditional low houses, typical of an old Ottoman town. At the top left, red printed text reads "Salut de Brousse." A modern watermark with a website address appears across the lower right of the image.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing the striped Romanesque-Gothic façade and bell tower of the Cathedral of San Lorenzo, with its wide staircase in the foreground and surrounding city buildings. Text is printed beneath the image.

Black-and-white postcard-style image showing a country church with a tall spire, stone walls, arched windows, and a small graveyard with crosses in the foreground. Trees surround the church and there is a low stone wall and gate by a dirt road. Printed text at the top left reads "Forshem. Kyrkan."

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a rural lakeside village. A narrow bridge or causeway crosses the water toward a cluster of buildings dominated by a tall church with a steep spire on a small peninsula. Farm fields, scattered houses, tree‑lined roads, and wooded hills fill the background. At the lower left a small boat is on the water. In the bottom left corner the word "Nes." is printed; in the lower right is a small printer's or publisher's mark with numbers.

The image displays a vintage black-and-white photograph of a monument surrounded by trees and greenery. The monument is an obelisk covered in ivy, with reliefs and the word 'JAHN' prominently carved on its upper part. The card has printed text at the top that reads 'GRAZ-JAHNDENKMAL-3038-' indicating the site and possibly a series or catalogue number.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over a river with a paddle steamer named "GERMANIA" in the foreground. On the opposite bank stands a hill crowned by a large castle complex and a Gothic cathedral with tall twin towers. Below are town buildings and trees. German captions at the top read "Meißen a. d. Elbe" on the left and "Albrechtsburg u. Dom" on the right.

Colored panoramic view over a river valley toward a city dominated by a steep, wooded hill with buildings on its top. The foreground is framed by tree branches, and farmland and scattered houses stretch along the river leading into the dense urban area. The sky is softly tinted and there is printed red text in the upper left corner.

Colorized vintage postcard depicting a brick ruin set among tall trees and greenery. The structure is a large, semicircular apse-like wall with arched openings and a few standing columns, clearly the remnant of a larger historic building. At the bottom margin, printed red text identifies the scene.

Old black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside town with a forested bank in the foreground on the right and water stretching across the image. On the opposite bank stands a compact townscape dominated by a large church with a tall spire. At the top of the postcard three versions of the town name are printed in Latin and Cyrillic scripts.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a European town square with a large ornate fountain in the center and a historic building behind it. The fountain has multiple statues, including a standing figure elevated on a column and several figures around the basin, with curved water spouts or arches. The adjoining building has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, an arcaded ground floor with stone columns, and a long wooden balcony on the upper floor. A man is visible in the foreground pulling a two-wheeled handcart across the square. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Vintage sepia postcard with two inset black‑and‑white views: on the left a large ornate fountain with multiple water jets and statuary in a landscaped park, captioned "Franz Josef-Brunnen." On the right, an image of a tall rectangular tower rising above trees. At the top right is printed text "Gruss aus Graz." The left margin carries the printer's credit "Stengel & Co., Dresden, 4725." There is cursive handwritten text and a date on the right side and along the bottom.

A vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of Athens with the Acropolis and the Parthenon on the hill in the background. In the foreground is a broad boulevard with formal gardens and buildings on either side, labeled as Boulevard Olga. Ancient ruins, likely the Temple of Olympian Zeus, appear to the left. The postcard includes captions in Greek and French and a printed web address/logo at the bottom.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a landscaped square or park with walking paths, benches, and trees, dominated by a large central monument with a statue on top. In the background are mountains and several prominent buildings including a tower. The caption at the bottom identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white image showing a cobblestone approach to a large arched gate in a worn Baroque or Renaissance‑style building. Above the rusticated stone arch is an elaborate coat of arms flanked by two lions and crowned with multiple coronets and plumes. Paint is peeling from the facade, revealing age and damage. A uniformed guard with a pickelhaube‑style spiked helmet stands in front of the archway with a dog at his side; other figures are visible in the shaded passage beyond. Iron railings line both sides of the approach.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large Art Deco department store building dominating a city square. The building has tall vertical lines, two tower-like structures, and the word "KARSTADT" on the main tower. Flags line the roof, and shops with awnings front the street. A subway entrance marked with a large "U" is visible in the square. Printed caption text along the bottom identifies the location as Berlin-Neukölln and the Hermannplatz square with the Karstadt department store.

A black-and-white, vintage view of an ornate suspension bridge crossing a wide river in a European city. The bridge has highly decorated steel towers with finials and elaborate latticework, and massive stone pylons with stairways and sculptures at the riverbank. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and a few carriages or early vehicles move along the bridge and the adjoining promenade. On the far bank stand multi‑story European buildings, and to the left a church with twin spires rises above the riverfront. The image corners are damaged and irregular, reinforcing the feel of an old postcard or photograph. No legible printed caption is visible.

A colorized vintage panoramic view of a spa town surrounded by forested hills. In the foreground stands a large octagonal white building with red decorative bands and many arched windows, next to other grand spa or hotel buildings and a tall red chimney. Behind it stretches a dense cluster of ornate 19th‑century houses, hotels, and pavilions embedded in greenery. The single printed caption in the sky area at upper left reads "Marienbad." The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century European postcard.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a waterfront scene dominated by a large round stone tower with crenellations at the top. Small buildings line the shore and a boat lies in the foreground on calm water. Greek and French captions are printed in the upper left, and a modern website watermark appears at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an inner courtyard surrounded by Renaissance-style arcaded galleries with multiple arched loggias and a steep tiled roof with dormer windows. A small domed staircase tower stands in the middle of one side, and an ornate well or fountain is visible in the courtyard. At the lower left margin of the image, a caption in cursive script reads "Graz Landhaushof."

Black-and-white postcard showing a calm river or reservoir bordered by forested hills. In the foreground are trees and the shoreline; on the water are small boats and a sailboat. In the distance, partly obscured by trees, stands a hilltop castle. German text is printed along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a street view of Sibiu with pedestrians and a bicyclist framed by an arch. Prominent is a Baroque church with an onion‑dome clock tower on the main square; adjacent historic buildings line the square. The reverse has Romanian text, two purple 20‑bani R.P. ROMÎNĂ stamps, and the printed heading REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ.

Multiview color postcard labeled SIBIU, showing the city's coat of arms and several views of Sibiu's historic center: the ornate cast‑iron Bridge of Lies over a curved brick rampart, the tall spire and clock of the Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral rising above red‑tiled roofs, a narrow old street with a hanging barrel sign, and a grand boulevard with an early‑20th‑century building and parked cars. The reverse has Romanian text, stamps, and a handwritten message dated 1982.

Color view of medieval brick fortifications with a deep outer wall and a round defensive tower with a red tiled conical roof along a tree‑lined lane. Reverse shows blue‑ink handwriting, a Romanian 40 Bani stamp (oil derrick), Bucharest postmarks dated 1971, and the credit line indicating Sibiu.

Color postcard showing Sibiu's medieval brick city walls with an arched gate at the base and a round defensive tower with a steep red-tile roof. Leafless trees line a promenade atop/behind the wall; historic houses stand inside the fortifications. A modern lamppost is visible. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 Bani "Posta Romana" stamp, and Sibiu postmarks.

Color photo view of a historic central square with formal gardens, people walking, 1960s–70s cars and buses, and baroque and medieval buildings. On the right stands a baroque church with an onion-dome tower; a tall Gothic spire rises behind the rooftops. The reverse has Romanian stamps and a Sibiu postmark.

Color postcard showing Sibiu's historic brick Stairway Passage with the Evangelical Lutheran Cathedral of St. Mary rising above it, featuring a tall spire with four corner turrets and clock faces. People walk through the vaulted passage. The reverse has Romanian handwriting dated 13 June 1983, a blue Romanian postage stamp marked "ARTA POPULARĂ / POSTA ROMÂNĂ" and a Bucharest transit postmark. Printed caption identifies the scene as the Stairway Passage in Sibiu; publisher Editura Meridiane and price are shown.

Color postcard showing a winter evening view of Sibiu's medieval fortifications: a massive octagonal stone tower with machicolations and a covered wooden walkway along the brick wall, flanked by a snowy street with car light trails and historic houses. The reverse has the Poșta Română logo, address lines, and a multilingual caption identifying the towers of Sibiu's medieval fortification, plus printer and photographer credits.

Color postcard showing a medieval European old town with red-tile roofs and a prominent Gothic church featuring a tall central spire flanked by four smaller spires and clock faces. A curved red-brick ramparts-like walkway and cobblestone street with a small orange car are in the foreground. Clear blue sky; people strolling on the ramp. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and Bucharest postmark; printed caption indicates Sibiu.

Color postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance castle with multiple pointed towers and timbered galleries on a forested hillside in the mountains. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40 bani stamp, and a circular postmark from Sinaia dated 1972. Printed caption at bottom left reads "SINAIA — Muzeul Peles."

Multiview color postcard of Bucharest showing four sights: the Arcul de Triumf on a broad boulevard with cars and a trolleybus; Mogoșoaia Palace beside a lake with people rowing; the façade and gardens of the Bucharest National Opera; and the Carol Park Mausoleum with an arched bridge and boats on the lake. In the center is the socialist-era coat of arms with the caption "BUCURESTI." The reverse has Romanian postal layout, a "Posta Romana" 40 bani stamp with București cancellations, printed captions, and a handwritten message addressed to Oțelu Roșu, Caraș-Severin.

Color postcard view across a lakeside path in a leafy park, with two people walking in the foreground and a large Stalinist high‑rise crowned by a tall spire across the water. A small boat is on the lake; a lamp post and poplars line the path. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Bucharest postmark, a Romanian stamp, and printed caption indicating Bucharest/Parcul Herăstrău.

A vintage Romanian postcard. The front shows a black‑and‑white photograph of Peleș Castle with tall spires, labeled "SINAIA - Muzeul Peleș." The reverse has Romanian printed headings, a handwritten message, and an airmail stamp (40 BANI, airplane) canceled in 1962, addressed to Satu Mare.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent dining room with a very long polished table, rows of high‑back chairs, richly carved wood paneling and ceiling, and a large chandelier. The reverse has a Romanian 40‑bani stamp, Bucharest postmark, a multilingual caption identifying the room, and a handwritten Romanian address and message.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent historic dining room with a very long wooden table flanked by high‑backed chairs, crystal centerpieces, ornate carved paneling, a richly coffered ceiling, and large chandeliers. The reverse identifies it as the dining room of the Peleș Museum (Peleș Castle) in Sinaia, Romania.

Color postcard showing a grand Neo‑Renaissance castle with multiple spires and timbered sections on a wooded hillside, with mountains in the background. The reverse side is in Romanian, bearing a preprinted Posta Romana stamp and the caption identifying the site as the Peles Museum in Sinaia.
Color postcard showing Peleș Castle in winter, with snow-covered slopes and the Carpathian Mountains behind. The reverse has Romanian address fields and publisher details, priced in lei.

Color postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance castle with tall spires set against snowy alpine scenery and evergreen forests. The reverse has printed addressing fields in Romanian and a caption identifying the site as Peleș Castle in Sinaia, with multilingual titles.

Color souvenir postcard with a golden border showing the Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle surrounded by autumn foliage with the Bucegi Mountains and blue sky in the background. The front caption reads "Castelul Peles." The reverse is a modern divided back titled "SOUVENIR COLLECTION," crediting AGNUS Design s.r.l., and identifies the scene as "SINAIA – Castelul Peleș – The Peles Castle," with a photo credit to Ion Serban (2002) and a code "SN 08 PH."

Multi-view color postcard showing exterior and richly decorated interior rooms of Peleș Castle with a vertical yellow strip reading MUZEUL PELEȘ. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, address to București, Romanian postage and cancellations from Sinaia and București.

Color multi-view postcard showing Peleș Castle in Sinaia with towers, façades, statues and terrace gardens. The word "PELES" appears vertically on the left and "Muzeul" at top. The back has Romanian postal layout with an imprinted 40 bani stamp bearing the socialist coat of arms, price, and address lines.

Color postcard showing Peleș Castle with tall spires and timbered facades set against the Carpathian Mountains, framed by autumn trees. The reverse has Romanian text, a 40‑bani airmail stamp and cancellations, with address lines filled in blue ink.

Color view of a modernist high‑rise hotel and a large arched-window theater under a blue sky, with a few cars and pedestrians in front. The hotel bears the rooftop sign "HOTEL BUCURESTI." These are the InterContinental Bucharest hotel beside the National Theatre in central Bucharest.

Color postcard showing the richly carved wooden Dining Room of Peleș Castle, with a long table set with candelabra, high-backed chairs on both sides, elaborate coffered ceiling and chandeliers. The reverse reads "CARTE POȘTALĂ," includes multilingual captions identifying the scene as the Dining Room of the Peleș Museum in Sinaia, and credits the publisher Editura Meridiane and photographer Al. Comănescu with a printed price.

Color postcard showing the exterior of the painted Voroneț church with vivid frescoes on the walls, steep wooden roof and a tall bell tower with a cross, set among trees and hills under a blue sky. The reverse side has multilingual caption and Romanian postcard layout.

Two-sided postcard. Front: a color photograph of the famous exterior fresco 'The Last Judgment' covering the west façade of Voroneț Monastery's church, with rows of saints, angels and Paradise scenes painted on the blue background under the eaves. Back: Romanian layout with "CARTE POȘTALĂ," address lines, a stamp box, a printed multilingual caption identifying Voroneț Church and the subject of the fresco, and a blue circular price mark of 2 lei.

Color postcard showing a steep brick passage with arches and pedestrians, known as the Stairs Passage, with the tall spire and four corner turrets of a clock‑faced Lutheran cathedral rising above tiled-roof houses under a bright blue sky. The reverse has printed publisher and location notes in multiple languages.

Color postcard showing the Church of Cozia Monastery with striped brick-and-stone walls, a domed roof with a cross, gardens in the foreground and forested mountains behind. The reverse has a Romanian 40 BANI POSTA ROMANA stamp canceled in Călimănești, Vâlcea, printed caption about the Cozia Monastery in multiple languages, publisher details, and a handwritten greeting and Bucharest address.

Color view of Regensburg on the Danube: the Stone Bridge with its bridge tower in the foreground and the twin spires of Regensburg Cathedral rising behind. The reverse shows German postage (50 Deutsche Bundespost) with a cancel promoting blood donation and a printed caption identifying the view. Addressed in blue ink to Bucharest, Romania.

Vintage Romanian postcard showing the richly carved wood dining room of Peleș Castle (Peleș Museum) in Sinaia, with a long banquet table and chandeliers. The reverse has Romanian handwriting in blue ink, a 40 B POSTA ROMANA stamp (DENSUS), 1976 postmarks, and a multilingual printed caption.

Vintage color postcard showing the white wooden double-leaf drawbridge Magere Brug spanning the Amstel River with traditional Amsterdam canal houses in the background under a blue sky. The reverse has printed text at top-left, dotted address lines on the right, a stamp box marked "ST 1/42," and a vertical divider ending with a windmill icon.

A multiview tourist postcard showing mountain resorts, hotels, alpine scenery and the famous Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle in the center image. The title on the front reads "VALEA PRAHOVEI" in red, indicating the Prahova Valley in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a red POSTA ROMANA 55 BANI stamp, and printed multilingual captions.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large spa complex with mansard roofs, dormer windows, and a central portico with columns, set against forested hills. People stroll along a landscaped promenade and a canal/terrace in front. The reverse has Romanian printed text identifying the place as Slănic Moldova – Băile Centrale and a handwritten message with an address.

Vintage sepia postcard showing the ornate interior of the Florentine Hall at Peleș Castle: large crystal chandeliers, carved wooden furniture, an elaborate marble fireplace, paneled walls with paintings, and a coffered ceiling with an allegorical painting. The reverse has address lines, a stamp box, and Romanian captions.

Old sepia postcard showing a blue-toned photograph of a castle nestled among pine-covered mountains, viewed from a road with a railing. The back carries Romanian stamps and a Bucharest postmark dated 23 Aug 1929, plus a handwritten message and address. Printed title reads "Castelul Peleș."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard. Front shows Peleș Castle surrounded by forested hills in Sinaia, with a person working in the foreground. Red captions read "Castelul Peleș" and "Sinaia." The reverse has printed heading "UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE – ROMÂNIA – CARTA POSTALA" with dotted address lines.

Colorized view of a hilltop fortress with multiple red-roofed towers above a village and forested slopes at dusk. People in traditional clothing walk near a wooden bridge in the foreground. Captions read "Bran" and "Castelul Regal." The reverse is a Romanian divided back with address lines, the heading "România," postal-rate note, publisher credit from Bran, and the year 1933.

Vintage colorized street scene of a grand hotel façade along a broad, tree‑lined boulevard at dusk. Caption reads "Bucuresti. Palace Hotel. - Bulevard Elisabeta." The reverse shows Romanian handwriting, postal cancels from Bucuresti, two red 1 LEU Romania stamps, and an address to Bulgaria.

Color postcard showing a large modernist domed exhibition hall with glass walls, broad plaza, flower beds, and crowds. Tall light poles and vertical flags (including the Romanian tricolor) frame the scene. The back has a printed multilingual caption and the Romanian National Tourism Office imprint.

Color postcard showing a grand multi‑story spa hotel with a central tower (Hotel Cerna) in a mountainous, forested setting. Several 1960s cars are parked on a cobbled square. To the right stands a small striped Orthodox church with a dome. People are gathered on the hotel steps. The reverse has Romanian text, address lines, stamps and postmarks.

Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard labeled "Iași," showing several landmarks of Iași: the Palace of Culture, the façade of the National Theatre, the Golia Monastery bell tower, a statue in a city square with a tram, and a Moldavian‑style Orthodox church. The reverse side has Romanian People's Republic printing and address lines.

Sepia/black‑and‑white postcard view of Bucharest's Palace Square showing the newly built domed Sala Palatului surrounded by landscaped roundabouts, modernist apartment blocks and a few pedestrians and cars. A printed caption appears at the top right. The reverse bears standard postcard layout and pricing.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic diagonal close‑up of the modular rhomboid forms of Constantin Brâncuși's Endless Column reaching into the sky. The reverse reads "CARTE POȘTALĂ," lists a price and publisher, and identifies the subject in multiple languages as Brâncuși's Infinite Column in Târgu Jiu.

Black-and-white postcard showing a central square with trees and historic houses, dominated by a tall Gothic church tower with a clock and a steep patterned spire. The reverse has Romanian layout text, a stamp box with the number 148, and printing credit.

Black-and-white postcard showing extensive seaside archaeological ruins with low stone walls and foundations; the reverse lists the site as the Histria ruins under the Museum of Archaeology in Constanța, in multiple languages.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ruins of a medieval stone fortress, viewed through a rocky archway. Crumbled towers and arched doorways are visible with a dirt path in the foreground. The reverse is printed in Romanian, indicating the image is of the ruins of Neamț Citadel and listing the publisher and price.

Night view of a domed neoclassical concert hall with Corinthian portico, illuminated and photographed from a square with several 1960s–70s cars parked in front. The inscription on the entablature reads ATENEUL ROMAN. The reverse shows the Romanian postal template with POSTA ROMANA and fields for address.

Color postcard showing a broad intersection along Strada Horea in Cluj, lined with ornate historic buildings with tall spires. Buses and pedestrians fill the streets. The reverse has Romanian text including 'CARTE POȘTALĂ', publisher Editura Meridiane, price in lei, and photographer credit Al. Mendrea.

Color postcard showing a Secession/Art Nouveau building with steep gables and shingled spires behind a blue fence, photographed on a clear day. The reverse has Romanian text, publisher details, a price in lei and a stamp box.

Color postcard showing a brick Orthodox church with three cross-topped domes and arcaded windows, set behind a low stone wall and flowerbeds. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian 40B postage stamp (Posta Romana) and a Pitești postmark. The printed caption identifies the church as St. George's Church in Pitești.

Multi‑view color postcard showing Târgu Mureș, Romania: a tall modernist high‑rise labeled Hotel Grand; a modern plaza identified as Theatre Square with low white buildings and flowerbeds; an aerial view of the central area with the clock‑towered Administrative Palace and the Culture Palace near Roses Square; and a broad boulevard with apartment blocks and a statue. The reverse has Romanian stamps and postmarks and handwritten Romanian message dated 1982, addressed to Bucharest.

Color postcard showing the ornate facade, tower and terrace statues of Peleș Castle with a flower garden in Sinaia, Romania. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Bucharest postmark, and a Romanian airmail stamp featuring cosmonaut A. Nicolaev.

Vintage Romanian postcard showing the ornate interior of Sala Unirii (Union Hall) in the Alba Iulia citadel: a long arched hall with chandeliers, stucco decorations, marble columns and display tables; flags are visible along the right wall. The reverse has Romanian printed captioning, a brown 55 B Posta Romana stamp, a Zlatna (Alba) postmark, and a handwritten message addressed to Bucharest.

Color postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with a circular dome and a colonnaded portico on a corner square with tram tracks, a red tram, an obelisk-like monument, pedestrians, and mid‑century cars. The back has Romanian text, stamp, and postmarks.

Color view of a grand Beaux‑Arts building with corner domes at a large urban intersection, busy with pedestrians, crosswalks, trolleybus wires and several 1960s–70s cars. This is the University of Bucharest building at University Square in central Bucharest.

Color postcard showing a TAROM jet airliner on the apron with its tail bearing the Romanian flag and TAROM logo. In the background are the terminal building with the sign "BUCUREȘTI–OTOPENI" and the control tower of Bucharest's Otopeni Airport.

Color postcard showing tourists walking among the stone walls and standing columns of an ancient seaside ruin under a bright blue sky. The reverse has Romanian publisher information, a multilingual caption identifying the site, two POSTA ROMANA 20 BANI stamps, a handwritten message and an address.

Color postcard showing a broad boulevard and landscaped square in Cluj, with the Orthodox Metropolitan Cathedral on the left, the National Theatre/Opera building with rooftop statues on the right, and 1960s cars on the street. The reverse is in Romanian, with a 40 Bani Poșta Română stamp and a handwritten message dated 18.07.1969. The card is printed with "CLUJ — Piața Victoriei."

Color postcard showing the Orthodox Metropolitan Cathedral in Timișoara, with its patterned green-tiled roofs and tall central spire, seen from a tree-lined boulevard with flower beds and overhead tram wires. The reverse side has a Romanian 40 bani stamp, Timișoara postmarks, and a handwritten Romanian message, addressed to Bucharest.

Color postcard showing an oblique aerial view of a fortified monastery complex in a green valley with forested hills. The complex has high stone walls with corner towers and a central painted church—this is the Sucevița Monastery. The reverse side has Romanian address lines and a printed caption identifying the site.
Color postcard showing an ornate carved wooden spiral staircase inside a lavish historic interior. The reverse side is laid out for mailing and printed in Romanian.

A multiview color postcard showing the Iron Gates hydroelectric and navigation complex on the Danube: dam, spillways, locks for ships, road across the dam, and electrical substations with pylons. The front has Romanian captions in yellow panels. The reverse is a Romanian postal back with printed stamp and price.

Color postcard showing the church within Sucevița Monastery, a Moldavian painted monastery with steep shingled roofs and defensive walls, set against a forested hillside. The reverse bears Romanian text naming the site and publisher.

Color postcard showing the painted exterior walls and shingled roof/tower of the Voroneț Monastery church in Bucovina. Back side has Romanian printed layout "CARTE POSTALĂ," a Romanian 40 bani stamp, and cancellation marks from Suceava and București.

Museum postcard from Romania reproducing an old engraving: a view of Bucharest with a hilltop princely palace complex and church towers above the Dâmbovița River, a wooden bridge with carts and people, watermills on the bank, and figures in period dress in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian address fields and credits the Art Museum of the Socialist Republic of Romania; the image is titled "Palace at Bucharest," engraved by William Watts after Luigi Mayer.

Sepia postcard view of a mountain resort town: a grand arcaded building set in a wooded park with the Carpathian mountains behind. The reverse bears Romanian text including the state name of the era and a caption indicating Sinaia and a park view.

Sepia postcard showing a fountain with the bronze Statue of Hercules in a spa-town square, with three children standing at the basin. Grand 19th‑century buildings and a church steeple rise behind, with wooded hills in the background. The reverse is printed with multilingual captions identifying the scene and marked "Carte poștală" and "EDITURA DE STAT."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical academic building set behind a formal garden. Another colonnaded building appears at the right edge. The reverse is printed in Romanian and Russian and identifies the subject as the medical–pharmaceutical institute in Timișoara; it bears the heading 'CARTE POȘTALĂ'.

Multi-view color postcard showing the medieval town and citadel of Sighișoara: panoramic hillsides with red-roofed houses, several fortified towers and walls, cobbled streets and a square seen through an arch. The iconic Clock Tower dominates multiple views. A red banner with yellow letters reads "SIGHIȘOARA" on the front; the back has Romanian postcard layout and publisher details.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing landmarks of Târgu Mureș. The main image depicts the Secession‑style Culture Palace facing a landscaped square; other panels show an elevated city view with the large dome of the Orthodox Cathedral, a central street scene with period vehicles and ornate lampposts, and a panoramic landscape outside the city. The front title reads "Tg. MUREȘ." The back has Romanian text, a 1959 Târgu Mureș postmark, and handwritten greetings and an address.

Night view of an airport apron with a TAROM aircraft tail marked YR-IMC in the foreground and the round terminal building with a control tower behind it. A neon sign reading "Bucuresti" glows on the terminal. The reverse bears the TAROM logo and a caption identifying the scene.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large Gothic church with a very steep tiled roof and buttresses, seen above the rooftops of a historic town surrounded by forested mountains. On the reverse there is printed Romanian captioning identifying the site, a 40 bani fish-themed Romanian stamp, circular postmarks, and a short handwritten message and address in blue ink.

Black‑and‑white seaside view showing people walking on a promenade with a balustrade. At the end of the pier stands an ornate Art Nouveau building on the Black Sea shore — the famous casino. Reverse side has Romanian printed headings, a purple Romanian stamp commemorating "zece ani dela eliberare 1944–1954," a Constanța postmark, and a handwritten message/address in Romanian.

Color view of a hilltop medieval fortress with red-roofed towers and thick stone walls, seen from a curving road with houses below. The reverse side is a printed Romanian postcard template with a pre-printed stamp and address fields.

A commemorative postcard featuring a historic black‑and‑white street scene overlaid with small color photos of landmarks along Calea Victoriei in Bucharest. The caption celebrates 300 years of the street formerly called Podul Mogoșoaiei. Landmarks pictured include the Romanian Athenaeum, the CEC Palace, the former Royal Palace/National Museum of Art, and Kretzulescu Church.

Color postcard showing a mountain resort town with villas and red-roofed houses at the base of steep, rocky peaks and dense conifer forest. Several white apartment blocks stand out in the foreground. The scene matches the Bucegi Mountains rising above Bușteni under a bright blue sky.

Color postcard showing the ornate Neo‑Renaissance Peleș Castle with tall spires, timbered and stone facades, ivy on the walls, terraces and statues, formal gardens with visitors, and forested mountains in the background. The reverse has Romanian layout text "CARTE POȘTALĂ," publisher credit Editura Meridiane, multilingual captions naming the castle, a price in lei, and photo credit.

Color photograph of a striped brick-and-stone Orthodox church with a central dome and crosses on top, seen in a courtyard with paths, lawn, a bench, and several people walking under a bright blue sky. The back has multilingual captioning and publisher/price details.

Multiview color postcard showing landmarks of Brașov, Romania: at left the Saint Nicholas Church; top-right the Council House on Piața Sfatului; bottom-right the Black Church with the wooded mountain backdrop. The city coat of arms appears on the front. The back has Romanian postal layout, a Poșta Română 40 bani stamp, a circular postmark reading PREDEAL with a 1974 date, and a bilingual caption listing the three sights.

Color postcard showing a modernist high‑rise hotel with a crenelated roofline and a grid of small square windows. The white concrete building stands by a landscaped boulevard under a bright blue sky. The back identifies it as the Continental Hotel in Timișoara, Romania.

Color postcard showing a large medieval hilltop fortress with red-tiled roofs and multiple towers rising above dense evergreen forest, viewed through pine branches against a bright blue sky. The reverse side has multilingual captions identifying the site, a vertical imprint of the Romanian National Tourism Office, a publisher mark, and a postage stamp (40 BANI) with a raspberry illustration.

Color postcard showing a large Belle Époque grand hotel with mansard roofs and balconies, set in landscaped gardens with mountains in the background. The reverse bears a Romanian 40 bani stamp marked POSTA ROMANA, a handwritten Romanian message and address, and a printed caption identifying the scene.

A richly gilded Orthodox iconostasis with intricate Baroque woodcarving, a central set of Royal Doors with a cross, and flanking painted icons (including the Virgin and Child and a bishop saint). Numerous small oval saint medallions run along the upper frieze; the color palette is heavy in gold with green panels.

Color postcard showing a large, old linden tree in a city park in early spring. Behind it stands an obelisk flanked by lion sculptures, and a pavilion-like building; a child with a red-and-white hat holds yellow flowers in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian publisher and caption text identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand eclectic/neo‑Romanian palace with a tall clock tower and steep roofs, fronting a busy square with pedestrians and modern street lamps. Reverse side bears Romanian handwriting, a purple 50 Bani stamp of R.P. ROMINA, and postal cancellations.

Sepia-toned street view showing a tree-lined avenue leading toward an arched gateway in a historic building. Horse-drawn carts and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing move along the cobbled street. Multi-story buildings with arcaded windows and colonnades frame the scene. The top of the card is printed with the caption "Graz. Partie beim Burgtor".

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone paving. A large Baroque‑style church with a tall onion‑domed tower dominates the background. Around the square stand three‑ and four‑storey buildings with steep tiled roofs and shopfronts at street level. Painted signs in German are visible on the facades. Horse‑drawn carts and several pedestrians in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing move across the square. The overall composition and border suggest an old photographic postcard.

Black‑and‑white view over a small European town in a hilly landscape. Dominating the right side is a large multi‑winged castle or palace on a rise, with towers and steep tiled roofs. In the middle distance stands a tall church with a slender spire and a large adjoining nave. At the left is a multi‑storey industrial building with many identical windows and a tall smokestack. The foreground shows grassy fields and the roofs of smaller houses; one roof in the lower right bears faint painted lettering. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century picture postcard of a historic town with a castle and church.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing the overgrown stone ruins of a large building, likely a castle, with crumbling walls, arched openings and a tower-like section. Trees and vegetation grow around the structure. The lower margin contains printed red text indicating the location and publisher, along with handwritten cursive text in a Scandinavian language.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a wooded valley with scattered villas and farmhouses along a winding road. In the foreground stands an ornate late‑19th/early‑20th‑century villa with a turret and steep roof, surrounded by a garden and fence. Further back, more detached houses lie among trees, with forested hills and terraced fields rising in the background. The style evokes a Central European spa or resort village in a mountainous region. Along the bottom border there are some hand‑written or printed alphanumeric marks, but no clear title or caption.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a grand historic city square. On the left stands an ornate neo-Renaissance city hall with domes and towers. In front of it is a busy market scene with many stalls and umbrellas, people walking, and a central monument with steps. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey traditional European buildings with shopfronts. Printed captions at the top identify the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a stepped pyramid in a desert landscape, with two riders on camels or donkeys in the foreground. The structure is a large stone step pyramid rising in several tiers. At the lower right is a website watermark and handwritten-style caption; a small number appears in the lower left corner.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a riverside town with a prominent hilltop complex consisting of a large Gothic-style cathedral with tall spires and an attached castle-like palace and tower. Below the hill are rows of old town houses along the riverbank, with a paddle steamer or riverboat on the water in the foreground. Printed German captions identify the location.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a castle complex with two prominent square towers featuring ornate gabled tops and small lantern structures. The castle buildings with steep tiled roofs rise behind a tree-filled park and a decorative wall, with a wooden fence in the foreground. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as a castle in Strehla on the Elbe River.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing the richly decorated Renaissance façade of a large castle courtyard building with numerous statues in niches, surrounded by garden greenery. The caption at the top left identifies the site as part of Heidelberg Castle, specifically the Otto-Heinrich wing (Otto Heinrichsbau).

A sepia-toned historical photograph showing an enormous crowd gathered in a city square or open area for a demonstration or rally. Many people wear winter coats and hats and hold flags and banners. In the background stands a cityscape with a prominent church or town-hall–like spire. Purple Cyrillic text printed at the top left reads a place name and the date 10 March 1917.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large church with tall round and pointed towers and Gothic-style arched windows. The building fills most of the frame, viewed from an angle, with a small garden or grassy area in the foreground. Printed captions in German at the top read "Freiberg i. Sa." and "St. Petrikirche." A vertical imprint along the left edge notes the publisher and the year 1905.

Vintage sepia multi‑view postcard with a patterned border. It shows three photographs: at the top, a large three‑storey school building behind a fence labeled in Bulgarian as a girls' gymnasium; in the middle, a park or open field with trees, a pavilion and a distant church tower, labeled Ayazmoto; at the bottom, a large Orthodox church with multiple domes, labeled as the Church of St. Nicholas. Along the bottom edge there is a greeting text indicating it is from Stara Zagora.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central statue of a man in a long coat standing on a tall pedestal in a landscaped square or park. On the left is an ornate multi‑storey civic building with arched windows; in the background to the right stands a church or bell tower partly hidden by trees. Flowerbeds and paths surround the monument. Along the bottom border of the image, printed text identifies the place as the statue of Dr. Ioan Rațiu in Turda.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large fortified complex with a high round tower, crenellated medieval walls, and an attached palatial wing with many rectangular windows and classical details. The structure stands on heavy stone ramparts above trees, with mountains rising in the background. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large stepped pyramid rising from a flat plain, framed by cactus and yucca-like trees in the foreground. A person wearing a broad-brimmed hat sits in the shade on the left, looking toward the pyramid. The landscape is semi‑arid with scattered shrubs and agave plants under a partly cloudy sky.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a broad river, with people standing along the banks. On the far side are trees, houses on a hillside and a large building or fortress above the town. French and Ottoman Turkish text are printed at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large hilltop castle complex above dense trees. The building features several massive round towers, one with an onion-shaped dome, steep gabled roofs with dormer windows, and two tall, slender church-like towers with cupolas in the background. The architecture is late-medieval/early Renaissance Central European. No text or caption is visible on the image.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a coastal city with a long stone pier or jetty leading into a harbor. People walk along the pier, with mooring posts and lampposts on each side. Sailing ships are docked to the right, and a dense cluster of low-rise buildings stretches along the waterfront at the base of surrounding hills and mountains. A fortress or castle is visible on a hill overlooking the town. Red printed captions in Greek and French appear at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a medieval brick complex with crenellated walls and tall towers. The central structure has arched windows with grills and battlements along the roofline. In the foreground stands a narrow bell tower, and in the background a larger clock tower. At the bottom margin is a printed caption identifying the view.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an industrial waterfront scene with a brick steam pumping station building in the center, a tall smoking chimney, and arched water outlets at its base. Traditional Dutch windmills stand on both sides in a flat polder landscape. Printed captions in Dutch appear at the bottom margin, identifying the location and publisher.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an outdoor seawater swimming stadium with terraced concrete stands around a rectangular pool, sandy beach area in the foreground with bathers, and a tall diving platform. In the background are fortification walls and buildings, and to the far right industrial buildings with smoke from chimneys. Printed captions in Swedish appear in the lower left and right corners.

Black-and-white postcard showing the grand interior patio of a museum with arched colonnades and classical statues displayed around the courtyard. The tiled floor has decorative patterns, and rope barriers separate visitors from the sculptures. Printed caption at the bottom reads in French that this is the Grand Patio of the Bardo Museum.

A colored vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a monastery complex in a river valley surrounded by steep rock cliffs and forested hills. Fields stretch across the valley floor, and a river meanders along the right side. In the foreground is the large monastery with a church tower and multiple buildings arranged around courtyards. Decorative handwritten script covers the lower portion. Printed text in German appears on the image margins and at the bottom.

A monochrome postcard showing the richly decorated interior courtyard of a historic Islamic school, with carved stucco arches, columns with intricate geometric and floral motifs, and a long rectangular reflecting pool or basin in the foreground. The architecture is highly ornamented in the Moroccan style. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene and the photographer.

Black‑and‑white image of an ornate vaulted interior hall with a highly decorated neo‑Gothic ribbed ceiling and patterned walls. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide panoramic view of an archaeological excavation on a rocky mountainside. Sepia-toned historic postcard depicting the courtyard and portico of a large church or mosque-like building with arched colonnades. Colorized view from a hillside clock tower overlooking a European city with dense historic buildings and a river. Black-and-white panoramic view of a 19th‑century European spa town nestled in a steep, wooded valley. Dense rows of multi‑storey historicist townhouses and grand hotels line the hillside. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside town with reflections in the water. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a sturdy stone building beside a metal bridge over fast‑moving water, surrounded by forested cliffs. Colored vintage postcard showing a grand neo-baroque / eclectic concert and events hall. The facade has ornate sculptures, columns, round windows, and a mansard roof with statues on top. Color-tinted historic postcard showing a lively town square with people standing and walking in the open space. Colorized vintage postcard showing an ornate, two‑story waterside pavilion with elaborate neoclassical and Ottoman architectural details, situated directly on the Bosphorus shore behind an intricate wrought‑iron fence. Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a cobblestone street in a European town. Tall narrow townhouses line both sides, with simple stucco facades and shutterless windows. A sepia-toned postcard showing a round stone tower with small windows and a steep conical roof, standing on a grassy hill lined with trees. A black-and-white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a river, showing the large Albrechtsburg castle and the cathedral with tall spires rising behind it. Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox-style cathedral with a dominant central dome and several smaller domes, all topped with crosses. A stylized winter cityscape framed by white snowflakes, showing a mix of medieval towers and church spires alongside modern industrial buildings, a bridge over water, and a construction crane. Black-and-white view of a massive medieval stone fortress wall on a grassy hill, with large cylindrical corner towers featuring narrow slit windows. The sky is filled with dramatic clouds and there is a wooden fence along the slope in the foreground. No visible printed text on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy central square with many parasol-covered market stalls, a prominent statue on a pedestal, street trams, and rows of historic multi‑storey buildings with shops and signs. Old black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a monumental stone terrace with arched arcades and conical-roofed towers in neo‑Romanesque style. A monochrome postcard showing a dramatic river with rapids flowing through a rocky gorge, flanked by forested cliffs. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval fortified riverside town. Colorized historical postcard view of a European town square with a central fountain and statue ensemble surrounded by café tables and parasols. Colorized historic postcard view of a large stone fortress-like building with a massive round tower in the foreground and a rectangular multi‑story block attached. Sepia-toned postcard view over a wide river with barges and a groyne in the foreground, a bridge and town along the riverbank, and a large hilltop complex with prominent spires and castle-like buildings on the right. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large monastic complex with a church and tower seen from across an open field. The building has Baroque-style architecture and is surrounded by trees. Black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a simple church building with a tall, steep spire and a rectangular tower. Black‑and‑white view over a calm river with a multi‑arch stone bridge in the middle ground. Colorized winter view of a steep funicular railway climbing up a snow-covered hill toward a tunnel under a large building complex. Black-and-white postcard showing the Gothic façade and choir of a large cathedral with elaborate stone tracery, pointed arches and a rose window. Colorized vintage postcard showing a white Lutheran church with a tall steeple topped by a cross, seen behind bare trees and a low fence in a snowy or slushy landscape. The sky is blue with light clouds. At the top are multilingual captions naming the town and the Lutheran church.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a view of a fortified complex. On the left is a multi‑storey building with several chimneys and shuttered windows, partly obscured by vegetation. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall stone monument with an ornate crowned column and a seated female figure at its base. The monument stands in a landscaped area with low fencing, plants, and a dirt foreground. Printed red text at the top identifies the location and the monument.
