Handwritten cursive text runs along the right edge, and printed captions and publisher details appear around the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside townscape. On the left stands a prominent church with a tall spire above clustered wooden and masonry buildings on a slope. The river runs across the foreground with timber or bridge-pier structures in the water. On the right bank are more houses and a large multi-storey building among trees. Printed captions appear in Latvian along the bottom border.

Sepia-toned image showing a large Baroque-style palace or castle with several round domed towers and a central spire, situated directly on the shore of a lake. The view is from across the water, framed by large leafy trees and a path in the foreground, with low shrubs and reeds along the lakeside. The architecture suggests a European water palace or moated castle.

Black-and-white view of a European town square with a large fountain and monument at the center. The monument consists of a tall pedestal with columns and a kneeling female archer statue drawing a bow on top. At the corners of the fountain base are sculpted deer. Surrounding the square are multi-story historic buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows; one building has a clock tower. A few people stand near the fountain, and shopfronts with signs line the background.

Colored vintage postcard showing a stone fortress complex with thick walls and a bastion beside a body of water, connected by a multi‑arched stone bridge. Mountains are visible in the background. Printed captions in Greek and French/English appear at the top, and a website watermark is at the bottom.

Sepia-toned photograph of a tall, cylindrical medieval stone tower standing on a raised fortification or castle wall. The tower has a crenellated top with a flagpole and flag. Behind and to the right is a long, rectangular building forming part of the same defensive complex. Trees frame the scene on the left and right, and a park-like area with paths and benches occupies the foreground. The overall style and wear suggest an early 20th‑century postcard. No visible printed caption or back text is present in the image area shown.

Black‑and‑white night view of a large illuminated hilltop complex reflected in a river. The complex combines a Gothic church with twin spires and an attached castle‑like group of buildings with steep roofs and towers. Lights outline the structures and scatter through trees on the slope; a small boat is visible on the dark water in the foreground. There is no visible caption or writing on the image side.

A monochrome (black‑and‑white) panoramic view over a small European town set in rolling countryside, with a large castle complex on a hill to the left featuring two tall pointed towers, a river curving through the town on the right, and a prominent church with a steeple near the river. Traditional houses and small buildings are scattered in the valley and foreground. At the top left, printed in red Gothic‑style script, is the caption identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway line curving through a rural landscape toward a small town. A steam locomotive runs along the tracks on the left, with telegraph poles beside the line and fenced grassy fields in the foreground. In the background rises a prominent church with a tall spire among trees and low town buildings. Red printed captions in Swedish appear at the top: one on the left describing the scene from the railway and one on the right naming the town, Mariestad.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings, shutters on the windows, horse‑drawn carriages and a few people. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large castle-like complex with a prominent tower. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street view (Badgasse) in Colditz, and the publisher information appears below.

Black‑and‑white image showing an outdoor swimming pool complex with diving boards and many bathers in vintage swimsuits. Behind the pool stands a large, ornate grand‑hotel style building with turrets and steep roofs, set against mountainous scenery. The composition and style resemble an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century European resort postcard.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a church with a tall spire and large sloping roof, partially obscured by a row of leafy trees along a cobbled street. A small figure sits at the base of one tree in the foreground. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Danzig and the building as St. Barbara Church, with a publisher credit and number.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a long arcade with several arches and columns in front of a religious building. At the left there is a domed tower with an onion-shaped dome. The architecture combines Byzantine and Ottoman features. Printed captions at the bottom identify the view as the Church of St. Sophia in Salonica, with text in French and English and a date of 1917.

Color postcard showing a formal garden with lush greenery, a statue centered among shrubs, and a neoclassical villa with columns on the right. There is printed caption text at the bottom and handwritten cursive text along the margins and lower edge.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a path bordered by dense trees leading toward a large hilltop castle complex with a tall, slender tower and steep roofs. The view is partly framed by overhanging branches. At the bottom margin there is a handwritten-style caption in German.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a picturesque courtyard scene with old half-timbered and masonry houses with red-tiled roofs, a large leafy tree in the foreground, and several children standing behind a low picket fence. In the distant background two ornate church or cathedral towers rise above the roofs. At the top center is a printed German caption, and a handwritten number appears in red ink in the upper right corner.

A sepia-toned interior view of a richly decorated Gothic room with vaulted ceiling, ornate stone doorway topped by coats of arms, a sculptural niche, wooden paneling, tables and chairs. The scene appears to be a historical municipal office or council room. Printed German text at the bottom identifies it as a room in the Breslau town hall, specifically the antechamber of the senior mayor and mayor.

A sepia-toned postcard showing the terraced gardens and main façade of Sanssouci Palace in Potsdam. A large central fountain shoots water high into the air in the foreground, flanked by classical statues. Behind it rise symmetrical garden terraces lined with trees and balustrades, leading up to the domed palace building at the top.

Black‑and‑white view of a large, ornate brick building with a mansard-style roof, dormer windows, and decorative brick patterns. The facade has a central entrance with an arched doorway and is surrounded by a wrought‑iron fence. At the top of the central section there is an inscription that reads "BIBLIOTECA UNIVERSITĂȚII," indicating it is a university library.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped square and gardens with a large central monument, surrounded by trees and framed by mountains in the background. On the left is a tall tower with a domed top, and on the right a crenellated castle tower with a flag. The caption at the bottom reads "TRENTO - PIAZZA DANTE E GIARDINI."

Vintage sepia postcard with a monochrome photograph of a sculpted bust of the Italian poet Giovanni Prati on the left, and a handwritten Italian message on the right. The bust appears rough-hewn at the base and shoulders and is captioned below. Printer's credit is vertically printed in red along the left margin of the image. The card is oriented horizontally, with the photo and caption taking the left half and the manuscript text filling the right half.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town in a river valley. In the foreground there is a weir and a narrow bridge across the river, with multi‑storey industrial and residential buildings lining the banks. One prominent riverside building bears large painted signage, and another long block with many windows stands on the right. Behind the riverside quarter, densely packed houses climb a wooded slope towards a large hilltop castle complex with towers and ornate gables. On the distant right ridge stands a small church with a steeple. The overall scene suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial town dominated by a historic castle.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate metal bridge with decorative lampposts and pedestrians walking along the embankment. Across the river stand multi‑story townhouses and a church tower with a green onion dome and clock. In the background, a wooded hill rises with fortification buildings on top and a distinctive clock tower on the slope. The printed caption at the top left reads "Graz. Schlossberg."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large cathedral with a tall central tower capped by an ornate dome and spire, rising above surrounding low townhouses and streets. The image is framed with a white border, and printed captions run vertically along the left side, identifying the location and the church.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a river with strong flowing water in the foreground, a bridge and a solid stone building with arched openings in the middle, and forested hills in the background. At the bridge pier is a large sculpted stone head, representing a river spirit. Printed captions and publisher information appear at the bottom of the image.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large Baroque church and monastery complex set on a hill in a rural, hilly landscape. The complex has red-tiled roofs, two tall twin towers with onion domes, and a central domed structure. Smaller surrounding buildings and paths lead through gardens and fields in the foreground. In the upper right corner, red printed text reads "Mariatrost bei Graz."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view over the Danube River in Budapest, showing the Széchenyi Chain Bridge with early automobiles and carriages crossing. The foreground features large riverside buildings, and across the river is the Pest side with a dense row of classical buildings. A large domed church, identifiable as St. Stephen's Basilica, rises prominently in the background. Text is printed in red at the bottom margin in Hungarian and German.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a brick pedestrian bridge or walkway leading toward two square brick pillars with decorative caps, surrounded by dense trees. At the far end of the bridge stand a couple of people near a gate, with a hint of water or open space visible beyond the trees. The image has a white border with printed captions at the bottom indicating the location and subject.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an archaeological site with extensive stone ruins and a low rectangular building with a pitched roof in the middle ground. The ruins stretch across the foreground with a few small human figures walking among them, while gently rolling hills and a road appear in the background. On the right side of the card there is printed bilingual text in French and Greek identifying the site as the royal palace of Minos.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neo‑Renaissance city hall building with a large central dome and corner towers, opening onto a busy square filled with market stalls and umbrellas. Tram tracks and pedestrians run along a broad street lined with multi‑story buildings. A church tower rises in the background. Handwritten German text appears along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a large round masonry tower with a conical roof on the left and a tall church with a high, narrow spire on the right. Leafless trees and snow-covered ground dominate the foreground, with some low buildings and a wall visible between the two towers. A handwritten number "4230" appears at the top of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the massive stone fortification walls and towers of an old coastal city built on a hillside. A prominent round fortress dominates the upper part of the image, while defensive walls and bastions run down the slope beside clusters of Mediterranean-style houses and abundant trees. At the bottom margin in cursive script is the word "Dubrovnik," and on the right the phrase "Foto Tempo," indicating the photographer or studio.

Sepia-toned historic view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a river with moored wooden bathhouses or barges and a metal truss bridge crossing the water. Along the riverbank stands a row of multi‑story buildings with steep roofs; a tall church tower with an onion dome and clock rises prominently from the town. On the hillside behind the town are terraced paths and a large fortress complex on top of the hill, as well as a separate clock tower structure on the slope. The scene is framed like a classic early 20th‑century city postcard.

Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobbled town square with an equestrian statue at its center. On both sides stand rows of 3–4 story buildings with shops, cafés, and traditional German signage. To the left is a building labeled "Cafe Central" and another sign for "Adolf Meyer". On the right are facades with painted signs including "Carl Lochmann". In the background rise two tall, identical neo‑Gothic church towers. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll across the square.

Color view over a small European town with many low wooden and masonry houses, red and grey roofs, and abundant greenery. In the distance stands a tall church with a pointed spire dominating the skyline, alongside a few other larger buildings and a water tower. The style and printing resemble a mid‑ to late‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

A black-and-white postcard showing the façade of a Gothic cathedral with two tall, ornate spires and a central entrance tower. The view is from a street or square leading up to the building, with trees and lower buildings on the sides. At the bottom margin there is printed German text identifying the cathedral, and red handwritten numbers appear vertically on the right side.

A colorized vintage illustration showing a riverside or lakeside scene with trees and small houses in the foreground and a large brick Gothic cathedral with two tall, slender spires rising above the town in the background. The overall style and wear suggest an old printed postcard.

A color postcard showing a busy urban square with pedestrians, trees, and several cars and buses from the mid‑20th century. On the right is a yellow historic theater-like building with a decorated facade and a banner above its entrance. In the center background stands a taller, more modern block with vertical window bays and a rooftop sign in a Baltic-style language. On the left edge there is a marquee with neon letters partly visible. The scene is framed by large trees and cobblestone pavement.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned square with a prominent historic town hall building (Rathaus) in the center. The facade has tall arched windows, four white columns, and decorative towers or turrets along the roofline. Flanking the square are older multi‑story buildings and small shops. Printed captions in German appear below the image and along the left edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior arcade of a mosque. Long carpets line a covered colonnade with arches and doors on the left. Two veiled figures sit on the carpets, while another figure walks in an open courtyard to the right, bordered by a wooden fence and trees. The caption in French is printed along the bottom margin.

Illustrated view of the Potala Palace on a hill above the city of Lhasa, surrounded by mountains and scattered buildings below. The image is framed like a collectible trade card or postcard with Dutch text describing Lhasa as the holy city of Lamaism and mentioning the Potala, the 'besielde berg' (ensouled or sacred mountain). At the bottom is an advertisement line for Liebig products, and on the right a facsimile signature 'J. Liebig'.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with old houses and stone walls, with several people in early 20th‑century dress walking or standing in the foreground. In the distance, part of the city fortifications or walls is visible on a hill. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Salonique/Salonica and describe it as a corner of the fortifications, dated 1917.

Black‑and‑white riverside scene showing a large iron arch bridge with masonry piers spanning a wide river. In the foreground are cobblestone quays with moored riverboats, cranes, stacked lumber, barrels, and a horse‑drawn wagon loaded with bricks. On the far bank and hills rise villas and larger buildings. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century European cityscape.

Vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The picture side shows four photographs from the city of Pécs, Hungary: the ornate City Hall building labeled "Városháza"; a wooded hillside scene with a building labeled "Üdülőszálló" (holiday hotel); a grand cathedral with towers and cascading fountains labeled "Székesegyház"; and a wide street view labeled "Ferenc József út", with tram tracks and buildings leading toward distant hills. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a Hungarian stamp reading "MAGYAR KIR. POSTA" with a postmark, and the printer's mark "FOTO WEINSTOCK" and code "4206/41. sz."

Vintage colored postcard showing a broad, straight avenue lined with trees and tram tracks in a historic city. On the right stands a large Art Nouveau building with a tall spire; in the distance a cathedral with multiple towers rises against hilly, green surroundings. The front has printed captions at the bottom and appears slightly worn. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Hungarian, printed postcard dividing lines, and a publisher's stamp.

A multi-view black-and-white postcard showing several scenes related to Burg Kriebstein and its surroundings. The central image depicts a medieval hilltop castle rising above a rocky, wooded river valley. Other panels show a church-like interior with an ornate painted vaulted ceiling and altar, paintings or artwork associated with the castle, and river or reservoir views with boats and forested hills. In the lower center there is white Gothic-style German text on a black background.

Color-printed postcard showing a lakeside view of a baroque hunting castle with four round corner towers and red domes, reflected in the water and framed by dark tree branches in the foreground. At the bottom margin, the caption reads "JAGDSCHLOSS MORITZBURG."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a coastal view with a fortified hilltop complex dominating the background, likely a citadel. Sailing ships are anchored in the calm harbor, and low waterfront buildings and trees line the shore in the foreground. The upper right corner bears printed text in French reading "Souvenir de Corfou." The image has a faded, early-photographic style typical of late‑19th or early‑20th‑century postcards, with some handwritten marks and a stamp impression near the bottom.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a dense European port city with a busy waterfront lined with ferries and small ships, curving quays, mid‑rise blocks, and some areas under construction cut into rocky terrain. A large green park with tree‑lined avenues stretches inland, surrounded by blocks of 19th‑ and early‑20th‑century buildings. Overprinted purple text and a red frame line appear on the image, suggesting it is a proof or archive copy of a postcard view.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a European town seen across treetops, with dense low-rise buildings and, dominating the skyline, a large Gothic-style church or cathedral featuring two very tall, slender spires. Rolling hills rise in the far background. The image has rough, worn edges and some surface damage typical of early photographic postcards. No visible caption or printed text appears on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded grandstand in front of ornate historic buildings during a medieval-style jousting tournament. Two armored riders on horses tilt with lances in an arena separated by a long wooden barrier, while spectators fill tiered seating and flags and banners hang from poles and facades. In the foreground, costumed figures watch the event. Printed caption text and publisher information appear along the bottom margin.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large Orthodox church with multiple onion domes and a central bell tower, standing on a raised plot of land with stairs leading up. A few small figures are visible in the foreground on an open, bare ground. Printed Russian text appears beneath the image.

Black‑and‑white view of a cobbled courtyard enclosed by Renaissance and Baroque buildings. On the left stands a massive, older-looking structure with a steep gabled roof and small dormer windows, attached to a round tower and ivy‑covered walls. In the center rises a more ornate palace façade with triangular gables and a tall tower with a lantern and spire. On the right is a long arcade-like wing with repeated arched windows and sculpted figures above them, also covered in ivy. Several slender lampposts and simple metal posts line the otherwise empty courtyard. At the very bottom of the image, faint handwritten text appears to read something like a date, possibly "1902," mirrored or upside down.

A colorized view over a European riverside town with tightly packed multi‑story houses with red-tile roofs along a riverbank. Above the town, on a wooded hill, stands a large medieval hilltop fortress complex with multiple walls, towers, and buildings. To the right is a tall church with a distinctive Baroque onion-dome tower. The scene is surrounded by green countryside under a lightly clouded sky. No visible printed captions or text appear on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large castle complex and cathedral towers on a hill above a river. In the foreground are riverside houses and boats; above them stand the fortified palace buildings and twin Gothic spires of a cathedral. There is German handwriting-style printed text on the right side identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing views of Assisi. The upper part presents a wide view of the hill town with its basilica complex stretched along the slope. To the right is a broader landscape labeled "Panorama" with fields and small figures in the foreground and the town on the hill in the background. At the bottom left, framed decoratively, is a view of a medieval fortress labeled "La Rocca (XIV secolo)". Decorative text and a round stamp‑like mark with the letters "A. C. T." also appear.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large rectangular Renaissance-style palace or castle on a hill above a town. The long multi-windowed building with hipped roofs and dormers dominates the scene, with terraced gardens or walls in front and smaller town houses with tiled roofs below. The caption "Bilin Schloss" is printed in red at the top left, and a vertical red publisher's imprint appears along the right edge.

An old black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a Baroque or late Renaissance building with ornate stonework. In the foreground there is a balustraded stone terrace partly covered with climbing plants and trees. Behind it stands a two‑storey mansion or palace wing with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows. At the center is an elaborate arched entrance with sculpted decoration and a balcony, suggesting a historic European residence or palace complex. The lower edge of the image is damaged, and handwritten numbers are visible along the bottom border.

Color-printed view of a large white building with arcades and red-tiled roofs, set behind a formal garden full of flowers and walking paths. A small national flag flies atop the central roof. White benches line the garden paths. The image has a vintage, slightly faded print quality and is framed by a white border, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards.

Monochrome postcard-style print showing a medieval brick city gate and fortification. A round tower with a steep conical roof stands at the left, pierced by small slit windows. An arched gateway leads through the wall, with a couple of small human figures beneath it for scale. High, sloping ramparts or earthworks reinforce the walls on both sides. The scene is rendered in a somewhat artistic, etched style rather than a sharp photograph, and there is no visible caption on the front.

Black-and-white multi-view postcard showing a large baroque courtyard complex. The top image appears to be an old painting or engraving of the site with carriages and people in 18th–19th‑century clothing. The two lower photographs show the same baroque pavilion wings and richly decorated gate surrounding a fountain basin, with visitors in 20th‑century dress. The architecture features long colonnaded façades with many tall windows, elaborate sculptural ornament, and the distinctive crowned portal of the complex.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a large Renaissance-style hunting palace complex with gabled roofs, a central tower, and ivy-covered walls, set behind trees and an open lawn. Printed caption at the lower right reads "Jagdschloß Wermsdorf."

Sepia-toned photograph with a decorative scalloped border showing an Italian town square. On the left is a mid‑20th‑century apartment block with street‑level shops, including a bank; on the right is a large historic palazzo with small Gothic windows and a projecting balcony. A few pedestrians and a cyclist move across the largely empty square.

A black‑and‑white view of a massive stone Neo‑Renaissance/Neo‑Baroque style public building on a corner lot. The façade is richly ornamented with tall Corinthian columns, statuary in niches and on the roofline, decorative bas‑reliefs, and a heavily rusticated ground floor. Several arched entrances with steps lead into the building. In the foreground there is a formal garden or square with paths, low iron fences, and early 20th‑century pedestrians in long coats and hats. The image edges are worn and irregular, suggesting an old photographic postcard or plate.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a cobblestone courtyard framed by old stone buildings and trees. To the left is a large masonry wall with a lantern; ahead stands a multi-storey gabled building with arched entrance; to the right another rough-stone house with steps. The scene is tranquil and mostly empty. German text printed in the bottom margin identifies the location.

The image is a vintage postcard depicting a bustling European city square with ornate historic buildings, a monument with statues in the center, people and horse-drawn vehicles, and a hillside featuring a prominent clock tower overlooking the square. The scene is labeled 'Graz. Hauptplatz.' at the top left.

A monochrome (tinted) historic postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilltop town dominated by a large complex of multi‑storey buildings and towers, including a prominent round defensive tower on the right and baroque‑style roofs and spires in the center. Smaller houses and greenery spread down the slope in the foreground. The caption "Elbogen." is printed in red at the lower left, with the publisher credit "Brück & Sohn, Meissen." and the number "1035" in small red type at the bottom edge.

A sepia-toned image featuring a historic church with a tall tower in a central European town, surrounded by trees and rooftops, with hills in the background. The printed text at the top identifies the location and church, and there is a publisher's mark on the right side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large arched truss bridge crossing a wide river. Boats are visible on the water in the foreground, with low, flat riverside scenery and some trees and buildings in the distance. The caption at the bottom reads "Waalbrug - Nijmegen." The image has a sepia tone and a printed border typical of early–mid 20th‑century postcards.

The front of the postcard shows a hand-tinted image of a large neo-gothic church with a tall central steeple and red-brick details, located in a town setting with surrounding greenery. There is text at the bottom that reads 'KYRKAN I SUNDSVALL.' The back features a green stamp from Sweden dated 1910 and is addressed in Swedish in ornate handwriting. The postcard uses multiple languages for 'postcard,' suggesting it was meant for international as well as national mailing.

The image is of an illustrated postcard featuring a large, historic castle with two prominent towers and an extensive building complex, situated beside a river or body of water. The building rests on a slight hill or elevated area surrounded by trees. At the top, in red Gothic-style script, is the text 'Schloß Rochlitz i. Sa.' The sky is clear with a gradient from blue to a gentle dusk or dawn light.

Black-and-white view of a historic town square with a large Gothic/Renaissance-style town hall dominating the scene. The building has a steeply pitched tiled roof, three stepped-gable façades, a slender central spire, and a clock. On the ground floor is an arched entrance and a sign reading "Rathskeller" above an awning. To the right stands a building with a sign "Hôtel zum" and a horse-drawn carriage in front. On the left, multi-story townhouses line the street, one marked with the vertical sign "F. Richard Fladriz." Several pedestrians stand or walk across the cobblestone square.

Colorized vintage view over a European riverside city. A river flows through the center with tree‑lined embankments and a bridge crossing it. On the right bank stand rows of red‑roofed buildings and a prominent white neoclassical building; on the left are more houses and a broad promenade. A steep hill rises behind the town, topped with fortification‑like structures and a tower. The word "GRAZ." is printed in red at the top left.

Vintage black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone street lined with several‑story buildings sporting awnings and shop signs. A woman in dark clothing walks across the mostly empty street while a few other figures stand near shopfronts. At the left foreground is a prominent curved sign for a cigar shop. In red print at the top it says that the scene is of Schmiedegasse in Pirna; small red text is also printed at the bottom edge.

Colorized historic postcard view of a steel truss bridge leading toward a large fortified castle complex with round and square towers and red-tiled roofs. Soldiers in uniform are marching across the bridge toward the castle. A church tower is visible in the background, and utility poles line the right side. Printed titles in German identify the place as Torgau on the Elbe River and Schloss Hartenfels.

Colorized landscape view over a river valley with a railway line, small industrial buildings with a tall brick chimney, and scattered houses amid dense greenery. On the distant hill to the right stands a large castle-like complex. At the top left of the image is printed the caption "Rochsburg i. Muldentale".

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a richly decorated neo-baroque / historicist theater building on a corner, with arched entrances, ornate columns and balustrades. A few pedestrians stand on the cobblestone street and tram tracks curve in the foreground. At the top of the card, printed text reads "Riga." on the left and "Russisches Theater." on the right.

A colorized historical postcard view of a baroque palace at the end of a wide garden avenue, lined with tall trees and manicured lawns. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll along the paths; a horse‑drawn carriage approaches the palace. At the top left, printed text in German identifies the scene as a palace in Dresden's royal Great Garden.

The postcard features a vibrant, color photograph of a well-dressed woman standing next to a donkey in a lush garden full of blooming flowers. In the background, there are wide, terraced steps leading up to a modernist building with large columns, above which a sign in Cyrillic reads 'КАЗИНО' (casino). There are fountains, trees, and a few other people visible, suggesting a lively public or resort area.

Black‑and‑white view of a large landscaped central park with tree‑lined alleys, flower beds, and a central obelisk/monument, bordered by a busy boulevard and historic buildings, with wooded hills in the background. The reverse has Romanian text printed 'REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÎNĂ — BRAȘOV — Parcul prieteniei', a Romanian 40‑bani stamp, postal cancellation, and a handwritten message and address dated 16.VIII.1966.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a fortified church with steep shingled roofs and a tall central tower, framed by silhouetted tree branches. The reverse has a Romanian 40 BANI stamp, multilingual caption identifying the site as the Precista fortified church, and a handwritten Romanian message addressed to the Central Military Hospital in Bucharest.

A multi-view vintage postcard showing several scenes from Meissen on the Elbe River. The central image features the twin-spired Gothic cathedral (Dom). Surrounding views include a panorama of the town and river seen from Albrechtsburg Castle, the state porcelain manufactory complex, the town hall on a large square, and a riverside view with Albrechtsburg Castle and the cathedral on the hill above the town. The captions are printed in German.

Color postcard showing an ornate Orthodox church with two tall octagonal towers and richly carved stone façades, set against a blue sky with trees and lawn in front. The reverse has Romanian handwriting in blue ink, a Romanian 40 Bani stamp (Poșta Română), postmark, and an address to Baia Mare. A printed caption identifies the church.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Neo‑Renaissance castle with tall spires nestled on a forested mountain slope. The back side has Romanian text, a blue 40 Bani POSTA ROMANA stamp with an industrial motif, and an address written to Sibiu. Printed caption states "SINAIA. Muzeul Peleș."

Multiview postcard featuring Secu Monastery in a wooded valley and several liturgical objects: a 17th‑century chalice, a 19th‑century holy water vessel, a printed homiliary of Metropolitan Varlaam (1643), a 19th‑century paten/plate, and a 19th‑century gospel with ornate cover. Front titles read "MÎNĂSTIREA SECU" and "JUDEȚUL NEAMȚ". The reverse has multilingual captions and the imprint of the Metropolis of Moldavia and Suceava in Iași.

Color postcard showing the Romanian navigation lock of the Iron Gate I Hydroelectric Power Station on the Danube. Two vessels are inside the lock chamber; the river, mountains and an island are visible in the background. The reverse has the usual address lines and stamp box and credits the Iron Gates Region Museum.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade of the National Theatre building in Cluj, with statues atop its towers and the inscription "Teatrul National" on the pediment. The reverse is printed with multilingual captions naming the theatre in Cluj and bears Romanian People's Republic postage stamps (35 bani and 5 bani), Bucharest postmarks, a handwritten Romanian message and an address in București.

A hand‑colored historic postcard showing Pont Adolphe, a large stone arch bridge spanning a deep valley with a river and construction works below. The bridge has multiple arches, with urban buildings, trees, and a large institutional-looking structure in the background. Text in French and German is printed along the bottom margin.

Vintage-style printed view of a European city square with a tall Marian or victory column at its center, surrounded by Baroque and classicist buildings. Market stalls line the left side, and people in 18th–19th century clothing walk across the cobbled square. A horse‑drawn carriage and riders move along the streets. The right side features a large, ornate palace-like building with many windows and a central arched portal. The image is monochrome and appears as an old engraving reproduced on a postcard. No legible text is visible on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large curved masonry dam with a roadway along the crest. A man in early 20th‑century clothing stands near the base of the structure. On the right side are terraced construction works, small buildings, and a forested hillside in the background. The printed caption in German at the top left reads "Talsperre Klingenberg i. Sa." and there is a handwritten red number in the top right corner.

A vintage postcard depicting Franziskanerplatz in Graz, Austria. The image shows a square with old European buildings and a prominent church with Gothic windows and onion-domed towers. Horse-drawn carts and people are visible in the cobbled square. There is handwritten text in French at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large round stone tower with crenellations and a flag on top, set by a waterfront promenade with people walking and carts or carriages on a road or tram tracks. Greek text appears at the top right, with a French translation beneath, and a website watermark at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white view of a European old-town street and square with brick and stone townhouses, shops at street level, and people walking on a cobbled plaza. The central building has a large arched window and ornate gable with the inscription in German script above the window. Shopfront signs in German are visible on the ground floor. In the background rise the tall spire of a Gothic cathedral and, to the right, a large medieval castle tower set on a hill.

Black‑and‑white view of a European city with densely packed tiled roofs in the foreground, baroque church towers, and a large wooded hill behind the riverfront buildings. On top and along the slope of the hill are fortification structures and paths, and on the right side stands a prominent clock tower. Printed text at the bottom identifies the publisher and the city.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with decorative floral framing. On the left is an oval vignette showing stone ruins with large arched openings, likely from an old cathedral, surrounded by illustrated flowers. Across the upper part of the card is a panoramic view of a town along a waterfront with a church spire and a small sailboat on the water. In the center-right, stylized text reads "Hilsen fra Hamar".

A black‑and‑white historic postcard-style image showing a tall medieval brick tower rising above low houses along a cobblestone street. The tower has Gothic brickwork, narrow arched windows, and a steep roof topped with a richly ornamented spire and flagpole. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move along the street in front of the tower, suggesting a late 19th or early 20th century scene in a European city. Awning‑covered shopfronts sit at the base of the tower, and additional historic buildings appear in the background.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a tall, cylindrical stone tower with a steep conical roof standing beside a street lined with trees and fences. Behind the tower are residential-style buildings and a mountainous landscape under a blue sky. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

A black‑and‑white image showing a large crowd of well‑dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion gathered in front of and along a long colonnaded arcade. The building is neoclassical, with repeated arches, Corinthian-style columns, ornate friezes, balustrades, and statues on the roofline. The crowd fills a promenade that runs beside the structure. There are hanging signs on the arcade and another grand building visible further along the promenade.

Sepia-toned photograph of a large, ornate neoclassical building with two stories plus a raised basement, tall rectangular windows, and arched windows on the ground floor. The facade has pilasters, decorative window pediments, and a central entrance with steps and a small portico. Along the roofline is a balustrade and an elaborate sculpted crest bearing Latin text, including the word 'INSTITUT.' In the foreground is a path or driveway bordered by a clipped hedge and lawn. At the bottom of the image, handwritten text identifies the location and date.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing the silhouette of a hilltop castle ruin against a bright, cloudy sky. Trees and forested slopes obscure the lower part of the structure, while broken walls and two prominent towers are visible on the right. The caption "Burgruine Gösting." appears in small white type at the bottom left of the image.

Monochrome historic postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to an arched gate complex attached to large, multi‑storey buildings with tiled roofs and ornate towers. The central building has two rows of arched windows above three large passageway arches. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks. The caption at the top reads "Graz. Burgtor, Erzherzog Johann-Allee."

Colorized interior view of a large Ottoman mosque, showing massive fluted columns, green and patterned tiled walls, pointed arches, and arched windows. Hanging chandeliers and calligraphic Arabic bands decorate the space. Along the right margin a printed caption identifies the scene.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a large religious procession on a cobblestoned street. Priests and participants carry large decorated banners with sacred images and crosses, surrounded by a crowd of men, women, and children in early 20th‑century clothing. Historic urban buildings and a church tower rise in the background. Printed captions in Hungarian and German appear beneath the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate city gate and adjoining fortified walls with a tall square tower. The architecture is Islamic/Maghrebi, with an arched entrance decorated with geometric motifs. In front of the walls are small market stalls and people in traditional clothing walking along a dirt street. Printed caption text in French appears along the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a large public square and garden with a prominent monument at its center. The statue stands on a tall pedestal in a circular plaza surrounded by trees and paths. In the background are mountains and several towers and historic buildings. Printed red text at the top identifies the location as Piazza Dante with its monument and public garden in Trento.

A color postcard showing an outdoor concert by a municipal brass band performing in a historic European square surrounded by pastel-colored buildings and a large audience seated on temporary bleachers and behind barriers. At the center-right of the square stands an ornate baroque fountain with statues, and in the background is a domed building with a tiled roof. The band members wear blue uniforms and play various wind and percussion instruments while facing the crowd. At the bottom of the postcard there is large printed text in Italian.

A sepia-toned photograph of a Romanesque church porch with three arched openings supported by slender columns. At the top of the porch is a gabled structure with a statue in a niche. On either side of the steps stand two sculpted stone lions facing outward. The facade behind shows striped masonry and a row of small arcades above. The overall style suggests an historic European cathedral entrance.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing the front façade of a large church with a rose window, classical pediment, and ornate portal. A bell tower with a dome rises behind the façade. There are a few people walking in the open square in front of the church, with trees and surrounding buildings visible. Printed captions appear along the bottom margin naming the location and church.

Color postcard showing a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city with red-roofed buildings. The tower has two large clock faces with Roman numerals and a steep shingled roof. At the top left is printed red text, and faint handwritten German text is visible across the sky area.

A sepia-toned, antique-style illustration of a large Baroque or early-18th‑century palace with a formal geometric garden in the foreground. The main building has a long central block with a steep roof and a tall central spire, flanked by two lower wings or separate pavilions. In the garden, symmetrically arranged parterres, paths, and topiary are visible, with a few finely dressed figures strolling on the main walkway. The sky is filled with stylized, heavy clouds, typical of old engravings. There is no visible printed text on the image itself.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large hilltop castle complex with multiple steep-roofed buildings and a round central tower, alongside a baroque-style church with an onion-shaped spire. Below the rocky, wooded slope sit several smaller houses and a stone bridge crossing a stream in the foreground. The overall style and setting suggest a central European medieval townscape. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.

A monochrome postcard-style image showing a bustling market square in front of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance building with domes and towers. Numerous stalls with umbrellas line the square, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and trade. On the left side a church tower rises above the surrounding buildings. Printed German text in the upper left identifies the scene as Graz and mentions the town hall, Herrengasse, and parish church.

Colorized view of a European riverside city with a bridge crossing a blue river, lined by trees and historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the background, a steep wooded hill rises, crowned by fortification walls and buildings; to the right on the hillside stands a prominent clock tower. The caption at the top left reads "GRAZ, Schlossberg," and additional commercial signage is visible on one of the riverside buildings.

A vintage postcard showing the interior of a large stone cathedral with tall arches, side chapels, and a prominent staircase leading up along the wall. There are wooden railings and choir stalls, religious statues, and dim light streaming in from tall windows. The entire front, including the image area, is heavily overprinted with handwritten correspondence. At the bottom, printed red text identifies the scene.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Orthodox cathedral with domes and crosses on the left, opening onto a very broad, tree‑lined square or boulevard with scattered pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and surrounding low buildings. Inset at the bottom right is a view of an obelisk‑like monument. Printed captions in Bulgarian (Cyrillic) and German identify the cathedral and send greetings from Varna.

A sepia-toned photograph showing a prominent medieval-style clock tower standing on a steep, rocky, and wooded hill. The tower has a large clock face and a steep shingled roof, overlooking rooftops below. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text in German.

Black-and-white interior view of a historic church with arched ceilings, wooden pews, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, a decorated pulpit on the left wall, and an altar with a large cross and plants at the far end. The lower right corner contains printed caption text identifying the church.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The main images show a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle complex on a hill above a town and river, photographed by day and illuminated at night. A bridge crosses the river in the night view. Another panel shows the interior of a traditional restaurant with wooden chairs, tables with white cloths, wall pictures and hanging lamps. In the center there is a title block with stylized German text referring to a historic guesthouse.

Colored illustrated postcard showing an ornate Ottoman-style public fountain on a street in the Arab quarter of Cairo. The fountain façade has intricate arches, metal grilles and rich decoration, with people in traditional clothing walking and conversing nearby. A narrow street recedes into the distance with a minaret visible, and there is a tree and a street lamp in the foreground. French captions and a German publisher credit appear in the margins.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop complex consisting of a castle-like palace and a Gothic cathedral with tall spires, rising above a town and trees. At the bottom center, white printed text in German identifies the location.

Color-tinted historical postcard showing a large open square with carriages and pedestrians in front of a monumental arched gate flanked by buildings. On the right stands a tall clock/observation tower and another ornate building. The architecture is Ottoman-era. Printed caption text in French at the bottom left identifies the scene as the entrance and tower of the Seraskierat in Constantinople. A modern website watermark appears across the lower right.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a cobblestone square with a central statue and fountain in front of a long brick building featuring multiple stepped-gable façades. The statue stands on a tall pedestal in the middle of the square. At the bottom left of the card is the printed caption "Bruges. — Place Memling." and on the right side there is a handwritten signature.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view taken from across a body of water, showing a large historic church or cathedral complex with a prominent square tower topped by a baroque-style dome. Surrounding it are older gabled buildings and trees along the shoreline. The word "Strängnäs" is printed in the lower left corner.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town with medieval stone towers, church spires, and old houses clustered on a hill above a valley. Prominent round and square fortification towers and a large church dominate the skyline. At the bottom right, white printed text identifies the view as being from Scharfenweg in Bautzen.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing an urban waterfront scene with trams, cars, pedestrians, and boats. A tall metal elevator tower with an elevated walkway connects to a multi‑story building on the right, while older buildings and a harbor fill the background. The image has deckled postcard-style edges and printed captions at the bottom.

A monochrome, vintage view of a narrow medieval street with steep‑roofed houses and a tall, slender Gothic tower rising behind them. The tower has a long, tapering spire topped with a weather vane. The houses have stepped and curving gables, many-paned windows, and tile roofs; small figures walk along the street at the bottom of the image. The overall style suggests a historic European town scene. No visible caption or printed text is present on the front.

A vintage monochrome/green-tinted postcard showing a busy bridge in Constantinople with pedestrians, a tramcar running along tracks, and boats at the sides. In the background rise multiple mosque domes and minarets on the opposite shore. The French caption at the top mentions the new bridge and the view of Galata, and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing domed white roofs and an ornate entrance of an Islamic mosque with intricate arches and decorative carvings. A tall minaret rises in the background against a hillside cityscape of dense buildings. Printed French text at the top identifies the view as Oran – La Mosquée du Pacha, and a small publisher credit appears in the lower right corner.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a medieval stone castle ruin on a rocky, columnar basalt hill, surrounded by vegetation. A tall rectangular tower and a round turreted structure connected by curtain walls dominate the scene. At the top of the image there is a printed German caption identifying the site.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside view with a steamship on the water, low buildings and a wooded hill with a tower in the background. The lower margin has printed captions identifying the location and publisher, and handwritten date and signature on the front.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a richly decorated fountain with a bronze statue of Neptune holding a trident, enclosed by an ornate wrought‑iron fence. The fountain stands in a cobblestone square lined with tall, narrow, gabled townhouses in Northern European Hanseatic style. On the right edge is a large brick building. People in early 20th‑century clothing and horse‑drawn carriages are visible. A shop sign with German text can be seen in the background.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a narrow old European street lined with multi‑story buildings with shutters and balconies. A tall medieval tower rises above the houses in the background. In the foreground are two figures, one pushing a handcart loaded with goods and another in a dark cloak and hat walking along the street. Printed captions identify the scene as a street in Trento, specifically Via S. Maria Maggiore. There is a red postage stamp in the upper‑right corner with cancellation marks.

Sepia-toned historical view of a European city street with an electric tram in the foreground, horse-drawn carts, pedestrians, and tree-lined avenues. In the background rises a dense old town on a hill, dominated by several tall, slender church spires and historic buildings with steep roofs. The scene feels like an early 20th‑century city-center square or junction.

The postcard depicts a picturesque European townscape with a prominent hilltop castle or fortress overlooking red-roofed houses and a church with a tall steeple. In the foreground are open fields and rows of trees. The overall style is vintage, suggesting an early-to-mid 20th-century origin. At the bottom left, partially in cursive script, is the text 'Stolpen i. Sa.'

The postcard features a black-and-white illustration or photograph of a historical European city street scene, with people, horse-drawn carriages, and classic buildings. Dominating the background is a large baroque-style church tower with a clock. The street scene shows people in 19th-century attire. On the main building in the right foreground, there is visible signage reading 'RUDOLF KRONHAUS.'

A vintage black-and-white image of a neoclassical building complex with grand columns, statues atop high pillars, and people walking in front. The central structure is highly ornate and resembles ancient Greek architectural style. The text on the postcard is in Greek and French, indicating a souvenir from Athens, specifically of the Academy.

A black and white vintage postcard depicting a European cityscape along a river with a prominent cathedral and castle complex on a hill. In the foreground, old buildings and rooftops cluster, and a historic stone bridge spans the river. The river, bridge, and imposing architectural features dominate the scene. The text is in German, written in a script font at the bottom.

The image shows a historical black-and-white postcard with a panoramic view of a city topped by a large and prominent mosque with multiple minarets, likely the Selimiye Mosque. The image shows a group of Austro-Hungarian soldiers in uniform operating a field artillery gun in a courtyard with a building featuring arched windows and doors in the background. The architecture is characteristic of Central European military barracks or fortifications from the late 19th to early 20th centuries. There is printed text at the bottom in German.

The image is a black-and-white postcard depicting a dramatic riverside view of a large gothic-style cathedral and castle complex perched on a hill above a town. The river flows in the foreground, with small buildings along the riverbank. The structures atop the hill are characterized by pointed spires and intricate architecture.

A black-and-white image showing a large historical complex on a hill, likely a castle or palace, viewed from a distance. The foreground features a field, a large tree, and leafy branches, which frame the image. Below the castle structure are smaller houses and trees typical of a European town.

This is a multi-view postcard showing four different landmarks in the city of Graz. The images depict (top left) the Kaiser Franz Josef-Kai with the Schlossberg hill and its clock tower, (top right) the K.k. Universität (Imperial and Royal University), (bottom left) the Hauptplatz (main square), and (bottom right) the Stadttheater (city theater). The postcard is visually characterized by hand-tinted colorization and contains German text labeling each view.

A black-and-white photographic postcard showing a wide, tree-lined avenue with people walking on the sidewalks and a few early 20th-century automobiles on the street. In the distance, a prominent building sits atop a hill. The lower text identifies the street as 'Paseo de la Reforma para Chapultepec.' The scene conveys an elegant, expansive boulevard with vintage street lamps.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a tram (number 412) in front of a series of ornate, late 19th to early 20th-century European buildings. There is a business sign reading 'C. Friedrich Hermsdorf' on one building. In the background, terraced vineyards cover the hillsides, and a notable baroque-style religious building or pilgrimage church sits atop a hill. Telephone poles and early 20th-century urban features are visible.

The image shows a minimalist postcard commemorating the years 1917 and 1966, with a prominent red hammer and sickle symbol on the left, indicating Soviet or Communist significance. There is also a vertically rendered drawing of a church or tower with a spire and cross, suggesting a recognizable historical building, likely Eastern European.

A black and white image showing a grassy park area with a stone wall and flowerbeds in the foreground. There are benches and a blurred white classic car on the road. In the background, several small cannons are mounted on the grassy hill, with a flagpole, scattered trees, and an outdoor cafe with umbrellas visible.

The image shows a sepia-toned historical courtyard with arched galleries over multiple levels and a domed staircase structure. There is an ornate well on the left, and classic Baroque architectural ornamentation on the windows and arches. The lower edge of the image contains handwritten text.

The image features a black and white photograph of an ornate, castle-like building situated atop a steep, terraced hillside covered with vegetation and fenced pathways. The structure features Neo-Gothic architectural details such as battlements, pointed turrets, and arched windows. A stone stairway and a small stone hut or cellar with a wooden door can be seen in the foreground, leading up the hill toward the building.

The postcard displays an old, sepia-toned photograph of stone ruins nestled in a wooded area. The structure appears to be made of large, weathered blocks with arches and partial wall remains, indicating it was once a significant building, possibly medieval. There is a wrought iron or wooden gate in an archway and partial stone staircases visible, surrounded by large trees casting shadows across the ruins.

A black-and-white historic postcard image depicting a picturesque stone bridge crossing over a calm river or canal. In the background, there are several prominent architectural structures, including a rounded tower, onion-domed roofs, tall chimneys, and a pair of spired church towers. The area is framed by a line of tall trees and landscaped riverbanks, suggesting a European setting with mixed industrial and historical architecture.

A black and white image depicting a large, historic castle-like building with two prominent Gothic cathedral spires dominating the hilltop. Below it flows a wide river, upon which a steam-powered paddle boat travels. In the foreground are several trees and riverside structures. On the hill, one can discern classic European architecture with steep roofs. Some signage is visible, but is difficult to read in detail.

The postcard shows a large Catholic church with a tall, ornate spire topped by a cross, flanked by smaller towers with similar steep roofs. Trees without full foliage are visible in the foreground. The title 'Libau. Katholische Kirche' is printed at the top left in red letters.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a section of a historic fortress or castle with thick stone walls partially covered in vegetation. There are buildings on top of the wall and some people are visible near a railing. The postcard includes printed text in German and a circular stamp. The overall style is early 20th century.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a town square with people, horse-drawn carts, and buildings lining the street. Large trees are in the background with a prominent church or cathedral visible behind them. The postcard features handwritten text across the image and at the bottom, with a printed label identifying the location.

The image shows two white boats named 'ASTREA' docked beside a historic stone building with a distinctive onion-shaped dome and turret. The building appears to be a castle or manor situated by the water, surrounded by greenery. The sky is clear, and the setting appears peaceful and picturesque.

The image shows a black and white postcard featuring a prominent brick church with two tall, ornate towers topped with crosses. The church is set atop a hill with trees and a winding dirt path leading up to it. There is a solitary person visible on the path. The postcard has Swedish text and credit to a photographer or publisher in Stockholm.

A black and white photograph postcard depicting an ornate stone Gothic interior with elaborate columns and arches. There is a small altar or chapel in the corner with a stained glass window above it. The stonework features intricate carvings and decorative motifs typical of medieval ecclesiastical architecture.

A black and white image showing a large, elegant European square or park surrounded by ornate, historic multi-story buildings in a grand architectural style. The scene includes men in formal clothing and women with parasols and prams, typical of turn-of-the-20th-century attire. The park is landscaped with paths, fencing, and planted trees, and there is a sense of urban sophistication and civic order.

This is a sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a view of the Schlossberg hill and surrounding buildings in Graz, Austria. Atop the hill sits a fortress complex, and to the right is the famous clock tower (Uhrturm). The river Mur and a bridge are visible in the foreground, and the city's old architecture can be seen along the riverbank. There is printed and handwritten text on the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate early‑20th‑century building with a domed corner, arched windows and wrought‑iron balconies. Ground‑floor signs read "HOTEL PALACE," while large rooftop letters show "CEC," the Romanian savings bank. Pedestrians and street activity are visible. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a Romanian stamp and postmarks, and printed caption identifying the view as Hotel Palace in Craiova.

Color postcard showing a large stone triumphal arch with sculpted reliefs and inscriptions, set against a bright blue sky. A cyclist and a small red car pass in front; trees frame the scene. The reverse side has Romanian postal markings and caption identifying the monument.

Color postcard showing a close-up of an old tiled rooftop and chimney overlooking the medieval town. In the background are red-roofed houses and a distinctive clock tower with a bulbous spire, along with church domes and greenery. Reverse side bears Romanian text and publisher marks.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of the spa town of Bad Kissingen, seen from the Ludwigsturm. The reverse has a red 10 Pfennig Bayern stamp with a Bad-Kissingen postmark and is addressed to Stockholm, Sweden.

Black‑and‑white waterfront view of Malmö showing buildings along the quay with a small sailing boat in the foreground. The reverse has a multilingual "CARTE POSTALE" header, publisher credit, and a Swedish handwritten note.

A vintage multiview postcard depicting Brussels, with illustrated panels of the Manneken-Pis, the Brussels Town Hall and the Maison du Roi around the Grand Place, plus a vignette of a Brussels milkman. Colorized night view of the Singer Building skyscraper illuminated against a cloudy sky; reverse side has printed description, address lines, two green 1-cent U.S. postage stamps, and a New York postmark dated 1921.

Colorized view of the Albert Memorial in Kensington Gardens, London, framed by an ornate printed border. The reverse shows a divided-back British layout with a royal-warrant line and an 'AFFIX STAMP' box, plus a blue-ink handwritten message and address to Sweden.

Sepia postcard showing a courtyard with a large bronze armillary-sphere instrument set on a raised platform, in front of a traditional Chinese building with tiled roof and lattice windows; bare tree branches at right. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a long stone gallery of Angkor Wat with balustraded windows and palm trees, showing the inner first terrace on the north side. A red French caption is printed along the top.

Tinted view of a rural white church behind trees and a stone wall, with a steep green roof and belfry. A Swedish caption appears at the top right. The reverse reads 'BREVKORT' with multilingual postcard headings, bears a green 5 öre Swedish stamp postmarked 1907, and is addressed to Skarblacka.

Colorized vintage view of a lakeside peninsula with a tall-steepled church above red‑roofed houses and trees. In the foreground is Wörthersee with a pier and a small lighthouse-like fountain spraying water.

Color postcard showing the Gothic St. Michael's Church with a high spire dominating a central square. Color view of a grand Orthodox cathedral with a large central dome and smaller domes, opening onto a broad square with flowerbeds, trees, and traffic circles. Sepia/black‑and‑white postcard showing a baroque palace with a garden in front. Caption at top-left reads "SIBIU – Muzeul Brukenthal (sec. XVIII)".
