Romînă / Poșta", multiple circular postmarks dated 1963 from Sibiu, Cugir and Geoagiu-Băi, and handwritten Romanian message and address.

A colorized vintage postcard-style view over a hilly town with many trees in bloom. At the top of the hill stand several prominent buildings including a large church with a tall spire and other substantial masonry structures, likely historic civic or religious buildings. Below, clustered townhouses and small industrial buildings fill the valley. A curving path or road runs through a green foreground hillside. The sky is softly tinted blue with scattered clouds. The caption in the upper left reads "Leisnig i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white image of a richly decorated Gothic church portal with pointed arch, dense sculpted figures around the doorway, and statues in niches on both sides of the entrance. Below the image, faint handwritten text appears reversed, as if the card has been photographed from the back.

Colorized panoramic view over a European town with dense tree cover in the foreground and tightly packed buildings with red and gray roofs in the middle. A tall church with a pointed spire and a large castle-like complex stand on a rocky hill to the left, overlooking the town. Factory chimneys and multi‑story townhouses are visible, with open countryside and fields stretching into the distant horizon. The caption "Leisnig i. Sa." appears printed in red at the top left.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a hilly riverside town with a large castle-like building on a forested hill to the left and smaller houses and streets below. A river and bridge run through the right side of the scene, and rolling wooded hills and fields extend into the distance. The caption "Scharfenstein i. Erzgeb." is printed at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view of a European historic city square with a large monument and fountain in the center, surrounded by multi‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and arcades at street level. Market stalls with umbrellas and pedestrians fill the square. In the background on a hill stands a fortified wall with a prominent clock tower (the Uhrturm). The overall look is early‑20th‑century urban Europe.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a historic European town built along a small river. In the center stands a tall round stone tower on a fortified base beside a narrow bridge crossing the river. Nearby is a large Gothic‑style church with a steep spire and tall pointed windows. Surrounding them are dense clusters of traditional gabled houses with tiled roofs, set against rolling open fields in the background. The image has the framing and composition typical of an old picture postcard. No visible printed caption or text appears on the image.

Monochrome vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with a large hilltop castle complex dominating the skyline, identified as the Schloss. Below it are clustered roofs, church towers, and trees. In the foreground a river with a low weir (Muldenwehr) and a wooden structure crosses the water. The caption in German is printed at the top in red letters.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a ballerina in a long, light-colored classical tutu performing on an outdoor stage before a very large crowd. The dancer is in an elegant arabesque pose, facing a dense audience that fills the entire background. Behind the crowd are rows of trees, flagpoles with raised flags, and large multi‑story buildings with traditional European architecture. A large statue or monument is visible to the left in the distance.

Colorized postcard view of a rocky hill with the ruins of a castle on top, overlooking a river or canal with a long steamship passing by and leaving a plume of white smoke. Small houses with red roofs sit at the foot of the hill and along the valley. The scene is framed by green hills and a blue sky. Title text in German appears at the top of the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large monument dominated by a standing statue of Dante Alighieri atop a multi-tiered pedestal richly decorated with sculptural groups. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and walk around the base of the monument. Behind it are trees, a bell tower, and steep rocky mountains. At the top left is handwritten text indicating a date, and printed text at the top right names the monument.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a busy market square in front of a large Baroque-style town hall with a central tower and clock. Numerous stalls and people fill the foreground. To the right stands a substantial church with a tall tower. The caption at the bottom in German reads "Weißenfels a. S. Rathaus."

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting the entrance courtyard and towers of a large Renaissance castle complex. Steeply pitched tiled roofs, ornate gateway with statues and coat of arms, and tall spires dominate the scene. The architecture is framed by older stone houses in the foreground. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location and the castle entrance.

Colorized historic view over a European town with red‑tiled roofs along a river in the foreground. Two people stand on a riverside path. Behind the houses rises a large Gothic church with multiple tall spires and an extensive walled complex or castle. The scene is printed in a painterly style typical of early 20th‑century postcards. In the sky area at the top left is a short German caption.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large military barracks complex with several brick buildings, arcaded wings, and a tall tower surrounding an open parade ground. On the field in the foreground, soldiers are assembled in formation while an officer stands to one side. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the Prins Hendrik barracks in Nijmegen, associated with the colonial reserve.

A black‑and‑white postcard photograph showing a winter scene of old fortification walls with multiple brick arches along a snowy moat or path. Leafless trees stand on top of the walls, and a large arched gateway is visible in the background. On the right margin, there is vertical German text and a small coat of arms, suggesting it is a historical view of a European fortress structure.

A black‑and‑white panoramic photograph shows a hillside fortification with round towers and walls overlooking a dense coastal city and harbor. The image caption at the bottom identifies the view as a panoramic view of Yedi Koule in Salonica (Thessaloniki). The style and print look like an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large mural or wall painting set within a vaulted interior. The scene depicts a crowded Renaissance gathering with nobles, townspeople, children and dogs in front of a cityscape with towers in the background. The mural is framed by ornate architectural details above a decorated wooden panel and a pointed doorway. German caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large historic building with a multi‑tiered tower and onion‑shaped dome roofs, standing on a hillside. Below the structure are terraced vineyards with stone retaining walls; a lone person is working among the vines. The style of the building is Central European, reminiscent of a manor or small palace overlooking wine‑growing slopes. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

A monochrome postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic complex on a hill. In the foreground, a crowded paddle steamer sails along a broad river. On the hill above the town rises a fortified palace with multiple steep roofs and towers, next to a Gothic cathedral with tall spires. Printed text at the top left reads "Meissen – Albrechtsburg u. Dom".

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobbled town square bordered by old two‑ to three‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs. Signs on the ground‑floor shops are in German, and a horse‑drawn carriage stands in front of one building. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square. On the hillside behind the square rises a large fortified complex with long walls, gabled roofs, and a tall church spire, suggesting a historic castle or monastery dominating the scene.

A colorized historic postcard view of a riverside town with a large castle complex and cathedral on a hill above the river. In the foreground are barges and a steam-powered boat on the river, a quay with people walking, and red‑roofed houses along the bank. On the hill stand a tall round tower, an extensive palace-like building with many gables, and a Gothic church with twin spires. The sky is clear blue and the overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard. Red printed captions at the top read the town name and the names of the castle and cathedral, with an added handwritten number in red ink on the right.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large Renaissance-style riverside castle with multiple wings, towers, and a tall spire, situated on the bank of a wide river. In front of the castle is a metal bridge crossing the river. A sailing boat with two people is in the foreground, and the buildings and bridge are reflected in the calm water. The printed caption at the top reads "Torgau a. Elbe. Schloß Hartenfels".

Vintage postcard showing an open‑air theatrical performance in a large stadium filled with spectators, many holding light-colored umbrellas. In the foreground, actors in ancient-style robes perform on the track area. Greek and French captions are printed on the image, referring to a representation of Sophocles' tragedy Antigone in a stadium in Athens.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval castle perched dramatically on top of a steep rocky cliff, surrounded by tall cypress trees. In the foreground are dense palms and other lush vegetation, giving a strong contrast between the rocky height and the verdant garden below. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed text identifying the place.

A monochrome postcard showing a tall Romanesque-Gothic bell tower rising above a cluster of old stone rooftops. The tower has several stacked arcaded levels and ends in a pyramidal spire topped with a cross. A few birds sit on the foreground roofs, and the sky behind the tower is cloudy with some visible stains or damage on the photograph. There is a wide blank margin at the bottom, typical of early 20th‑century postcards.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex overlooking a river valley with terraced slopes and a factory building below. The castle sits on a steep, wooded hillside and is surrounded by substantial stone walls and towers. Printed German captions in red at the top left and right identify the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square with market stalls and umbrellas in the foreground and a grand, ornate town hall building with multiple towers and a central dome in the background. Trams, horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians populate the square, and multi‑story historic buildings with awnings line the streets. The caption printed at the top left reads "Graz. Hauptplatz, Rathaus."

Black-and-white panoramic view over a semi-industrial European town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground is a factory complex with a tall chimney and multi-storey industrial buildings. A curving road or rail corridor leads through the valley, bordered by modest houses and open fields. In the distance are more residential buildings, several multi-storey institutional-looking blocks, and church-like towers, all set against rolling cultivated hills. Trees frame the image in the front corners, giving it a composed, scenic look typical of early 20th-century postcards.

Black-and-white postcard view from a stone terrace and stairway on a hillside, shaded by a large tree, overlooking the historic rooftops and domes of a European city. In the distance are ornate buildings and church towers. Printed text at the bottom identifies the viewpoint as the Bürgerbastei on the Schlossberg in Graz.

Sepia-toned image of an ornate Gothic doorway inside a historic building. The pointed arch door is richly decorated with carved stone tracery and a patterned wooden door. On either side of the doorway hang framed portraits. To the left is a wall calendar showing 'Februar 11 Montag.' The lower margin of the card bears printed German text identifying the location as the Gothic door in the town hall of Breslau.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large Neo‑Renaissance palace‑like building with elaborate roofline, balustrades, and sculptural decoration, set behind a formal garden with lawns, flowerbeds, and pathways. Another similar institutional building stands at the right, with a monument or column in the garden between them. The setting appears to be an academic or governmental complex in a Central European city. A small number "1127-20" is printed in white in the lower right corner; no other text is visible.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a narrow cobbled street flanked by low townhouses leading to a tall church with a slender spire and cross on top. A few pedestrians stand near the church entrance. Printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Church of Saint Anne in Bruges and includes publisher information. There is also some red handwritten text near the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European spa town nestled in a valley, with dense historic buildings, church towers, colonnades and a river or canal running through the center. Forested hills rise in the background. At the bottom, red printed German text identifies the scene as "Karlsbad. Blick von Cafe Panorama." and the publisher "1315 Brück & Sohn, Meissen." The number 1315 is also handwritten in red at the top.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic square with a monumental fountain in the foreground, decorated with statues of Neptune and other figures. Behind the fountain stands a Romanesque cathedral with a rose window and tall drum-like tower, and to the left are older civic buildings lining the square. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Fontana del Nettuno in Piazza Vittorio Emanuele III in Trento.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large stone church with a tall clock tower and spire. The tower façade includes mining symbols above the clock. The building has high arched windows and a steep roof, with a small graveyard visible in the foreground. At the top of the image, printed text reads "Røros, Kirken". The style and print suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small baroque-style pavilion with an ornate roof and cupola set in landscaped gardens. On the right is a long tree-lined avenue, and a woman in late 19th- or early 20th-century dress leans against a tree holding a parasol. Red printed captions in German appear at the top and bottom of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a richly decorated Baroque crucifixion altar. At the center is a large crucifix of Jesus on the cross, surrounded by putti (cherubs), clouds, rays of light, and ornate columns. Below the crucifix stands a statue of a female saint above a framed depiction of a holy face. The text at the bottom identifies the scene as an altar in a church in Graz.

Colorized postcard view of a river scene with a side‑wheel steamship full of passengers in the foreground. Behind it rises a steep rocky hill topped by a medieval castle ruin and associated buildings, surrounded by terraced vineyards and a few houses along the riverbank. Printed text at the top reads in German about the castle ruin near Aussig.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide river scene with small rowing boats in the foreground and wooded hills on both sides. On the left bank, a town and a prominent complex on a hill (likely a castle) are visible. The printed caption at the top left in red ink reads "Leisnig i. S. Muldenpartie."

Black‑and‑white street scene of a European city with cobblestones and people in early‑20th‑century clothing. On the right stands a large, richly decorated neo‑Renaissance/Baroque palace‑like building with statues, gables and pilasters. To the left are smaller two‑storey townhouses with shopfronts and striped awnings. Various shop signs in German hang above the windows. A sign reading "APO…" (likely Apotheke, pharmacy) projects into the street on the far right. Handcarts and pedestrians populate the square in front of the grand building.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a dense Central European city with many 19th‑century buildings and several church towers. The skyline is framed by distant hills. At the bottom center of the front side, bilingual text reads in Romanian and Hungarian. The overall design, border, and print style suggest an early 20th‑century picture postcard.

Monochrome historic postcard showing a cobblestoned street lined with old stone buildings and steep gabled roofs in a medieval town. A shop in the foreground bears the sign "Franz Würfel." In the background, tall Gothic spires rise above the roofs. Printed red text at the top reads "Meißen. Am Burglehn." and at the bottom there is a publisher credit.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European city nestled in a valley surrounded by high, rugged mountains with some snow on the peaks. The foreground shows dense historic buildings, church steeples, towers and a fortified-looking structure. Handwritten text and printed captions appear along the bottom margin, including the word 'Trento' in red and a photographer's credit.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a railway line and small station in a valley, with semaphore signals and level‑crossing barriers in the foreground. Trees and a fenced property line the tracks, and in the distance, on a wooded hill, stands a large baroque palace or castle complex. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large suspension bridge over a river in an urban setting. The foreground shows landscaped gardens, paths, and fountains, while the bridge's ornate towers and approach ramps dominate the center. In the background stand church spires and city buildings. At the top are multilingual captions (Hungarian, German, and French/English) identifying the scene as the Elisabeth Bridge in Budapest and comparing its span to the Niagara Bridge.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a European town square bordered by Baroque-style buildings. In the center stands an ornate column or monument. Behind the square, on a hill covered with trees, rises a prominent clock tower with a steep roof. Handwritten-style text at the bottom reads "Graz. Karmeliterplatz mit Schlossberg-Aufgang."

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a castle-like building with a square tower and crenellated roofline, surrounded by trees and orchards in a valley landscape. The structure appears historic and fortified, and there are additional outbuildings on either side. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in Italian.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a long neoclassical palace building with arcades and many windows, set behind an open square where people in traditional dress walk and riders on horseback move across the foreground. The sky is lightly clouded. At the bottom left, a caption in French reads "Le Caire. Palais d'Abdin." There are handwritten signatures and a circular postal or archive stamp on the lower part of the card.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside town with a prominent Gothic-style castle complex on a hill above the river. A paddle steamer named "SAXONIA" travels along the river in the foreground. At the bottom in red print it is labeled with the town name and the castle, and there is a small publisher credit and number along the lower edge.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a baroque church with a tall bell tower topped by an onion-shaped dome and cross, situated along a narrow street framed by multi‑story townhouses. To the left of the church stands a slender stone obelisk or column monument with relief decorations at its base. Overhead electrical or tram wires cross the sky. The scene appears quiet with a few small figures near the monument, and there is a simple chapel-like building just behind the church tower.

Sepia-toned landscape view over a historic town in a valley framed by lush vegetation in the foreground (palms, flowering shrubs and trees) with snow‑covered Alpine mountains in the background. A tall church tower with a pointed spire dominates the center of the town, and to the right on a hillside stands a rectangular medieval tower or castle keep. The image has a white border with slightly scalloped edges, typical of vintage postcards.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large brick railway station building with arched windows and a central clock above the main entrance. A flag flies from the roof. In front of the station there is a landscaped square with flower beds, a road with an early/mid‑20th‑century car, and several pedestrians. The style and print layout suggest an early 20th‑century European postcard.

A black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a grand spa or resort complex nestled in a forested landscape. The large multi‑wing hotel and pavilion-style buildings feature mansard roofs, ornate facades, and long verandas overlooking formal gardens and walking paths crowded with elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century fashion. In the foreground runs a tree‑lined road with a horse‑drawn carriage and an early automobile. The whole scene suggests a fashionable health resort or casino in a wooded, hilly area. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front of the card.

Vintage monochrome (blue‑tinted) postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with a central octagonal dome and a tall bell tower with an onion-shaped roof, opening onto a broad square with a prominent baroque fountain in the left foreground. Decorative blank cartouche at the top and red printed captions identify the location and subject.

Colorized view of a large historic castle complex rising above dense trees. The building has thick stone walls, several round towers with conical and domed roofs, and an adjoining long white wing with a red-tiled roof and dormer windows. The sky is blue with a few clouds. At the top left, printed text reads "Wurzen. Schloss." indicating the depicted castle in the town of Wurzen.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an elevated panoramic view of Monaco. The image captures the rocky promontory of Monaco-Ville (the Old Town) jutting into the sea with dense buildings on the cliff, the harbor and coastline stretching into the distance, and hills in the background. Printed captions in French and English at the top describe it as a general view of the principality.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs from the Kriebethal/Kriebstein area. The upper left shows a country inn labelled "Gasthof Kriebethal" surrounded by trees. The upper right shows a railway line entering a truss bridge with a prominent hilltop castle in the background, captioned "Burg Kriebstein". The lower left image depicts a concrete dam with water spilling over, titled "Talsperre Kriebstein". The lower right view shows a wooded reservoir landscape with a boat on the water, captioned "Partie an d. Talsperre".

A tinted pink postcard showing a park scene with a large round medieval tower beside a waterway, trees, a small bridge, and people walking and boating. On the right is part of a grand building and handwritten cursive text. Printed captions read "Nijmegen." at the top right and "Kronenburgerpark." at the bottom center.

Sepia-toned image showing a large medieval-style clock tower on a hill, with a steep shingled roof and wooden gallery. A giant clock face is mounted on the tower wall. In the foreground, a man in traditional clothing holds a bucket while a woman in a dirndl-like dress kneels on the path, seemingly posing playfully. Below the hill a townscape stretches into the distance.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a tree-filled park with benches and people in early 20th‑century clothing. On the left stands a large monument with a tall statue of a standing figure atop a multi-tiered pedestal (the Dante monument). On the right is a bust of a man on a high plinth (Giuseppe Verdi). Distant mountains are visible beyond the trees. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a large neoclassical building set back from a broad avenue lined with trees and lampposts. The structure has a central block with columns and symmetrical wings, likely a parliamentary or governmental building. At the bottom are printed captions in Greek and French, and there is purple handwritten script across the lower margin.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a town nestled at the base of steep, terraced mountains. The foreground shows dense urban blocks with multi‑story buildings and tree‑lined streets; in the middle distance rise church towers and older stone structures typical of a historic European city. The rugged hills behind dominate the scene. In the upper right corner the caption 'TRENTO-TRIENT' is printed.

Colorized night-view postcard showing a large round red-brick tower with a steep, dark, conical roof and several smaller spires. The moon and clouds dominate the dramatic sky. At the base of the tower are lower buildings with lit windows and people in early-20th‑century clothing walking in the street near a gas streetlamp. Faint red text at the top reads a place name, and white text at the bottom right appears to be a publisher or collection mark.

Black-and-white postcard showing a historic train station building with brick walls, arched windows, and steep dark roofs with small spires and decorative ironwork. Several people stand in front of the entrance, and many bicycles are parked along the facade. In the foreground is a cobblestone square with a lamppost and a freestanding information/phone kiosk. The lower margin of the image contains the caption 'KARLSTAD. Centralstationen.'

A monochrome panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested valley. In the foreground are fields and scattered trees; behind them lies a compact village with traditional European houses and a prominent church with a steeple. On a hill above the village stands a sizable castle-like complex. The landscape extends into rolling hills in the background. The title text "Liebstadt i. S." is printed in red at the top.

A colorized historic street scene showing a large crowd of elegantly dressed people walking and riding in carriages along a broad avenue lined with trees. In the distance stands the Arc de Triomphe. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as an avenue leading to the Bois de Boulogne in Paris, along with a series number and publisher initials.

An old monochrome illustrated postcard showing a harbor scene with sailing boats moored beside a quay. In the background stands a tall stone clock tower with a pointed roof, surrounded by traditional multi‑story buildings and distant hills under large stylized clouds. At the lower right is a heraldic shield with two towers above wavy lines of water and a scroll bearing the inscription "RIVA".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town in a hilly landscape. Foreground buildings include a manor‑like structure with a round corner tower and several multi‑storey houses with steep roofs, while to the right stands a larger fortified complex or castle on higher ground. The background features terraced hills and scattered houses along a valley road. The caption at the bottom reads "Petschau." The publisher line at lower left reads "1044 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

Color postcard-style image showing a distant panoramic view of a historic European harbor city seen from across a body of water. The skyline features multiple tall, slender church spires and older masonry buildings, with port cranes and industrial structures visible along the waterfront under a partly cloudy sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a vaulted stone passageway with heavy masonry arches, likely part of an old cloister or church ruin. In the background are Gothic-style window openings without glass, and in the foreground a later-added electric lamp hangs from the stone arch. The scene has a narrow corridor feel, with rough stone walls and worn floor. Along the lower border of the postcard there is cursive text.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph shows a long Spanish Colonial style mission church with a stepped bell gable (campanario) at the front and a row of heavy buttress-like pilasters along the nave. Several bells hang in the arched openings at the top of the façade, which is topped with a cross. In front of the building are palm trees, a low white wall, and a dirt foreground, suggesting a warm, arid climate. The image has a white border and some faint, upside‑down handwritten text along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilltop complex consisting of a castle and an adjacent church tower above a forested slope. Below are winding roads and several smaller houses. The title in red Gothic-style script is printed at the top, and a vertical printer's credit appears along the right edge.

A vintage monochrome (blue-tinted) postcard showing a large brick school building in winter, with bare trees and snow on the ground. The school has several stories, many windows, and a small tower-like structure on one corner. In the background are tall church spires. There are purple postal cancellation stamps on the right side and a red handwritten number "75:" near the bottom. Printed captions beneath the image identify the location and building.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, old fortified building with high walls and a sloping roof, partially covered in vegetation. In the background stands a church tower with a clock and cross. A park-like area with trees and a path lies in the foreground. At the bottom, white printed text reads "Čakovec – Stari grad Zrinskih."

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a round stone tower or memorial building on a hilltop. The structure has a cylindrical body with small windows, a heavy cornice, and a crenellated upper section, all built of rough stone. A rectangular base with an entrance and steps leads up to it. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the entrance. Large flags with horizontal light–dark–light stripes fly on poles around the monument. Trees and a simple fence line the foreground.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand historic street in Cluj, showing a long neoclassical building with ornate façades, arched windows and Corinthian columns. To the left stands a church tower with a baroque onion dome and clock. Trees line the sidewalk and early‑ to mid‑20th‑century cars are visible on the road. The caption "CLUJ — Vedere" appears in the upper left corner.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. A road lined with trees runs along the bottom of the hill. The castle has long, sloped tiled roofs and several wings extending along the ridge. Printed captions in German appear in the lower margin, naming the location and the castle.

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road with tram tracks, lined by tall brick and stone buildings. On the left are many statues mounted on the facade of a large historic building; on the right are shopfronts with awnings. Numerous pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing and cyclists move along the street. In the distance stands a prominent historic tower and building complex in the town square. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Korte Burchtstraat."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing several sailing vessels moored along a quay. A person with a bag over their shoulder walks on the waterfront in the foreground. In the distance, part of a city waterfront is visible. Printed captions in French and English at the bottom describe the scene and identify it as Salonique/Salonica, with vessels near the quay and the White Tower.

Vintage propaganda-style postcard showing a young man in a suit holding a staff with the Latvian red‑white‑red flag, with multiple Latvian flags waving behind him. He raises his right arm in a salute. In the background are industrial scenes with cranes, smokestacks and arched bridges. At the bottom, bold text in Latvian highlights the date "15 MAIJS" and a slogan.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate hotel complex with arcaded façades and corner towers around a landscaped circular plaza with trees, lamp posts, and early 20th‑century automobiles. A central tower with a domed top rises above the building. Postal markings and cancellation are visible at the top right, and a handwritten caption appears along the bottom edge.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large Gothic church with tall pointed windows and a slender spire rising above a cobblestone street. Trees line the side of the church, and a horse-drawn carriage stands on the street corner. The lower margin has printed captions in German identifying the place and the publisher.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing an ornate museum interior with gothic architectural elements and sculpted tombs surrounded by railings. The room is richly decorated with reliefs, statues, and wall paintings. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as the guard room in the museum at Dijon, containing the tombs of the Dukes of Burgundy.

A black-and-white postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with columns and a drum-shaped dome on a small hill, with people walking along paths in front of it. To the right is the entrance to a metro station with large letters on the roof spelling out "МЕТРО" and people entering and exiting. The style and clothing suggest a mid‑20th‑century Soviet urban scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style view of a European town with a shallow river in the foreground, crossed by a simple metal truss footbridge. Along the right bank stands a row of late‑19th‑century townhouses and small apartment buildings with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the background, on a rocky hill above the town, rises a large hilltop fortress with a long, curved main building and a tall tower crowned by a statue or figure. A few pedestrians walk along the riverside promenade. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a hillside covered in terraced vineyards with scattered trees and small paths. At the foot of the hill stand several early‑20th‑century villa-style houses with gardens and fences. On the hilltop to the right there is a larger building or small castle-like structure flying a flag. The caption at the bottom left, printed in red, identifies the location as Kötzschenbroda–Niederlößnitz, and a publisher line appears beneath it.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rocky artificial grotto with a small waterfall and dense foliage in a park. In the foreground, three men sit in a rowboat on a pond in front of the grotto. Printed captions at the bottom identify the scene and the publisher.

Vintage illustrated postcard with two main vignette images framed by small green leafy branches. The left vignette shows a tall lighthouse tower labeled in French, standing by the sea with surrounding low buildings. The right vignette depicts a busy seafront promenade with colonial-style buildings, people walking, a horse‑drawn carriage, and a monument with a statue in the foreground, with ships and smoke in the harbor background. Printed captions mention Port Said and Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee, with handwritten messages over part of the card and a watermark from the website elia.org.gr.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a small Russian Orthodox church with a large onion dome topped by a Russian Orthodox cross. The façade has ornate arches and columns framing the main doorway, above which is an icon painting of religious figures set in a curved niche. The building is enclosed by a low fence along a quiet street with early 20th‑century style lampposts. Hills or wooded slopes are visible in the background.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a European city with a river running through the center, lined with trees and multi‑story buildings on both banks. Several bridges cross the river. On the left shore a building shows the sign "HOTEL FLORIAN". On the right side, a hill rises with a fortification or castle-like complex and a tower on top, overlooking the city. Mountains are visible in the distant background. The top left corner has the printed word "Graz".

Colorized vintage view along a river lined with multi‑story European buildings on both banks. In the background rises a steep, green hill crowned with fortifications and a prominent clock tower. Multiple bridges cross the river. The caption printed in red at the top right reads "Graz. Mur, Schloßberg."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural landscape with a wooden fence in the foreground, trees and open field, and a large church building with a central dome and cross in the middle right. To the left stands a separate bell tower topped with a cross. At the top of the card there is a printed caption in a decorative font.

Colorized historic postcard showing a tall rectangular stone clock tower with multiple stories and arched windows. A clock face is visible near the top and several flags fly from the roof. At the base of the tower, a crowd of people is gathered. The sky is tinted pink and blue. Multilingual captions (French, Ottoman Turkish, and German) are printed at the top, and a small logo or URL appears near the bottom.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing exterior and interior scenes of a historic castle complex. The upper row presents three different views of a stone castle with towers, gables and steep roofs, surrounded by trees and forested hills. The lower row shows two interior rooms furnished as a dining hall and lounge, with wooden ceilings, tables, chairs and armchairs. In the center is a black panel with German text identifying the place as Schloss Reinsberg and mentioning a holiday home of the VEB Kombinat Schwarze Pumpe.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Gothic-style town church with tall pointed windows, steeply pitched roof, and a small spire at the front. At the rear right are two baroque-style tower structures. Trees and a few surrounding buildings are visible in the foreground. The printed captions at the top read "Pegau." on the left and "Stadtkirche." on the right.

A black‑and‑white, likely early 20th‑century postcard-style photograph showing a large Gothic and Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The church has one massive Gothic tower at the west end, a long nave with flying buttresses and pointed windows, and a Romanesque‑looking east end with two large rose windows and round‑arched details. Smaller towers and surrounding multi‑story European townhouses frame the scene, with a tree‑lined open space in the foreground. No printed caption or handwriting is visible on the image.

Color photograph of a large Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The church has pale stone walls, a tall octagonal dome-tower topped with a cross, an ornate façade with a large rose window, and an attached porch with arches and columns. Adjacent buildings have medieval stonework and crenellations. Several 1960s–1970s European cars are parked in the open square in front. Mountains rise in the background under a clear blue sky.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a European town with church spires and traditional buildings in the lower half, and, in a whimsical photomontage, a woman in early 20th‑century dress floating above the town holding an umbrella and a handbag. The caption at the bottom is printed in red German text, along with a publisher line and date.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a narrow street with groups of people standing and walking. At the center stands an ornate neo‑Gothic structure with pointed arches and pinnacles, built into a raised terrace and staircase. Historic buildings and a gatehouse line the street on the left, with trees on the right. At the bottom margin, printed red text reads the city name and a description of the place, with a handwritten signature below.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an inner courtyard with arched colonnades and latticework in an Islamic architectural style. A central fountain stands in the middle of the open courtyard. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a courtyard of the Bahia Palace in Marrakech, and a small credit reads "Photo Flandrin."

Illustrated sepia-toned postcard showing a detailed drawing of a large historic castle with multiple steeply pitched roofs and towers rising above dense trees. At the bottom is printed German text identifying the site, with space left blank for a message, and a small artist's signature on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view showing a busy harbor with several steamships and smaller boats docked along a quay. Crates and goods are stacked on the pier, with people walking and working. Across the water stands a large, ornate palace-like building and a dense row of multi‑story historic buildings behind it. The scene is urban and clearly northern European. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location in Swedish.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large lattice steel arch bridge with massive stone towers crossing a wide river. Below the bridge runs a railway line with several freight cars in the foreground. On the river a paddle steamer with passengers is visible. The caption "Riesa. Elbbrücke." appears printed at the top left.

Black‑and‑white night view of a richly decorated Baroque palace complex, illuminated against a dark sky. The long façade has tall arched windows and a balustrade lined with statues. At the center stands an ornate pavilion crowned by a large, onion‑shaped dome topped with a crown. In the foreground is a moat or canal crossed by a simple wooden bridge leading toward the palace wall.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large Gothic and Gothic‑revival cathedral complex with twin ornate spires rising from a fortified hilltop ensemble of long, steep‑roofed buildings. The complex stands above a slope planted with what appear to be vineyards, and is surrounded by trees and smaller historic buildings. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

An illustrated view of a European old town square with cobblestone streets and gabled houses. The buildings have steep red-tiled roofs and light-colored facades, with some shopfronts at street level. In the background rises a tall, slender church spire in Baroque style. The perspective shows a quiet intersection of streets framed by historic merchant houses. There is a small signature of the artist at the bottom.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a rural tree-lined road labeled "Mariatosterstrasse". On the left is part of a house with a tiled roof; on the right runs a fenced path bordered by tall conifer trees. In the distance, partially obscured by trees, stands a church-like building with a tower on a hill. The overall style suggests an early 20th-century European scene.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing a cobblestone street with pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background is a large multi‑storey building complex with a steep tiled roof and many chimneys, identified as a castle or palace. Trees and a low wall with gate pillars line the street. On the right edge stands a substantial building facade. The caption at the bottom reads in German, indicating the view is of Hofgasse street with the castle in Graz.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with wooden and stone houses. Many children and a few adults stand and walk along the street. In the distance rises a large church tower with a clock and dome. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as a street named Norra Kyrkogatan in Vänersborg.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard view of a grand railway station with large arched glass train sheds and a central domed entrance building. The station stands on an elevated viaduct with arches, overlooking a broad open square where early 20th‑century trams and horse-drawn or early motor vehicles are visible. At the top left, the printed caption reads "Dresden — Hauptbahnhof."

Color postcard view of a hilltop complex with red-tiled roofs and a large Gothic church with twin spires, likely a cathedral, rising above surrounding historic buildings and a cylindrical tower. In the foreground, people walk across a small bridge or street with red‑and‑white railings and traffic signs, under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

A colorized postcard view of a European city along a turquoise river, with a bridge crossing the water and rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs on both banks. A steep hill rises behind the city, crowned by fortification walls and buildings, and to the right is a prominent clock tower on the hillside. Mountains are faintly visible in the background. The caption at the top is in German and identifies the scene as Graz with the Schlossberg and the Schöckl.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a town with several large, old buildings and a stone bridge crossing the river. The buildings resemble a historic castle or manor complex along the riverbank, with trees and gardens in the foreground and gentle hills in the background. Printed text in German appears at the top left.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a church with a prominent onion-shaped dome and a square bell tower in the foreground, surrounded by a metal fence along a street where a few people in traditional dress are walking. Printed multilingual captions at the bottom identify the scene as the Church of Saint Sophia in Salonica (north‑west view).

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town dominated by a large medieval stone church surrounded by trees. The church has a steep gabled roof and a separate wooden belfry with a pointed roof. Around it lie wooden houses, a larger multi‑storey building in the foreground, open fields and farmland in the distance. In the bottom left corner the word "LOHJA" and the number "2760" are printed.

Monochrome postcard showing an interior view of an armory hall filled with suits of plate armor and helmets. In the foreground on the right is a life‑size armored horse with a rider's armor, set on a low platform. To the left and in the background are rows of standing armors and many helmets hanging from the ceiling. The caption printed at the bottom reads in German and mentions Graz and the Landeszeughaus (provincial armory).

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a valley town surrounded by wooded hills. In the left foreground stands an ornate, turreted structure with pointed arches and decorative tile roof, described as a ruin, while below and to the right lie clustered houses, a main street with tram or rail tracks, and a small formal garden. The image is captioned in red Gothic-style script at the top.

Black‑and‑white view of a large cobblestoned town square bordered by multi‑storey historic buildings. On the right is a town hall with a clock‑tower topped by a weather vane; at street level a sign reads "Ratskeller." Across the square are several shops and businesses with German signage painted on their facades. A fountain or monument stands near the center of the square, and a church spire rises in the background. A few pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across the otherwise empty square.

A colorized winter cityscape shows a street and tram line descending between snow‑covered trees toward a small square. In the middle distance stands a cylindrical red‑brick tower with a conical, snow‑covered roof and an attached lighter building. Further back rises a distinctive church with an onion‑shaped golden dome and lantern. People and an old tram are visible on the street, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European city.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a broad town square with people walking and several horse-drawn carriages. On the left stands an ornate town hall with a stepped gable facade and an attached clock tower. Behind it rise two tall Gothic church towers and the large roof of a church. Surrounding the square are traditional multi‑story buildings with steep roofs. Decorative German text is printed at the top and along the left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad river with a stone embankment in the foreground. A paddle steamship with a smoking funnel moves along the water. Across the river stands a large castle-like complex with high walls, a round corner tower and several tall spires and roofs, behind a line of trees and lower houses. To the left a multi‑span iron bridge crosses the river. The sky area on the upper left is heavily damaged or overexposed, leaving a large white blotch.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside view of a historic European town. In the foreground is a weir and rocky river (the Spree). Along the riverbank stand multi‑storey houses and small timber‑frame buildings, with a low bridge and people walking by the water. Behind them rises a fortified town with stone walls, taller buildings, and a prominent church tower. Printed German captions at the top label the view with location details, and a vertical imprint on the right margin shows the publisher information.

Color postcard-style view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is an ornate iron bridge and riverside promenade with a few pedestrians and decorative lampposts. Across the river stand several historic multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and, to the right, a tall church tower with a distinctive onion-shaped dome. Behind the city rises a green hill topped with structures, including a prominent clock tower on the slope. The overall look suggests an early-20th‑century printed postcard of a central European town.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic church dominating a cobbled town square. The building has a tall central tower with a baroque onion-shaped dome topped by a slender spire and cross. The lower tower and west front are in a more Romanesque/early Gothic style with small arched windows and a decorative roundel, while the long nave to the right has pronounced Gothic buttresses and pinnacles. A few small figures stand on the square, and plain multi‑storey townhouses frame the background.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a European market square with tram tracks running through a cobbled street. On the left is an arched passageway with posters and a standing figure in shadow. On the right are tall historic buildings with gabled facades and window boxes. In the distance stands a church-like tower with a clock and baroque spire rising above surrounding houses. Outdoor tables or stalls line the square. Handwritten-style German text is printed beneath the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a narrow canal flanked by tall multi‑story buildings with many windows. Laundry hangs from some windows and balconies extend over the water. In the distance, a prominent neo‑Gothic church spire rises above the surrounding buildings. At the bottom margin, cursive text identifies the location as a canal (Fleet) near Stockelhörn and St. Nikolai Church in Hamburg.

Colorized panoramic view of a European city with dense red‑roofed buildings in the foreground and midground. In the center rises a steep hill topped with fortification‑like buildings and a tower, surrounded by trees. Rolling green hills and low mountains form the backdrop. At the very top left of the front side appears a printed caption in German.

A two-image postcard mounted on a white background. The left image shows a stone castle with round towers situated on a small island in a calm lake, viewed from the water with rocks and shoreline in the foreground. The right image shows the castle's interior: a stone hall with vaulted brick ceilings, arched niches, and wooden benches along the walls. At the top of the card are printed and handwritten Finnish words indicating the location and an archive reference.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing an early‑20th‑century urban avenue with tram tracks, overhead trolley wires, pedestrians, and vintage automobiles. On the left are mid‑rise commercial buildings with signs and posters; one large storefront awning reads "GRAN ORIENTAL." On the right dominates an ornate multi‑story building with heavy classical columns, balconies, awnings, and a bustling sidewalk beneath. People in period clothing (hats, long dresses, suits) walk along the street.

Sepia-toned interior view of an elaborately carved wooden choir with two tiers of relief panels and choir stalls along the walls. The image shows richly decorated religious scenes and figures, with numerous carved seats at the bottom. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as the choir of San Martín in Santiago and credit the editor Varela, Óptico.

Black‑and‑white landscape view framed by trees, showing a hilltop baroque church complex with twin towers and a large dome above a rural village and fields. At the top of the image there is printed text reading "Mariatrost bei Graz." The scene looks like an early 20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large Gothic cathedral with a very tall central spire, flanked by smaller towers and steeply pitched roofs. The building rises above trees in the foreground, with hills or a hazy landscape in the distance. Text identifying the cathedral and the publisher is printed on the image.

Colorized vintage view of a landscaped park area with a brick arched bridge and a tower-like belvedere building partially hidden by trees. A man in old-fashioned clothing stands on a path in the foreground, with a streetlamp and an advertising column nearby. At the top left, printed in red and black, it reads "NIJMEGEN. Belvédère."

Colorized historic postcard showing a grand baroque-style manor or small palace on a hill with a red roof and dormer windows, surrounded by lush landscaped gardens. In the foreground there is a round fountain pool with several arched water jets and flower beds. Below the image, German cursive text identifies the place.

A tinted historic postcard showing a central square with a large church or basilica complex featuring a tall clock tower with a steep spire and several smaller spires and red-tiled roofs. The foreground is an open plaza, and surrounding buildings include a house with arcades on the left and another with business signage on the right. The bottom margin contains printed greeting text in a Slavic language and the publisher's credit.

Illustrated postcard showing an ornate Baroque/Neo-Baroque palace complex with statues along the balustrades, tall arched windows, and a prominent green dome in the background. The architecture is drawn in a simplified, poster-like style with beige walls and a blue sky. Text in Hungarian and German appears at the bottom margin, along with the city name.

A black‑and‑white night view across a river toward an illuminated Baroque cityscape. Dominating the scene is a tall, ornate church tower attached to a large, richly decorated building complex; other historic buildings with domes and spires stretch along the waterfront. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and the water in the foreground reflects the city lights.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic building with a small tower and ornate cupola, likely a baroque or late‑renaissance structure. The house has multiple stories, shuttered windows, an arched loggia on the ground floor, and a steep tiled roof. Leafless trees and a garden or park area surround the building, with other houses visible in the background. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as the Minoriten-Schlössel near the Volksgarten in Graz.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a large mosque, filled with hanging lamps, chandeliers, high domes, arches, and ornate details. At the bottom there is printed caption text identifying the location, along with a small website watermark.

A colored vintage postcard view of a European city square lined with multi‑story historic buildings and red-tiled roofs. In the foreground is a busy public square with market stalls, people walking, a central monument/statue on a pedestal, and a tram. In the background, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower and fortification. The style is early 20th-century. At the top left is printed text reading "Graz. Hauptplatz." Various shop signs are visible on the buildings around the square.

Black-and-white postcard showing a countryside church complex with a tall, separate bell tower on the left and a steep‑roofed stone church on the right, surrounded by trees and a low stone wall. In the bottom left corner, white caption text reads "Kalix Kyrka." The overall style suggests an early–mid 20th century photographic postcard.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a townscape with blooming trees in the foreground, small houses with red roofs, and a prominent church complex on a hill. The church has steep red gabled roofs and a tall tower with several stages and a small cupola at the top. A wooden fence and path lead up the slope. Printed German text at the top identifies the scene and viewpoint.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a small Orthodox-style monastery with a domed church and arched colonnade. Trees and a dirt courtyard occupy the foreground, with a couple of figures walking near the colonnade. The border is cream-colored with printed captions in French and English beneath the image, and there is a publisher credit along the lower left edge.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large historic building complex with multiple wings and sloping tiled roofs, partly obscured by trees and greenery in the foreground. The architecture resembles a Central European castle or manor house. At the bottom, in red print, there is German text identifying the place and the publisher with a date.

A vintage postcard designed to look like the front page of the Portuguese newspaper "O Seculo". In the middle, a torn-paper effect reveals a black‑and‑white photograph of a large Gothic‑Manueline monastery with towers and an ornate façade. Below the image, another torn opening contains the printed caption "Lisboa. Mosteiro dos Jeronymos." The rest of the visible page is dense Portuguese newspaper text with the masthead "O SECULO" at the top.

Sepia-toned winter scene showing a snowy hillside with trees and a bench in the foreground, overlooking a town in the distance. Dominating the background is a large cathedral with multiple towers, partially obscured by mist. At the bottom of the image, handwritten-style text identifies the location.

Sepia-toned aerial photograph of a European city center showing a large tree-lined square with a prominent monumental building on one side, surrounded by dense blocks of historical buildings and streets. In the top-right corner, white text reads "GRAZ AUS DER LUFT" indicating an aerial view of Graz.

A colorized historic postcard view of a European cityscape dominated by a large white church with a tall clock tower and spire. The church stands behind a row of multi‑story residential buildings with red-tiled roofs, lining a tree‑planted street or square in the foreground. The background shows additional rooftops, chimneys, and distant low hills under a pale blue sky. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Graz. Josefsirche" (likely intended as "Josefkirche").

Sepia-toned postcard showing an ancient stone gateway built of massive blocks. Above the lintel is a relief sculpture of two opposing lions flanking a central column, known as the Lion Gate of Mycenae. Through the gate a rocky passage and a metal fence are visible. Printed text appears along the bottom margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestoned town square with a central circular flowerbed surrounded by a low metal fence and a tall pedestal bearing a bust statue. Traditional two‑story buildings with awnings line the square, and mature trees form a backdrop; a tower with a cupola rises behind them. Several people, including a child in the foreground, stand near the monument. In the lower left corner, there is a dark label with white handwritten-style text.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a small town with open fields in the foreground. On a hill behind the town sits a large medieval castle complex with several towers. To the left of the castle is a tall church with a slender spire rising above the clustered town houses. Trees frame the scene at the bottom and right edges. In the upper left corner, printed text reads "Stolpen i. Sa."

A black‑and‑white nighttime photograph of a large fortified castle with a massive round tower on the left and a long facade of multi‑story buildings with many rectangular windows and crenellated battlements. The structure sits above high stone walls with some trees below. The building is dramatically lit from below against a dark sky, with no visible people or vehicles. The print has a thin dark border with a slightly scalloped edge, typical of vintage postcards.

Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a wooded path with bushes and trees on both sides and a wooden bench in the foreground on the right. Through an opening in the foliage, a baroque-style church tower with an onion-shaped spire and clock can be seen rising above the roof of a large building complex in a valley, with hills in the distant background.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a row of tall ancient columns, the ruins of a classical Greek temple set in an open landscape with low hills in the background. The caption beneath the image is printed in French and Greek and identifies the site as the Temple of Jupiter in Athens. There is also a modern website watermark on the lower right.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic building with multiple wings and a steep tiled roof, reflected in a calm body of water in the foreground. Trees and shrubs surround the structure. The main building resembles a castle or manor house built on a small rise. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an ornate multi‑storey corner building with richly decorated facades and a tall, elaborate dome-like roof tower. Awnings cover the ground-floor windows, likely of a café or hotel, and a person and a horse-drawn carriage are visible on the cobbled street in front. At the bottom margin, red printed Hungarian text identifies the location and the building.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a European city on a river. A multi-arch stone bridge crosses the water, with numerous moored riverboats below. On the left stands a tall baroque-style church tower; near the center is a grand neoclassical theater building; in the background is a high tower and several other domes and spires. The word "Dresden." is printed at the upper left of the image.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a full-length statue of a man in 19th‑century dress, standing with one foot raised on a rock and one hand on his hip. The statue stands on a tall stone pedestal with text carved on the front. At the base are numerous floral wreaths and bouquets. Leafless trees and some indistinct buildings appear in the background, suggesting an urban park in late autumn or early spring.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Baroque-style country house or small palace behind a gate, framed by dense trees on both sides of a driveway. The building has a long façade with many windows, dormers in the roof, and a central pediment above the main entrance. At the bottom margin of the image is a handwritten-style caption in German.

Black-and-white (slightly tinted) postcard view of a long, rectangular historic building with a steep tiled roof and multiple dormer windows. A small tower with a clock or bell and spire rises from the roof. The building is partly screened by trees and shrubs, with an open lawn in the foreground. At the top left, red printed text reads "Elsterwerda. Schloss." indicating the depicted site.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large medieval-style castle with towers and crenellated walls perched dramatically on top of a high, stratified limestone cliff. Dense forest covers the slopes below the cliff. In the foreground is a calm river with several small rowboats carrying people in early-20th‑century clothing and hats, suggesting leisure boating. The overall style is scenic and romantic, with no visible printed text on the image side.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a large stone church with a tall clock tower and greenish roof, set among trees and in front of a row of multi‑story urban buildings. The sky is bright with scattered clouds. The words "Göteborg" and "Vasakyrkan" are printed at the top, indicating the church depicted.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a European city in the mid‑20th century. A tram marked with the number 2 runs along a busy avenue lined with multistory buildings, awnings, shopfronts, and pedestrians. Several 1930s–1940s style cars are on the road. In the background stands a large cylindrical brick water tower with decorative columns and a conical roof. On the right side of the image a vertical shop sign reads "SALAMANDER." The print has a white border with slightly deckled edges, typical of old postcards.

Sepia-toned historic view of a large brick railway station with decorative striping, gables, and towers. Horse-drawn carriages stand in front of the building and a clock is visible above the entrance canopy. At the bottom margin, printed text reads "Station — Nijmegen."

Color-tinted postcard view of a riverside promenade lined with large trees and benches, with people walking along the quay. Across the river stand multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the background rises a wooded hill topped by fortification walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill is a prominent tower with a large clock face. The printed caption in red at the top left reads "Murquai mit Schlossberg."

A colorized historical postcard showing a large monument to Dante Alighieri in an open square, with mountains in the background. The multi-tiered pedestal is decorated with reliefs and statues, topped by a standing figure of Dante with one arm raised. At the base are additional allegorical figures, including a winged lion. A bell tower and buildings are visible behind trees, and several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand around the monument. The words 'Trento' and 'Monumento a Dante' are printed at the top.

Black-and-white postcard view of a church with a tall clock tower topped by a spire and cross. The church has a large, multi-faceted metal roof and is surrounded by manicured hedges and trees, with stone steps and a path leading up through a landscaped garden. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. In front of the cathedral stands an ornate baroque fountain with statues and flowing water. On the left is a smaller fountain topped by a bird sculpture. A tall bell tower with an onion-shaped dome rises on the right side of the cathedral. A few people in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the cobbled square. At the top of the card, printed in red, is the title indicating the location.

Colorized vintage view of a bustling European market square with stalls, carts, and numerous people in early 20th‑century clothing. Tall, narrow gabled houses surround the square, and a prominent church tower rises in the background. On the right are multi‑story buildings with signage for cafés and shops. The caption at the bottom left reads "Nijmegen, Groote Markt."

Color image of a monumental baroque fountain in a large city square. The fountain features dramatic sculpted male river gods and rock formations with water pouring into a circular basin, topped by an obelisk. Surrounding the fountain are historic multi‑story buildings with warm-colored facades and people walking around the square.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a Baroque pilgrimage church and complex on a hillside, with multiple domes and spires above arcaded walls and a sloping grassy foreground. Printed red captions in Czech appear beneath the image, and a red manuscript number is written in the top right corner.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilly, wooded landscape with a small town. On the hilltop stands a large fortified complex resembling a castle alongside a church with a tower or dome. Below, near a road, there are a couple of standalone houses or industrial-style buildings. The printed caption at the top reads "Wolkenstein i. Erzgeb." in German.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a sloping market street in a small European town, looking toward a large Gothic-style church with a tall spire in the background. Multi‑story buildings line both sides of the street; signs on them advertise an apothecary and a business named Carl Sprotte. People are walking and working on the street, with a horse-drawn cart visible. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene, and a vertical imprint on the right margin credits a printer and the year 1905.

A monochrome postcard-style image showing a medieval European walled town with multiple round defensive towers and a very tall, slender church spire rising above the rooftops. Trees and a park or open green space frame the view in the foreground, while the fortified walls and towers form a continuous line across the middle of the image. The photograph has an old-fashioned, slightly sepia look. No visible caption or writing appears on the front.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, rectangular, three‑storey villa with simple neoclassical lines, a glazed veranda, and several tall chimneys. The house stands above a stone wall and dense trees, next to a broad paved terrace bordered by a metal railing. To the right, along the wall, is a small round watchtower with a conical roof, resembling part of a fortification or castle enceinte. Hills or mountains are faintly visible in the distant background. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a narrow cobblestone road lined with multi‑story buildings with shutters and balconies. At the end of the street stands a prominent church with a tall bell tower and dome. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. At the bottom edge, printed text identifies the scene as Trento – Via Camillo Cavour.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large neo‑Renaissance palace‑like public building on a corner by a riverside or canal. The structure has three main stories plus an attic, richly decorated façades, arched windows on the ground floor, pilasters, statues, and a central clock set in a mansard roof with ornate corner towers and spires. In front, horse‑drawn carriages travel along the street beside an embankment wall and an ornate streetlamp, suggesting a late‑19th or early‑20th‑century European city scene.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four photographs of historic buildings and cityscapes. The upper left shows a large ornate institutional building along a broad street. The upper right shows a substantial city hall–type structure dominated by a tall clock tower. The lower left image is a riverfront panorama with stone bridge arches and Baroque church and civic buildings along the opposite bank. The lower right image features an elaborate Baroque pavilion with rich sculptural decoration and large windows, with another domed building visible in the distant background.

Color postcard showing the standing Doric columns of an ancient temple ruin in a rural landscape with a large mountain in the background. At the top there is bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the site as the Temple of Apollo at ancient Corinth. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white image of a landscaped city park with flowerbeds and trimmed hedges surrounding a central statue. Behind the park stand multi‑storey 19th‑century apartment buildings with mansard roofs. The name "Tadeusz Kościuszko" is visible on the base of the monument.

Colored postcard showing an evening riverside scene with moored steamships in the foreground and an arched steel bridge spanning a wide river in the background.
