Black-and-white postcard showing a large tanker ship sailing through a broad waterway in front of an ornate, white, domed building with arcaded facades on the waterfront. The shoreline behind is densely built with mid‑rise urban buildings. The scene suggests a busy harbor or canal city, photographed from an elevated vantage point.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large two‑towered church building viewed from the street. The tall, plain towers have steep roofs and small arched windows. At the front is an ornate entrance portal with a round window above it, opening onto a town square with a few small figures. At the top in red Gothic-style print is the caption identifying the location and the church.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a view of Schloss Weesenstein, a castle with a tall tower and clock, standing on a hill above trees and a small arched bridge over a stream in a valley. The image has printed red text at the top left identifying the place.

Colorized vintage image showing a Gothic-style church facade with pointed arches, ornate tracery, and a large central portal, next to a tall bell tower with a clock. A few people stand in the square in front. The sky is softly tinted and there is printed text at the top right identifying the location.

A colorized vintage view of a formal garden with palm trees, manicured hedges, and a curving gravel path. In the background stands a neoclassical building with columns. At the top left there is red text in Greek and French, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.

A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignette scenes of a historic European city, featuring parks, ruins, a tower, streets with horse‑drawn carriages, and surrounding countryside. Decorative flowers frame the images. Large stylized text reads "GROETE uit NIJMEGEN," suggesting it is a greeting from the city of Nijmegen. Individual scenes are labeled in Dutch, including a ruin, parks, a railway street, and views of nearby areas.

Monochrome image showing a Renaissance-style courtyard staircase attached to a substantial stone building. The double-flight exterior stairs have balustrades and are supported by heavy columns with arches beneath. At the top of the stairs stand three slender pinnacles or obelisks. In the background are vaulted loggias with rounded arches and balustrades on the upper floor, and a decorated ceiling in the upper arcade. The scene appears to be an inner courtyard of a historical civic or palace building in a European city. There is no printed caption or visible handwriting on the image side.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a coastal scene with a large round stone tower, crenellated at the top, standing by the waterfront. Small boats float in the foreground near a quay, and low houses line the shore behind the tower. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location and landmark.

Black-and-white historic postcard view of a city street with a large multi-story museum building in the foreground and a tall, ornate tower rising in the background. Small figures walk across an open square or wide street. The upper left of the card bears the place name 'Bautzen.' and the upper right identifies the scene as 'Museum u. Reichenturm.'

A monochrome postcard showing an interior view of an ornate building with arches, columns, balconies, and richly decorated walls. The architecture has a historic, possibly Byzantine or Ottoman style. The image is centered on a cream border with printed captions beneath the photo in two languages.

A monochrome, old-style printed postcard showing a central European town square. The scene is a drawing rather than a photograph, with baroque‑style buildings surrounding an open cobbled plaza. In the middle stands a small fenced monument or column. To the right is a church with a distinctive large onion dome topped by a star and cross, and an attached porch with arches. Behind it rises a square bell tower with a hipped roof. On the left is a long multi‑windowed building with a small turret and cross, possibly a monastery or civic building, and a vaulted gateway leading out of the square. Low wooded hills form the background. Very small text is printed at the bottom edge of the image, partly readable as dates and words but not entirely clear.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square dominated by a tall church tower with a clock and a steep, multi‑tiered spire topped by a weather vane. Around the base of the tower stand 2–3 story houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. Shop signs in German are visible at street level, and a few people in early 20th‑century dress stand or walk in the open square. The upper sky area appears overexposed or masked, emphasizing the tower silhouette.

Black‑and‑white, vertically oriented street view of a European town, showing a cobblestone main street lined with two‑ and three‑story buildings. At the left stands a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped spire topped by a cross and a clock on its facade. People in early‑20th‑century clothing, including children, walk or stand along the street. Shop signs hang from several buildings, but the resolution prevents reading them clearly. The sky is blank and overexposed, emphasizing the silhouette of the church tower.

A vintage monochrome postcard illustration of a busy European city square with tram tracks curving through the cobblestone street in the foreground. The central focus is an ornate, multi‑story Renaissance building with richly decorated façade and arcades at street level. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather around the square. Adjacent buildings have shop signs, including one advertising a ladies' clothing shop (Damen‑Hüte). A handwritten caption at the bottom identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a large historic building in a courtyard setting, likely a palace or manor house. The structure has steep, tiled gabled roofs, ornate Baroque or late‑Renaissance gables, many rectangular windows, and ivy climbing the façade. On the right stands a central clock tower with a domed roof and lantern, topped by a weather vane. An arched gateway appears on the left, also decorated and framed by stone. Trees line the right side of the open courtyard in front of the building. The image is bordered in white like a printed postcard. No legible printed caption is visible.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by forested mountains. The fortified walls, towers, and main castle buildings stretch along a ridge above a valley. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text indicating the location and altitude of the castle.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town with a bridge over the river, several boats and barges along the quay, and red-roofed buildings at the water's edge. A wooded hill rises behind the town, topped by a church-like building. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Meissen. Martinsberg." and there is a red handwritten number "384" in the top right margin. Along the left border is vertical publisher text.

A colorized historical postcard view showing a section of massive stone city walls with multiple round towers, identified as the 'Sept Tours' of Constantinople. In front of the fortifications are several multi‑story houses with red and light roofs surrounded by greenery. The sky is blue with some clouds, and there is printed text at the top and a website watermark at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the city of Graz with the Mur River in the foreground and the Schlossberg hill with its fortress and clock tower in the background. The cityscape is framed by a decorative border of alpine flowers (likely edelweiss). On the right side, there is a Tyrolean-style hat with a feather and a cloth bag tied with a cord, adding an alpine folk motif. The caption in German appears above the view.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a city seen from a wooded hillside. In the middle distance is a prominent hill with fortification-like structures on top, surrounded by a dense urban area and fields in the foreground. Bare tree trunks and branches frame the image. A caption centered in the lower white border reads "Graz."

Colorized view of a grand Baroque palace complex with richly decorated façades and a prominent entrance pavilion topped by a large greenish dome-crown with a golden crown ornament. A wooden bridge crosses a water-filled moat or canal in front of the building, and a flower garden with red blossoms occupies the foreground. The image has the typical printed look and proportions of a vintage tourism postcard. No visible printed text appears on the front.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large medieval church surrounded by trees and greenery. The church has red-tiled roofs, stepped gables and a tall central tower with a white midsection and darker dome-like top. At the top of the card there is printed German text giving the place and a note that the main church was built around the year 1225.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a narrow man‑made canal cut through high rocky cliffs, with a ship passing between them. The sky is pale and the steep rock walls dominate both sides. Printed multilingual captions at the top identify the scene as the Canal of Corinth. A website watermark (www.elia.org.gr) appears across the lower part of the image.

Black‑and‑white winter view of a narrow snow‑covered medieval street running between a high rough stone wall on the right and lower houses on the left. Heavy snow lies on roofs and the roadway where two small human figures walk away from the camera. In the background rises a large round stone tower with a conical roof, part of a city wall. An ornate wall‑mounted street lamp projects over the lane.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an ornate Baroque pavilion opening onto a formal garden. The central building has a richly decorated façade with large arched windows, sculpted figures, and a domed roof topped by a sphere. Curved arcades with repeated arches extend to both sides, enclosing the garden. Manicured paths, hedges, and topiary trees line the foreground, with a few small human figures near the entrance for scale.

A black‑and‑white harbor scene showing a busy quay with several steamships and smaller boats moored along the pier. People, early automobiles, and horse‑drawn carts move along a cobblestone waterfront with tram tracks. Across the wide river or harbor are shipyards with large cranes and industrial facilities. In the lower‑right corner is a circular printer's mark that reads "ÄKTA FOTO" with stylized initials in the center.

Color illustration of an old European building with arched arcades at street level and richly painted façades depicting animals, horses, and human figures. The upper stories have green wooden shutters and small wrought‑iron balconies. On the left is the rounded apse and dome of an adjacent church. A small fountain with a statue stands in front of the arcades, and a few people are visible in the square. The card has no visible caption or writing on the image side.

A colored vintage postcard view over a coastal town showing a historic Ottoman complex with domed roofs and a minaret near the waterfront. Old stone walls descend toward a harbor with several sailing ships anchored. The sea stretches into the background. Greek and Latin text titles identify the scene as the Imaret of Kavala, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a large neoclassical basilica with a central dome and towers, surrounded by a cobblestone square and small trees. At the top of the card, in red text, it identifies the location as Budapest and labels the building as a basilica in several languages.

Sepia-toned street view of a European city with a tramcar running along a narrow street lined with multi‑storey buildings and shop awnings. In the background rises a tall Baroque church tower with an onion-shaped dome. People are visible on the sidewalks. Faint printed caption text appears along the top margin, and additional small commercial signs and posters are visible on the right-hand buildings.

Illustrated view of a European town square with market stalls and white umbrellas surrounding a central statue on a fountain. The square is bordered by multi-storey historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and shop signs in German. On the hill behind the square stands a fortified clock tower with a steep roof, overlooking the town.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with three photographic views of the city of Pécs, Hungary. The top image is a panoramic view of the old town with church towers and surrounding hills. The lower left image shows a large cathedral with four towers and a terraced fountain or steps in the foreground. The lower right image depicts a lively public square with a decorative fountain in the center, surrounded by buildings and people. The front caption reads in Hungarian: "ÜDVÖZLET PÉCSRŐL!" ("Greetings from Pécs!"). The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, printed word "PÉCS." at top left, an address to Budapest on the right, and two Hungarian postage stamps overprinted with the year 1945.

The postcard shows a color photograph of a historic Ottoman-era mosque with a stone dome and a tall slender minaret rising behind it. The reverse side has multilingual printed captions identifying the mosque, standard postcard address lines, stamp boxes, and publisher information in Hungarian.

Color postcard showing a central square with a large domed building, a former mosque now church, in the middle. In the foreground are flower beds, steps, and people walking or sitting. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a view over a central square dominated by a tall Baroque column/monument surrounded by a low fence and steps. The reverse side shows handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a Hungarian postage stamp labeled "MAGYAR POSTA," and a small publisher's mark mentioning Budapest.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand Romanesque cathedral with four towers at the far end of a terraced fountain garden and promenade. The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, address lines, a circular postmark mentioning "Pécs," and a Budapest printer's mark.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. The front shows a long Romanesque cathedral façade with arched windows, colonnades, statues on the upper level, and a tall bell tower with a spire and cross. The reverse side has a green Hungarian postage stamp, a circular postmark, printed postcard layout lines, handwritten Hungarian address to Budapest, and a short handwritten message.

Colorized historic postcard showing a busy central square with a large stone monument in the middle, horse‑drawn carriages, people walking and trading, and a tram. POSTA" and "10 FILLÉR".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a divided back. A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing several landmarks of a Central European city: a fountain in a busy square, grand historic civic buildings with domes and towers, a hillside hotel or sanatorium surrounded by forest, and stone ruins framed by an arch. The reverse has printed text on the left, a handwritten Hungarian message in blue ink diagonally across the center, pre‑printed address lines on the right, and a green Hungarian postage stamp canceled with a circular postmark.

Color postcard showing the front view of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with four tall towers and a statue on a pedestal in the foreground square. The postcard shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a large Romanesque Revival cathedral with multiple towers and a richly decorated façade featuring arcades and statues. A black‑and‑white view over a busy central square with a large equestrian statue on a pedestal in the foreground, flower beds and pedestrians around it, and multi‑storey historic buildings with shops and awnings lining the streets. Vintage sepia postcard showing a central square with broad terraced steps, a stone balustrade and formal gardens. Black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a large cathedral with Romanesque‑revival arches, painted ceilings, chandeliers and an elaborate high altar and baldachin. Black-and-white postcard showing a grand historic city hall square. Night view of a central square with an equestrian statue in the foreground and the dark silhouette of a large historic church or mosque-like building with a tall tower and domes in the background. Multi-view postcard. The front shows a large stone building with a prominent light-blue dome in a historic cityscape, surrounded by red-roofed houses and hills in the background. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque in the background, an equestrian statue on a high stone pedestal in the foreground, and a tall column with sculpted figures (a plague column or holy trinity column) to the left. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neo‑baroque theatre building with a large central dome, side domes, ornate sculptures and columns at the entrance. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic square with a long Baroque building along one side and a tall sculptural column with religious figures and a star on top in the center of the square. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a European city square with historic buildings. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large central square in a European city. Black-and-white postcard showing an interior view with richly carved stone or marble reliefs depicting religious scenes and figures in horizontal bands, likely part of a Christian cathedral museum display. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with a richly decorated fountain in the foreground and a large domed building in the background. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with an ornate stone drinking fountain in the foreground, decorated with sculpted lion heads and reliefs, surrounded by a circular flowerbed. Black-and-white view of a European city square with a cobblestone street and 1950s–1960s cars. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque on the left and an equestrian statue on a high pedestal in the middle foreground. Night view of a large, square stone building with a high greenish dome and small arched windows, illuminated by warm lights. Black‑and‑white image showing a large domed stone building in a city square, with arched windows and a cross-topped finial on the dome. A monochrome drawing of an ornate 19th‑century synagogue on a street corner, surrounded by an iron fence and adjacent buildings, with several small cars, a motorcycle, and pedestrians in the foreground. Color postcard showing a Romanesque cathedral with four tall towers and an ornate façade, seen from a grassy park with benches, trees and an iron fence in the foreground. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with four tall spired towers rising above trees and stone walls. Color postcard showing a large central square with gardens, steps, and fountains. Color view of a large historic square with a central stone-domed building in the background, a tall dark plague column or religious monument on the left, and a prominent equestrian statue on a stone pedestal on the right. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with a large domed former mosque/church building, stepped terraces with a fountain, and surrounding historic buildings. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a central square with historic buildings. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy European square with a domed church or mosque-like building with a bell tower on the left and an ornate multi‑story historicist building with shops on the right. Color postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a large Roman Catholic cathedral with high arches, ornate coffered ceiling, frescoes and mosaics, and an elaborate altar and baldachin at the far end. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic building complex with Romanesque‑style elements, including a tall square tower and arched windows. Color postcard showing a decorated stone fountain with animal-head spouts and rich ornamentation, standing in a flower bed on a busy urban square. Color postcard showing a central European city square with historic buildings. A tall clock tower with a star on top dominates the left side, attached to an ornate building. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy urban square with mid‑20th‑century cars and many pedestrians. A color postcard showing a central square in a historic European city. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a city square with tree‑lined streets, early automobiles and pedestrians. Color postcard showing the Mosque of Jakovali Hassan with its tall stone minaret and domed prayer hall set among surrounding buildings. Color postcard showing an elevated view over a historic European city square crowded with 1960s–1970s era cars. A night-time color postcard featuring a tall illuminated television tower rising above dark tree silhouettes under a deep blue sky. The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with multilingual captions identifying the subject and Hungarian publisher information.

Color postcard showing a large, stone, domed former mosque with small arched windows, now topped by a cross, situated on a stepped square with flower beds, lawns, and benches in the foreground and several mid‑20th‑century cars parked along the steps. The postcard displays a seaside open-air café with colorful chairs and tables. The prominent feature is a classical white colonnade with circular entablature and distinctive art-deco style lamps. The postcard shows a vibrant, crowded beach scene with people sunbathing and swimming along a long sandy shore. A black‑and‑white winter view of a historic hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires, attached to a long palace-like building. An old black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic town with tiled roofs, church towers and a clock‑towered civic building. Sepia-toned historic street view labeled "Oschatz — Dresdner Straße." The image shows a broad unpaved street lined with multi‑story buildings on the right and trees and houses on the left. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large wooden graduation tower structure with a viewing platform and walkway, likely part of a spa's salt‑evaporation works. In the foreground there is a small stone grotto, a dirt path, some low plantings, and a woman in long skirt and blouse standing near the garden. The printed caption in German appears at the bottom.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a reconstructed ancient Greek treasury building with two caryatid statues as columns at the entrance and a richly sculpted pediment and frieze. A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignette scenes of Meissen. The upper left shows the hilltop Albrechtsburg castle complex above a river with boats. Black‑and‑white scenic view of a European city with a river in the foreground, a bridge crossing it, historic buildings and a church tower with a bulbous dome on the right, and a wooded hill behind them topped by fortifications and a prominent clock tower. Printed caption text along the bottom right reads "GRAZ. Schlossberg," and a small number "1222" appears in the lower left.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a busy waterfront with several steamships and small passenger boats on a wide river or harbor. Black-and-white postcard showing the richly decorated interior altar of a chapel behind an iron grille. The altar is adorned with flowers, candles, and an ornate framed figure or statue, likely of the Virgin Mary, set within baroque-style architectural carvings. At the bottom margin, there is a caption in German with a serial number identifying the place as a chapel in a church in Graz.

Black‑and‑white view of a wooded river valley with a calm stream in the foreground and two large historic buildings on a forested hillside in the background. The buildings have steep, gabled roofs and multiple small windows, resembling an old European castle or manor complex. Leafy branches frame the top edge of the image. There is no clear printed caption on the front, only some faint handwritten or scratched marks near the lower border.

An old German postcard with a sepia photograph in the upper left showing a large hilltop fortress or castle complex above a town or river. The address on the right is written to a recipient in Heidelberg. The overall style is late 19th or early 20th century.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing an elevated view over a historic spa town in a wooded valley. Below, a river or canal with promenades on both sides runs through the center of the town, lined with grand 19th‑century buildings. Distinctive onion‑domed church towers and other historic structures rise above the streets. The word "Karlsbad." is printed in the upper right corner of the image area.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town in a valley with a prominent hilltop castle or fortress dominating the skyline. Church towers and traditional buildings fill the mid‑ground, with trees and greenery in the foreground. At the bottom edge there is a caption in German identifying the place.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene leading up to a fortified gate set in an old city wall. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the view and location in Croatian and French.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside promenade in a European spa town. Multi‑story historic buildings line both sides of a narrow river or canal with tree‑lined walkways and small bridges crossing the water. Early 20th‑century cars and pedestrians move along the main street. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the spa town of Karlsbad, showing the Kurhaus, Mühlbrunn colonnade area, and Hotel Imperial.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a church and adjacent multi‑story residential buildings. The church has a tall central tower with a spire, arched windows, and a fenced yard in the foreground. To the right is a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century townhouses. Printed text at the top left reads "Döbeln — Jakobi-Kirche".

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a rainy, stormy view of a European city with a river, bridge, church towers, and a hilltop fortress or castle above the town. Lightning, heavy rain, and people in the streets are depicted. Inset at the lower right is a circular vignette of people being blown about by the wind. The lower margin contains printed German text in a decorative typeface, and there is handwritten German script across the bottom and right edge. The main printed caption reads "Grüsse aus Graz."

A vintage monochrome view of an Italian city square dominated by an ornate baroque fountain in the center, surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings with arcades and shuttered windows. On the right is a domed building, and people can be seen walking in the background. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as Trento and describe the square and fountain.

A vintage, monochrome postcard view of a narrow street leading to the ornate façade of a Baroque-style church. The building has a triangular pediment, several arched windows and niches with religious artwork, and a decorated entrance portal. Multi-story classical buildings line the right side of the street. The card has scalloped edges and printed title text at the top.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand historicist theatre building with a domed roof, ornate façade, columns, statues and a fountain in front. It is situated on a street corner with multi‑storey residential blocks and a tree‑lined area opposite. Early motor vehicles and pedestrians appear on the street. Handwritten notes are visible across the image and near the bottom. Printed caption at the bottom reads the city district and the name of the theatre and adjoining street in German.

An old sepia-toned postcard depicting a fenced war memorial column topped by an eagle in front of a hilltop castle or fortified manor, surrounded by tall leafless trees. To the left is a small white gatehouse with large wooden doors. The setting appears to be a central European town or village. Printed title text in red is at the top right.

An old tinted postcard view of a wide, rough dirt road running between high earthen/stone ramparts and fortification walls. Long, low military barracks and buildings stretch into the distance, with mountains capped with snow in the background. The scene depicts a military encampment on or beside old Venetian fortifications. At the bottom margin there is printed caption text along with an editor/photographer credit and a Greek website watermark over the image.

Black‑and‑white postcard image of a tall obelisk monument in a landscaped park or square. At the top of the obelisk stands a large eagle sculpture with wings spread. At the base is an allegorical seated female figure holding a flag or standard, with cannons and decorative elements around her. The pedestal is surrounded by low bollards linked with chains and bordered by flowerbeds. In the background are trees and several multi‑story 19th‑century style buildings. Colorized vintage postcard showing a large seaside votive temple on a hill, with a tall central tower and arched façade in a neo‑medieval style. In the foreground are a pink house, garden walls and a road; trees line the slope leading up to the church. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Panjón in Galicia and names the building as the Templo Votivo del Mar.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside promenade with women and a child walking along a path with a wooden railing beside a calm river. Across the river lies a small town with trees and houses, dominated on the hill by a large castle-like complex. The printed red text at the top identifies the view as a promenade along the Mulde river in Colditz.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide cobblestone square with children playing in the foreground and people walking or riding carts in the mid‑ground. A black‑and‑white postcard depicting an ornate Baroque pavilion with elaborate sculptures, large arched windows, and a grand stairway leading up to the entrance. The architecture is part of a larger courtyard complex surrounded by arcades and balustrades. The caption at the bottom right reads "Dresden. Zwinger-Wallpavillon".

A sepia-toned postcard showing the courtyard and entrance buildings of a historic monastery complex under a large spreading tree. Several robed figures stand near the arched gateway of a stone structure with wooden balconies. Printed captions in French and Greek identify the site as the Monastery of Hagia (Agia) Lavra, and a modern website watermark appears across the lower center.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bandstand or music pavilion in a tree-lined city square during winter. A black‑and‑white photograph of a passenger steamboat named ASTREA sailing on calm water, filled with people on the decks. Low city waterfronts and distant church towers or tall buildings line the shore in the background under an overcast sky. Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a street scene with a church-like clock tower and, behind it, a tall Ottoman-style minaret. Black‑and‑white view across a calm river or lake toward an ornate iron bridge with decorative lampposts and stone pylons. Black‑and‑white view of a large wooden public building with a steep metal roof and central cupola, standing in an open grassy field. Black‑and‑white postcard-style cityscape showing a fortified medieval town built on a river bend. A monochrome postcard reproducing a detailed historical painting of a ceremonial reception scene from the Council of Trent. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a statue on a tall pedestal in the foreground, trees behind it, and a fortified hill with walls and a cross on top in the background. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide view of an ancient stone amphitheater with concentric rows of seating rising around a circular orchestra. Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a town square with a fenced garden and a large pedestal supporting a bust monument of Kaiser Wilhelm. Sepia-toned panoramic view over a formal baroque-style garden leading toward a city center. Sepia-toned landscape view taken from an elevated terrace with a wooden gazebo and railing in the foreground and the wall of a large building (likely a castle) on the right. Black-and-white winter view of a snow-covered town featuring a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall clock tower and spire, seen from across a small bridge over a frozen river. A sepia-toned photograph showing a group of children in ancient-style costumes posing in a choreographed stance inside an ancient stone theater. In the lower right corner there is a printed website address, and in the lower left a circular archival stamp or logo.

A vintage two-panel postcard. The upper image shows a panoramic view of a valley town with hills in the background and a large rectangular Baroque-style building with corner towers in the foreground. Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a river with a metal truss bridge and riverbank promenade. Colorized vintage view of a large fortified complex with high stone walls and a tall cylindrical tower, surrounded by smaller buildings and trees with mountains in the background. A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with dense rows of houses, church towers and a large Gothic cathedral dominating the left side of the skyline. Black‑and‑white image showing a large, ornate, ivy‑covered villa or small palace on a wooded hillside. A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a grand neoclassical colonnade with arches and statues on the balustrade above. A monochrome postcard view of a wide river in the foreground with tree branches framing the scene from the left. Black-and-white street view showing a broad boulevard with tram tracks and overhead wires, lined with neoclassical buildings and a long fence with columns on the right. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic complex with steep gabled roofs and church-like spires standing on a wooded hillside above a valley with scattered town buildings and a factory chimney. The caption in red German text appears at the top right on a blank sky background.

Colorized view of a European city scene showing a church with a tall green steeple and clock tower on the left and a large ornate opera house on the right, separated by a tree-lined square with a tram or bus and pedestrians. A black-and-white postcard view over a European city from an elevated hillside. Below and to the left stretches a dense townscape of multi‑storey buildings along a river, with industrial facilities and chimneys visible further back. Low hills or mountains form the background. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad, tree‑lined street with a cobblestone surface and several pedestrians and horse‑drawn vehicles. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a city with wooded hills in the background. In the foreground is a lake or pond with many people rowing small boats. Black‑and‑white landscape view of a hilltop castle complex overlooking a dense town in a river valley, framed by trees in the foreground. Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Renaissance-style town hall building on a broad square. The façade has multiple gabled dormers, many rectangular windows, and a small central tower. A color postcard showing a snowy winter scene of a grand historic square. In the foreground stands a chimney sweep carrying ladders. An illustrated postcard showing a stylized riverside view of a large neo‑Gothic building with a central dome and many spires, seen from across a wide river with small boats in the foreground. An old monochrome postcard view over a dense hillside city with low houses and tiled roofs. Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neo‑baroque theater building at night with a bright full moon in the sky. People are gathered in the square in front of the building. A vintage, monochrome postcard depicting a long brick railway station building with ornate brickwork and tall chimneys. A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a paved ancient street flanked by ruins in Pompeii. On the right side stand the remains of a temple platform and walls, with steps leading up from the street. The caption in Italian is printed at the top left.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a waterfront cityscape. Large classical buildings stand along the opposite shore, including a prominent rectangular palace-like structure. Black‑and‑white postcard image showing vaulted arcades opening onto a busy urban square. Two men in early 20th‑century dress stand under the arches near advertising columns. Black‑and‑white interior view of an ornate historic room with a large fireplace, classical paintings, a chandelier, carved columns, a long table with chairs, and a bust near a tall window. The caption at the bottom identifies the room as the famous wedding chamber in the town hall of Nijmegen.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large Romanesque‑Revival Catholic church with twin square towers, a rose window, and an arched main portal. Sepia-toned view along a riverside promenade with trees and pedestrians on the left and a bridge crossing the river toward a historic cityscape. A monochrome postcard view of a courtyard framed by leafless trees and simple wooden fencing. Historic masonry buildings with tiled roofs, small windows, and decorative stonework surround the yard. Sepia-toned postcard showing a small market square in a historic European town. In the foreground is an octagonal fountain with a statue. A sepia-toned postcard showing large stone ruins in the foreground, likely the remains of a medieval fortress wall or tower with an arched opening.
