The image has a wide border, and the bottom-left corner bears a printed caption with the place name.

Sepia-toned interior view of an old Byzantine-style church or cathedral, showing stone columns with capitals, arches, an ornate chandelier, and an iconostasis with religious icons and candles. The image is framed by a postcard-style border, with a caption in French at the bottom and a modern archive watermark on top.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an inner courtyard with a formal lawn, flowerbed, and young trees in front of a large Renaissance‑style castle complex. The building has high gabled roofs, ornate stepped gables, towers with clock and lantern, and an elaborate arched portal with coats of arms. Text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

Vintage monochrome view of a leafy public square with a central flower bed and fountain in the foreground. Behind the park stands an ornate historic building with arched windows and corner turrets, fronted by a large statue on a pedestal. Streetlamps and surrounding multi‑story urban buildings frame the scene. At the top, printed in red, is the title indicating the location as Chemnitz and the old town hall.

A colored postcard showing a richly detailed historical mural or painting framed by vaulted arches and decorative borders. The scene depicts a large group of finely dressed people in Renaissance-style clothing gathered in an outdoor setting, with dogs, children, and nobles interacting. In the background a church or cathedral tower rises above the town. The lower border of the image is decorated with ornamental panels and a doorway, and beneath this is a German caption printed in a decorative script.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close-up of Gothic stone sculptures on the façade of a cathedral. Four standing figures in draped robes are set in ornate vertical niches with intricate architectural canopies above and decorative carvings below. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as part of Strasbourg Cathedral and describes the figures as the fiancé and the wise virgins.

Sepia-toned view of a small river or canal bordered by a footpath and stone wall, with old multi-storey houses on the left and trees on both sides. On the hill behind the houses a larger historic building or castle complex is visible. The scene is tranquil and rural, and printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a river steamer crowded with passengers in the foreground and a large Gothic hilltop complex with tall spires and steep roofs rising above a town in the background. The boat is moving along a broad river; on the opposite bank are small houses and riverside buildings at the foot of a wooded hill crowned by the imposing cathedral-like structure and castle-like wings.

Black‑and‑white view of a large neo‑Gothic/neo‑Renaissance style castle or palatial villa on a slope, partly obscured by trees and shrubs. The building has crenellated rooflines, several cylindrical corner turrets with battlements, and a central clock tower. Arched windows with shutters line the façades. The foreground is a grassy hillside, and there is no visible caption or border text on the image side.

Colorized historical postcard showing a two-story building with a richly patterned red-and-white tiled roof and a central arched entrance. The façade is light-colored with rectangular windows, and several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the building. To the right, part of a church tower with a clock is visible. Hungarian text appears at the top and above the entrance.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view of a city with a steep hill rising prominently in the center. The hill is topped with fortification structures, likely a castle or fortress, and the foreground shows a patchwork of fields, trees, and low buildings leading into a denser urban area. At the top margin, German captions identify the viewpoint and the hill, and on the upper right the city name is printed.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large group of men, women, and children on a wooden pier or boardwalk, posed closely together for a formal photograph. Most adults wear early 20th‑century clothing: suits, ties, and boater or flat caps for men; long skirts, light coats, and wide‑brimmed or cloche‑style hats for women. Several children are seated in front, some in sailor outfits. Behind the crowd, on a hillside, stand numerous wooden villas and resort-style buildings, including a prominent large hotel or sanatorium overlooking the town. The setting suggests a coastal or resort town in a temperate climate. No visible text or caption appears on the image side.

Illustrated postcard showing two men in traditional-style clothing with caps, wide trousers and clogs walking in the foreground. Behind them is a stylized night-time cityscape with gabled houses and a tall church tower, lit streetlamps, a couple walking in the distance, and a large anthropomorphized moon with a face in the dark sky. The word "Nijmegen" is printed below the scene. Along the left edge appears the publisher's imprint and a small logo with a number at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white image of a long neoclassical colonnade with rows of Corinthian columns and a coffered ceiling. Well‑dressed men and women in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century fashion stroll or stand along the walkway. At the far end are large arched openings. Benches line the wall on the right. The architecture suggests a prestigious spa or public colonnade, and there appears to be faint handwritten text along the bottom edge.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large neoclassical three‑storey building with a central portico and colonnade, set behind an open square with trees and paths. Printed captions in French and Greek at the top identify the place, and there is handwritten text in ink across the upper part of the image. A watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large stone arch bridge spanning a deep, tree‑filled valley. On the far side of the bridge stands an ornate historic building with towers and a tall clock‑like spire. The scene is framed by trees in the foreground. At the bottom center of the image, a caption identifies the location.

A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a monumental mausoleum with a classical facade and an arched entrance. On top of the hill above the mausoleum stands a tall column with a prominent cross, and several people are seen walking on the stairs and around the site. The facade is inscribed with 'VLADISLAO VARNENSI,' and there are coats of arms visible above the lettering. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Cyrillic, date references, and cataloging numbers.

The postcard features a large, imposing stone monument of a standing figure on a stepped pedestal, set in a landscaped park with a flower bed in the foreground and benches along the pathways. Behind the monument, the sea is visible, with trees surrounding the area. The back of the postcard has printed text in several languages (Bulgarian, French, German), including the location 'VARNA', and mentions a monument dedicated to anti-fascist fighters.

A colorful collage postcard featuring various scenes from Varna, Bulgaria. The images include a busy beach with many people swimming, a grand building and public square, a hotel with a classic car in front, a park entrance with columns, a view of a port with ships, and a cityscape with prominent buildings and roads. The word 'Варна' (Varna) is prominently displayed in Cyrillic on an orange bar in the center.

A vintage black‑and‑white waterfront view showing numerous moored sailing boats and piers in front of a dense row of multi‑story historic buildings and church spires. The perspective is across the water toward an urban harbor area busy with people and vessels. At the top in red print appears the caption "Stockholm. Fiskarehamnen."

Black-and-white postcard showing a formal garden with trimmed hedges, statues, a pond in the foreground, and a large classical-style manor or small palace centered in the background. The view is straight along a central axis through the garden towards the building. Small printed text at the bottom left identifies the location, and there is a circular publisher's mark with a number at the bottom right.

Colorized view over a wide strait with calm blue water and small sailing boats. On the left hillside stands a long medieval fortress with multiple round towers. In the foreground are red‑tiled roofs and the minaret of a mosque. The card bears a handwritten signature at the top and a printed watermark with a website address near the bottom.

A vintage colored postcard showing a tall, ornate clock tower in an open square lined with trees, with water visible in the background. A single person walks in the foreground. The image is heavily overlaid with handwritten cursive text. At the bottom are printed captions in red identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a riverside castle complex set in flat farmland. The ensemble includes several tall square towers with steep roofs and small spires, gabled buildings in a Northern Renaissance style, inner gardens and orchards, and surrounding trees. A broad, gently curving river flows behind the castle, with fields and scattered farmhouses stretching to the horizon. The print has worn and torn edges, consistent with an old photographic postcard. No printed caption or handwriting is visible.

Colorized vintage postcard showing an ornate white pavilion beside a pond within a landscaped garden or park, surrounded by dense trees and cypress-like tall trees. People can be seen walking near monuments or tombstones on the right side. At the top it is labeled in French, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand neo‑classical colonnade along a river or canal, crowded with elegantly dressed people in early 20th‑century clothing. The long colonnaded building has statues on the roofline and ornate arches, backed by a wooded hillside and several large spa hotels or villas. Printed caption text in German at the top reads "Karlsbad. Mühlbrunnen-Kolonnade."

Black-and-white postcard showing an urban street scene with strong brick Expressionist office blocks. On the left is a sharply pointed, ship-like building with arcades at ground level, and on the right another large brick office block with many small windows. Cars and trucks from the early 20th century are parked on the street. In the distant background a church spire rises over the city. Printed text at the bottom reads "Hamburg. Chilehaus und Sprinkenhof" and a small number "3172" appears in the corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting a stone bridge over a small river with rocky banks, modest houses beside the bridge, and a tall square medieval tower with crenellations in the background. A metal pedestrian or rail bridge appears on the left. The printed caption at the top right reads "Trento - Torre Vanga." The image has an aged, early‑20th‑century photographic style with a light border typical of old postcards.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall cylindrical stone tower with a small entrance door, narrow windows, and a viewing platform ringed by a railing near the top. The tower stands on a rocky hill and is surrounded by a low stone wall with metal fencing. Sparse trees and scrubby vegetation appear in the foreground. Printed text in German at the upper left reads "Wurzen i. Sa.  Bismarckturm." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a tall, fortified Renaissance-style tower with a steep roof and corner turrets, topped by an ornate open belfry/clock tower. The building stands in an urban setting next to a more classical stone building. Below the image there is a printed caption in Russian.

Color image showing a hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring two tall spires and several smaller spires, attached to a castle-like ensemble with red-tiled roofs. The complex rises above a river, with wooded slopes and lower houses along the waterfront. In the foreground there is a grassy riverbank and a wooden balustrade, with leafy trees framing the view under a bright blue sky.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a hillside area with a prominent tall church with a tower on the left and several large institutional buildings on the right, likely a children's hospital, surrounded by trees, roads, and rail tracks in the foreground. Printed text at the top names the church, the children's hospital and the city in Swedish; a small reference code appears at the bottom left.

Vintage monochrome postcard with light tinting showing a stone tower with a tall conical roof in a tree‑lined square, people walking in the foreground, and another fortified tower and castle-like complex in the background against a mountainous landscape. The word "Trento" is printed at the top in red, and "Torre verde e Castello" at the lower right. A vertical publisher credit appears along the left edge.

A black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view labeled "Arco" at the top. In the background, a dramatic rocky hill rises with a fortified castle or ruins on its summit, surrounded by trees. In the foreground there is a low stone wall, a narrow water channel, cultivated fields or vineyards, and a few houses and trees lining a path where long white cloths appear to be laid out to dry. The scene is framed by distant mountains under a lightly clouded sky. Printer information and a serial number appear at the bottom left.

A colorized postcard view of a historic European town labeled "Bautzen." In the foreground a large multi‑arched stone bridge crosses a river in a green valley. Residential houses with red-tiled roofs and gardens appear on the left, while the middle ground shows medieval towers and fortifications leading up to a dense old town on a hill. Several church spires and a tall towered building dominate the skyline under a lightly clouded sky.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a Gothic-style building identified as a library. The façade features tall pointed-arch windows, decorative stonework, a small ornate entrance pavilion with columns and a coat of arms, and a steep gabled roof topped with a cross. The building opens onto a cobblestone square, with a few small figures visible near the base. Printed caption text appears at the top in red.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Gothic interior room with ribbed vaulting decorated with floral patterns, tall traceried windows, and a richly decorated tiled stove and doorway. A white margin at the bottom contains printed German captions identifying the location and room, along with the photographer's credit.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a Neo‑Gothic building with stepped gables and pointed windows, identified as a library. The facade includes ornate stonework, arched entrances at street level, and tall mullioned windows above. Printed captions in French at the bottom read "La Bibliothèque" and "Bruges." The printer's credit and card number appear in small text along the lower edge.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a rural alpine landscape with rolling green hills, scattered houses, and a prominent baroque hilltop church with twin towers on the right. In the foreground stands a boy in traditional alpine clothing holding a statue of the crowned Virgin Mary with the Child Jesus. Mountains rise in the background. Printed captions in German appear at the top left and bottom center, and there is a vertical publisher credit on the right edge.

Sepia-toned panoramic view of a historic European town on a river, showing an industrial building in the foreground, dense traditional houses with gabled roofs in the middle, and a large church and castle complex with towers and spires dominating the skyline. Printed captions in German identify the town and key buildings.

A black‑and‑white historic view over a European riverside city. In the foreground is a large statue of an armored knight with a plumed helmet, standing on a richly decorated stone pedestal and holding a sword. Two children sit on the base of the monument while a uniformed man stands nearby. Curved stone balustrades frame the terrace. In the background, across a wide river, are church towers with baroque spires and dense urban buildings fading into the distance. The image has damage or overexposed areas in the sky and no visible printed caption.

A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a European city with a wooded hill rising steeply in the center-left. On top of the hill there are fortifications and buildings, while at its base and along a river to the right stretch dense city blocks, bridges, churches, and multi‑story buildings. The title text at the top left reads in German. The overall style and printing suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense historic city quarter with tiled roofs. Dominating the hill in the background is an enormous neo‑baroque palace complex with a central dome and multiple pavilions, terraces and retaining walls. To the right, a broad river runs through the scene, crossed by a suspension bridge with stone towers resembling 19th‑century chain bridges. The foreground shows a large, ornate public building facing a tree‑lined street. The image appears to be an old photographic postcard with no visible printed caption on the front.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a long neoclassical railway station building with domed pavilions and a central portico. In front of the station are horse‑drawn carriages, carts and small figures of people on an open square. Part of the right side of the card is torn. At the bottom, printed captions in Russian and French identify the place as Moscow and the Kursk railway station.

Tinted historic postcard view of a large multi‑span steel truss railway bridge crossing a wide river at night or dusk, with a full moon in a cloudy sky. A traditional sailing boat is in the foreground under the bridge. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen. Spoorbrug." in red lettering.

A black‑and‑white view up a gently curving path toward a tall, slender church tower with a high spire rising above treetops. The tower has several distinct stages and arched windows, set on a small hill or park-like area. Two small figures walk on the path in the middle distance, and mature trees frame the scene on both sides under a cloudy sky.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside city. In the foreground is a metal bridge with pedestrians, a horse‑drawn or early motor carriage, and tram tracks crossing a wide river. On the opposite bank stands a dense old town of gabled houses climbing a hill. Dominating the skyline is a large medieval hilltop complex with fortified walls and tall twin‑spired Gothic church towers, resembling a cathedral integrated into a castle‑like palace. The overall style and clothing of people suggest an early‑20th‑century scene.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined square with a large brick concert hall in the background. The building has tall vertical windows, decorative brickwork and a central tower‑like section. In front are young trees, a low fence, and what appears to be a terrace or garden area. Printed caption text runs along the bottom edge of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a waterfront city scene. A grand multi-storey hotel and adjoining ornate buildings line a quay with trams, horse-drawn or early motor vehicles, and many pedestrians. Boats are moored along the water's edge. In the foreground there is a formal park with paths and trees. Printed caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

Colorized photograph showing a stone fortress building seen through a dark archway in the foreground. A cobbled path and gravel road lead uphill toward a thick stone wall with a gate and a rectangular, rough-hewn stone building topped with a greenish metal roof and small belfry-like turret. The sky is bright blue with a few clouds, and low greenery lines the path. No printed text is visible on the image side.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a close view of stone arcades and Corinthian columns forming part of an ancient Roman-style peristyle courtyard. In the background are old buildings with tiled roofs. At the bottom, printed text identifies the location as the Peristil in Split.

A black-and-white postcard showing a waterside scene with a large brick building on the left labeled as the post office, a quay in front, and a steamship with smoke rising from its funnel on the right. Church spires and other city buildings are visible in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads "Malmö. Posthuset." and there is a handwritten code "PM 946" at the top right.

A bound album titled "Sverige i bilder" containing multiple vintage postcards. The cover is blue with a printed scenic illustration of a waterside building, and the handwritten name "Erik Stef(n)berg" appears below the title. Inside pages show monochrome and tinted postcards depicting Swedish townscapes: a snowy riverside village with wooden houses and a small bridge, a detached wooden house labeled as a locality, a coastal shoreline, and an industrial complex with chimneys and factory buildings. The captions on the cards and album are in Swedish.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard with an oval-framed photograph of a large Gothic-style church with a tall central spire opening onto a landscaped square with paths and a statue group in front. The caption in Hungarian is printed below the image on the beige card stock.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a large round stone tower with a high domed roof topped by a small lantern and cross. The tower stands on a gentle hillside with rows of trees and vegetation in the foreground and additional wooded slopes in the distance. In the upper right corner, red printed German text identifies the view as a scene by the castle tower in Freyburg.

Hand-colored vintage postcard view of a riverside townscape. A calm river flows in the foreground, with trees lining the left bank and a small weir or dam across the water. On the right bank stand traditional European houses with red-brown roofs and a prominent medieval tower next to a stone bridge. The sky is softly tinted in pastel colors, giving an old-fashioned appearance. Printed captions identify the scene and publisher details.

Illustrated Easter/spring postcard showing three large colored eggs in the foreground beside pussy-willow branches and small flowers. Behind them stand ruins of an old stone castle or fortress on a hill. To the right is a townscape with a church featuring a tall, narrow spire and simple clock or round window on its tower, with low houses and a river or plain beyond. The greeting text at the top is in Estonian.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a stone frieze with standing and seated figures laid out on the ground, photographed with Athens and surrounding hills in the background. Greek text is printed beneath the image, accompanied by French text identifying the scene as a frieze from the Theatre of Bacchus in Athens. There is handwriting and postal cancellation marks on the card.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy European city street lined with ornate historic buildings. A tram line runs along the center of the street with pedestrians and carriages. On the right side stands a tall baroque-style church or tower with a clock, while domed and spired buildings are visible on the left. At the top left, printed in small text, it reads "Graz. Herrengasse."

Vintage monochrome view of a river or rapids flowing between rocky, forested banks, with industrial buildings and a long truss bridge spanning the water. The scene is labeled in the upper right corner with the location name in Swedish.

Colorized vintage view of a large city square bordered by trees and neoclassical buildings. The square is mostly open, with paths and scattered greenery, and multi‑story houses line the background. On the right side stands a prominent neoclassical building with columns. The top left contains printed multilingual text identifying the place, and postal cancellation marks are faintly visible over the sky.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a riverside town with barges and a paddle steamer on the river. On the hill above the town stands a large Gothic ensemble with towers and steep roofs identified in the caption as Albrechtsburg and the cathedral. Handwritten-style captions in German appear along the lower border.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European city taken from an elevated vantage point, probably a hill or castle. In the foreground are trees and steeply roofed buildings; to the lower right stands a richly decorated neo‑Renaissance building with a large central dome and smaller corner domes, facing a square. Numerous church towers punctuate the dense historic roofscape beyond, with flat plains and distant low hills in the background. A small white number "656" is printed in the lower left margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a calm park landscape with a pond or canal in the foreground and reeds along the water's edge. In the middle distance a path curves through low hills and trees, with a person walking or cycling. On the left stands a traditional wooden windmill on a small rise; farther back and slightly right is a large rectangular building that looks like a manor or public building. The sky is lightly clouded. The printed captions "Slottsparken." and "Malmö." appear at the top corners.

Black‑and‑white view of a grand spa-resort complex in a narrow valley backed by dense forested hills. The foreground shows a long, ornate colonnade or pavilion with domed roof sections; behind it stand several large, multi‑storey neoclassical and belle‑époque style hotel buildings with many windows and balconies. A tall chimney emits smoke, and on the wooded hillside above is a solitary monument or lookout. The overall layout and architecture suggest a European spa town from the early 20th century.

Color postcard-style image showing a large waterfront building complex with a central, flat-roofed, light-colored block and an ornate, historic-looking facade on the right. Several floors of windows and balconies face a calm harbor. Two white passenger boats are moored along the quay in front of the buildings. Cars are visible along the street by the water. At the bottom border of the image, handwritten text reads "WAXHOLM II".

Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a large hilltop castle complex with tall Gothic spires and fortified walls dominating a small town below. In the foreground a steam-powered riverboat named "GERMANIA" with a striped flag sails along the river. The scene looks like a historical European riverside city with a prominent cathedral-castle ensemble above terraced houses.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a riverside town dominated by a large brick public building with ornate gables and a metal roof, a church spire behind it, leafy parkland in the foreground, and a round tower‑like structure near the river on the right. The caption "Umeå" appears in the lower left corner.

A vintage multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard with five images related to Countess von Cosel and Stolpen Castle. The central image shows a hilltop town with a fortified complex above surrounding fields. Other images depict a portrait of Gräfin v. Cosel, the Coselturm tower of the castle, an ornate model of her travelling coach, and an interior salon furnished in historical style. Gothic script in the center reads "Burgstadt Stolpen i. Sa." with caption labels under each smaller image.

Color postcard view of a European historic town square seen through a stone archway. The square is paved with cobblestones and busy with people, market stalls, and umbrellas. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with steep red-tiled roofs and ornate stepped and curved gables in a late Gothic / Renaissance style. The central yellow building has several decorative gabled dormers; adjacent grey and cream buildings show typical North/Central European historic town architecture. The clothing styles of the people suggest mid‑20th‑century (post‑war) Europe. There is a round road sign with a red border on the right side.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a small town scene with a prominent church tower rising above trees and, to the right, the ruins of a hilltop castle. In the foreground stands a large villa-style house partially obscured by foliage. The lower margin bears a printed German caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a coastal city with dense low buildings leading to the sea. In the right foreground is the stone wall and round tower of a hilltop fortress. The caption at the bottom is printed in Greek, English, and French, and there is a website watermark across the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard view of a busy harbor with many ships, docks, cranes, and waterfront buildings. In the far distance a lighthouse is visible at the entrance of the port. The image has a printed caption at the bottom identifying the scene as Alexandria and mentioning the docks. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears across the lower right.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a gently sloping cobblestone road lined with multi‑story townhouses on both sides. People, including children with carts, walk along the street. In the distance stands a prominent tower with an onion-shaped dome. At the top of the image there is printed caption text identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a monumental historicist building with two small corner towers and a grand arched portal reached by a broad stairway, set against a wooded hillside. On the left side are several multi‑story town buildings along a street; in the distance a hilltop monument is visible. The caption in red at the top identifies the scene as a grave and gymnasium complex associated with Turnvater Jahn in Freyburg an der Unstrut, Germany.

Black‑and‑white historic view of a stone arch bridge over a broad river, with trams and pedestrians crossing. On the far bank rises an ornate baroque cityscape with tall church towers and domes, dense multi‑story buildings, and monumental riverside facades. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the embankment and bridge; trees and grassy terraces appear in the foreground.

Color image of a hilltop medieval castle ruin surrounded by stone walls and towers, set above a forested slope with patches of snow. Behind the fortress rises a dramatic range of snow‑covered mountains under a clear sky. The image fills the whole card, with no visible caption or text on the front.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a leafless, tree‑lined foreground with a low earthen rampart or embankment, and in the distance a large white church with two tall symmetrical towers. The photo is framed artistically between dark tree trunks. At the bottom there is a caption in a Latin-script language and a small circular number '66' at the lower right.

Colorized old postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with multiple green onion domes and crosses, rendered in a painterly style. The building stands alone on an open square, and at the top left of the card is printed text in German identifying the location.

Colorized historic postcard view of a medieval stone fortress tower and walls on a rocky hill, with trees and landscaped greenery in the foreground. To the right, a straight, tree-lined avenue recedes into the distance. The sky is softly tinted blue and peach. Printed red text in German appears at the upper left of the image.

A colored view over the historic town of Meissen, showing a hillside covered with trees and red‑roofed houses leading up to a large hilltop complex with a cathedral featuring twin Gothic towers and surrounding buildings. In the right foreground stands a separate church tower with a greenish dome roof. The sky is blue with a few clouds, and red German text is printed along the top.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession or gathering of men in dark coats and uniforms, many wearing peaked caps, in front of a large neoclassical building with tall columns and sculptural relief above the entablature. The scene appears ceremonial, with people assembled in rows on a cobblestone square, trees without leaves in the background, suggesting a cool season.

Illustrated vintage postcard bordered with grapevines, showing a riverside town with a stone bridge over a wide river, several boats and a steamer, and on the hill above a large church and castle-like complex with towers and spires. At the top it reads "Gruss aus Meissen." Small printer information is along the left and bottom margins.

Black‑and‑white view over a large European square with grand stone buildings. On the right stands a richly decorated neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire, tracery windows and buttresses. In the center is a monumental theater or opera house with a domed roof and classical façade. To the left are substantial civic buildings with steep roofs and a clock tower. The open square in front is mostly empty except for scattered pedestrians and a few trees without leaves, suggesting winter. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.

Colorized vintage view of a crowded promenade beside a large neo‑classical colonnade building next to a river. The colonnade has arches and statues on the roof, while elegantly dressed people with hats and umbrellas fill the walkway. Text in German at the bottom identifies the place as Karlsbad and the Mühlbrunnen colonnade.

Sepia-toned historic street view labeled "Budapest. Alagut-utczca — Tunnelgasse." It shows a tree-lined avenue with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. At the end of the street there is an arched tunnel entrance in the hillside, and above on the hilltop stands a large palace-like building complex. The overall style and vehicles suggest an early-20th-century cityscape.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town taken from a slightly elevated, tree‑covered slope. In the foreground are leafy trees, dirt paths and a few detached houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the middle distance a dense historic townscape with many gabled roofs is visible. Dominating the skyline are several large church buildings: to the left a massive church or cathedral complex with multiple towers, toward the center another church with twin towers, and to the right a prominent large church with a tall spire and long nave. Low hills or vineyards form the background horizon. Along the right vertical edge there is a handwritten or printed number sequence, but no clear caption on the front.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view framed by large stone columns and arches, looking into a sunlit courtyard with Romanesque/late Roman architecture. In the middle distance are arched arcades and an entrance between massive masonry walls, with a few people standing in the square. On the right is a building with shuttered windows and a shop sign reading "G. DEL BIANCO." At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the scene as Split and mentions the entrance to the cathedral.

A monochrome historic postcard view of a European city square with a large, ornate Neo‑Renaissance building featuring a central dome, clock, and corner towers. In front of it stands a multi‑tiered monument with statues, surrounded by an open plaza with café tables and umbrellas. A broad street with tram tracks, early motor vehicles, and pedestrians runs alongside rows of traditional townhouses; a church tower is visible further down the street.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a large historic building complex partly hidden by trees on a hillside. The main structure on the left has multiple stories, steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and a small dome-like corner tower. To the right stands a smaller villa-like building with a tiled roof. Dense woodland forms the background. At the top of the image, a handwritten-style caption in German reads "Schloß Coswig i. Sa."

Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a dense historic town with steep tiled roofs, a church tower with a clock in the foreground, a central market‑square area, and a long multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a broad river in the background. Beyond the river lie fields and low hills. On one of the buildings near the square the name 'Emil Ranpf' is visible, along with other German signage on facades.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside view of Grenoble. In the foreground is the Isère River with a bridge crossing it. On the opposite bank are buildings at the foot of a steep rocky hill, with additional fortifications visible higher up the slope. A large mountain rises in the background. Printed caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wide, straight street lined with ornate multi‑story buildings leading toward a tall neo‑Gothic church tower. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalks. The word "GRAZ." is printed at the top. At the lower right, the street name "Nibelungengasse." is printed. There is a circular stamp reading "STEIERM. LANDES-ARCHIV" and the year "1903" on the lower right margin. Along the left edge appears a vertical publisher/date line.

Black-and-white view of a large stone church shot through trees and a fence in the foreground. The building has multiple steep, tiled roofs, a large round rose window, and a central tower with wooden cladding. At the bottom left there is a printed caption in Swedish describing the church, and in the bottom right a small oval logo stating it is a real photograph.

Sepia-toned postcard with a wide border showing a bustling market square filled with horse-drawn carts and people. At the center stands a large Gothic-style town hall with an arcade of pointed arches on the ground floor and a tall, slender tower topped with a spire and weather vane. Gabled merchant houses surround the square, and another church or towered building is visible to the right. The image appears to be a reproduction of an older painting or engraving of a European medieval town hall square.

Colorized historic view of a grand neo-baroque town hall building with a central dome and clock tower, flanked by symmetrical wings and smaller spires. In front stands a large monument with multiple statues around a fountain, and a public square with people walking and market stalls with umbrellas. The caption at the top left reads "Graz. Rathaus."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad urban street lined with multi‑story historic buildings and trees. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalks and in the street, and there is a prominent church tower with a clock rising on the right side in the distance. At the bottom margin there is a printed caption in German identifying the scene as Bismarckplatz and Herrengasse in Graz.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a tall round defensive tower and adjoining walls on a sloping street with small buildings and pedestrians in the foreground. Decorative red text at upper right reads 'Salut de Constantinople.' At the bottom left there is a caption in French identifying the location, and a printed publisher line runs along the lower edge.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard with an oval-framed photograph mounted on a textured card border. The image shows a massive medieval city gate with round towers and battlements beside a canal, a small bridge in front, and a traditional windmill standing on a mound in the background to the right. At the bottom of the card, printed text identifies the scene.

Monochrome postcard showing a cylindrical medieval-style brick tower with a conical roof in a landscaped park. In the foreground there is a pond or moat with a small iron footbridge crossing the water, trees without leaves around it, and an islet. The image is framed in a circular vignette. Text at the bottom identifies the scene as Nijmegen and Kronenburger Park, with publisher and photographer credits.

Illustrated historic postcard showing elegant people in late‑19th‑century clothing strolling in a landscaped city park with a large ornate fountain labeled "Franz Joseph Brunnen" in the Stadtpark. To the right are inset views of a statue of a woman on a pedestal in a wooded area and a small decorative structure or shrine with a person looking at it, plus a tower in the background. Floral decorations and the title "Gruss aus Graz" appear in stylized script, and the lower part of the card is filled with handwritten purple ink text.

A vintage illustrated postcard with multiple vignettes of city views. The main scene shows a riverside panorama with historic buildings and a church tower along the Mur river, with a hill topped by a fortress in the background. Smaller images depict a city square, a theater building with a domed roof, a tall lookout tower in a park, and a lake with trees and boats. The central caption reads "Gruss aus Graz," and the vignettes are labeled with German place names.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornamental fountain with a central statue in a circular basin, surrounded by landscaped park greenery. Water jets arch around the statue. The caption below reads "GRAZ, Stadtpark - Brunnen." An oval red advertisement in the upper right corner says "Schichts Seifen die besten." There is also fine print along the left edge naming the publisher.

Colorized vintage view over a river with an iron bridge in the foreground, ornate lampposts, and a promenade. Across the water is a row of historic multi‑story buildings with red roofs and a tall church tower. In the background rises a wooded hill topped with fortifications and a prominent clock tower. Printed caption text appears at the top in German.

Vintage postcard featuring a large Greek flag with a royal crown emblem in the top left and a sepia photograph of the Parthenon temple on the Acropolis below. Beneath the image are printed captions in French: 'LE PARTHÉNON' and 'ATHÈNES'. There is cursive handwritten correspondence across the lower part of the card.

A multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard composed of five photographs. The images show: a riverside town with industrial buildings in a valley; a large stepped‑gabled town hall on an open square with people and early automobiles; the ornate twin‑tower west front of a Gothic cathedral; a view along a river with a bridge, boats, and a tower in the foreground; and a panoramic scene of the same river crossed by a long bridge leading toward a hilltop cathedral complex and old town. The layout and style suggest an early‑20th‑century European city postcard.

Colorized panoramic view over a historic European city with dense, red‑roofed buildings seen from an elevated, green hillside. A prominent church-like structure with a steep, pointed roof appears on the left, and a grand civic building with ornate façade is visible near the center. The lower margin has printed German captions and publisher information, with handwritten cursive text across the bottom.

Black-and-white postcard showing the richly decorated interior of a mosque. The image focuses on an ornate mihrab niche framed by arches and intricate Islamic geometric and floral patterns. Tall candlestick-like stands or lamp holders flank the scene. At the bottom there is printed caption text in French identifying the location as Sidi-Bou-Medine and describing the interior of the mosque and its mihrab.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a grand, tree‑lined riverside promenade in a Central European spa town. Elegant multi‑storey historicist buildings line the street on the left, while on the right is a colonnaded structure with statues on its roof, filled with strolling people in early 20th‑century clothing. In the background, more buildings climb the wooded hills. German text at the top identifies the scene as Karlsbad and specific streets or quays; publisher information appears at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bustling cobblestoned square with people in early 20th‑century clothing walking in front of ornate Gothic-style buildings. Tall decorated trees and a small pavilion marked "Exposition" indicate a horticultural exhibition taking place in the city's main square. Printed caption text is visible beneath the image and along the left margin.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Renaissance Revival opera house on a busy city street corner. The multi‑story building has arched windows, elaborate stonework, and a prominent mansard roof. In front and alongside run wide streets filled with pedestrians, horse‑drawn vehicles or carriages, early automobiles, and several electric trams. At the top right of the image is a printed caption identifying the scene.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall rocky outcrop with a statue of a deer or chamois standing on its peak. At the base there is a simple wooden rail beside a path, and in the background a town lies in a hilly, wooded valley. At the top left, in red print, is the caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a European market square with cobblestone ground and rows of stalls selling goods, many people in early‑20th‑century dress, and horse carts. On the left and center stand narrow gabled townhouses with steep tiled roofs and painted façades bearing German‑language shop signs. In the background, on a hill above the town, rises a large fortified castle complex with towers and massive walls, overlooking the square.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a neoclassical complex with a central temple‑like building featuring a columned façade and triangular pediment, flanked by colonnaded wings. Two tall columns with statues stand in front, and there is a formal garden with palm trees and paths in the foreground. Greek and French captions are printed at the bottom, and there is handwriting and postal ink on the image.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a city. The tower has a steep shingled roof, projecting wooden galleries, and huge clock faces with Roman numerals on its sides. In the foreground is a path and trees; in the background, the city spreads out across a valley. Printed caption text at the top reads: "Graz. Uhrturm am Schloßberg".

A black‑and‑white view of a historic European market square lined with ornate gabled houses and a prominent town hall–like building on the right. On the left stands a tall clock tower with a distinctive bulbous crown. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk across the open square in the foreground. At the bottom center of the image, the caption reads "MARKT — NIJMEGEN."

Black‑and‑white view of a vaulted stone courtyard seen through a large Gothic-style arch. The image shows a two‑storey arcade with rounded arches and a central courtyard where a sculpture or fountain stands. The scene has a medieval, cloister-like atmosphere. At the lower right, a modern website watermark is visible.

Sepia-toned postcard image of a large stone hydroelectric power station building beside a fast-flowing river. The structure has a series of tall arched windows and multiple water outlets at its base. Trees and another industrial building are visible in the background. At the top right of the card is printed text reading "Trollhättan, Kraftstationen."

Vintage black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view over a wooded valley with a village and a large castle-like complex on a hill. The castle has a tall tower with a spire rising above multi‑storey buildings. The settlement lies along a narrow valley with scattered houses and a railway or road running through. At the top center, in red print, is the word "Weesenstein."

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a historic Italian square with cobblestone pavement. In the foreground is a stone lion sculpture at the base of a column. In the background stands a tall medieval clock or civic tower with Ghibelline-style battlements, attached to or overlooking a long palazzo façade with arched doors, balconies, and shuttered windows. Several people are gathered in the square. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as 'TRENTO - Torre Grande' along with a small serial number.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a European town. Multi‑story buildings line both sides of a wide street with trees and a sidewalk; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the pavement and a horse‑drawn carriage travels down the road. In the distance, a baroque church with two onion‑domed towers dominates the background. At the top of the card, printed in a serif typeface, is the caption "Bodenbach-Rosawitz."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cylindrical medieval brick tower with a conical roof and a cross-topped spire. The tower stands at the end of a wet, reflective street bordered by multi‑story buildings. Small figures of pedestrians and an early 20th‑century car are visible. Below the image is a caption indicating the location and name of the tower.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall medieval church with a massive square tower and a very high, slender spire rising above an old town with pitched-roof buildings. In the foreground is the church roof and nave; in the background another church tower is visible. At the bottom right the caption reads "NIGULISTE KIRIK".

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over the historic center of a city framed by mountains. In the foreground is a square with arcaded buildings and a domed church roof. A tall medieval clock tower with battlements rises prominently on the right. The caption at the bottom margin reads "TRENTO - Panorama dal Duomo."

Black‑and‑white view of a busy town square with market stalls and many people in traditional European clothing. The focal point is a large Renaissance‑style town hall with a steep tiled roof, gables, small towers with spires and a central clock. In the foreground, groups of women wearing regional folk costumes gather near a fountain; horse‑drawn carts and early carriages are visible at the right.

Black-and-white photograph showing a procession of riders on horseback in elaborate, historical-style uniforms with plumed helmets crossing a narrow bridge toward a fortified gate. The gate is part of a large stuccoed building with many rectangular windows and a tiled roof. Above the arched gateway is an ornate baroque coat of arms flanked by two lions and surmounted by a row of crowns or plumes. People on foot follow the riders through the gate. The image has the appearance of an old printed postcard, with some handwritten or printed marks at the very top edge.

A monochrome postcard depicting an old stone ruin surrounded by trees. The structure has partially collapsed walls, arched windows, and remnants of columns, indicating a historic building in decay. At the bottom center of the card there is printed text indicating the location of the ruin.

Illustrated postcard showing a stylized drawing of a grand neoclassical building with a large dome, colonnaded façade, sculptural pediment and statues on the roof, surrounded by trees in the foreground. Below the image there is printed text indicating the location and building name, with additional publisher information at the very bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white vintage photograph showing a very large crowd gathered outdoors in a park or tree‑lined avenue. Most people wear hats and coats typical of the early 20th century. In the background there is a small monument or statue on a pedestal and some placards held above the crowd, but no legible writing. The card has the typical white border and format of an old photographic postcard.

An old sepia-toned postcard designed over the front page of a Portuguese newspaper titled "Novidades" dated Friday, 4 April 1902. In the center, a torn-paper effect reveals a photograph of a waterfront fortress tower with battlements, identified below as "Lisboa. Torre de Belem." The photo is overprinted with a large circular postal cancellation. There are multiple postal marks and extensive handwritten script in ink addressing the card to a person in Spain. The overall style is antique and journal-like.

Color postcard view of a large river curving through a green landscape with meadows on the inside of the bend. A historic white paddle steamer with a red‑topped smokestack and many passengers is sailing in the foreground; the name "RIESA" is visible on the side of the vessel. On the right bank stands a hilltop complex dominated by a large Gothic‑style church with tall spire and attached castle‑like buildings overlooking a town of red‑roofed houses. Bridges cross the river in the middle distance, and low wooded hills form the background.

Black‑and‑white photograph postcard showing a small rural church complex with a steeply pitched tiled roof and whitewashed walls, accompanied by a separate wooden bell tower with shingle cladding. The foreground includes a path, lawn, and low landscaping. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the church as Grevbäcks kyrka, and publisher information appears on the right.

Illustrated postcard showing a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river with several steam-powered boats below. The bridge carries roadway traffic and connects to a historic town with church towers and dense traditional buildings on the far bank. Dutch text is printed along the bottom margin of the image.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the façade and side view of a large cathedral with a decorative gabled front, arched portals, and a dome and bell tower behind it. Surrounding city buildings and a distant landscape are visible to the left. The caption at the bottom margin reads "MESSINA - Duomo - Secolo IV."

Colorized panoramic view of a historic European city with red-roofed houses and public buildings nestled around a wooded hill, beyond which lie soft, rolling mountains. Atop the hill and nearby elevations are small pavilion-like lookout structures. The caption in German at the top identifies the scene as a view of Graz from the Hilmwarte. Additional small print at the upper right edge indicates the publisher and city.

A colorized historical postcard showing a grand railway station building in an Orientalist architectural style, with arched windows, domes and corner turrets. People walk and ride horse‑drawn carriages along a broad street in front of the station. Printed multilingual captions (French, German, and Ottoman Turkish) identify the building and its location.

A vintage sepia-toned winter view over a harbor area with snowy trees, railway tracks, horse-drawn vehicles on a road, and smoking ships at the quays. In the distance a low, industrial and civic skyline of a northern European city is visible across the water. Handwritten-style captions appear in two languages along the bottom border.

A vintage multi-view postcard designed as a strip of photographic film winding across a grey background. Each film frame shows a different landmark or city view in color: a panoramic river-and-mountain view of the city, monumental buildings, a circular colonnade, a war memorial or monument, a fountain in a square with historic buildings, and a church with a tall bell tower. On top of the film strip there are cut-out labels with Italian text.

A color postcard-style image showing a coastal hilltop fortress overlooking a seaside town. In the foreground are tropical trees, including palm fronds and a flowering tree with vivid red-orange blossoms. Below are red-tiled roofs and low-rise houses; in the distance, on a green hill, a large, light-colored fort dominates the skyline with the ocean visible beyond under a blue sky.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a medieval cylindrical stone tower with a steep conical roof standing along a broad street or square. The tower has small rectangular windows and is flanked by multi‑story townhouses. Leafless trees line the street, mountains are faintly visible in the background, and several pedestrians, including a child in the foreground, walk or stand near the tower.

Black‑and‑white photograph of a Romanesque cathedral dominating a town square. The building has a tall, polygonal bell tower with paired arched openings, an apse with blind arcades, and a smaller, ornate porch-like structure with columns and a gabled roof in front. People in early‑20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the fenced area in front of the church. Townhouses line the street on the left; a large domed structure and additional stone buildings appear behind the cathedral.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing the apse and rear side of a large Romanesque cathedral. The central octagonal dome-tower with arched windows rises above heavy stone walls, semi-circular apses, and decorative blind arcades. A small entrance porch stands on the left, with a fence and a few pedestrians in front. The lower margin has a printed caption in Italian identifying the location, and the remaining white space is filled with handwritten Italian text and a date.

Black-and-white postcard showing a panoramic view of a German town with many tightly packed houses, church spires on the left, and a castle-like complex with towers and surrounding parkland on the right. In the lower part, a decorative frame with a laurel wreath and lyre emblem contains German text and a ribbon announcing a singers' festival in Waldenburg, Saxony, dated June 13–14, 1908.

Black-and-white image showing a large baroque water castle on an island, photographed from across a broad lake. The building has four round corner towers with domed roofs, a central church-like projection with a tall spire, and formal tree-lined terraces along the shoreline, with two small pavilion buildings near the water. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a central square with a statue monument in the foreground, umbrella‑covered market stalls, a tram and pedestrians. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey historic buildings with shop signs in German. In the background, a steep hill rises with fortification walls and a prominent clock tower on top. The printed caption at the bottom reads "KÜNSTLERKARTE" and "GRAZ, HAUPTPLATZ".

Colorized scenic postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground, lined by trees and multi‑story historic buildings. A bridge crosses the river toward a church tower and other urban structures. Behind the city rises a green hill crowned with fortifications and towers. In the background are soft, rolling mountains under a pale blue sky. At the top of the image the caption reads "Graz Mur, Schloßberg."

An old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with fields and gardens in the foreground, a cluster of low houses in the middle ground, and a church with a tall spire rising above the town skyline. The style and aging of the card suggest an early 20th‑century production. Printed captions in three languages appear at the top.

Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large Baroque monastery complex behind leafless trees. The main church has a steep roof and an ornate tower with a bulbous spire. In the foreground, people walk along a path or road with a low fence, giving a view of the monastery courtyard buildings. The printed caption in German at the upper right reads "Kloster St. Marienstern."

Sepia-toned photograph showing a row of massive round stone defensive towers with city walls behind low-roofed buildings along a quiet street. In the background a church or town-hall spire rises above the old town skyline. The style suggests a historic European walled city. No visible text appears on the front of the card.

Colorized historic view of a central town square with a large, light-colored town hall building featuring a tall clock tower and ornate gable roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and gather in the square. Surrounding the square are multi‑story buildings with red roofs, including one signed as a hotel and restaurant. German captions are printed at the top identifying the place as Pirna in Saxon Switzerland and specifying the market square and town hall.

A black-and-white aerial or elevated view of a formal city park with tree-lined paths, a central fountain, and landscaped gardens. A river and bridge run through the middle distance, with dense trees and a backdrop of multi‑story historic buildings and church spires. At the bottom margin, multilingual captions identify the scene as the gardens near the opera house in Riga.

A colorized early-20th‑century view over a landscaped park with a winding path. A woman holding a red umbrella walks along the path in the foreground. In the distance, on a hill, stands a large grand hotel complex with red roofs and corner towers. The printed German caption at the top mentions Karlsbad and a view from the Posthof Promenade toward Hotel Imperial.

Black‑and‑white image of a richly decorated church interior with a Gothic-style stone and carved-wood pulpit reached by a spiral stair, elaborate tracery and heraldic shields on a gallery, stained-glass windows, patterned wall hangings, and a commemorative wall relief of a robed man beside an arched door. The floor is tiled with light-and-dark diamond patterns.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an old, somewhat dilapidated multi‑storey manor or palace-like building beside a pond or moat. Leafless trees stand in front of the facade, partially obscuring tall arched windows and open loggias or balconies. A small figure walks at the far left and a horse and cart stand to the right. The reflection of the building is visible in the still water in the foreground. Handwritten text appears faintly at the lower left of the image.

Sepia-toned photograph showing an inner courtyard with a long arcaded loggia on the right and a balustrade in the foreground. On the left stands a small domed turret-like structure with circular windows and a steep external staircase leading up toward an upper level of a Renaissance-style building with arched windows and a tiled roof.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a broad public square beside a canal with a small bridge in the foreground. The square is bordered by multi‑story classical buildings; the most prominent one in the center has an ornate façade and arched windows, identified as the Exchange (Börsen). People, horse‑drawn vehicles, and early street life are visible. Printed red caption text appears below the image.

Vintage black-and-white postcard view of a large riverside castle complex with towers and fortified walls, seen from across the water. Trees line the embankment in front of the castle, and a church tower rises further in the background to the right. The lower margin contains printed German text in red and small publisher details in black.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing the front façade of a large church with a rose window, classical columns and an ornate entrance portal, standing on an open square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings. A tall bell tower rises on the left side of the church, and mountains are visible in the background. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square. The printed titles at the top read "TRENTO" on the left and "Chiesa di Santa Maria Maggiore" on the right.

Hand-colored vintage view of a town square with a prominent round stone tower on the left, featuring many green-shuttered windows and vines at street level. On the right is a crenellated stone wall resembling old fortifications, with posters on a billboard near its base. In the background are multi‑story buildings and a distant tower or castle, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk through the square. The caption text in Italian at the top identifies the scene as a location in Trento.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverfront city with elegant historic buildings along the bank, a bridge over the river, and a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortifications and towers. A prominent church tower with a bulbous dome rises among the riverside buildings. On the hillside stands a famous clock tower and other structures. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned photograph of a gently sloping, cobblestoned street lined with large trees on both sides. On the left is a multi‑story classical building with rectangular windows and simple decorative panels; on the right is a high stone wall and a sidewalk. A few pedestrians walk along the pavement. In the distance, partly framed by the trees, a cylindrical water tower or similar structure rises above lower buildings. At the very top center of the card, the number "1034" is handwritten in red ink.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a lush, tree‑lined basin or spring with reeds in the foreground and water flowing toward the viewer. Stone steps rise at the center to a terrace with balustrades, behind which are tall palm and conifer trees. On the right side stands a multi‑story classical building with arched windows and balconies. The printed captions beneath the image label the place in several languages.

Black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing a small harbor filled with wooden rowing boats and sailboats in the foreground, with a town's quayside buildings and a large multi‑storey hotel or civic building behind. A flag with a Nordic cross flies above one of the buildings. The lower left corner contains the printed caption "MARSTRAND", and a small number "8642" appears in the lower right.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town, taken from a descending lane with simple houses in the foreground and massive medieval stone fortifications behind. Prominent round defensive towers with crenellations, tall spires and a large Gothic‑style church or castle complex dominate the skyline. There is a water tower with a conical roof further back, and dense town buildings stretching into the distance.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a circular neoclassical rotunda with many columns and a domed roof, standing in an open area framed by large leafless trees. Multi‑storey buildings appear in the background. Decorative text in French and a souvenir stamp-like emblem are printed on the front.

Sepia-toned view of a very long Renaissance‑revival school complex on a riverside, with trees along the embankment and the building reflected in the calm water. A chapel-like wing with a small spire is visible on the left. Small boat on the river. Printed captions at top read the subject and city.

Colorized early 20th‑century view over a bustling outdoor market square filled with stalls and crowds. Ornate market buildings line the right side; multiple tall church spires rise in the background and a domed building appears to the left. The caption at the lower left reads "Libau. Petermarkt."

Sepia-toned view of a neo‑Gothic church with a very tall spire rising above a row of steep gabled roofs, seen from across a tree-lined river with a small bridge at right. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Pforzheim. Stadtkirche."

Sepia cityscape of Graz showing the River Mur with a steel truss bridge in the foreground, rows of historic buildings and a baroque church tower with an onion dome, and the Schlossberg hill behind with fortifications and the prominent Uhrturm clock tower. A printed caption at bottom right reads "Graz. Mur und Schloßberg."

Moonlit scene of a landscaped park with people strolling and children playing near an octagonal brick/stucco tower topped by a bulbous onion dome with a small lantern. Trees and a small pavilion sit nearby; the image looks like a painted view reproduced as a color postcard.

Black‑and‑white night view of a solemn religious ceremony staged in front of a large Romanesque cathedral façade with arcaded gallery and three portals; clergy and choir are visible. Caption at lower left reads "Pécs. Missa Sollemnis." The reverse bears Hungarian handwriting, a green 10 fillér stamp of Hungary, and a PÉCS postmark dated 1936.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the main square of Pécs with the ornate Baranya County Hall (captioned Megyei Tanácsháza) behind the Holy Trinity column and a landscaped plaza with cars and pedestrians. The reverse has Hungarian handwriting, a MAGYAR POSTA stamp, and an address to Budapest dated 1957.
Black-and-white vintage postcard showing the stone ruins of a medieval church with a broken tower and apse, surrounded by trees. A printed caption at the top reads 'Sigtuna. S:t Olofs ruin.'

Colorized vintage postcard view of a tree-lined square with low buildings and market stalls, with a wooded hill and fortifications above. A red-roofed clock tower is visible on the hillside. Printed caption reads "Gruss aus Graz. Lendplatz."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex above a riverside town. The caption in red at top left reads "Meissen. Königl. Albrechtsburg." A tall cathedral spire and another tower under scaffolding rise behind the castle. The Elbe river and timber rafts are visible in the foreground. Publisher credit is printed vertically at the right edge.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a bustling market square with stalls, pedestrians, bicycles and horse‑drawn carts. On the right stands an ornate town hall with arched windows and a clock tower. A church tower rises in the background. Handwritten captions appear along the lower margin.

Black‑and‑white real‑photo view of a ruined hilltop castle. A smooth, slender cylindrical tower with several round holes stands in front of a rough stone curtain wall; behind, a larger round keep rises above the trees. Dense foliage covers most of the slope; no printed captions are visible.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a grand neo‑Renaissance bank building on a corner with arched windows and ornate reliefs, fronted by a cobblestone square and trees. A caption in Russian and German appears at the top left, and a Russian inscription runs along the façade above the entrance.

Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a large hilltop complex with a castle-like building and an adjacent Gothic cathedral. The cathedral's twin west towers are surrounded by dense scaffolding while a slender completed spire rises between them. Below, along the riverside, lumber yards and workshops line the embankment; a smokestack and several small boats are visible. German signage appears on riverside buildings.
