Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestoned town square bordered by 2‑ to 3‑story historic buildings. On the left is a row of houses with shopfronts; in the middle distance rises a church tower with a clock and onion‑shaped spire. On the right side stands a prominent multi‑story civic‑style building with arched windows and decorative stonework, facing the open square. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the square, and bicycles are visible near the large building. Mountainous terrain appears faintly in the background.

Colour-tinted vintage postcard view of a coastal promenade with railings and trees on the left and the sea on the right. In the background a large fortified rock with ramparts and buildings stands out, forming a citadel by the water. A small boat is visible in the bay. There is printed caption text in French at the bottom and handwritten notes across the lower margin.

A monochrome winter scene showing a historic European town covered in snow, with a frozen or icy river in the foreground. A multi‑arch stone bridge crosses the river toward a large hilltop complex of Gothic towers and steep‑roofed buildings dominating the right side, likely a castle and cathedral. Snow blankets the roofs and the riverbank. At the bottom left margin in cursive script is the caption "Meissen im Winter."

A vintage black-and-white postcard view showing a small passenger boat or ferry sailing on a body of water in front of a tree‑lined shore with several large buildings. One prominent domed church-like structure with a lantern tower stands on the hill, and to the right there is a large, ornate building with towers. The upper left corner of the card bears printed text in Swedish describing the view of Skeppsholmen in Stockholm.

A historical black‑and‑white postcard showing a large column of British troops marching through a coastal town with Venetian-style fortifications and an old harbor. Many soldiers and officers are visible, along with civilians watching from rooftops and balconies. In the background are stone walls, bastions, and mixed Ottoman and Venetian architecture, including a minaret. On the right side of the postcard there is printed bilingual text in French and Greek describing the departure of British troops from Candia/Heraklion in July 1909.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a hilltop castle complex rising above dense forest. The large building has multiple gabled roofs, a prominent rounded central dome-like tower, and a church-like tower with an onion-shaped spire on the right. The image has a white border with handwritten-style German caption at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white aerial view of a large industrial complex surrounded by forest, lakes and a scattered town. Several long factory halls with saw‑tooth and gabled roofs, tall brick smokestacks emitting light smoke, and rail sidings dominate the center. In the foreground stands a prominent multi‑storey manor‑like building with a central dome and formal entrance, set within landscaped grounds and trees. Beyond the factories are wooden houses and villas along the lakeshore and within the forested hills. There is no printed caption or other visible text on the image.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town with traditional European houses, a church with a tall spire, and several fortress-like towers on a hill behind the town. In the foreground is an empty ploughed field bordered by a wooden fence. Red printed text at the top left reads "Gruß aus Stolpen." and sideways along the left edge is the publisher credit.

A colorized panoramic view of a European city nestled between green hills and mountains. In the foreground are villas and buildings with red-tiled roofs surrounded by trees and fields; further back is a denser urban area with church towers. On a wooded hill to the right stands a prominent tower-like structure. At the top left of the image, printed text in German reads 'Graz von der Hilmwarte.'

Sepia-toned postcard showing a scenic viewpoint with benches and people sitting under trees, looking toward a muscular lion statue on a stone pedestal. The statue overlooks a hilly landscape in the background. Printed captions in German identify the location as the Hackher monument on the Schlossberg in Graz. The publisher information appears at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a central stone monument on a stepped base surrounded by an iron fence. Around the fenced monument are several canvas tents, with people and belongings visible near them, suggesting temporary shelter in a damaged urban area. In the background are low, partially ruined buildings and a cloudy sky. The lower border of the postcard contains printed Greek and English captions identifying the location as Solomos Place in Zante (Zakynthos), along with a website watermark and publisher details.

A sepia-toned architectural photograph of a Mughal-style pavilion built of light-colored stone, with intricate jali (latticed) screens, carved brackets, and a domed chhatri on the roof. The structure stands at the edge of a fort wall or high platform, with railings and balconies overlooking a drop on one side. There are no printed captions on the front aside from a small numeric code in the bottom-right margin.

Colorized vintage postcard showing the garden of the Achilleion palace in Corfu. It depicts a formal landscaped garden with hedges, palm trees and statues, including a prominent seated figure in the center. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk among the paths and stairs. At the right is a neoclassical building with columns. Printed captions in French and another language identify the scene as the garden of the Achilleion in Corfu.

Black‑and‑white view across a wide river toward a hill crowned by a large medieval castle complex. Below the castle, closer to the water, stand industrial and residential buildings with a tall chimney. A low weir or series of posts crosses the river, and a stone arch bridge is visible in the distance on the right. In the foreground, a small rowboat with two people is on the water. The image has wide white margins like an old photographic postcard. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image side.

Colorized panoramic view over a European city with red-tiled roofs, green parks, and a large tree-covered hill in the middle distance. On top of the hill a tower-like structure is visible, with mountains in the far background. At the top of the image there is a printed German caption.

Black‑and‑white landscape view over a river in a steep valley. A suspension bridge with two heavy masonry towers spans the river, while farther downstream a low footbridge crosses near the water. On the right, atop a forested hill, stands a sizable medieval castle complex with thick walls and a high central keep, attached to which is a church with a tall tower and steeple. On the left bank and in the background are smaller village buildings and wooded hills. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a European small town dominated by a large hilltop castle complex with a tall, tiered Baroque tower rising above multi‑winged stone buildings and steep tiled roofs. Below the castle are several modest houses, tree‑lined streets, and a riverbank road curving to the right. Forested hills surround the settlement. On the gable of a large building in the right foreground there are several painted advertisement panels in German.

A hand-colored historic postcard showing a panoramic view of a small Central European town with red-roofed houses, a prominent church with a tower in the center-right, and a large stone castle with round towers on the left. The town is surrounded by open fields and gentle hills. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the town and publisher in German.

Colorized vintage view over a hilly town with dense greenery. In the foreground there is a winding white path through a park or landscaped hillside, with trees and flowerbeds along fences. Below the hill stands a cluster of small houses and industrial buildings with red and light-colored roofs and a tall brick smokestack. On the ridge above are larger bourgeois-style houses and mansions, and on the right a prominent Gothic-style church with a tall spire. Beyond, a river plain or lowlands stretch into the distance. The card shows heavy age stains and discoloration, especially in the sky area. No legible printed text is visible on the image side.

Multi‑view color postcard with a dark red border showing a formal baroque park and palace. The upper images depict wide lawns with flowerbeds, stone balustrades and statues, including a large ornamental vase with sculpted figures on a pedestal. The lower left view shows a dynamic baroque sculpture group of two figures on a high base amid gardens. The lower right image shows a grand baroque palace with ornate façade and central pediment, fronted by a large pond or lake with many swans and a low, terraced shoreline.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a drawing/engraving of a hilltop city with large stone buildings and fortifications on a bluff, a gate and bridge in the foreground, carriages and soldiers on the road, and handwritten greetings along the bottom margin. German captions are printed at the lower left and right edges.

Colorized historic postcard view of a large neoclassical building with a central domed tower and two long wings with red roofs, labeled as a museum. The building faces an expansive open square or parade ground where small figures of people stroll. The sky is blue with scattered clouds, and low hills and trees are visible in the distance. The words "Zwickau." and "Museum." appear at the top.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing the interior of a grand glass-and-iron spa hall with tall arched windows and ornate decoration. In the center stands a large classical statue above a spring opening, around which workers—mostly women in aprons—are filling bottles and crates with mineral water. On the right, there is printed red German text describing the scene and publisher information at the bottom.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a park. The fountain has multiple tiers with classical statues: three draped female figures stand below the upper basin, while several seated or kneeling figures and putti surround the lower basin. Strong water jets arc outward in a ring. Trees and gentle hills form the background, with a church or tower visible in the distance. At the top left is printed German text identifying the location.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a medieval hilltop castle surrounded by dense forest. The multi‑story stone fortress has steep gabled roofs, turrets, and a central tower. At the bottom left of the image there is a printed caption identifying the site. The photo has a white border typical of vintage postcards.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large cobblestoned square bordered by multi‑story historic buildings with arcades at ground level. In the background, a church tower rises above the rooftops. On the right side stands a large baroque fountain with statuary. A few pedestrians and a cyclist cross the nearly empty square. A handwritten-style caption along the bottom white margin identifies the square.

Black‑and‑white view of a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river. The bridge has a prominent central arch with vertical supports and lower approach spans on either side. In the foreground there is a riverside embankment and some moored boats or barges. At the lower left corner, white printed text reads "De nieuwe Waalbrug". The overall style resembles an early– to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a busy harbor with piers lined by warehouses and port buildings, several steamships and sailing vessels in the water, and a lighthouse in the distance. Printed caption at the top reads "No. 39. Port Said - Port" and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears across the lower right.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a bell tower with an onion-shaped dome rising above trees on a landscaped hill. A curving path leads toward the tower, and several people in old-fashioned clothing stroll or stand on the grass in the foreground. The printed red caption at the top identifies the scene as a bell tower on the Schlossberg in Graz.

Vintage sepia-toned illustrated postcard showing views from Graz. The main image depicts a tall, multi-story tower with an onion-shaped dome set among trees and hills. Below it is an arched stone structure resembling old fortifications or ruins, with people walking along a path. In a smaller circular vignette on the right, there is an ornate iron pavilion or bandstand with a domed roof in a park, surrounded by trees and figures in late 19th‑century clothing. Decorative lettering at the top right reads "Gruss aus Graz." Publisher and printer information is printed along the lower edges.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a European riverside city. In the foreground a wide river is crossed by two adjacent bridges: an older stone-arch bridge and a newer steel-girder bridge on concrete piers. A long river barge steams upstream, and densely packed houses line the opposite bank. On the hill above stands a large fortified palace complex with multiple towers and steep roofs; one tall structure is surrounded by scaffolding. A church with a pointed spire is visible nearby. The scene suggests an old town with a castle overlooking the river and bridges.

A colorized postcard view of a large neo-Gothic country house and grounds identified as Margam Castle. The image shows stone walls, battlements, towers, and a central gatehouse with ornate windows and turrets. At the bottom is a printed caption strip with the place name.

Illustrated postcard showing two German soldiers in blue uniforms with pickelhaube helmets shaking hands in the foreground, one holding an Imperial German flag. Behind them are inset black‑and‑white photographs: one of a building with towers and another panoramic view of a riverside cityscape with church spires. Decorative foliage frames the images. The greeting text on the right reads "Gruss aus Lübeck." A small red number "No 1225." is printed at the bottom.

Color postcard view of a richly decorated Baroque pavilion and surrounding courtyard. The central building has large arched windows, elaborate sculptures and reliefs, and a mansard-style roof. Curved colonnades extend from both sides, enclosing an oval forecourt with terraced steps and rows of benches, suggesting it may be used as an open‑air venue. Trees form a green backdrop behind the ornate stone architecture. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park with a pond in the foreground, a sloping lawn with fences and rows of trees in the middle, and behind them a richly decorated Orthodox church with multiple onion domes and crosses. Surrounding the church are grand late‑19th‑/early‑20th‑century apartment and villa buildings with eclectic and half‑timbered façades. A small signboard stands by the path near the right side of the image.

Color-printed vintage postcard showing a formal garden with flowerbeds and a straight path leading toward a large, elegant building in the background. The structure is a French Second Empire–style mansion or palace with a mansard roof and a tall central clock tower. Trees and ornamental shrubs frame the garden, and the image has a grainy, early color-printing look with a white border.

Colorized vintage view of a river with green banks and a path in the foreground. Across the river lies a low settlement and, prominently on the horizon, a large domed building with a tall minaret, suggesting a mosque. Trees surround the buildings. Greek text is printed at the top, and a website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears at the bottom right.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large Baroque water castle with round corner towers and a chapel-like wing, reflected in a surrounding pond or moat. Trees and a promenade line the water and several small figures walk along the path. The sky is cloudy and the card has the typical white, slightly deckled border of mid‑20th‑century postcards. At the bottom, a German caption identifies the site as a Baroque castle near Dresden.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a Baroque church and adjacent ornate buildings lining a cobbled street with tram tracks. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. At the bottom, printed captions identify the view as in Graz, depicting the Barmherzigen-Kirche and Café "Helm". A vertical imprint along the left edge gives the publisher information from Graz.

Black-and-white postcard view of a lakeside town with traditional steep‑roofed buildings in the foreground and a tall clock tower with a pointed spire rising behind them. The scene is taken from the water, with mooring posts visible along the quay. The architecture is central European, and handwritten captions appear in German at the bottom margin.

A black‑and‑white/sepia panoramic view over a valley town surrounded by rolling hills. In the foreground are trees framing the scene; below runs a river and a railway line with tracks curving along the valley. Industrial chimneys and factory buildings occupy the lower right, while the middle distance shows a dense cluster of houses and several taller towers or church steeples. The town extends up the hillside. At the top right in red Gothic-style script is the caption identifying the location and viewpoint.

Colorized vintage view of a river scene with small boats and houseboats moored along grassy banks lined with trees. In the background a large metal bridge spans a wide river. The caption in red text at the upper right reads "NIJMEGEN Gezicht op de Waal," indicating a view of the River Waal at Nijmegen.

Black‑and‑white aerial view of a large four‑masted sailing ship moored along a riverfront or harbor promenade. Smaller boats are tied nearby. Behind the quay is a tree‑lined park and a low‑rise town with detached houses and a few institutional buildings. Several mid‑20th‑century cars are visible near the waterfront. The overall look suggests a historic tall ship preserved at a city waterfront. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image.

Colorized postcard view of a large waterfront palace with white façades and green domes, seen from across the sea under a clear sky. At the top it is labeled in French "ALEXANDRIE - Le Palais Ras-el-Tin." A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears near the bottom over the water.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a waterfront promenade with people walking and small boats along the shore. A large round tower with crenellations stands prominently beside the water. The card has printed captions in French at the bottom and a publisher credit on the left.

Sepia-toned vintage view from a hillside terrace overlooking a city. On the left stands a distinctive medieval clock tower with a large round clock face and steep, shingled roof, partially obscured by a leafy tree in the foreground. A path and low stone wall run along the viewpoint, with the cityscape spreading out in the background on a plain below.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a landscaped park with curving paths, benches, manicured shrubs and tall trees. A decorative street lamp stands near the path in the foreground. Rising above the trees in the background is an ornate historic tower with a domed, pinnacled roof. The sky is lightly clouded. Printed German text appears at the top of the image.

Colorized illustration showing a riverside cityscape with a bridge over a wide river in the foreground, a hill densely covered with trees and crowned by fortifications and towers in the middle, and distant mountains under a pastel sky. Historic multi‑story buildings line the riverbank, and a prominent clock tower stands on the hillside. Printed text at the top left names the scene in German.

Colorized vintage view of a large European town square surrounded by historic multi‑story buildings with red and brown tiled roofs. In the middle of the square stands a monumental fountain or statue with multiple figures and steps, around which people stroll and small market stalls and café umbrellas are set up. In the background, on a wooded hill, a prominent clock tower rises above old fortification walls. The caption at the top left reads "Graz. Hauptplatz."

Vintage sepia photograph of a grand neoclassical–baroque theatre building seen from the front-left corner, with ornate facades, arched windows, sculptures, and statues on the roof. A curved driveway and landscaped area lead up to the entrance. Decorative street lamps stand in the foreground. At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the building as the national theatre.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large fortified complex on a riverside hill. A long rectangular building with many small windows sits on top of a high stone wall. Rising behind it is a tall Baroque-style church tower with an onion-shaped dome and slender spire. Trees and landscaped slopes descend toward a calm river in the foreground, with a small decorative wooden footbridge near the water. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a wide, busy boulevard lined with multi‑storey historic buildings and tram tracks. Crowds of people, several trams, and what appears to be a marching formation fill the street. In the foreground stands a monument with a sculpted figure on a pedestal. Church or clock towers rise in the background. The caption at the top reads "Dresden. Hauptstrasse." and a small imprint with publisher information appears near the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large crowd in a stadium with stepped marble seating and a ceremonial entrance. Uniformed soldiers, dignitaries, and elegantly dressed spectators fill the scene. Text in Greek and French along the bottom identifies the event as the arrival of the King and Queen of Italy and Greece at the stadium in Athens.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with cobblestone pavement. A tall clock tower with a bulbous spire and cross stands prominently to the left, attached to an older stone structure. In the background on a slightly higher elevation is a large building with multiple small towers, resembling a castle or palace. On the right side is a building with painted signage reading "Hôtel Stadt D…" and smaller German text below, indicating a hotel and restaurant. On the left is another building with shop fronts, one labeled "Möbel‑Magazin" and "Ernst Voigtländer & Söhne". A hanging sign in the foreground reads "Zum … Haus". A few people are visible walking in the open square and one man in a hat stands at the left edge.

Vintage postcard showing a black‑and‑white photograph of a multi‑arched stone bridge spanning a river, with trees on both banks. The upper area includes several green Greek postage stamps postmarked in 1905. Along the bottom are printed captions in Greek, French, and English identifying the bridge, with extensive handwritten text in Greek filling the lower margin.

A monochrome postcard view of a river crossing with a ferry landing. In the foreground are cobblestones, railings, a horse-drawn cart, and several people near a small pier structure with posts and cables. Across the wide river a long metal bridge spans from left to right. The style is early 20th century. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene as the ferry from Nijmegen to Lent and a small serial number appears in the lower left.

Historic postcard framed by a brown stone arch with a city coat of arms at the top left. Through the arch is a black‑and‑white view of a large neo‑Gothic parish church with a tall central spire and clock, located on a town square flanked by multi‑storey buildings with shops and people, carriages, and trees in front. There is printed multilingual text at the bottom left and center, and handwritten script across the lower part of the card with a date.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large rectangular castle with corner towers, partly hidden by trees and situated above a stream or small river in a valley. At the top in red lettering is the caption 'Castel Cles Val di Non.' Additional small red text appears at the bottom margin, likely a printer's line and date.

A sepia-toned panoramic view over a small riverside town with a mix of wooden houses in the foreground and a larger, more monumental masonry building at the center. Beyond it stretches a broad river or lake with wooded hills on both banks and scattered industrial buildings and piers along the shoreline. At the very bottom edge of the image, partially cut off, is the caption text naming the location.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate resort hotel set amid lush gardens with palm trees and winding paths. The multi‑story building features towers with domed roofs, many balconies, and an arched bridge-like structure connecting wings over a garden walkway. A person can be seen seated on a bench in the landscaped grounds. In the sky area on the right, the red number "6725." is printed.

Colorized vintage view of a riverside promenade with a woman in traditional dress leaning on a wooden fence by a wide river. Across the river stands a bridge and a row of ornate multi‑story buildings. Behind the town rises a steep, green hill crowned with fortification walls and towers. At the top left of the image text reads "GRAZ. — Mur Schlossberg." indicating the scene shows the Schlossberg hill by the Mur River in Graz.

Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic/Romanesque hilltop complex comprising a cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle-like palace and round tower, rising above a riverside town. In the foreground, steam-powered riverboats with tall funnels travel along a broad river, producing dark smoke. Traditional European houses and a small turreted riverside building sit between the water and the steep, wooded hill leading up to the castle and cathedral.

Black-and-white postcard view of a grand historic opera house in neoclassical/Baroque style with a large central dome, ornate sculptures on the pediment and roof, and a columned portico. Trees and a curved driveway frame the foreground. Printed captions in the lower corners identify the location and publisher.

Colorized panoramic view over a small European town in a river valley. A river with a bridge runs on the left, red‑roofed houses and church towers fill the center, and steep hills with terraced slopes rise behind the town. On the right stands a round medieval tower on a wooded hill. The printed title at the top left reads "Camburg a. Saale." Additional small vertical text appears along the left and right borders.

Colorized postcard view of a large hilltop castle surrounded by dense greenery. The multi‑story building has white walls, red gabled roofs, and green domed towers. A stone wall runs along the foreground. At the top of the image, printed in red, are the words "Zschopau." on the left and "Schloss Wildeck." on the right against a clear sky.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic riverside view of an industrial city with factory buildings, chimneys, warehouses, and a church spire in the distance. In the foreground is a river or canal with quays and small boats, and an open, grassy bank. The bottom margin contains the printed caption "Tampere - Tammerfors" and the publisher credit, while the rest of the lower area is filled with handwritten correspondence in a cursive script.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a grand spa theater complex. On the left is a multi‑story building labeled "Sachsenhof" with many windows and balconies. In the center is a neoclassical building with four large columns and a pediment, labeled "Kurtheater." Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll in the open square and paths in front of the buildings, which are surrounded by trees.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a crowded town square during a fair. In the foreground stands an ornate baroque fountain with multiple statues and basins, surrounded by people in early 20th‑century dress. Market stalls and dense crowds fill the streets extending from the square. Multi‑story historic buildings with arcades and shuttered windows frame the plaza; a tall bell tower rises on the left and a domed church on the right. The printed caption at the top reads in Italian, identifying the scene as Piazza Duomo during the St. Joseph fair in Trento.

A sepia-toned image showing the flooded entrance gate of a brick structure, identified as the gate of a castle. The gate is an arched brick gateway with some architectural detailing on top, partially submerged in floodwater. Leafless trees and traditional European buildings are visible in the background, reinforcing a winter or early spring setting. At the bottom, Dutch text is printed.

A sepia-toned postcard featuring an old stone fortress with thick walls and few small openings. The structure is bordered by trees and a small dirt path leading up to it. There is an animal, possibly a donkey or mule, visible in the foreground. Greek and French text appears under the image, accompanied by a numerical identifier.

The image shows a sepia-toned photograph featuring an old stone ruin with tall windows and a pointed roof in the background, alongside a more modern building with columns and a balcony in the foreground. Well-maintained grass and trees surround the site with a dirt road and stone posts. There is a printed caption at the bottom left.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Renaissance-style castle with multiple windows, ornate gables, and a prominent central tower topped with a spire. The structure appears old and weathered. The upper left contains German text printed directly on the image.

A vintage postcard shows an ornate, historical building with a large clock tower in a grand architectural style, likely late 19th or early 20th century. The text 'Danzig. Hauptbahnhof.' is printed at the top in a decorative script. There are horse-drawn carriages and people in early 20th-century attire, indicating the era. Architectural details are elaborate, with towers and statues visible.

A black and white postcard photograph showing a river (the Elbe), a bridge, and a prominent hilltop architectural complex with tall spires, surrounded by a historic townscape. Some boats are visible on the water, and a tree frames the foreground. The text at the bottom reads 'Meißen a.d. Elbe. Blick von Proschwitz.'

A black and white postcard showing a large historical castle complex situated near a winding river in a rural landscape. The postcard has German text at the top which identifies the location as Strehla an der Elbe—Schloß, suggesting the image is of a castle (Schloss) near the Elbe river in the town of Strehla. The scene includes the castle buildings surrounded by trees and fields, with the river Elbe visible in the background.

A vintage black and white postcard depicting a rocky shoreline with waves crashing, with a distant city skyline visible on the horizon under a cloudy sky. Notable features of the skyline include several steeples or towers, characteristic of old European cities. In the bottom left, there is a handwritten inscription.

A black-and-white image of a historical town with two prominent castle towers to the left, surrounded by trees and a wooden fence along a path. In the distance to the right is a large church with a tall steeple. The image appears the be somewhat damaged or partially cut at the corners, with no visible modern elements.

A black and white image shows a narrow cobbled street lined with wooden houses, leading up to a large, prominent church with characteristic Northern European gothic revival features (steep gables, round windows, pointed roof). A classic street lamp is visible on the right side, and bare trees suggest the photo was taken in colder months.

A sepia-toned postcard image showing a busy market scene filled with people, many wearing traditional clothing, along a stone embankment with buildings and trees in the background. The spires of a large cathedral are visible above the rooftops. The printed text reads 'Uppsala, Fisktorget' in the top right corner.

The image shows an old, colorized postcard featuring a large monument with an angel statue on top. The monument is flanked by ornate street lights, stone sculptures, and immaculately landscaped surroundings. The text at the top left reads 'Reval. – Russalka-Denkmal.', and fine print runs vertically on the right side of the image.

A black and white image showing a large, open cobblestone public square bordered by historic buildings, with a fountain at the center. In the background, a hillside dotted with trees rises above the town, and there is a prominent medieval-looking building or castle at the right. There are several people walking, and the scene appears old, likely early 20th century. Shop signs are visible on the facades. The text 'Ferdinand L...g' (likely Ferdinand Lengyel) can be read on one building, and there are other less readable signs.

A sepia-toned postcard showing a hillside with traditional stone houses at the base and a ruined castle (kastro) on its peak. The scene is framed by foliage and features classic early 20th-century buildings. There is text in both Greek and French, and a watermark for elia.org.gr.

The postcard features a black and white photograph of a Gothic cathedral roof adorned with elaborate spires, pinnacles, and flying buttresses. The architecture is highly ornate, with numerous statues and intricate details visible along the roofline. There is French text printed vertically to the right side of the image, describing the subject.

A sepia-toned postcard featuring a large, ornate, multi-story historic building with a pointed turret on the corner. There are many horse-drawn carriages and people in period dress gathered in a bustling square in front of the building. Text appears in both printed and cursive hand at the bottom and left margin. The overall scene suggests a European city in the late 19th or early 20th century.

A black and white vintage image of a broad street lined with trees and wooden houses. In the distance, there is a church with a tall spire. People, some in old-fashioned attire, are walking along the unpaved road. The words 'Lovisa' and 'Södra Esplanadgatan' are printed at the top.

A vintage postcard showing a wide, tree-lined avenue with horse-drawn carriages, early automobiles, and a double-decker bus on a cobblestone street. Vintage sepia postcard view of a grand, multi‑storey Belle Époque hotel complex nestled at the base of a forested hillside. The large central building has many windows and dormer roofs, with a more ornate wing on the right featuring tall arched windows and decorative towers. In the foreground are glass-covered promenades or colonnades, terraces with tables and umbrellas, and people strolling in elegant early‑20th‑century attire. At the top in red text it reads "Karlsbad" on the left and "Grand Hôtel Pupp" on the right.

Black‑and‑white view from a dirt road descending into a valley, framed by trees and village houses. In the mid‑ground a stone bridge and fenced path cross a stream. Beyond, on a rise, stands a large Renaissance‑style castle complex with multiple gabled roofs and corner towers. To the left of the castle rises a tall church tower with an onion‑shaped spire. Rolling hills and scattered buildings lie in the background, giving a Central European small‑town impression. There is no visible printed or handwritten text on the image side.

A black-and-white postcard view of a historic fortified hill with stone walls, old buildings, and a tall church tower rising above trees and a park-like path in the foreground. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Tallinn and the Toompea hill, with text in Estonian and German.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a small stone lookout tower on a hill, partly surrounded by trees and shrubs. A dirt path leads up to the tower, with rocks scattered along the ground. A person is seated near the base of the tower. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a tall medieval city tower rising from a gateway at the edge of a town square. Surrounding the tower are low historic buildings and a larger neoclassical school building. People walk and ride horse-drawn carriages across the square. The captions in German at the top identify the scene as Bautzen with the Reichenturm and the industrial and trade school.

A black‑and‑white view of a large hilltop complex with a tall, ornate baroque tower rising from a multi‑storey castle or monastery building. The structure has steep tiled roofs with dormer windows and is surrounded by dense forested hills. Smaller houses with gabled roofs lie below the main complex in a valley town. The overall scene is rural and Central‑European in character. No visible text appears on the image.

A colorized historic postcard view of a grand concert hall building set behind trees and a small garden with flowerbeds and a fountain. The facade has arched windows, ornate roof details, and awnings bearing the word "VEREENIGING." At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a concert building in Nijmegen.

A black‑and‑white night view of a wide city street flanked by tall buildings. Dominating the scene are two symmetrical high-rise towers connected by a bridge in the distance, with light trails from cars on the street below. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Kungsgatan with the Kungstornen (Kings' Towers) in evening illumination in Stockholm. Printer/publisher details appear in the lower right corner.

Color-printed postcard showing an ornate Baroque church interior with a richly decorated high altar featuring a crowned Madonna and Child surrounded by golden rays, garlands, angels, and twisted columns. At the bottom, decorative German text identifies the altar and location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the grand interior of a vast domed building with galleries, arches, mosaics, and large circular Islamic calligraphic medallions hanging on the walls. The architectural space is clearly that of Hagia Sophia. Greek text is printed below the image, and a vertical caption with the editor's name appears on the right border.

Black-and-white postcard showing an ornate Renaissance-style arcade with a long row of arches supported by columns and richly decorated friezes above. Behind and to the left rises a more massive building with steep roofs and dormers, and in the background a tall baroque church tower with a bulbous dome. The scene is an open courtyard or square with metal railings and bollards in the foreground. No printed captions or text are visible on the image side.

Black-and-white image of a large, cylindrical masonry tower on a hill, surrounded by trees and sloping terrain. The tower has a tall, smooth drum with small windows or slits and a prominent domed roof topped by a small lantern structure and cross-like finial. In the distance, partially hidden by trees, are a few buildings and a broad landscape. There is no visible printed text on the image side.

Colorized historic postcard view of a grand neoclassical building with a large dome topped by a winged statue, identified as part of an art academy. In the foreground are curved stone stairways and a formal flower garden with geometric beds. In the background rises a large domed church and surrounding city buildings. The scene is tranquil with a single figure walking down the stairs. The printed caption at the top is in German.

A black-and-white aerial view of a large baroque fountain in an open square. The fountain features multiple tiers and statuary, with a central figure holding a trident, likely Neptune. A few small human figures walk around casting long shadows, and a tree canopy appears at the bottom of the image. On the right margin there is printed handwriting-style text identifying the scene.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long row of ornate late‑19th‑century buildings facing a tree‑lined square or park. There are people walking and a horse‑drawn carriage in the open foreground. Printed captions read "Zagreb (Croatie)" on the left and "Mihanovićeva ulica" above the buildings. The bottom margin is filled with handwritten cursive text in an old style.

Color postcard-style image showing a large Orthodox monastic complex with red-tiled roofs and a small domed church, surrounded by trees and greenery in a valley, with hills and mountains in the background. At the top, there is bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the convent. A website watermark appears at the bottom right.

An old sepia-toned postcard showing a large Eastern Orthodox cathedral with multiple onion-shaped domes topped by crosses. The church has ornate neo-Byzantine / Russian Revival detailing, arched windows, and a prominent central dome with smaller side domes. To the left stands a stone obelisk monument on a pedestal, surrounded by short posts linked by chains. Low-rise European-style buildings frame the square in the background. The surface of the card is worn and stained, with faint handwritten marks near the top edge.

Vintage sepia postcard depicting the inner courtyard of a large Renaissance castle complex with ornate façades full of statues and windows, ivy-covered walls, a central tower, and an arched colonnade in the foreground. Trees and a path run through the courtyard. The caption at the top reads "Heidelberg. Schlosshof." and a printer's credit appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white riverside view showing a grand late‑19th‑century corner building with ornate façades and a tower, a quay with warehouses and railway structures behind it, and a hill with a baroque church or chapel in the distance. A long side‑wheel paddle steamer is moored along the riverbank, with its paddle‑box bearing a decorative inscription. The foreground shows a pebbly shore with a small wooden rowboat pulled up on land.

Colorized historic street view showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops with striped awnings. In the background rises a large church or cathedral with multiple towers and spires. The caption at the top reads "Naumburg a. Saale. Steinweg und Dom.", indicating the scene is of the Steinweg street leading toward the cathedral (Dom) in Naumburg on the Saale River. Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.

A black-and-white postcard-style photograph showing a grand hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral and attached castle-like buildings overlooking a river with boats in the foreground. At the bottom of the image, there is cursive text identifying the scene.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left stands a large historic building with a tower and steep roof, resembling a small castle or manor, surrounded by dense trees on a rocky bank. In the foreground is a calm river or lake with reeds along the shore. Across the water on the right is a long low bridge or weir structure and small buildings with red roofs, all set against a tree-lined horizon under a pastel sky. Red printed text at the top reads the location and subject in German.

Color postcard view of a partly ruined stone castle surrounded by lush green trees and landscaped gardens. A round medieval tower with a conical roof and weather vane rises behind crumbling curtain walls with tall window openings. A few small figures walk along a curved path in the foreground under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds.

A multi-view color postcard with a yellow-green border featuring four photographs of historic buildings and gardens in and around Dresden, Germany. The upper left circular image shows a manor house by a pond. The upper right rectangular image shows an ornate Baroque gallery along a water moat with a bridge in front. The lower left image shows a large palace with multiple domed towers behind trees and water. The lower right image shows a courtyard or garden with a fountain, flowerbeds, and people walking in front of a grand building. In the center, red German text reads "Dresden und Umgebung."

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a wooden bridge over a river with a town in the background. The bridge has substantial timber supports and railings, and the riverbank is lined with trees and small houses. Below the image are multilingual captions identifying the bridge as the Gauja Bridge in Valmiera.

Black‑and‑white postcard view through an arched gateway into a cobbled castle courtyard. The sides are framed by high, somewhat weathered masonry walls covered with vines and old windows. At the far end stands a multi‑windowed residential wing with a central passageway arch and a distinctive small baroque tower or cupola rising from the roof. At the top of the card is printed the caption "Wildenfels — Schloßhof".

Illustrated panoramic view over a river valley and the city below, seen from an elevated terrace with a railing and flowerbeds. On the right is a monumental stone pedestal bearing a crouching lion statue (Major Hackher monument). In the foreground, several people in early-20th‑century clothing stand on the terrace. In the background are hills and mountains surrounding the town. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as the Schlossberg and Major Hackher monument in Graz, with a view of the city.

Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a riverside cityscape. In the background on a hill stands a large Gothic and Renaissance complex with multiple spires, identified as the royal Albrechtsburg overlooking the river. Below are dense town buildings and a stone bridge crossing the river. In the foreground on the water are a long paddle steamer and moored boats. The title text appears in red at the top and along the left edge, with a handwritten number in red ink at the upper right.

A black-and-white postcard showing a formal garden with a circular fountain in the foreground, palm-lined paths, and a grand Beaux-Arts style building in the background. The printed caption at the top identifies the scene as the casino and gardens of Monte-Carlo. Small publisher information appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a formal procession of well‑dressed men in top hats and long overcoats walking in front of a grand baroque‑style building. One man at the right wears a sash, suggesting an official or ceremonial role. The background façade features large arched doors, decorative columns, and an ornate sculpted coat of arms or emblem above the entrance. The scene appears to be an early‑20th‑century civic or diplomatic event in front of a major governmental or royal building.

An old black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, elegant spa or hotel building with verandas and glass canopies, set in a landscaped garden with palm trees. Behind it rises a steep rocky hill topped by a medieval hilltop castle. Mountains surround the valley. The card has printed and handwritten text in multiple languages (Italian and Czech) on the front, including a greeting and an address at the top, and dense handwritten correspondence at the bottom.

Colorized historic postcard view of the entrance façade to a grand palace-like building with a central tower, arched doorway, and symmetrical wings with red-tiled roofs. Decorative street lamps and gate pillars frame the entrance path, with trees and foliage on both sides. Printed German text appears in the sky area at the top right.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad square or street bordered by multi‑storey buildings on the right and a fortified complex with round towers on the left. Mountains rise in the background under a pastel evening or morning sky. There are a few pedestrians and horse‑drawn carts in the open space, plus tall slender trees and a small red kiosk near the center-right. The word "Trento" is printed in red at the top left, with a handwritten repetition above it.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a statue of a woman with a lamb on a pedestal, surrounded by dense trees and greenery in a city park. A low metal fence encircles the rocky base of the monument. Printed captions at the bottom read "Graz" and "Waldlilie im Stadtpark." The pedestal bears German text including the word "Waldlilie" and a date.

Black‑and‑white view of a grand, tree‑lined avenue flanked by richly ornamented late‑19th‑century buildings with mansard roofs and elaborate facades. The street is densely built, with hotel‑like structures bearing balconies and bay windows; in the background, larger villa‑style buildings rise on a wooded hillside. The overall feel is of a historic European spa or resort town. Visible signage on one of the buildings reads "EXCELSIOR" and "EXCELSIOR HOF."

Colorized historical postcard view of people with horse-drawn carriages waiting by a small ferry across a river or inlet. In the background stands a large Gothic brick monastery ruin with a tall, windowed gable, trees, and village buildings. The printed German text at the top identifies the monastery ruins and the city of Reval.

Black-and-white postcard showing a large ornate fountain in the center of a public square. The fountain features multiple sculpted figures around a circular basin, with a prominent statue on top. Surrounding the square are neoclassical buildings; on the right a domed building with an arched façade is visible. The scene is labeled in Greek and French at the bottom margin, identifying the location as Patras and Place Georges I.

Vintage black‑and‑white (sepia) postcard showing a panoramic view of the historic town of Bautzen seen from the south across a tree‑covered foreground. A dense cluster of old buildings with several prominent church towers and fortified structures dominates the skyline. At the bottom, printed text in German identifies the view and the publisher.

A black‑and‑white (sepia‑tone) postcard view of a cityscape seen from a sloping, tree‑lined path with wooden railings. In the background rise medieval towers, fortification walls, and tall church spires typical of a historic Baltic town. The single printed caption at the top center reads "REVAL."

Colorized postcard view of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The white and light-gray buildings with red roofs and a tall church-like tower rise above the trees. The foreground shows slender tree trunks, and the background extends to a distant horizon under a pale sky. Text is printed on the lower margin of the image area.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large star‑fort style fortress with high brick ramparts covered in grass and dry moats in the foreground. Behind the fortifications stand long, simple barracks‑like buildings with many windows and gabled roofs, and a single church tower with a Baroque‑style spire rises among them. Low mountains or hills appear faintly in the distant background. The overall look suggests an old European military fortress complex.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ruins on the Athenian Acropolis. In the background are classical Greek temples and structures, including the Parthenon on the right and other Acropolis buildings to the left, with scattered stone blocks and fragments in the foreground. The caption at the bottom is in French and there is also a website watermark.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Baroque-style building with ornate window surrounds, a central entrance portal, and a small tower-like structure on the roof. It stands on a cobblestone square with a smaller wooden building to the left. The printed captions at the bottom read "Mitau" on the left and "Museum" on the right.

Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalk. On the right, signage for shops and a confectionery & café is visible; in the distance a tram or carriage is on the street and a church spire and hilltop castle or large building rise above the town. Printed red text at the top names the town and street; publisher information appears at the bottom.

Old monochrome postcard showing a crowded town square with many people gathered in front of a tall stone clock or bell tower, surrounded by traditional low buildings. Handwritten purple ink text covers part of the top-right sky area. Printed captions in Greek and French appear at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a monastery complex seen from a road or bridge lined with white posts and trees. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and a tall baroque church tower with a spire. In the foreground on the right, several women and children stand near a baby carriage along the railing. The printed caption in red at the top reads "Kloster St. Marienstern.", and there is a red handwritten number on the right side.

Black‑and‑white view of a grand neo‑Baroque building with richly decorated façades, large arched windows, mansard roofs, and a central tower. The structure sits in a wooded valley beside a narrow river or canal with a road lined by early automobiles and carriages. Behind it rises a forested hillside and scattered villas and terraces. A church with a tall spire stands slightly behind and to the right of the main building. A sign in front of the building reads "ATELIER WAGNER." The overall look suggests a Central European spa or resort town.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Gothic cathedral with a tall square tower and pointed spires. The facade features large arched windows with tracery, and there are trees and people walking in front of an iron fence. A tram or early bus is visible on the street. The caption at the top reads in French, indicating the city and that the building is the cathedral.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting an ornate neoclassical theater building on a corner square. The façade has arched doorways, tall arched windows, sculptural reliefs in the pediment, and decorative elements above the windows. There are street lamps, a small landscaped area with a statue or sculpture, and adjacent buildings and trees. The lower part of the card is mostly blank, with red printed captions indicating the subject and location, and small vertical publisher text along the left edge.

Illustrated view of a bustling market square surrounded by multi-storey historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. Numerous vendors stand at stalls under white umbrellas selling produce, while townspeople in early 20th-century clothing walk among them. A statue stands on a pedestal in the middle of the square. In the background on a hill rises a prominent clock tower. The right margin bears printed text "Graz, Hauptplatz" indicating the scene as the main square of Graz. Shop signs on the buildings include German words such as "DAMEN-HUT-SALON" and "CAFÉ".

Black‑and‑white view of an inner courtyard of an old European building with timber eaves and a continuous wooden balcony running along the upper floor. The courtyard has stone plaques and reliefs on the walls, barred basement windows, and a large arched portal with an iron gate reached by a short exterior stair. Above the ground-floor windows is a framed inscription panel in a Gothic or Fraktur script, and various coats of arms or carved shields decorate the walls. In one corner lies a pile of round stone cannonballs, suggesting a historic or fortified site. The architecture has a late‑medieval / early‑Renaissance Central European character.

Black‑and‑white view of a large Gothic and neo‑Gothic complex on a hill, with a massive multi‑storey building in front and an ornate church with two tall, slender spires and openwork tracery rising behind. The steeply pitched roofs have rows of dormer windows. Below the hill are tree‑covered slopes and rooftops of smaller houses partly hidden by blossoming trees in the foreground. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.

Colorized vintage view of a grand neo-baroque palace façade with large columns, ornate sculptures, and stairways opening onto a formal garden with paths, flowerbeds, and trimmed trees. A dramatic equestrian statue stands on an elaborate pedestal in front of the building. Along the right edge, printed vertical text reads "Budapest, Várkert – Burggarten."

Color photograph of a grand baroque interior staircase with double sweeping stairways, richly carved balustrades, statues along the stairs, and large urns on the railings. The walls are highly ornamented with stucco reliefs and niches, and the ceiling above the staircase is covered by a large, dramatic fresco depicting historical or mythological scenes with many figures and vivid colors. The view looks down from the upper part of the staircase into a long vaulted corridor.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a stone colonnaded arcade with arches and columns, likely part of a Byzantine-style monastery or church. The passageway looks out over a distant town and hilly landscape. The border is cream-colored, and there is printed caption text in the lower left and a website watermark in the lower right.

A colorized postcard view of a lively European town square surrounded by multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center is a large monument with statues and steps, and many café-style tables and umbrellas fill the square. People stroll around the plaza. On the hillside in the background stands a prominent clock tower. Handwritten text in German covers the top portion. Printed caption at the upper left reads 'Graz, Hauptplatz.'

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley. On the left, a large hilltop fortress complex dominates the scene, with thick walls and gabled roofs surrounded by trees. Below and to the right, tightly packed traditional houses with steep roofs line the streets. In the distance on the right, a large church with a tall, pointed spire rises above the town. Printed German text at the top identifies the location as Leisnig in Saxony and names the castle and hill.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a Gothic cathedral with two tall, ornate spires rising above a medieval-looking bridge and fortified wall. Traditional European houses with steep roofs sit below the wall, and bare trees frame the foreground. At the top in red print it is labeled with the place name and subject; there is also a red handwritten number along the right edge.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historicist university building with ornate façades, arched ground‑floor windows, statues along the roofline, and a landscaped lawn in the foreground. The image is framed by a white border. Publisher information appears at the lower left and the building is labeled at the lower right.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a historical street and square with a long Renaissance‑Gothic palace featuring an arcade of arches on marble columns. People in early 20th‑century dress walk along the open plaza, with lampposts in the foreground and a steep hillside rising behind the town. The printed caption at the top left reads "Dubrovnik. – Ragusa."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside town. In the foreground is a calm riverbank with a small boat pulled up on shore and several people standing or playing near the water. Across the river stands a dense cluster of houses and buildings dominated by a large Gothic church with twin spires. Trees line parts of the shore and the overall style is early 20th‑century.

Black-and-white street scene showing a modernist low commercial building on a corner with large windows and awnings. Pedestrians in early‑20th‑century clothing walk across a broad square with tram or trolleybus wires and tall street lamps overhead. Leafless trees line the pavement. On the roof are large neon-style signs in a Nordic language, and in the foreground bottom-left is caption text identifying the location as Helsinki and the building as Lasipalatsi.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a wooded landscape with a small river or stream in the foreground and a path along its bank. In the background, partly obscured by trees, stands a large castle-like building with a tall pointed tower. At the bottom margin there is printed text naming the place.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an elaborate Baroque palace complex along a water-filled moat or canal. A long façade with many identical arched windows and rich sculptural decoration runs horizontally across the image. On the right stands an ornate pavilion with a tall, onion‑shaped crown dome topped by a large crown. In the foreground a wooden pedestrian bridge crosses the water, with people standing or walking on it. Trees are visible to the left and the sky is partly cloudy.

A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a riverside or ravine with a stone wall, scattered grave markers in the foreground, and a townscape in the background. Prominent is a mosque with a minaret among low houses and bare winter trees. Printed red text at the top identifies the location in Latin and Greek script.

Sepia-toned image of a Gothic stone relief showing the Crucifixion of Christ. In the center, Jesus is on the cross above a skull, flanked by soldiers and saints below, while above him a row of seated figures, likely apostles or prophets, sit in niches beneath small arches. The style suggests a medieval cathedral façade or tympanum, reproduced as an old photograph suitable for a devotional or art-history postcard.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over a wide river with a steamship and barges. On the opposite bank lies a historic European town with dense traditional houses, church spires, and a large complex on a hill. The caption in red German script at the top right reads "Blick auf Pirna a. Elbe." indicating a view of Pirna on the River Elbe.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide city street with horse‑drawn carriages, an early tram, gas street lamps, and pedestrians. On the left stands a neoclassical church with a bell tower and large dome, fronted by columns. The street runs into the distance between multi‑story stone buildings. Printed text in Russian and French at the top identifies the location as St. Petersburg and Sergievskaya Street.

An illustrated postcard showing a grand historic theater building with ornate classical architecture and a green dome, set on a city square. Surrounding it are multi‑story urban buildings, trees, and small figures of people walking and a person with a cart in the foreground. The sky is stylized with scattered white clouds on a blue background. Along the bottom border, printed text identifies the scene in multiple languages.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a busy harbor with several sailing ships and steamers docked at piers. A small rowboat is on the water in the foreground. In the background is a historic European city with church spires and dense low-rise buildings. At the top, in red German text, it reads 'Reval mit dem Hafen.'

A sepia-toned postcard showing a hilltop castle dominating a rocky outcrop, surrounded by forested mountains. In the foreground stands a person in traditional rural clothing holding a cow on a pasture path. The lower left border contains a caption in Italian identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white image of an ornate suspension bridge with tall decorative towers and ironwork, crossing a river. In the foreground are tree‑lined walks and a landscaped square; on the right stand large stone pylons with sculptural reliefs. The overall composition and framing resemble an early 20th‑century postcard view of a major European city bridge.

Colorized vintage view of a riverside or lakeside scene in a lush forest, with birch trees in the foreground and dense greenery all around. In the background, partially obscured by trees, stands a medieval-looking castle complex with two tall, steeply roofed towers and large stone walls, reflected in the calm water below. There is no visible writing on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a large medieval hilltop castle with thick walls, towers, and steep gabled roofs, surrounded by dense trees and forested hills. Below the fortress stand several late‑19th‑century villa‑style houses and town buildings, giving a layered perspective from the foreground residences up to the castle above. No visible caption or border text appears on the image side.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view showing a large castle complex on a wooded hill to the left and a city with church towers and a river valley to the right. The title in red Gothic-style script at the top mentions Heidelberg and its castle, describing the view from a terrace. There is a large blank area at the bottom reserved for writing. Along the left edge in small red text is the publisher information.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a man riding a camel in a desert foreground with large domed mausoleums and minarets in the background. The architecture is Islamic, with several prominent domes and towers. At the bottom in French it identifies the scene as the tombs of the caliphs in Cairo.

A monochrome postcard showing an opulent Baroque interior with ornate wall panels, gilded decorations, large framed paintings, sculptures, and an elevated canopied bed surrounded by a balustrade. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the room as the bedroom of Louis XIV in the Château de Versailles.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large equestrian statue on a tall plinth in the foreground. The rider wears historical military dress and a plumed hat. Behind the statue are low town buildings; one has signage reading "SALUHALLS KAFFE" and "SALUHALL". In the background stands a square church tower with a clock and a domed roof topped by a cross. A cyclist rides across the cobbled square.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a narrow valley town with a river or canal and a main road running along it, lined with multi‑storey houses typical of Central Europe. On the left foreground stands an ornate, exotic‑looking building with onion domes, patterned tiled roof, and a tall tower with elaborate arches and pinnacles, surrounded by trees and a formal garden. In the distance on a hilltop are the ruins of a castle overlooking the town. The scene is rural‑mountainous, with wooded hills enclosing the settlement. No printed or handwritten text is visible on the image itself.

A black-and-white postcard view of a riverside promenade lined with multi‑storey historic buildings and trees. Behind the city rises a steep, wooded hill topped with fortification walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill stands a prominent clock tower. In the foreground, signage on the buildings includes a café and various shops. The caption along the bottom border identifies the scene as Graz, showing the Schlossberg hill and the Kaiser-Franz-Josefs-Kai embankment.

Black‑and‑white image of a waterfront bathing or leisure pavilion built on piles over the water, with ornate wooden balconies, many windows with curtains and striped awnings. In the foreground is a wooden pier and a small floating platform with a moored buoy. Behind the pavilion rise wooden villas on a hillside and, further back, a tall spired church dominating the skyline. The scene suggests a northern European seaside resort town. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside industrial and residential area in a valley with a weir and small bridge across the river. On the slopes above stand large historic buildings and a small church on the right. The printed title at the top identifies the scene as Bautzen and the Seidauer Spree bridge with the weir and Hammermühle (hammer mill). Several buildings bear signs, including one for a bicycle works and another labeled Hammermühle. Publisher information is printed vertically along the right edge.

Color postcard showing a striking mid‑century modern building with a dramatic wave‑shaped concrete and copper roof. Several 1950s American cars are parked in a row in front on a circular drive, with a manicured lawn in the foreground and a blue sky with scattered clouds above. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a grand waterside castle reflected in a calm lake. The building has four large round corner towers with domed roofs and lanterns, steep central roofs with small spires, and a formal garden and tree‑lined terrace along the water. Two small pavilion buildings flank the lakeshore in front of the castle. Forested hills are visible in the background. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image.

A black‑and‑white view of a formal city park or promenade framed by symmetrical tree‑lined paths and flowerbeds, leading toward a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance building at the center background.
