A black-and-white postcard view of a European town seen from a distance across fields and a wooden fence. In the middle distance there are trees and low industrial buildings with a plume of smoke, while the background is filled with dense townhouses. Dominating the skyline is a large church with a tall tower and baroque-style dome roof. The overall appearance suggests an early-20th‑century photograph printed with a white border. At the bottom, in cursive script, is a caption naming the town.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large central square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with red-tiled roofs and green shutters. In the middle of the square stands a monumental fountain or statue group on a raised, stepped platform, with people walking and a few carriages or early trams visible. On a wooded hill in the background rises a clock tower with a steep, pointed roof and large clock faces. The printed captions at the top read "Graz." on the left and "Hauptplatz." on the right.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large church with a tall tower on the left and an extensive brick institutional complex on a hill to the right, with a chimney emitting smoke. In the foreground is an open field or park with paths and people walking and playing. At the bottom, white printed caption text identifies the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing river traffic on a broad river. In the foreground are moored sailing boats with tall masts and people standing on the quay. In the middle distance are steam or motor vessels with several flags and, to the left, an arched steel bridge spanning the river. Low tree‑covered banks and cloudy sky form the background. Printed captions identify the scene as the Waal at Nijmegen, and the left margin bears the printer's line. A handwritten name or note appears at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large concert hall building in a park-like setting. The structure has an ornate façade with many windows, decorative reliefs, and a lower veranda or terrace in front furnished with tables and chairs. A taller tower-like section rises on the left. Mature trees frame the scene, a fence and walkway run along the foreground, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing are visible. Caption text is printed along the bottom edge of the image.

Color image showing a grass airfield with several gliders and people in summer clothing preparing for flight. The gliders have registration numbers beginning with "DM-" and are parked on a large meadow. In the background there is a forested hillside dotted with villas, a tall slender TV tower on the ridge, and a distinctive steel truss cantilever bridge over a river to the right, under a blue sky with scattered clouds.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a landscaped park with curved paths, benches, ornate lampposts, and a large monument at the center. The monument consists of a rocky pedestal crowned by a winged angel-like figure holding a cross, known as the Russalka monument. In the background are pavilion-style wooden buildings and trees. People sit on benches and stroll through the park, giving the scene an early-20th‑century atmosphere. The captions on the front identify the place and the monument.

Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with three photographs of urban landmarks. The top image shows a modernist glass and concrete building with a jagged roofline, cars from the mid‑20th century parked in front, and historic church towers rising in the background. The bottom left image features a large city hall–type building with a prominent clock tower. The bottom right image shows an ornate Baroque courtyard façade with statues, balustrades and a richly decorated gate crowned by a large dome‑like crown; in front is a fountain basin.

Black‑and‑white view of a large European manor or small palace with a corner tower and steep tiled roof, seen from an elevated angle over dense trees in the foreground. The building has several floors of tall rectangular windows and dormer windows in the roof. In the background, there is another long wing of the complex and a distant church or chapel tower with an onion‑shaped dome, typical of Central European Baroque architecture. No visible caption or border text appears on the image.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large Ottoman mosque complex with a central dome and two tall minarets beside a multi‑arched stone bridge and a river in the foreground. Low buildings surround the complex. Printed text in French at the upper left reads "Souvenir d'Andrinople. Mosquée Sultan Bayazid." and there is additional Ottoman/Turkish text at the upper right. A modern website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears at the bottom.

A monochrome postcard reproducing an old engraved city view: a fortified town with walls and gates spreads across the foreground, while a steep hill rises behind it, crowned by a large fortress complex with multiple towers, churches and defensive walls. Smaller houses, fields and trees occupy the front, and low mountains or hills appear in the distance. The overall style resembles an early‑modern (16th–18th century) Central European city panorama.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings. Hanging shop signs in German are visible on both sides. At the end of the street rises a large church with a baroque-style tower and dome. At the bottom, handwritten-style text reads "Riga - Kramerstraße-".

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex with a tall round tower and several multi‑storey buildings. The castle stands above terraced slopes, trees, and smaller farm and village buildings in the foreground. At the top of the image is printed German text identifying the site as Burg Gnandstein near Kohren.

A vintage multi‑view postcard with a sepia/washed color tone featuring several small illustrations of streets, plazas, and notable buildings of a town. In the center, decorative script reads "Recuerdo de Figueras" surrounded by floral motifs. Around the text are vignettes showing a long avenue, civic buildings, an interior of what appears to be a church or large hall, and outdoor urban scenes.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large fortified complex with a tall ornate church tower on the left and a massive round defensive tower on the right, connected by a long multi‑story building. The style is Gothic/medieval with later modifications. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Wittenberg on the Elbe, with references to the Lutherkirche and the Schlosskaserne.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a wide, tree‑lined urban boulevard with tram tracks and pedestrians. On the right stands a large ornate multi‑storey building with turrets and decorative facades, while older low buildings line the left side of the street. The view looks down the avenue toward distant domed public buildings. At the top of the postcard is printed text reading "Belgrad. Terazia."

Black‑and‑white view of a large Neoclassical town-hall-like building with a central portico of four columns and an ornate balcony above, surmounted by a tall square clock tower with two large clock faces and a flagpole. The building opens onto a broad cobblestoned square where people in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century European clothing stroll and socialize. To the left is an adjoining building with arched shopfronts; a large awning reads "CAFE WIEN." The architecture and signage suggest a Central European city square.

Colored illustrated postcard showing a hilltop baroque church with twin towers and red domes labeled "Maria Trost." A long stairway leads up through trees from a park-like area below. In the foreground are buildings and pavilions of a leisure or spa establishment with people walking and sitting outdoors. Decorative lettering at the lower right reads "Etablissement Weitzer." There is cursive handwriting across the lower margin.

Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing an ornate courtyard with slender columns and richly carved Moorish-style arches. Light streams into an open patio surrounded by intricate stucco decoration and tiled walls. At the bottom, red printed text identifies the scene and location.

A colored vintage postcard depicting a waterfront scene of Port Said with sailing boats and a tall lighthouse-like tower on the right. Inset at the left is an illustration of two men in traditional Middle Eastern clothing conversing under an archway, and above them a small round vignette of a veiled woman. The upper border is decorated with blossoming branches and fruit. French caption text appears below the main image.

Black-and-white panoramic view of a small European town surrounded by fields and rolling hills. In the foreground and center are dense clusters of traditional multi‑story houses with gabled roofs, several larger institutional or factory-like buildings, and a tall industrial chimney. On the left stands a prominent castle complex with towers and a fortified appearance. Near the center is a church with a tall spire rising above the town. The landscape behind the settlement shows open farmland and scattered farmhouses. In the upper left corner of the card, the word "Zschopau" is printed in a serif typeface.

Black-and-white postcard view framed by tree branches, showing a historic hilltop complex with a large castle-like building and a church with tall twin spires above a town on the riverbank. In the foreground a paddle steamer with a smoking funnel travels along the river. German caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white photograph showing a Baroque riverside palace with mansard roofs and ornate balconies on the right, its terrace and formal garden overlooking a broad river. Several people stroll or stand along the riverside parapet and path. On the left a river steamer with a flag at the stern travels upstream, while wooded banks extend into the distance under a cloudy sky. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

A sepia-toned historic postcard-style illustration of a spacious castle courtyard. On the left is an ornate multi-storey Renaissance stair tower with rich decoration; in the center background rises a tall, slender tower with a spire. Surrounding buildings form an enclosed court with arched doorways and windows. In the foreground stands a fountain with a sculpted figure holding a trident beside a rectangular basin. German text is printed at the top in red Fraktur-style script.

A hand-colored early-20th-century postcard depicting a historic multi-story Renaissance-style town hall with ornate bay windows and a green copper dome on the corner turret. The building has many rectangular windows and decorative reliefs on the facade, with shops and awnings at street level. At the bottom of the card, printed text identifies the location and publisher, including the words "Torgau. Rathaus." and a 1904 publication line.

Black‑and‑white view of an old European street corner focused on an ornate exterior stairway leading to a doorway with a domed canopy. The stair balustrade is decorated with sculpted reliefs and crests, and an elaborate wrought‑iron gate stands to the left. The wall surfaces are worn, with windows protected by heavy iron grilles. A street sign reading "Neumarkt." is fixed to the corner of the building. To the right stands a townhouse with shopfronts; a hanging sign advertises "Uhren & Goldwaren". A small archway and a cart covered with cloth are visible under the main building, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban scene.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of a European square with a prominent baroque church featuring twin towers with onion domes. The scene shows people walking in the square, early 20th‑century shopfronts with awnings on the left, and trees on the right. Printed caption text appears at the top of the card, identifying the place as Graz and Mariahilferplatz.

Sepia-toned panoramic aerial view of a city in a valley surrounded by mountains. A river with a metal bridge crosses the foreground, leading into a densely built historic center with church towers and urban blocks. At the top left is printed the caption "Trento - Veduta generale". The left edge shows holes, suggesting it was once bound in an album or booklet.

Sepia-toned postcard photograph showing a large neoclassical building with a tall portico of six Ionic or Corinthian columns and a triangular pediment. The façade is three to four stories high, with regularly spaced rectangular windows and modest ornamentation. In front is a cobblestone street or square, wrought-iron fence, stone posts, and old-fashioned street lamps. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand or walk near the steps. A utility pole with multiple cross-arms and wires appears on the left. A metric ruler is placed along the left edge of the image for scale.

Black‑and‑white view of a large castle or palace complex built on a high stone bastion above a wooded slope. A long façade with many rectangular windows runs along the right side, while to the left a taller section has a steep mansard-style roof topped with a decorative cupola and weather vane. A stone terrace with iron railings follows the edge of the fortification wall, leading toward the buildings. The image has wide white margins typical of vintage postcard prints. No visible printed text or caption appears on the front.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neoclassical palace with arcades and a colonnaded wing, surrounded by gardens and an open square where two people are walking. There is cursive handwriting across the image and margins. Printed caption at the bottom reads in French "SOUVENIR DE CORFOU - Palais Royal." A small printed credit appears along the left edge, and a watermark with the URL "www.elia.org.gr" is overlaid.

Color image of a large brick railway terminal labeled "CENTRAL STATION" with a classic European facade, arched windows, and mansard roof. In front are 1950s–60s style cars, pedestrians, traffic lights, and a street scene. A circular sign with a white "T" on a dark background, typical of Swedish metro signage, is visible near the left.

A black-and-white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, barges are moored along the riverbank. Above them rises a large castle-like building with many windows and steep roofs, and behind it stands a Gothic cathedral with tall, ornate twin spires and additional towers. Smaller houses and vegetation cover the slope below. Printed caption text appears at the bottom right of the image.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a church at the end of a snow-covered path lined with leafless birch trees and wooden fences. A domed tower rises above the main entrance. In the foreground, two children sit on a sled on the snowy path, with another person walking toward the church door in the distance. Printed captions at the top read "Kyrkan." on the left and "Piteå." on the right.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of a country church surrounded by tall trees and a graveyard. A dirt path lined with trees leads toward the church entrance on the left, while on the right a wooden belfry with a spire rises above the surrounding foliage. The scene is quiet and rural, and the words "Trosa Kyrka" are printed in the upper right corner.

A vintage sepia postcard showing the tall medieval belfry tower rising above a large square building with arched arcades and crenellated roofline. People and market stalls are visible in the square in front. Printed French text at the top left identifies the scene as the belfry of Bruges, and a printer's mark appears at the top right.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a partly ruined stone fortification and the minaret of a mosque rising behind or within the walls. The landscape in the foreground is rough ground with two people on horseback. At the bottom, printed captions in French and English identify the scene as being in Salonique/Salonica and mention a mosque whose minaret was cut by a shot.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard featuring a large Ottoman‑era building with a central dome, ornate arched windows and façades, and an adjacent tall minaret. A dense crowd gathers in front, likely for a ceremonial event. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower part of the image. Printed French captions appear at the top left and right, and there is a visible website watermark added later for archival purposes.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a dense low-rise neighborhood of flat-roofed houses in the foreground, labeled as an Arab village, with a large fortified citadel on a hill in the background. On top of the citadel stands a prominent mosque with a central dome and tall minarets, overlooking the cityscape. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge and a faint circular stamp mark is visible on the left. There is also a modern website watermark across the lower right.

A monochrome postcard showing a moated brick castle with corner towers and crenellated walls, surrounded by water and adjacent town buildings. The caption at the bottom identifies it as 'Castello di Fontanellato.' Additional small-print publisher information and initials in a circular logo appear in the lower area.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense historic town with tiled roofs and narrow streets, opening onto a broad square in the foreground. Dominating the square is a large, somewhat worn-looking town hall building with many rectangular windows and a central entrance, attached to a tall clock tower with a baroque-style roof and spire. In front of it stands a row of multi‑storey bourgeois houses bearing shop signs. Further back appear church towers and a round defensive tower, with open countryside and industrial facilities visible on the horizon.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a wooden pavilion-like structure built over a well or fountain on a hillside, with stone walls and buildings of a fortification rising behind it. Sparse trees and a path with a railing surround the structure. Printed captions in German appear at the bottom on a wide white margin.

A colorized vintage view of a landscaped park with flower beds, paths, and trees in the foreground. A gardener works on the lawn. In the background stands a large brick railway station with a central entrance, tall windows, and a small tower. People and a tram or trolley are visible in front of the station. At the bottom, there is printed text in Dutch reading "Nijmegen — Gezicht op Station."

A monochrome historic postcard showing a town square with a wooden market hall or pavilion in the foreground and a church with a tall, pointed spire behind it. Traditional European buildings with tiled roofs flank the square. Printed German text appears at the bottom of the image.

A vintage, monochrome collage postcard with large block letters spelling out a greeting phrase filled with small photographic views of a city—streets, houses, riverside scenes, bridges, and public buildings. The background is dark with scattered stars, and there is handwriting at the bottom margin.

Old monochrome postcard with a central photograph of a historic city gate and surrounding buildings on a sloping street. At the top is the printed caption "Kamenita vrata." The bottom margin has printed text and handwritten cursive writing, and more handwriting fills the right side. A round postal cancellation stamp on the upper left reads "KRAPINA 98 SEP 10." Vintage illustrated postcard showing the harbor and skyline of Riga with sailing ships in the foreground and a row of pastel-colored buildings and church spires along the waterfront. The image is bordered by handwritten cursive text across the top, bottom, and right side. Printed captions include the name of the city in Cyrillic and Latin, and the river name in German.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a panoramic view of a coastal city with multiple church spires and towers seen across a body of water, framed by tree branches and foliage in the foreground. The skyline appears old European. Red printed text at the top left reads in German, and there is small publisher text along the right edge.

Sepia-toned photograph of a richly decorated Gothic Revival church interior, centered on a tall stone altar and reredos with pointed arches, pinnacles, and statues of saints. Behind the altar are large stained-glass windows; on either side are side aisles with traceried railings and coats of arms. Statues stand in niches to the left and right. In the foreground is a baptismal font or lectern on a small pedestal, with steps leading up to the sanctuary.

A vintage black-and-white illustration showing a fortified castle or town under siege, with smoke clouds from cannon fire and curved trajectories of cannonballs overhead. The main building appears to have a church-like structure and watchtowers, all behind strong walls set on a raised mound. The words 'Düna' and 'Fluvius' are labeled on the rivers, and the caption below reads 'Die Belagerung von Kokenhusen i. J. 1700.'

The postcard depicts a large crowd gathered inside a grand stadium, with dignitaries and people in formal attire—some in traditional Greek clothing—prominently featured in the foreground. The stone seating and architecture are classical, resembling an ancient stadium. Several lines of text in Greek and French appear at the bottom, identifying the event as the entrance of the Kings of Italy and Greece into the stadium in Athens.

A black-and-white image depicting a large house or villa with elaborate gabled roofs and a wraparound veranda in the foreground. In the background, a prominent stone round tower with a conical roof rises above the trees, suggesting a medieval building. The foreground shows a stone retaining wall along a sloped terrain. There is no visible text on the image itself.

The postcard shows a painted or colorized panoramic view of a historical European city, with a river winding through a broad valley and many small buildings scattered throughout the landscape. A hill with a structure on top (likely a fortress or castle) is a focal point in the city center. In the foreground, there are trees and tall grasses, indicating the vantage point is from a hillside or elevated area. The text 'Graz von der Kanzl' is printed at the top right of the image.

A colored postcard showing a large, rectangular palace complex on the waterfront with several boats in the water. The palace is surrounded by greenery and classical buildings, while the cityscape with spires is visible in the background. The sky is light blue with some clouds. There is red text on the top left and right corners.

The image is a black-and-white photograph showing six people dressed as ancient Greek hoplite warriors, wearing crested helmets and carrying shields, performing a mock battle or re-enactment. The backdrop is an ancient stone amphitheater with stepped seating, suggesting a historical or archaeological setting. The lower right corner features the watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.

A black-and-white vintage postcard shows a central European square lined with ornate historic buildings. In the foreground, people stand on cobblestone pavement near a lamppost, with horse-drawn carts visible. Notably, there is a large church tower or historic building dominating the skyline. The architectural style is typical of Dutch or northern European cities, and storefront signs are also visible.

The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of an ornate stone staircase and a medieval-style bastion or terrace, viewed through an arched passageway. Several statues of figures in armor line the walls. In the background, there is a distinctive round tower with a pointed roof and arched windows, typical of neo-Romanesque architecture. The scene exudes a historic and somewhat monumental European feel. Printed text is present at the bottom of the postcard.

A black-and-white image shows a panoramic view of a European town, with traditional gabled houses lining a river and a large castle or palace dominating a hill in the background. The foreground features pine trees framing the scene, and there's a forested hillside behind the town. No visible text is present on the image.

A monochrome postcard showing a riverside scene with trees lining the bank, a building or belvedere on a small hill to the left, and a large arched bridge over the river in the distance to the right. Several boats are moored along the shore. Below the image is printed text identifying the view, with a large area of handwritten Dutch correspondence filling the lower half of the card.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town with dense medieval buildings, prominent church spires, and a massive round stone tower with fortification walls in the foreground. The town stretches across a rocky hill, and at the bottom center of the image the caption 'Bautzen' is printed.

Sepia-toned photograph showing a narrow street leading toward a large medieval stone gate flanked by two massive round towers with crenellations and machicolations. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk along the street; a bicycle is leaning against a wall. Above the arched passage of the gate there is a decorative panel with coats of arms or reliefs. The lower margin of the card shows a circular logo at left and a URL-like text at center.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large ancient stone amphitheater seen from the top rows looking down toward the circular orchestra. The seating rises in concentric tiers cut into a hillside, surrounded by trees. There is handwritten text in Greek across the upper margin. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the site, and a small printed URL appears at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a seaside promenade lined with palm trees and formal gardens. On the left stands an ornate pavilion on a pier extending into the sea, while people stroll along the broad waterfront boulevard. Elegant multi‑story buildings and a monument with a statue or obelisk are visible on the right, with hills in the background. The printed caption identifies the scene as the Jetty-Palace and the English Walk in Nice.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with an oval photograph showing a church tower rising above trees and rooftops, backed by steep mountains. The layout is simple, with the city name printed at the top left and the church name at the bottom right on a light, slightly stained background.

A colorized historical postcard view of a riverside town with a stone bridge crossing a broad river, a curving railway line in the foreground, factory buildings with chimneys, and a large hilltop castle complex overlooking the town. The scene is labeled in German at the top with the town name and the castle and bridge. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a spa-town scene in a narrow valley with wooded hillsides. A richly decorated, octagonal pavilion with arched windows and ornate detailing stands in the center of a square. A river with stone embankments runs along the left side, bordered by railings and multi‑story hotels or spa buildings. People in early 20th‑century clothing stroll and sit around the square. The word "Wildbad" is handwritten in script in the lower left margin.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view across a wide river toward a large hilltop palace complex with a central dome and long Baroque/neo‑Baroque wings stretching along the ridge. Below it, at the water level, stands a row of large classical buildings and promenades. A passenger steamboat is visible on the river in the foreground.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large church with a tall tower and spire topped by a cross. The façade features arched windows and decorative gables, with a rose window above the entrance. Trees frame the scene and there is a hillside and small buildings or gravestones in the background. White printed captions appear in the lower left and right corners.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small historic European town on a hill surrounded by forested valleys. Dense rows of gabled houses and stone buildings cluster along the ridge. A prominent church with a tall tower and baroque‑style dome stands near the center, and a larger fortress‑like complex or castle occupies the skyline behind it. In the foreground, a curving road leads past a large villa at the bottom of the slope. The image has no visible caption or printed text on the front.

Colorized postcard view of a rural settlement with red‑roofed houses and a large church with twin towers on a wooded hill in the background. The foreground shows gardens, paths, and several buildings, while fields and low hills stretch into the distance. The right margin contains handwritten cursive text. At the bottom is printed text in German identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over the rooftops of a small European town toward a large medieval cathedral with four tall towers. At the lower right, white script text identifies the location as "Naumburg a.d. Saale."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing an urban square with a tall obelisk-style monument on the left and a large domed Orthodox cathedral on the right. The cathedral has multiple domes topped with crosses, ornate façades, and a wide staircase leading to the main entrance. Printed multilingual captions appear at the top in Bulgarian, English, and French.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the richly decorated interior façade of an Islamic madrasa with arched doorways and intricate geometric tilework. The lower border contains a printed French caption identifying the location in Meknes and the Bou Inania Madrasa.

Vintage tinted photograph of a large two‑storey school building on a hillside, with symmetrical wings, tall rectangular windows, and wooden siding. A picket fence runs along the street in the foreground, and there are steps and railings leading up to the entrance. Low hills or a wooded slope rise behind the building. At the bottom margin, printed in red, is a Romanian caption.

A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a riverside view of a historic hilltop complex with Gothic cathedral spires and a large adjacent palace above the Elbe River. Trees frame the scene in the foreground, with houses and riverfront buildings at the base of the hill and a boat on the water. A caption in German is printed in cursive at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a forested hilly landscape with a large grand‑hotel style building dominating the center. Smaller villas and buildings are scattered on the slopes, and a tower stands on a distant hilltop to the left. Sepia-toned panoramic postcard showing a small European town with densely packed houses, villas, and larger institutional-looking buildings on a hillside. In the foreground there are open fields, while the midground and background are filled with trees and multi‑story townhouses. Printed red caption text appears along the bottom margin, with publisher information printed in smaller text.

Color postcard view of a historic Italian piazza on a sunny day. On the left is a red‑stucco Baroque church with a green and yellow tiled dome. In the center stands a row of old palazzi with arcades at street level and green awnings over shopfronts. People walk around the square and a few 1960s–1970s-era cars are parked along the buildings. Red flowers are visible in the foreground.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside path lined with tall trees leading toward a body of water on the left, and on the right a wooded hillside with stairs and a railing ascending to an ornate historic building featuring a tower and steep roof. At the top of the image are printed captions naming the location.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a street with tram tracks and a tramcar moving toward the viewer. Tree‑lined sidewalks and low houses flank the road. Vintage monochrome postcard showing the entrance to a castle complex. A curved stone bridge and walls lead to a gatehouse and main building with steep tiled roofs. Black-and-white postcard showing an interior view of a richly sculpted Romanesque-Gothic cathedral portal, with multiple archivolts filled with dense reliefs of biblical scenes and rows of elongated standing saints on tall columns. In the lower left corner there is faint printed text indicating an institution name.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a wide urban boulevard lined with multi‑story neoclassical buildings on the left and a fenced garden or park on the right. Text at the bottom in English and Greek identifies the scene as Amelie Boulevard in Athens. A modern watermark with a website URL is also visible.

A colorized historic street scene showing a busy European square with multi‑story brick and plaster buildings, awnings, shop signs, pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and electric trams on tracks. In the background stands a tall white church tower. The lower right corner contains handwriting in black ink and a red printed greeting caption.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a riverside town with hills in the background. In the foreground, several steam-powered boats and barges move along a wide river with quays and railway tracks on the bank. On the right, a large baroque-style castle or palace complex with a tall tower sits on a wooded hill above the river. The town with dense historic buildings stretches into the valley behind. Red printed German text is visible at the top of the card.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a close view of large, precisely cut Inca stone blocks forming a wall. On the left stands an Indigenous person wearing traditional Andean clothing (a poncho and cap). At the top, printed text in Spanish identifies the location as Cuzco, Peru, and refers to the famous twelve‑angled stone in the palace of the Inca Roca.

Black-and-white postcard showing the interior of a Romanesque church with massive stone piers and noticeably leaning arches. The view looks down a side nave toward the altar area. At the bottom margin is printed caption text in Spanish along with an editor credit.

Sepia-toned historic photograph showing a Catholic religious procession in front of a Baroque-style church or monastery. Clergy, altar boys and many women and girls in white dresses line up outside the main portal, which has a gabled pediment with a cross on top and decorative relief. To the right stands a small chapel or side structure with a dome-like roof and a canopy set up for the ceremony, with banners and processional lanterns. The architecture has stuccoed walls, rectangular and arched windows with wrought-iron grilles, and a tiled roof, evoking a Central European Baroque church complex.

Color postcard showing a river scene with a hydrofoil boat cruising in the foreground. On the opposite bank stands a classical city embankment with trees and large historic buildings, dominated by a large domed cathedral with a golden cupola. The printed Russian captions below the image read "ЛЕНИНГРАД." on the left and "На Неве." on the right, with handwritten blue ink in the lower-right corner.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an old stone house with a wooden arched door, cracked masonry, and a leafless tree leaning across the foreground. A rectangular window with metal bars is visible on the right side. Below the image there is multilingual caption text in Greek and French identifying the location in Ierapetra, Crete, and mentioning that Napoleon spent a night there. The web address "www.elia.org.gr" is printed over the lower right corner.

Black-and-white image of a grand suspension bridge crossing a wide river in a European city. The bridge has massive stone pylons and ornate steel towers topped with sculptural details. Pedestrians and a few carriages are visible on the roadway. On the far riverbank stands a dense row of historic multi‑story buildings with spires and domes; boats line the quayside. Trees and a landscaped park occupy the near foreground.

Black‑and‑white view of a walled courtyard or inner bailey of a large stone castle or fortress. The scene is lined with tall, pruned trees along a broad path leading toward an arched gateway set in a Renaissance or Baroque portal on the far wall. High, steeply pitched, tiled roofs with small dormers and irregularly spaced windows top the thick masonry walls. A few men in early 20th‑century attire stand and talk on the path, giving a peaceful, park‑like impression inside the castle complex.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a large baroque-style convent or school complex with a central tower and long wings, set in front of wooded hills and a small city. In the distant left hillside a clock- or watch‑tower is visible, and there is another small chapel or tower on the hill ridge. Trees and a fenced area or garden occupy the foreground. White printed caption text appears in the lower right corner.

Color image of a round medieval stone tower with a conical red-tile roof and a wooden gallery encircling the upper part. The tower stands by a dirt road bordered by leafless and budding trees, suggesting early spring. The sky is clear blue, and there are a few buildings in the distance. The overall style and print quality resemble a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

Black‑and‑white riverfront view of a European town. In the foreground a paddle steamer with passengers moves along a wide river, with barges and small boats moored near a quay. On the right bank stand 19th‑century townhouses and villas, behind a high embankment wall and promenade. Rising on the hill above the town is a large hilltop complex of fortified buildings and towers that looks like a castle or former monastery dominating the skyline. The surrounding landscape is hilly and partly wooded. No printed caption or other visible text appears on the image side.

Black‑and‑white view of a hillside town. In the foreground stand several large, ornate villas with steep tiled roofs and decorative façades, set behind fences and small trees. Behind them rises a terraced hillside that appears to be used for vineyards or agriculture. At the top center of the hill is a round tower‑like structure, and on the distant right crest of the hill is a church or monastery complex with multiple roofs and a tall spire. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century European spa or vineyard town.

Illustrated color postcard depicting a sunlit town square bordered by historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and a central column or monument. In the background on a hill stands a prominent clock tower. Two figures in light clothing walk near the monument, and trees add greenery to the scene. The word "GRAZ" appears at the top, and "KARMEITERPLATZ" (likely intended as Karmeliterplatz) is printed at the bottom. Handwritten script in German fills the right margin and lower edge, including a date notation along the top right.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a chapel with wooden pews and a central aisle leading toward a doorway under a dark wooden gallery or organ loft. Statues of religious figures are set into wall niches on both sides, surrounded by decorative painted cartouches with inscriptions. The lower left corner bears a printed caption in Swedish, and the lower right has a small oval publisher's mark.

Colorized historic postcard showing a neoclassical building behind a central monument with an angel-like statue holding an object aloft. The monument stands on a pedestal accessed by steps, surrounded by gas-style street lamps and a small landscaped lawn. In the background are additional older buildings and trees. The printed captions at the bottom read "Valkhof." in the center and "NIJMEGEN." at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a large church with wooden pews, tall classical columns, arched windows, chandeliers, a pulpit to the left and an altar at the far end. The image is captioned in Swedish at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned studio photograph of a young couple with a baby carriage. The man wears an early-20th‑century uniform and cap, while the woman is dressed in traditional folk-style clothing with a patterned dress, shawl, and head covering. They look down fondly into a wicker pram with large spoked wheels, covered with a fur blanket. Behind them is a painted backdrop of an old European city with church spires and historic buildings, giving the image a nostalgic, romantic feel.

Vintage colorized postcard showing, in the upper part, a man and a woman in Alpine-style hiking clothes holding long walking sticks, seemingly standing in mid‑air. Below them is a panoramic view of a city with a prominent, steep, wooded hill rising from the center, crowned by buildings. At the bottom is German text printed on the card.

A color postcard showing a striking modernist arena-like building with tall outward-leaning concrete supports and large glass panels. In the foreground there is a flowerbed full of red flowers and a parking area with several 1970s-era cars, some covered with tarps. In the upper right corner, there are postal cancellations printed over the image, one rectangular with Cyrillic text and a rocket illustration, and one circular postmark that reads "VARNA" and includes Cyrillic text and a date.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall, slender spire topped by a cross, pointed arches, rose window, and ornate detailing. The church stands in a landscaped garden with paths, trees, and a gated entrance in the foreground, and city buildings in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a waterfront scene in Stockholm. In the background stands a large rectangular palace building with many windows, and other classical buildings along the quays. Several boats are moored by the shore, while a passenger boat crosses the water in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the scene, and the boat bears a readable name on its side.

Colorized scenic view over a European city with red-tiled roofs and a river running through the center, crossed by several bridges. The image is taken from an elevated vantage point with trees and a wooden railing in the foreground. At the lower left, an illustrated girl in traditional dress holds a large bouquet of yellow flowers. In the distance, church towers and dense urban buildings stretch across a flat plain. In the top right corner, printed text reads "Graz vom Schlossberg."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tram passing in front of a historic castle-like building with towers and steep roofs, surrounded by bare trees and fencing. Pedestrians walk along the street and a small cart stands on the right. The bottom of the card has printed red text identifying the location, and small publisher information is printed in red at the lower left.

Vintage postcard showing two large standing statues of the pharaoh Ramses II among massive stone columns in an ancient Egyptian temple. The image is tinted in sepia/hand‑colored tones, with caption text printed in English and French on the right margin.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grand, ornate stone bank building labeled "WASABANKEN" facing a circular public garden with flowerbeds and a central statue on a pedestal. The scene looks down a straight city street with tramlines and early 20th‑century urban buildings. Printed captions in Swedish and Finnish identify the building and the city, and handwritten greetings appear in the lower part of the card.

A black‑and‑white image of a large historic building in Renaissance style, likely a palace or manor. It has steep tiled roofs with ornate gables, a central tower with a clock and cupola, rows of rectangular windows, and walls partly covered in ivy. A tree and open courtyard or park occupy the foreground.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a humorous montage: in the upper part, a man in an overcoat, bowler hat, and suit is seen floating in the sky while holding an open umbrella and a suitcase. Below him is a panoramic view over a small European town with dense rooftops, trees in the foreground, and a river to the right. German text is printed beneath the image, with publisher information at the bottom.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a hilly old town with brick houses and steep tiled roofs. In the foreground is a terrace-like building with neo‑Gothic windows and decorative balustrades, and behind it several larger brick structures and a square tower. A narrow street lined with houses descends to the right. In the distant background, a large arched steel bridge crosses a river. There is a handwritten-looking caption along the bottom edge and a small number on the right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate Renaissance facade with arched windows, statues in niches, decorative coats of arms, and ivy climbing the stone walls. On the right is an arched passageway leading through the building. Printed caption text appears at the bottom in German, identifying the scene as part of Heidelberg Castle (the Friedrichsbau with the portal to the Altan).

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic castle complex with a cylindrical tower and surrounding buildings, set against a mountainous backdrop. The scene looks over rooftops toward a valley. Printed Italian text at the top identifies the location, and there are some handwritten annotations on the image.

Black-and-white view over a dense historic town with steep, tiled roofs climbing up a hillside toward a large Gothic cathedral with two ornate western towers and a tall, slender spire behind it. To the right stands a bulky complex with a tower topped by an onion-shaped dome. Narrow streets and trees weave between the tightly packed houses. The overall look is of a Central European medieval cityscape photographed from an elevated vantage point.

A sepia-toned photograph shows a large historic building complex on a high stone terrace or fortification wall, likely part of a castle or palace. Below the wall is a park-like green area with trees and a small decorative wooden bridge over a path or stream. In the foreground, two figures—an adult and a child—walk along the path. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and the sky is filled with dramatic clouds. The style and printing suggest an early-20th-century picture postcard.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal panorama with a curving bay, wooded cliffs, a long pier or breakwater extending into calm water, and a large palace-like building set on a hill in the distance. At the bottom there is bilingual printed text in Cyrillic and French referencing Varna and the Euxinograd palace.

A sepia-toned postcard view across a waterfront toward a large rectangular palace-like building with many windows and a flat roof. In the foreground, several people stand or walk along the quay while a small steam-powered boat moves on the water. Trees frame the right side of the image. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom of the image.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a park with a curving waterway, a small boat with people, and walkers along a path in the foreground. Dominating the scene is a round medieval brick tower by the water, with a bridge and trees surrounding it; more buildings and a bridge appear in the background. The border is styled like a turned-up page corner. Printed captions identify the place as Nijmegen and Kronenburgerpark, and the left margin lists the publisher. There is a handwritten note at the bottom.

Colorized view of a European riverside city with a metal bridge crossing a turquoise river, lined with 19th‑century buildings and a church tower with a green onion dome and clock. Above the city rises a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortress walls and buildings; on the right side of the hill stands a distinctive clock tower. Printed in red at the top left is the caption 'Graz‑Mur‑Schlossberg'. A commercial sign on a riverside building reads 'JOS SOBEL'. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century tourist postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy waterfront square with several multi‑story historic buildings, market stalls, crowds of people, and small boats docked along the quay. A tall church spire rises in the background. At the top of the card the printed captions read "Stockholm" and "Kornhamnstorg."

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a tall statue of a medieval armored figure, identified as Olaf Tryggvason, standing on a high geometric stone pedestal. The figure holds an orb in his outstretched right hand and wears a helmet, tunic, and sword. The background is blank sky. Caption text appears along the bottom edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a church with a tall spire and clock tower, surrounded by leafless trees and curved walking paths in a park-like setting. The printed caption at the top reads "Eskilstuna. Kyrkan." in a serif font.

A colorized view of a European city with a river in the foreground crossed by a metal bridge, rows of historic buildings with red-tiled roofs, and a church tower with an onion-shaped dome. Behind the city rises a steep hill crowned by fortress walls and structures, with a prominent clock tower standing on the slope. Distant hills form the background. Printed caption text appears along the top edge.

Tinted vintage view of a park path with benches and a gas-style lamppost in the foreground, where two figures in old-fashioned clothing are seated. Behind the trees rises a square stone bell tower with arched openings and a small cupola on top. Roofs of nearby buildings are visible, and in the background are steep, rocky mountains. The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century colorized postcard of a European town in a mountainous region.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense trees and orchards. The castle features multiple connected buildings with steep gabled roofs and a prominent round tower with a crenellated top. At the top in red type it is labeled with the place and castle name; there is also vertical red printing along the left edge with publisher information and a date.

Black‑and‑white view of a narrow medieval passageway between stone buildings. On the left is a large Gothic window with tall vertical panes and tracery, likely part of a church or chapel apse. A small patterned stained-glass panel is visible in one of the lower window sections. In the center is a pointed, arched stone gateway in a thick wall, leading to a tree‑lined path beyond. On the right is a smaller building with a tiled roof and shuttered windows. The path is cobbled or dirt, bordered by low stone walls and overgrown vegetation. There is no visible text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large neoclassical castle-like building on a hill surrounded by dense trees, seen from across a calm body of water that reflects the structure. The caption strip at the bottom identifies the location in Spanish and French and includes publication details.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a semi‑rural hillside town. In the foreground are cultivated fields bordered by low fences. Beyond them rises a hill dotted with villas and houses surrounded by trees. On the left summit stands a church with a steep roof, tower, and large cross. On the right hilltop there is a tall cylindrical water‑tower‑like structure with a conical roof. The style of the buildings suggests early 20th‑century Central European architecture. No text is visible on the image.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a grand, castle‑like hotel complex on a steep, forested hillside. The main multi‑story building has several round corner towers with conical roofs, central cupola, and many balconies. Smaller villa‑style buildings and terraced gardens surround it, with a town scattered along the slopes and dense forested hills rising behind.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a vaulted hall displaying rows of historic cannons and artillery pieces. The guns are lined up on polished floors under a series of arches; military banners with ornate heraldic symbols hang from the ceiling above them. Light enters from an arched window at the far end, giving the space a museum‑like atmosphere.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a tall rectangular medieval brick tower with crenellations and small square windows standing in an open square, with mountains in the background and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing in the foreground. Trees line a street on the left and multi‑story buildings border the right side. The word "Trento" appears at the upper right, "Torre Vanga" at the bottom center, and a publisher's imprint runs vertically along the left edge.

Sepia-toned image of an old European courtyard framed by high plastered stone walls with rectangular windows. Ivy and climbing plants cover much of the walls and an arched passageway. A small curved stairway leads up to a door on the left, while an inner pointed archway with a sculpted element above it opens into a shaded passage under the building. The roof is steeply pitched with small dormers, typical of historic Central European architecture. There is no visible printed caption on the front.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town in a hilly landscape. In the middle stands a large medieval castle complex with thick stone walls and at least two prominent round towers with conical roofs and small finials. Around the castle are trees, gardens, and clustered houses with steep gabled roofs. In the right background there is a tall factory chimney, suggesting early industrialization. Rolling fields and wooded hills form the distant backdrop. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal harbor with stone fortifications extending into the sea. A large square fortress dominates the left side of the harbor entrance, with sailing masts and a long breakwater visible behind it. Calm water fills the foreground. Printed captions in French and Greek appear at the top, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.

Vintage black‑and‑white view over the town of Meissen toward a hilltop complex dominated by a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and surrounding castle buildings. Printed red German text appears in the upper left, and a vertical publisher imprint is on the right margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European riverside town with a stone and metal bridge crossing a wide river. A long barge is on the water in the foreground, while trams, pedestrians, and streetlights line the riverbank road on the right. On the hill above the clustered old town stands a large complex with twin Gothic cathedral towers and adjoining castle‑like buildings. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies the place.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a steep hillside with a dramatic zigzagging stone staircase built into the rock. At the top of the hill stands a distinctive medieval clock tower with a steep, irregular roof and large clock face, partially surrounded by trees and fortification walls. Traditional European houses with tiled roofs appear at the bottom edge.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a stone arch bridge crossing a river in a dry, hilly landscape. At one end of the bridge stands a decorative gate or portal; at the other end, medieval-looking fortification walls and towers rise above the river. In the distant background there is a hilltop castle. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene in Spanish.

Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a monumental Orthodox-style cathedral with a large central dome topped by a cross and two smaller domed towers flanking the main façade. The building sits on a raised platform with broad steps leading to three arched entrance doors. The architecture features rounded arches, columned drum under the main dome, and decorative stonework. In front there is a landscaped square with paths, low ropes as barriers, and a tall streetlamp with two hanging lanterns. Surrounding the cathedral are lower historic buildings. The number "97" is printed in white in the bottom-right corner. Very faint library/collection marking is visible across the image center.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a street scene in an old European city. The view looks down a broad street lined with historic stone buildings. On the left is a large church with a rounded apse and Romanesque-Gothic details; beside it rises a tall, narrow bell tower topped with a cross. Further along stands another crenellated tower with a clock. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street. A caption at the bottom identifies the location as Trento and names the street Via San Vigilio, with a serial number preceding the city name.

A colorized historic postcard view of a stone-paved main street lined with old stone buildings and arcaded columns in the foreground. People in early 20th‑century attire walk and stand in the square; a small fenced monument or column stands to the left. The scene is a classic European old-town street. Printed captions identify the place as Stradun/Stradone in Dubrovnik/Ragusa.

A monochrome postcard-style photograph showing a large, low, symmetrical pavilion-like building with two tall corner towers topped by domes and thin spires. The structure has extensive windows, a flat roof with railings, and a central entrance reached by a short staircase with a fountain basin in front. Simple garden furniture and benches sit on the gravel and lawn in the foreground, while tall coniferous trees form a backdrop behind the building.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a historic European town with densely packed tiled roofs, narrow streets, and multiple church towers. In the foreground is a tall baroque-style church tower rising from a large roofed building in the town center. To the left, on a wooded hillside, stands a complex that looks like a small castle or monastery with two Romanesque-style towers. Beyond the town are rolling hills, fields, and scattered villages, giving a picturesque valley setting. No visible printed caption or text appears on the front.

An old, tinted postcard showing the ruins of a rounded Romanesque structure set in a wooded park. The central ruin has tall, narrow arched windows and a large semicircular apse. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand and sit in the foreground. The image is framed by trees and surrounded by a light vignette. At the bottom, red printed captions identify the location as Nijmegen and the ruin as Valkhof.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque palace-like building with a central clock tower and ornate pediment, seen across a lawn with statues and framed by trees. At the bottom left, the caption reads "Landesanstalt Hubertusburg."

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall rocky outcrop in a wooded area with a statue of a chamois (mountain goat) standing on its summit. A man in early 20th‑century attire leans on a railing along the path at the base of the rock. Printed German text appears at the bottom, along with the publisher's information.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a leafy park with benches and people sitting and strolling in the foreground. To the right stands an ornate wooden bandstand or pavilion. Rising behind the trees is a large medieval stone church with a steep gabled roof and a tower topped by a bulbous cupola and clock. Printed text at the top names the place in two languages.

Vintage monochrome postcard view of Budapest showing steamships on the Danube River in the foreground and the large hilltop palace complex in the background. The image is lightly sepia-toned with printed red caption text at the top in Hungarian and German.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a small tower-like structure on a tiny islet in a calm strait, with a historic city shoreline and many minarets visible in the distant background. The central building has a square base, tiled roofs, and a tall spire. There is printed caption text along the bottom edge and a circular stamp mark on the left, plus a modern website watermark.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large arch bridge crossing a wide river. Crowds of people line both sides of the bridge and the riverbank; a few vehicles, including a bus, are on the roadway. On the right riverbank several moored sailing ships are visible. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and highlights the bridge's notable span.

A black‑and‑white view of a large waterside baroque castle with several round corner towers capped by domes and lanterns, a central section with a steep roof and a tall spire, and a formal tree‑lined garden between the castle and the water in the foreground. The image is framed like an old photograph or postcard, with no visible caption or border text on the front.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large brick fire station with a tall, ornate hose‑drying/watch tower rising above the main building. The architecture is 19th‑century historicist with arched windows and decorative brickwork. The foreground shows a cobblestone street, fence, and hedges; there are telegraph poles and a streetlamp. Printed captions in red read "Helsingfors" on the lower left and "Brandstation" on the lower right. The lower part of the card contains handwritten cursive text.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a tree‑lined street leading toward a tall church with a sharp spire. Multi‑storey stone buildings flank the street, and a few pedestrians and a cart are visible on the unpaved road. The words "Skara." and "Järnvägsgatan." are printed at the top.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a landscaped city park. The fountain has multiple tiers with sculpted figures and water basins, surrounded by smaller statues, flower beds, lawns, benches, and tall trees. At the top of the card, printed text identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white elevated view over a historic European town with dense, steep‑roofed houses in the foreground and a large fortress‑like complex with towers and spires dominating the mid‑ground. A tall industrial chimney and a long factory building stand to the left, while wooded hills frame the background. Streets curve between the tightly packed old buildings; the architecture appears Central European, likely German-speaking, early 20th century.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic hilltop complex above a riverside town. In the foreground, a paddle steamer is sailing on a wide river. Behind it rise terraced houses and, dominating the hill, a large castle-like complex with a Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires and steep roofs. The printed caption along the bottom identifies the scene. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town along a river. A masonry and metal bridge crosses the river in the foreground. On the right bank are rows of trees, modest multi‑story houses and civic buildings, and an open grassy area with laundry hanging on lines. In the background rise several church towers and spires dominating the skyline, and low wooded hills beyond the town. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.

Vintage black-and-white postcard with two inset photographs. The left image shows a hillside village with several houses in the foreground and, above them on the hill, a large pilgrimage church with twin towers. The right image shows a forest scene with an outdoor roadside crucifix (a wooden cross with a roofed shelter) and fencing around it. The captions beneath the images read "Maria-Trost bei Graz" under the left view and "Waldandacht" under the right, with a small printed serial number at the bottom left.

Black‑and‑white image showing a wide, empty square with a tall column topped by a winged statue at the center. Curved colonnades with large pillars frame both sides of the monument. A few pedestrians walk across the broad, tram‑track‑marked pavement in the foreground, and trees as well as a distant church spire are visible behind the structure.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a portrait of a Catholic bishop on the upper left and a large twin‑towered cathedral with a dome and surrounding buildings on the right and bottom. The text at the top and below the portrait is in Croatian, and there are purple handwritten notes and a date on the front.

A sepia-toned postcard photograph of a Renaissance-style arcaded courtyard with multiple levels of round arches and balustrades. On the left is a domed tower-like structure with small windows and an external staircase; on the right, a long façade of repeating arches. The courtyard is mostly empty, with light and shadow on the ground. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the ornate Gothic rooftop and central spire of a large cathedral, viewed from the roof with two small human figures walking along the stone slabs. Numerous pinnacles and statues line the roof. Printed captions in Italian and French are below the image.

Illustrated postcard showing a stylized view of the Hofburg palace complex with a large open square and lawns in the foreground, a mounted equestrian statue on a pedestal, and long baroque/renaissance palace façades in the background. Small walking figures are scattered across the square. Beneath the image there is printed text and a large blank area for writing.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a street scene with an ornate Renaissance-style town hall building lined with statues and tall windows on the left, pedestrians walking along a cobblestone street, and a church tower rising in the background. The captions at the bottom read "Nijmegen." on the left and "Stadhuis." on the right.

Black-and-white postcard showing a rural landscape with a church featuring a tall tower and bulbous spire on the right, and several school or residential buildings to the left, set behind trees and open fields in the foreground. At the top, printed text in Swedish reads "Färentuna kyrka och skola." There are a few handwritten annotations and marks near the top center and next to the church tower.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, grand neoclassical-style building with two rounded corner towers and a long central facade facing a landscaped garden with paths and flower beds. The image is bordered by a printed frame, and handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom edge.

Color photograph of a hilltop Gothic cathedral complex with two tall, dark spires rising above a long, slate-roofed building that looks like a castle or palace. The structure stands on a wooded hillside, with dense green trees in the foreground and a few small houses with steep, tiled roofs at the bottom. The sky is clear and blue with light clouds. No visible text appears on the image side.

A vintage black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with four photographs. The upper left shows a large medieval hilltop castle with multiple towers and a forested backdrop. The upper right depicts a lakeside or riverside resort with boats, piers, and many people seated under umbrellas at an outdoor café. The lower left shows a dam or lakeside promenade crowded with visitors, with timber buildings nearby and dense forest in the background. The lower right displays a winding river or reservoir running through a wooded valley with a small boat on the water. In the center, elegant script text reads "Zschopau-Talsperre Kriebstein."

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tall column and statue in a city square. Atop the column stands a figure; at its base is a sculpted winged figure beside a standing man on a pedestal inscribed "ADAM MICKIEWICZ". Behind the monument are multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with shops on the ground floor. Several people gather around the monument in the foreground. The lower margin bears printed captions in Polish and German identifying the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a richly decorated historic brick building on a street corner. The façade has stepped gables, tall mullioned windows with shutters, and a row of statues between the upper and lower windows. Sepia-toned early-20th‑century photograph of a group of finely dressed people (women in long dresses and large hats, men in suits and bowler/top hats) standing around a powerful indoor fountain or geyser. The scene is inside an ornate glass-and-iron pavilion with large arched windows and decorative ironwork. Steam or spray from the fountain fills the air, giving the image a hazy appearance.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside city with grand historic buildings, a curving colonnade and statue in the foreground, a large palace complex on a hill to the left, a wide river with several bridges and boats, and a domed parliament building visible in the far distance along the embankment. A formal park with curved paths and a busy square with trams and horse‑drawn vehicles occupy the lower right.

Colorized historic view of a wide tree-lined boulevard with tram tracks and an early electric tram in the center, pedestrians and horse-drawn vehicles, surrounded by multi‑story 19th‑century buildings. Two church or tower spires rise in the background on the left and right. At the top right there is printed text in Russian and German indicating the scene is Alexander Boulevard in Riga.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large ornate fountain in a city park. The fountain has a central sculptural group of several robed figures beneath a domed canopy, with numerous water jets arching outward into a circular basin surrounded by statues of children or cherubs. Trees and landscaped greenery fill the background, and a few people in early-20th‑century clothing stand around the basin. The captions printed in the lower margin read "GRAZ." on the left and "BRUNNEN IM STADTPARK." on the right.

Vintage monochrome postcard bordered in yellowish tone showing a tall stepped pedestal with a statue of an armed figure holding a flag, surrounded by chains and posts. In the background are town buildings including a church with a tall spire. Printed caption in Estonian appears below the image.

A colorized panoramic view over a European city with red-roofed buildings and a prominent, forested hill rising from the middle of the urban area. On top of the hill are several structures, likely fortifications or a tower. A river with bridges runs through the city to the right. The sky is lightly clouded. At the top of the postcard is printed text in German: "Graz von der Rainerwarte."

Vintage sepia postcard showing a large church under extensive scaffolding, flanked by medieval-style fortification towers and walls. In front of the complex is a square with a Marian/holy column and surrounding buildings. Decorative text in Croatian and German appears on the right and beneath the image, and a printer's mark is at the bottom right.

Colorized winter scene of snow-covered buildings on a hillside. A large striped spherical weather ball hangs in the foreground with the German greeting "Frohes Neujahr!" written across it. Two men in early-20th‑century clothing stand near the small building beneath the ball. At the top-left, printed text identifies the location as the weather ball and fortress at Schlossberg in Graz.

Black‑and‑white aerial/raised view over a river bend with numerous barges and a small passenger steamer. A long steel truss bridge with stone piers crosses the river in the foreground. On both banks there are quays, rail tracks, and mid‑European style houses and villas with steep tiled roofs. In the background a high rocky hill with a sheer cliff dominates the scene, with rail lines and a road curving around its base and more town buildings and distant hills beyond. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a historic central-European town square dominated by a large Gothic/Renaissance building with a very steep tiled roof and several stepped gables. The façade has arched doorways, a balcony, a small clock on one of the central gables, and signage at ground level. To the left is a row of multi‑storey townhouses with shops at street level, and a cobblestone square with a few pedestrians in front.

A panoramic black‑and‑white view of a coastal town built around a curved bay. Whitewashed, flat‑roofed houses line the waterfront, with a small harbor and several boats. Low hills and islands appear in the background across the calm sea. In the foreground are scattered buildings and rocky terrain. Printed captions in Greek and French identify the location, and a modern website watermark is visible along the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing an ornate baroque/rococo corner building with richly decorated stucco façade and arcaded ground floor on a cobbled street with tram tracks. Many people in late 19th–early 20th century clothing walk and gather under the arches. Several shop signs are visible on the façade, and a caption at the bottom reads "Graz. Luegg."

Black-and-white panoramic view taken from a hillside park or promenade, looking over a tree‑lined path toward a historic European town. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large fortified complex with multiple wings, towers, and steep roofs resembling a Renaissance or Baroque castle. Below the castle are dense rows of traditional gabled houses and at least one prominent church with a tall spire. The foreground shows open grass, young trees, wooden railings, and a small pavilion.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large Orthodox-style cathedral with domes and twin bell towers, set along a tree-lined street. A few pedestrians are visible in the foreground. Greek captioning appears at the bottom along with French text and a small serial number.

Colorized historic postcard view of a castle courtyard with light-colored plaster walls, red-tiled roofs, decorative stepped gables, and towers. Ivy covers parts of the façade, and there is a landscaped lawn and path in the foreground. The scene is labeled in German with red printed text in the sky area.

A hand‑colored vintage postcard depicting the entrance road and gate to a hilltop castle complex. The scene shows a stone path leading uphill along a wooden fence toward an arched gateway in a fortification wall. Above and behind the gate stand medieval buildings with steep slate roofs and a tall square tower with a pointed spire. Trees surround the walls. The image has soft pastel sky colors typical of early colorized postcards. German text is printed in red beneath the image.

Illustrated interior view of a large, crowded beer hall with vaulted, ornately painted ceilings and a huge circular chandelier. People in 19th‑century Central European clothing sit at long wooden tables drinking beer, while waitresses in traditional dresses serve them. In the background, wall paintings depict a cityscape. The image has a painterly style and a small caption printed along the lower edge.

A colorized historic view of a fortified medieval town with stone towers, church spires, and red‑roofed houses. In the foreground is a sloping path with small buildings and trees; in the middle stands a large church and several round and square towers connected by old city walls. Printed text at the top identifies the place as Bautzen in Saxony and highlights the Michaelis Church and the old waterworks tower.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style view over a historic European town built on and below a wooded hillside. On the left stands a large medieval hilltop castle with a prominent round tower and battlements, partly hidden by trees. Below and to the right stretches a dense cluster of steep‑roofed houses and narrow streets. Dominating the right side of the image is a large Gothic church with a tall spire and pointed-arch windows. The skyline includes additional church towers and old civic buildings. There is no visible printed caption or handwritten text on the front.

Black-and-white postcard image showing a rural road lined with trees leading toward a hilltop baroque church complex with twin towers and a dome. The church stands amid rolling countryside with scattered houses. A bench is placed beside a large tree in the foreground. Printed caption text appears at the top of the image.

A colorized historical postcard showing a large baroque fountain topped with a statue of Neptune in a town square, surrounded by old multi‑story buildings with arched porticoes and shuttered windows. A domed building rises in the background, and a few pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk near the fountain. The caption at the top right reads "Trento - Fontana e Casa Rella."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy European city square with a large historic building featuring a central dome, clock, and ornate façade. The square is crowded with people, market stalls with umbrellas, and an old tram on tracks running through the street. Tall spires and older buildings line the left side of the street. Caption text at the bottom left reads "GRAZ. HAUPTPLATZ" and at the bottom right "ERIKA-VERLAG – GRAZ, 1001".

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard depicting an ornate Renaissance-style building with large arched windows, statues in niches, and a balustraded roof. In front of the building is a fenced fountain featuring a prominent statue, with people and trees around a cobblestone square. The lower margin contains printed captions in German identifying the location and the publisher.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a broad square or open park area in front of a tree‑lined boulevard. Several people ride bicycles and walk across the open space, with tram tracks and a tram visible in the middle distance. Behind the trees stands a large classical building with a greenish roof, likely a concert hall. A decorative iron fence runs along the foreground. The caption along the bottom margin reads in red Dutch text.

A colorized historic postcard view of a domed mosque with a single tall minaret in a hilly urban area. The foreground shows a dirt path, stone walls, and small houses with red roofs; a few people walk on the path. The mosque has multiple domes and arched windows. Printed captions at the top read in French about Constantinople and the Kahrieh Mosque, and there is a web address watermark at the bottom right.

Sepia-toned interior view of an ornate rococo-style hall with elaborate stucco ceiling decoration, tall arched windows along the walls, large mirrors, and a tall tiled stove on the left. Handwritten text at the bottom identifies the place.

Black-and-white view of a large church with a tall clock tower and spire, surrounded by trees and a fence, with a spacious parsonage or manor house visible to the left. The foreground shows a road or open area, and printed captions in Swedish appear along the bottom margin.

A colored vintage postcard view of a large open square bordered by buildings and green areas, with a circular monument or statue in the foreground-left and people walking around the plaza. Snow-capped mountains and rocky hills rise in the background. The caption at the top left reads "Trento. Piazza Dante." indicating the scene is Piazza Dante in Trento, Italy.

A black‑and‑white view of a tree‑lined promenade or square with people walking in early 20th‑century clothing.
