At the right stands a large statue of a man in a dynamic pose on a tall pedestal inscribed with the word "PETOFI." Behind the statue is a grand multi‑storey historicist building with ornate windows and roofline. The foreground shows a cobbled street with chain posts separating the roadway from the promenade.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European city along a river, with a metal truss bridge in the foreground, rows of historic multi‑storey buildings on the riverbank, and a steep hill behind them crowned by a fortress complex. A tall church tower with an onion dome and clock stands prominently to the right, and another clock tower is visible on the hillside. Printed caption text appears at the upper left, and commercial signage is visible on riverside buildings.

A winter scene showing a grand historic building with towers and steep roofs covered in snow, viewed through snow-laden trees. People in dark winter clothing stand and walk in the snowy foreground behind a low fence. At the bottom of the image, red text identifies the scene in Hungarian and German.

Sepia-toned historic postcard view framed by an archway, showing a cobblestone street, stone wall, gas streetlamp and a row of old buildings leading toward a prominent tower with a pointed roof. The caption in German at the bottom identifies the scene as a view toward the royal Albrechtsburg in Meissen. Publisher information appears along the lower edge.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a historic European town with dense old buildings, a prominent round defensive tower by a river, a church with a tall spire, and several other towers rising above the rooftops. A bridge crosses the river in the foreground, and the overall style is that of an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Red printed text at the top names the place and main landmarks.

Monochrome printed postcard showing a round stone tower with a conical roof, standing on a small rise in a park‑like landscape. Bare trees with twisted branches dominate the foreground, suggesting late autumn or winter. A path curves around the hill and a few small human figures walk along it. The scene has a slightly dramatic, artistic rendering rather than a straightforward photograph. There is a small handwritten archival code along the lower edge outside the image area.

Colorized view of a large central square with market stalls, umbrellas and a prominent statue on a stepped pedestal in the middle. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and shop signs in German at street level. In the background, a steep, tree-covered hill rises above the town, crowned by a fortified structure and a distinctive clock tower. The printed words "Graz" and "Hauptplatz" appear at the top of the image.

A vintage postcard-style image showing a long, pale-colored classical building with many windows and an arched entrance in the center. The foreground is shaded by large tree branches and leaves, with a cobblestone courtyard in front of the building. The style suggests an old town or historic castle complex. At the bottom of the card, printed text reads "TALLINN." on the left and "Loss." on the right.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large hilltop castle complex above a river. The foreground features a calm river with a sandy bank and a few people near the water. Behind the river stand several townhouses and smaller buildings along the embankment. Rising above them is a massive Gothic‑Revival castle or palace with steep, patterned roofs, multiple towers, turrets, and a tall church-like spire. One part of the main building appears to be under restoration or construction, encased in a prominent scaffolding structure. Dense trees cover much of the slope up to the castle.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural waterfront village with wooden houses, small boats and a pier in the foreground, and a prominent stone church with a tall steeple on a hill in the background. The printed caption at the top left reads "Saltviks kyrka. Åland." indicating the church of Saltvik in the Åland Islands.

Black‑and‑white aerial photograph taken from a biplane, showing a fortified peninsula jutting into the sea with massive walls and bastions, likely an old fortress. Behind it lies a dense historic town with long waterfront buildings and a straight seafront promenade. Hills and additional coastline appear in the background. A web address watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed near the bottom right.

A vintage multi-view postcard with four colored illustrations of landmarks in and around the Dutch city of Nijmegen. The upper left view shows a park landscape with lawns, trees, a round brick tower and distant church-like buildings, labeled as Kronenburgerpark. The upper right view depicts a green park or estate with tall trees, a villa and a smaller white chapel-like building, labeled Koepel Wester Meerwijk. The lower left image shows a broad town square framed by multi‑story historic buildings and pedestrians, labeled Groote Markt. The lower right image portrays an ornate Renaissance-style brick weighing house with a steep roof and exterior staircase opening onto a busy square, labeled de Waag. Each view is captioned with the word 'Nijmegen.' in red script at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a small town in a river valley with a large medieval hilltop castle dominating the scene. Steep-roofed houses cluster below the castle walls and towers. In the distance a river and industrial smoke are visible. Red printed captions at the top read the town name on the left and the castle name on the right.

Black‑and‑white view along a straight tree‑lined road in a semi‑rural area. On the left stands a large villa with steep tiled roof, dormers, and decorative timber details, enclosed by a fence. Telegraph or power poles run down the center of the road. On the right is a grassy verge and orchards or vineyards supported by wooden stakes. In the distance, on top of a terraced hillside covered with vines, there is a prominent hilltop pilgrimage complex or monastery with multiple towers and a central dome, dominating the skyline.

A monochrome postcard image showing an ornate domed mosque complex with richly decorated exterior walls and a prominent, patterned main dome. A smaller dome and additional structures stand nearby, along with a slender minaret in the background. Low buildings and palm trees are visible on the horizon. Printed caption text at the top identifies the location as Alexandria and the Nebi Daniel Mosque, and a website watermark appears at the bottom.

A colorized historic postcard depicting a large neoclassical municipal building with colonnades and many windows, fronted by palm trees and a public square with people walking. Printed text at the bottom identifies it as the town hall (Hôtel de Ville) of Syra. There is a handwritten signature at the top and a watermark with a website address at the bottom.

A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a large baroque fountain with a statue of Neptune holding a trident on top, surrounded by multiple sculpted figures and basins with flowing water. The fountain stands in the middle of a cobblestoned square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings with shuttered windows. Tree branches frame the top of the image, and pigeons are visible in the foreground near some leaves. Printed caption text at the bottom identifies the location as Trento and specifies the square and fountain.

A vintage monochrome postcard depicting a packed open-air amphitheater with curved stone seating surrounding a central circular stage. The backdrop is a long neoclassical colonnaded façade with doors and decorations, and many people wearing early-20th‑century style hats fill the stands. Printed caption text appears below the image, and red handwritten numbers are on the bottom left and right margins.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square with a prominent monument at its center. The monument consists of a tall pedestal with a standing figure on top and seated figures at the corners, surrounded by steps. Historic multi‑storey buildings encircle the square; signs on the façades advertise banks, cafés, and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the open plaza. The caption "GRAZ – HAUPTPLATZ" appears at the bottom left, and the publisher credit "ERIKA-VERLAG-GRAZ. 522" is printed at the bottom right. Other building signs include "STEIERM. AGRAR BANK" and "CAFÉ NORDSTER".

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a view over a town in a valley, framed by two tall cypress trees and the ruined wall of a stone castle in the foreground. Mountains rise in the distance. The image is mounted on a decorative card border with handwritten Italian text beneath the photo.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with a tall church dominating the scene. The church has a high tower with a clock and an onion-shaped spire topped by a cross. Surrounding it are multi‑story townhouses and shops lining a relatively empty street where an early automobile and a few pedestrians are visible. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge of the image.

Colorized vintage view of an Italian-looking town square dominated by a tall rectangular stone clock tower with arched belfry openings at the top. Around the tower are multi‑story pastel buildings with shutters and arcades. In the foreground, several horse-drawn carts loaded with goods are parked in the open plaza, with low mountains visible in the distant background. The image is framed with a white border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No legible caption or writing appears on the front.

Color postcard view of a large medieval clock tower on a hill overlooking a densely built European city with red-tiled roofs. The tower has a steep shingled roof and prominent wooden gallery around the upper part, with two large clock faces showing Roman numerals. A path and greenery surround the tower, and several small figures stand at the overlook. At the top left of the image, printed text reads "Graz. Uhrturm."

A black‑and‑white aerial or elevated panoramic photograph of a dense historic town with rows of stepped‑gabled houses in the foreground and many church spires and traditional brick buildings stretching into the distance. The lower margin contains printed captions in French and English identifying the view as Bruges and describing it as a bird's‑eye view of the town, along with a small number "177" on the left and a printer's mark on the right.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic Scandinavian townscape. In the background stands a large church or cathedral with a tall square tower topped by an ornate dome and spire. In front of it are several older buildings with steep tiled roofs and many windows, set among trees and behind a wooden fence along a dirt road that curves in the foreground. The scene has a serene small‑town atmosphere. Printed text appears at the lower left and lower right edges of the image.

A black‑and‑white vintage view of an open city square with trees, paths, and fenced areas in the foreground. Multi‑storey brick and stone buildings frame the square on the left and right, and in the distance a large church or tower rises above the rooftops. The perspective looks across a tram or car road toward the park-like square. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's mark is visible in the lower right corner.

Close-up of a yellow and black postage stamp affixed to a postcard. The stamp shows a shield with a stylized castle or city gate in the center, surrounded by a lattice pattern and decorative side panels with leaves and crescents. At the top is the inscription "EESTI POST" and on the right edge a small box with the year "1938". At the bottom is the word "CARITAS" above the denomination "50" appearing in two opposing corners, with a small cross emblem centered below.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a grassy, marshy field with a raised, tree‑covered earthwork or wall on the right side. Trees and low vegetation fill the scene, and a building is faintly visible in the far left background. At the top of the image, printed text identifies the location as the castle wall in Kuressaare in three languages.

Color postcard showing a medieval hilltop castle surrounded by dense green forest, set against steep, dramatic, rocky mountains. The fortress has thick stone walls, a prominent square tower with a steep pyramidal roof and small windows, and ivy-covered outer walls. No visible printed title or text appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white panoramic cityscape of a European spa town nestled in a narrow valley with forested hills in the background. The foreground shows richly ornamented late‑19th‑century apartment and hotel buildings, with mansard roofs and elaborate facades. In the mid‑ground stands a small towered structure and dense rows of multi‑storey townhouses stepping up the hillside. At the top of the hill a small lookout pavilion or chapel sits on a rocky outcrop. The overall look suggests a historic resort city built along a river, photographed from an elevated vantage point.

Colorized panoramic view of a European city set in a valley with surrounding hills and mountains. In the foreground is a calm body of water with several small rowboats carrying people. Along the shore stands an ornate lakeside building with towers and a red roof, with tree-lined paths and other villas behind it. The middle and background show dense urban buildings, churches, and greenery rising up towards a hill with a fortification on top. Printed red text at the top reads in German.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large, fortress‑like barracks building with crenellated walls and several pointed towers on a street corner. To the left stands a massive round medieval tower with a conical roof. People walk along wide, mostly empty streets. The sky is softly tinted blue with scattered clouds, in a typical early 20th‑century postcard style. German text is printed at the top identifying the scene in Bautzen.

Black-and-white image showing a quiet cobblestoned street lined with 2–3 story masonry buildings, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century. The street is mostly empty except for a distant pedestrian and a lamppost in the foreground. In the background, on a small rise, there is a prominent tower with a steep spire and a relatively large, almost square belfry-like structure, suggesting a church or bell tower dominating a small historic town.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large tree trunk in the foreground with a historic, castle‑like garden building with two round corner towers in the background. The scene shows a landscaped lawn and paths, likely part of a botanical garden. The bottom border contains printed captions in German, including the place and photographer.

Vintage black‑and‑white view of a European city square with a circular fountain and small pool in the foreground, lined with leafless trees and bordered by grand late‑19th‑century buildings. On the left stands an ornate domed building, while on the right a tall Baroque church tower with an onion‑shaped spire rises above attached structures. The street running through the square contains early motor vehicles and pedestrians. Shopfronts with awnings face the square. No visible caption text is present on the front.

A black-and-white postcard view of a tall round brick tower attached to a church-like building. The tower has many arched windows arranged vertically and is topped with a viewing platform surrounded by a railing and a dome-like structure. A flag with a Nordic cross flies at the top. Below, people, horse-drawn vehicles, and early cars move along a busy street. At the bottom of the image, handwritten-style text reads "København. Runde Tårn."

Color postcard showing a small wooden boat with people near a quay on a waterfront at sunset or sunrise. Buildings, piers and masts are visible along the shoreline in the background. At the top left printed bilingual text in Greek and French identifies the view of the quay in Thessaloniki/Salonique. There is a handwritten message in French across the sky area, and a modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" at the bottom right.

Sepia panoramic view over the Johanneslund neighborhood with wooden houses and gardens, open fields beyond, and the silhouette of a large Renaissance-style castle with towers on the far right. Caption printed at the top left reads "Johanneslund. Kalmar."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a shoreline with rocks and shallow water in the foreground, dense trees in the middle ground, and a large rectangular ruin on a hill in the distance. A printed Swedish caption appears at the top left.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a huge crowd gathered in front of a grand Baroque church. A Swedish caption at the right mentions a protest meeting in Kalmar on 13 April 1903 against the abolition of the Kalmar diocese. The church facade matches Kalmar Cathedral. Publisher credit and a handwritten Swedish greeting appear along the right edge.

Hand-tinted scenic view across a calm moat or lake framed by birch trees, with a small stone arched bridge at center and, in the distance, a Renaissance castle featuring domed corner towers and a tall central spire.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing Madesjö kyrka (Madesjö Church) with a square tower topped by a cross and clock, arched windows, stone wall, and leafless trees. Swedish printed caption appears at the top, with a handwritten note "Byggd 1754" and a vertical handwritten message along the right edge.

Sepia-toned harbor scene crowded with people, horse carts, and steam/sailing boats. In the background stands a large Renaissance fortress with onion-domed spires and round bastions on an island. Decorative script along the bottom margin reads the photographer's name and the city.

Vintage postcard with a green background showing a large Swedish flag and an inset black‑and‑white photograph of a waterside Renaissance castle. The inset is captioned "Kalmar (Slott.)" and there is handwritten Swedish greeting text and a date. Publisher credit appears at the bottom: "Dillbergs Bokhandel, Kalmar."

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a grand Baroque cathedral with towers and a clock, seen from the square with a few people in front. Caption reads "Kalmar Domkyrka" at lower left; a small serial number appears at lower right.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a rural stone church with a square tower topped by a lantern and cross, surrounded by stone walls, small cottages, and trees. A horse-drawn wagon appears in the foreground. Caption in the upper left reads "Resmo kyrka."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large Baroque cathedral dominating a town square. Two people walk in the foreground; surrounding low buildings frame the plaza. The caption at the bottom left reads 'Kalmar, Domkyrka' and a serial number '9462' appears at the bottom right.

Divided-view vintage postcard: at left a hand‑tinted studio portrait of a woman in Swedish folk costume; at right a view of a large castle ruin rising above trees. Handwritten Swedish caption at top reads "Borgholms slott." More handwritten Swedish text appears below the right image. A publisher's imprint runs vertically along the left edge.

Tinted vintage postcard showing a long glass-and-steel conservatory with a central domed entry, formal flowerbeds, and a reflecting pool with small fountains in front. Red printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene; there is blue handwritten script along the right margin and bottom.

Black-and-white aerial view of a coastal Renaissance castle on a small island connected to the mainland by a causeway. The fortress has multiple round corner towers, a tall central tower with an onion-dome spire, outer rondel towers flanking the approach, and is surrounded by seawater and a moat.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a busy harbor scene with steamships, a crowd of people, and horse‑drawn carts on the quay. In the distance are the towers of Kalmar Castle. The caption at the bottom reads "KALMAR. ÖLANDSHAMNEN." and the publisher credit "Hjalmar Appeltoffts Bokh."

Hand-tinted postcard view of a harbor with small steamships and boats in the foreground and a large Renaissance castle with towers and domes across the water. The scene is labeled with place names in Swedish; open sky with scattered clouds. The lower margin contains printed captions.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a hedge‑lined promenade with benches and a seated man. At left stands a wooden house with a painted sign. In the distance are the distinctive towers and dome of Kalmar Castle. Printed caption identifies the view as Sjövallen in Kalmar, with publisher credit; there is a handwritten Swedish greeting dated 1905.

Hand‑tinted vintage view of a cobblestone castle courtyard with whitewashed walls and green metal roofs. In the center stands an octagonal Renaissance well pavilion with columns, heraldic shields on the base, a small lantern above, and a swan-shaped finial on top. A stone portal and windows ring the courtyard; trees frame the right side.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard of Gothenburg's harbor showing two ocean liners at the quay labeled as m/s Gripsholm and m/s Suecia, with cranes and waterfront buildings; the hilltop tower of Masthugg Church rises in the background.

A colorized vintage postcard showing a hilltop complex consisting of a church with a tower and an adjoining castle above a forested slope. The buildings have steep dark roofs and light walls, with trees and greenery filling the foreground under a pastel sky. Red German text captions are printed at the top and along the left and right margins.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing the stone ruins of an old monastic building with arched openings and partially collapsed walls. The foreground has scattered stone slabs; in the background are trees and open countryside. Printed caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom margin, and a small oval publisher mark with the word "AKTA FOTOGRAFI" is in the lower right corner.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large fortified castle with high stone walls, corner bastions, and a tall round tower. A road and walkway curve along the front of the fortifications, with a few pedestrians and a carriage visible. Mountains rise in the background. Printed captions and handwritten notes appear on the front, including the name of the city and castle.

An old monochrome postcard depicting a massive stone fortress with round towers and crenellated walls. In front of the arched entrance is rough ground with an old wooden cart, and parts of ruined walls extend along the right side. The top caption in French reads that this is the Yedi-Koulé fortress in Salonique, and there is a website watermark at the bottom right.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a European hill town. A large medieval hilltop castle complex with thick walls and simple gabled roofs dominates the left and center, rising above dense trees. A distinctive round tower with a crenellated, conical‑roofed top stands near the middle of the castle. Down the slope to the right lies a compact town with steep‑roofed houses and a tall Gothic-style church with a slender spire. In the foreground are cultivated fields or vineyards with several small human figures working among the rows.

Vintage black‑and‑white winter view of a hilltop parish church with a tall spire and arched windows, surrounded by bare trees and snow. A small bridge crosses a stream in the foreground. Caption at the bottom reads "Fra Vangs kirke."

Black‑and‑white real‑photo postcard showing a cobblestoned downhill street leading to a central square. At the far side of the square stands a neoclassical church with a pedimented facade and a tall open bell tower topped by a dome. An early automobile is parked at the curb and a few pedestrians walk along the street. The back is printed in Finnish/French with a Viipuri (Vyborg) photo credit.

Tinted view of the classical, domed main building of Moscow University with a grand colonnade, seen from the street behind a gated fence. Pedestrians walk along the sidewalk. Titles are printed in Russian and French at the top. The reverse is a Russian Empire UPU postcard back with address-only lines and bilingual Russian–French instructions.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ossuary chapel attached to a churchyard with a medieval tower and wall. Murals are painted on the chapel façade. Caption at the bottom identifies the site. The reverse has a green Swiss 'HELVETIA' 10‑rappen stamp, a circular MUTTENZ BASELLAND postmark dated 30.XII.27, and a handwritten German message addressed to Basel.

Sepia postcard showing a crowd with wreaths gathered around the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier beneath the Arc de Triomphe in Paris. Printed bilingual caption at top. The reverse reads "CARTE POSTALE," with a handwritten French message and an address to 52 Rue de Lévis, 17e, Paris. It bears French stamps, including one reading "COTE FRANCAISE DES SOMALIS."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a Romanesque church with three apses and a small bell gable, captioned "Barsinghausen – Kirche." The reverse reads "POSTKARTE," bears a green 5‑Pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp with a Hannover-area cancel, is addressed in German to Welsede near Pyrmont, and has a later blue museum stamp from Bad Pyrmont.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a spa complex with a long colonnade and a domed pavilion opening onto an open square filled with benches. A church spire and townhouses rise in the background. German captions along the lower border read "Bad Pyrmont" and "Brunnenplatz mit Wandelhalle." The reverse has German publisher details and a museum mark from Bad Pyrmont.

Multiview chromolithographic greeting postcard titled "Gruss aus Pyrmont," showing scenes from the spa town of Bad Pyrmont: the Fürstliches Schloss beside water and an arched bridge, the Brunnenplatz with the Trinkhalle pavilion full of promenading visitors, Café-Haus Reusch on the Hauptallee under large trees, and the Bahnhof (railway station). Floral decoration and a handwritten German message appear on the front; the reverse is a Deutsche Reichspost card with 5 Pfennig stamp and Hameln postmark.

Colorized postcard view showing a busy spa pavilion covered with garlands in a park-like setting, labeled "Bad Pyrmont – Stahlbrunnen." A tall church spire rises in the background and townspeople in period dress gather around the octagonal wellhouse. The reverse has a green 6‑pfennig Deutsches Reich stamp with a BAD PYRMONT postmark, an advertising cancel for spa cures, a museum cachet, publisher information, and handwritten message in German.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large hilltop castle complex with a tall tower and multiple attached buildings, identified in German as Schloss Weesenstein. The castle overlooks a small river or stream running through a valley, with trees, fields, and a few houses in the foreground. A small steam train with smoke from its chimney is visible on tracks beside the river. The printed caption at the top reads "Schloss Weesenstein i. Müglitztale."

Black‑and‑white interior view of a large neo‑Gothic church, looking down the central aisle toward an ornate pipe organ on the rear gallery. Tall pointed arches, clustered columns, wooden pews, chandeliers and a cross above the entrance arch are visible. Caption text in Latvian is printed along the bottom margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a tree‑filled parish park with people walking and sitting on benches. In the background stands a church with a tall bell tower and clock. At the top of the image is printed text identifying the location, with an additional handwritten note.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a tall monument with a statue of Dante standing on top of a multi-tiered pedestal surrounded by sculptural reliefs. The monument is set in a park with benches, trees, and mountains visible in the background. An ornate streetlamp stands to the right. The caption at the bottom reads in Italian: "TRENTO - Monumento a Dante".

A sepia-toned postcard showing a general view of a Romanesque church complex in a rural valley, surrounded by stone walls and fields. The main building has a simple façade with an arched doorway, small bell tower and attached cloister-like arcade. Low hills and scattered houses are visible in the background. Printed caption text appears at the top and along the right edge.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of an ornate Russian Orthodox church with multiple onion domes and a tall bell tower, surrounded by forested hills. In the lower right corner there is white printed text in German identifying the location.

Sepia-toned photograph of a formal park path leading to a tall monument. The monument consists of a rocky pedestal with a sculpted bust or figure in the middle and, on top, a winged female figure holding a laurel wreath aloft. Decorative multi‑globe street lamps flank the walkway. At the bottom of the image are three postage stamps, each cancelled with round postmarks.

Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a brick cloister or portico with arched arcades and ornate columns, including a central twisted column. The architecture is clearly historic and Italianate. In the lower left corner there is printed caption text indicating the location and subject, and in the upper right there is a circular mark with the letters "M.C.T.".

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a river with a long bridge in the foreground and a paddle steamer on the water. On the hill behind the bridge stands a large castle complex with prominent Gothic church towers, overlooking a town of dense historic buildings. The card has decorative, slightly scalloped edges and a caption in German at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white view of a cloistered courtyard with a garden, seen through a dark foreground arch and railing. The main building has two levels of arcaded galleries with rounded arches, tile roofs, and a large domed church rising behind, topped with a lantern and cross. The architectural style suggests a Mediterranean or Latin monastic complex.

Sepia-toned interior view of a large late‑Gothic church nave with very tall clustered pillars, elaborate ribbed and net vaulting, high narrow stained-glass windows, wooden pews, and richly carved galleries. At the far end stands a monumental multi‑tiered altarpiece and an ornate pulpit to the right.

A vintage, tinted night‑view postcard showing a large Romanesque cathedral with two prominent towers and an ornate multi-tiered fountain in the foreground. The moon and clouds are visible in the sky. The scene is framed by a light border, and a caption is printed below the image.

Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a large fortified complex with high walls, a prominent round tower and a long palace-like building behind it. Trees and a broad walkway with a few pedestrians appear in the foreground. The bottom margin bears a printed caption identifying the castle and handwritten script; there is also a vertical strip of handwriting on the right edge.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European riverside town. In the foreground a river curves past a multi‑arch stone bridge with an additional flat, more modern span alongside it. On the near bank are grassy meadows; on the far bank stand dense rows of traditional gabled houses and small industrial buildings. A large church with a tall spire dominates the right side of the skyline, while a twin‑towered church or abbey rises on the left. Bare tree branches frame the scene, suggesting it was photographed in late autumn or winter. There is no visible caption or printed text on the image side.

A sepia-toned postcard photograph showing a large Baroque basilica with a tall dome and a bell tower, fronted by a classical portico with columns. Trees and a fenced lawn appear in the foreground. Printed text at the bottom identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white image showing a large baroque lakeside castle with four round corner towers topped by domes and lanterns, and a central church‑like section with a tall spire. The building is reflected clearly in the calm water in the foreground, with trees and a small waterside pavilion on the left. No visible caption or writing appears on the image side.

A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, austere Baroque/Neoclassical building complex on a corner, with an attached church featuring a tall tower and spire crowned by a cross. The building has three stories with many identical rectangular windows and a modest cornice. Leafless young trees line the cobblestone street in front. Numerous people, including many children in dark winter clothing, stand along the sidewalk. The overall scene suggests a European town in the late 19th or early 20th century. A small street sign is visible on the corner of the building but is not clearly legible.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ornate baroque church interior with high vaulted ceilings, richly decorated columns, and numerous statues and stucco figures. The lower part contains handwritten German text. Printed captions at the bottom identify the location as a cloister and its princely chapel.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside scene with traditional German half-timbered houses on the left, a stone embankment and calm water in the foreground, and the ruins of a medieval tower or castle on a wooded hill in the background. The title text at the top left identifies the location as Weida in Thuringia on the river Weida. A small red-printed publisher credit appears at the bottom right.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large open square bordered by trees, landscaped gardens, and grand late‑19th‑century buildings. Church towers and spires rise in the background. The square is mostly empty except for a few pedestrians. The captions are printed in red, identifying the location as Nijmegen and specifically Keizer Karel Plein.

A monochrome postcard view of a large castle-like complex with round towers at both ends, high pitched roofs and small spires, set on a tree-covered embankment. In front of the castle is an open square or yard used as a timber market, with long stacks of cut wooden planks and a few workers walking around. Closer to the viewer stand several low wooden buildings, one with ornate decoration, another with a signboard on its facade. The scene has an early‑20th‑century feel.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a cobbled street and small square in an old village. In the foreground several women are washing clothes at a stone fountain or trough. Stone houses with wooden shutters surround the square, and a large tree stands near the fountain. In the background are ruins or castle walls on a hill with cypress trees. Printed text at the bottom gives a caption and publisher information.

A colored postcard showing a large classical stone building with arched windows and ornate cornices, set behind a low wall and lawn. Several people stand on the sidewalk and near the entrance; a street runs in front. The upper left corner of the card is torn. In the sky area at the top left, small printed text identifies the location as being in Chicago, Illinois.

A Czech postal stationery card with printed stamp and special Olympic-themed cancellation. The left side shows a red line drawing of a historic clock tower building, with a blue emblem of Europe and Olympic rings below. Nearby red text commemorates the 16th seminar of general secretaries and mission chiefs of the E.O.C. The upper right has a printed 3 Kč Czech Republic postage stamp depicting a small village scene with houses, church and trees, and is postmarked with a circular cancellation from Praha dated 21.9.1995. The right half of the card has typical postcard address lines and barcode marks.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a riverside town with a large hilltop castle complex, church steeples, dense historic houses, a small weir or dam on the river, and factory chimneys with smoke. The foreground is the river with trees; the title "Gruss aus Colditz." is printed in red script beneath the image, with the publisher credit in small type at the lower left.

Black‑and‑white vintage view of a European city street and square. In the foreground stands a large baroque fountain with multiple statues in a circular basin. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with arcades at street level and shuttered windows above. A broad street extends into the distance, lined with historic buildings; horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians are visible. On the right is a domed church or chapel. In the top‑right corner, red text reads "Trento Via Rodolfo Belenzani."

Black‑and‑white photographic view of a large brick Gothic church with a massive square tower on the left, steep tiled roofs, tall pointed windows with tracery, and buttresses. The building stands by an open square with a few small trees and several people posing in front, suggesting an early 20th‑century postcard or photographic print. The image has a dark border and slight corner damage typical of old postcards or glass‑plate reproductions. No printed caption or writing is visible on the front.

Sepia-toned postcard view showing a tall medieval brick tower with crenellations, identified as Torre Vanga, standing beside a broad open square. To the left runs a tree-lined canal or river with a path and railway tracks in the foreground, and mountains rising in the distant background. A few figures with umbrellas walk in the square near the tower. Handwritten-style caption text appears at the bottom margin.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large medieval-style castle complex on a wooded slope. Two main gabled buildings with steep roofs and many small windows rise above dense trees in the foreground. At the top right, printed in a serif font, is the caption identifying the site.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an ancient semi-circular stone odeon (theatre) with stepped seating in the foreground and the cityscape of Patras with buildings and church towers in the background. People are standing on the tiers. Printed bilingual captions in Greek and French identify the site, along with a catalog number and a website watermark at the bottom right.

Colorized historic street scene showing a bustling cobblestone avenue lined with multi‑story European townhouses and shops. People in late‑19th/early‑20th‑century clothing walk, sweep the street, and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. In the distance rises a tall church or town‑hall tower. At the bottom of the image, white caption text reads "Nijmegen. Burchtstraat".

Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate stone bridge with decorative lampposts crossing a canal in the foreground. On the right stands a large neoclassical theatre building with many arched windows, set in a small park with trees and shrubs. The water reflects parts of the bridge and building. Printed text in the upper right reads "Göteborg, Stora Teatern."

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside or lakeside landscape with trees, a small monument crowned by a large bird (likely an eagle) statue on a rocky hill, and a truss bridge in the background. Printed captions in red read "Grand-Duché de Finlande" at the top and "Tampere. Tammerfors" at the bottom. There is handwritten cursive text along the right margin and a narrow vertical decorative bar on the left.

A black‑and‑white night photograph showing grand baroque and historicist buildings illuminated along a riverfront. Reflections of the lights shimmer in the calm water in the foreground. On the right stands a tall, ornate church tower with statues along the balustrade. On the left are large civic buildings with a clock and a domed tower. A long, low riverboat or paddle steamer with lit windows is moored along the quay.

A vintage illustrated postcard featuring large, detailed strawberry plants with red berries dominating the design. Inset within one of the leaves is a small vignette of an architectural site labeled "Türkenbrunnen," showing a pavilion-like structure with columns and a walkway beside a building on a hillside, with a small figure in front. The word "GRAZ." appears at the top left, and there is small printed publisher information along the left and right margins.

Illustrated postcard showing a formal garden alley bordered by tall, dense green hedges leading toward a classical pavilion or fountain structure in the distance. Small, finely dressed figures stroll or sit on benches along the path. The style is early‑20th‑century graphic art with clean lines and muted colors. Text at the bottom names the location, and a small artist signature appears on the right of the image.

A black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story stone buildings on the left and a tall wooden fence on the right. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart can be seen further down the street. Mature trees form an alley in the middle distance. In the background rises a tall church tower with a slender spire, dominating the skyline. At the top center of the card, a handwritten number "4528" appears.

Black-and-white interior view of an old stone church with vaulted ceilings, wooden pews, an ornate pulpit on the right, chandeliers hanging from the ceiling, and an altar with a crucifix at the back. The caption at the bottom left identifies the church as Stenkyrka kyrka and notes that this is the interior. The photographer credit appears at the bottom right.

Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town taken from a field outside the built‑up area. In the foreground are cultivated fields and a few detached houses; behind them is a dense cluster of town roofs. On the right stands a large church with a tall spire, and further back in the center are several prominent church towers rising above the townscape. The lower margin is blank except for printed captions identifying the scene and publisher.

Colorized view down a tree-lined avenue with tram tracks leading to a twin‑spire Gothic‑Revival church. People and children stand on the street in early 20th‑century attire. The sky is pastel at dusk. The caption "Diekirch." appears at the top.

Hand‑tinted street view of a Dutch square showing a Renaissance stepped‑gable building with arched loggia (the weigh house) flanked by shops with Dutch signage. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century attire cross a cobbled market square. Caption at bottom reads "Groote Markt. NIJMEGEN."

Vintage Swedish postcard with a monochrome night view of the Royal Palace by the water in Stockholm, moonlit sky, and reflections. The address side has a green ornate border, Swedish 5 öre stamp marked SVERIGE, and 1901 postmarks. Printed captions identify the scene as Slottet, Stockholm; there is a handwritten New Year greeting and an address to Skara.

Color postcard showing the ornate Orthodox cathedral at the Curtea de Argeș Monastery framed by trees and gardens. The reverse has a handwritten Romanian message in blue ink, a blue 40‑bani Romanian stamp, and postal cancellations from Curtea de Argeș and Baia Mare dated 1971.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a town in a river valley with hills in the background. On the right is a large round stone tower on a wooded hill, likely part of a medieval fortification, overlooking rooftops and a church spire in the town below. Printed caption text appears in German at the bottom margin.

Colorized historic view of a river or moat with a rowboat in the foreground, grassy banks and trees on both sides, and a fortified hillside with stone walls and buildings to the right. In the distance rise several medieval towers and a prominent tall church spire of an old European city skyline. Printed captions identify the scene as Toompea's moat and the city of Tallinn (historically Reval).

Black-and-white postcard image showing a grand Neo‑Romanesque terrace complex with sweeping staircases, arched colonnades, circular decorative windows and two prominent conical towers. The structure is built of light stone on a hillside, with ornate balustrades, lampposts and multiple levels of walkways, viewed from below. A large arched entrance and broad staircases dominate the foreground; the long arcade and turrets run along the top of the rampart.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a large medieval brick complex along a canal, seen from behind an ornate iron bridge railing and cobblestone street. The buildings show stepped gables and tall Gothic arched windows. Printed caption text at the top identifies the scene as Saint John's Hospital in Bruges, in French.

Vintage monochrome postcard featuring an equestrian statue on a tall pedestal in a landscaped square. The statue depicts a rider in traditional military dress on horseback. Below the oval photograph there is bilingual caption text in Greek, French, and some English transliteration, as well as publication information in Greek and French and a circular postal emblem.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a European riverfront city. A broad river runs through the foreground with a bridge crossing it. On the far bank stands a row of multi‑story historic buildings with red roofs and a prominent church tower with a green onion‑shaped dome topped by a cross. Behind the buildings rises a steep, wooded hill crowned by fortifications and a hilltop clock tower. The scene is painted/printed in soft colors with people walking along the embankment.

Colorized view of a stone castle tower and surrounding ruins at sunset. The tall rectangular tower with a red-tiled roof stands to the right, attached to a round tower section. Overgrown walls, trees, and a path through grass lead toward the structure. Printed German text at the top identifies the site.

Black‑and‑white view across a river toward a steep hill crowned by a large Gothic cathedral with twin spires and an attached castle‑like complex of tall, steep‑roofed buildings. At the foot of the hill are smaller houses and a riverside quay with a long retaining wall. The composition and trimmed corners resemble an old postcard or photographic plate. No visible printed text appears on the front.

A color postcard composed of two landscape views. The upper image shows a European riverside cityscape with historic buildings along the water, a sightseeing boat on the river, and a prominent twin‑towered Romanesque church with flags atop each tower. Swiss flags hang from a building on the left. The lower image shows distant snow‑covered mountains under a blue sky, with the green spire of a church in the foreground. The overall style suggests a mid‑20th‑century tourist postcard.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside or coastal area with a sandy road leading to a wooden bridge or pier, small boats on the water, wooden fences, and a cart wheel in the foreground. In the background are trees, village houses with red roofs, and the large gabled ruins of a stone church or monastery. Text is printed in the upper left in Russian and in the upper right in Estonian/English indicating the location.

A commemorative postcard with a graphic illustration of a soldier sitting and raising one arm, rendered in blue on a light grey patterned background. Above the figure are the years "1918–1920"; below, in bold letters, is the phrase "EESTI VABADUSSÕDA". Small cross-like badges appear in the four corners around the main image. The design evokes a memorial to the Estonian War of Independence.

Vintage illustrated postcard with a decorative coat of arms on the left, showing a shield with multiple blue lions and a crowned, robed female figure above it. A scroll-like banner beneath the shield bears a short greeting. To the right of the coat of arms is a panoramic view of a harbor city at sunset with sailing ships, steam boats, and a skyline of tall church spires and buildings along the waterfront. Ornamental scrollwork connects the coat of arms and the city vignette, leaving the lower right area blank for writing.

A vintage, monochrome illustrated postcard showing a European city square with historic gabled houses, shops, a hotel and café with awnings, and a tall church or town-hall tower in the background. The scene is labeled at the bottom as 'Groote Markt' and 'Nijmegen'. The style suggests an early 20th‑century drawing of the main market square.

Black‑and‑white street view of a small historic town with wooden houses on both sides and a church tower with a cross in the background. The scene is framed by tree branches at the top. Ground floors host shops, including one with a hanging sign, and a few pedestrians are visible on the street. The lower left corner is labeled with the town name, and a small triangular publisher's logo with a number appears in the lower right.

Colorized vintage view over a river valley with hills in the background. A long arched stone bridge carries a railway line with a train in the foreground. On a hill to the right stands a large rectangular castle-like building with a tall church tower and red roof, overlooking the river and town. Small houses with red roofs line the opposite bank. Printed red text at the top names the place and identifies the castle.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a hilly residential area with large villas and greenery. A main street runs through the foreground, lined with walls and trees, while ornate mansions stand on the slopes to the right. On the hilltop in the distance a pavilion-like structure is visible. At the top of the card there is printed German text identifying the location as a street scene.

An old monochrome postcard view of a historic German town. In the foreground there is a stone path with a low wall, a gate, and a man standing near the entrance to a courtyard shaded by a large tree. Behind this are simple houses with gabled roofs and flower boxes. In the upper left rises a more elaborate building with steep roofs, turrets, and decorative windows, while in the background two tall Gothic church spires dominate the skyline. Printed red text at the top gives the location and viewpoint, and a vertical red imprint along the right edge appears to be the publisher's information. On the façade of one of the upper buildings is signage for a wine tavern.

Vintage color postcard divided into two main images. On the left is a statue of a man standing on a tall pedestal overlooking the water, with bollards and a quay in the foreground; the caption beneath reads "STATUE DE FERDINAND DE LESSEPS." On the right is a harbor scene with ships, quays, and low waterfront buildings; the caption reads "PORT-SAID. VUE ET PORT DE PORT-SAID." Decorative foliage separates the images. There is handwritten cursive text across the bottom and left margins and a date written at the top left.

Sepia-toned postcard view of a European riverside town with a row of multi‑story historic buildings along an embankment. Behind them rises a steep wooded hill with rocky outcrops, on top of which stands a fortified complex with walls, bastions, and towers. A funicular or inclined railway runs straight up the hillside toward the fortress. In the lower left corner there is an inset graphic advertisement for a hotel or entertainment establishment, and along the bottom margin is handwritten script identifying the location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard-style illustration of a broad cobblestoned square with tram tracks running through it. On the left is a row of ornate multi‑story buildings with arcades; one façade features elaborate stucco decoration and a projecting sign or figure. The square is animated by horse‑drawn carts, pedestrians, and market stalls with umbrellas to the right. In the background stands a large classical building with many windows and a central pediment, and farther back a church tower rises along the street axis. The overall look is of a historic European market square.

Black-and-white panoramic view over a European historic town with steep tiled roofs and narrow streets. In the foreground stands a large gabled building with several stepped Renaissance-style façades facing a small square. In the background on a hill rises a vast castle-like complex with long wings, towers, and a prominent Gothic cathedral with twin spires and another tall tower, dominating the skyline and surrounding town.

Black-and-white aerial view of a historic European city with dense stone buildings, tiled roofs, and a long crenellated wall bordering an open square or courtyard. The scene shows a mix of older medieval structures and more modern institutional buildings in the background. Handwritten-style white text at the bottom reads the city name and mentions that it is a panorama taken from an airplane.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of an ornate Baroque pavilion set on a small terrace among blossoming trees and grass. The octagonal building has tall arched windows, a balustraded terrace, decorative cartouches, and a small domed lantern with an open belfry on top. A stone retaining wall with an inscription and a fountain-like niche is visible at the base. The scene is rural and slightly hilly, with terraced slopes in the background.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a coastal medieval fortification with a tall, cylindrical stone tower and surrounding walls. Several old cannons are positioned along the ramparts aiming out to sea. There is French caption text printed at the bottom left and a modern Greek website watermark at the bottom right.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate historic theater building in a Central European city. The structure is richly decorated in a neo-baroque style with arches, columns, balconies, sculptures, and elaborate façade ornamentation. People in early-20th‑century clothing walk and stand in front of the theater. At the top of the postcard, printed in orange letters, are the words indicating the place and the building.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a large neoclassical villa behind a tree‑lined street and an iron fence with stone pillars. At the top there is French text describing the scene and mentioning Sultan Abdul‑Hamid. In the upper‑right corner there is an inset portrait of a bearded man wearing a fez. The overall style is early 20th‑century commemorative postcard.

Sepia-toned image of a large, ornate seaside-style mansion or palace with mansard roofs, a tall corner tower, stone-and-brick façade, arched windows, balconies, and a pergola-covered terrace. The foreground shows manicured lawns and gardens. On the right side, there is vertical handwritten text in purple ink; the bottom portion of the card is left blank for writing, consistent with an old postcard design.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a cobblestone street lined with two‑ and three‑storey houses, with people walking along the sidewalks. In the background stands a large church with a tall tower. The printed caption at the top identifies the location as streets in Kamenz in Saxony, Germany.

A color night-time illustration of a European city square with cobblestone pavement and surrounding multi‑story buildings with steep red roofs and glowing windows. In the center stands a dark statue on a pedestal, encircled by a low fountain or steps and several pedestrians. Gas or early electric streetlamps illuminate the scene. In the background, on a hill above the roofs, is a fortress or castle silhouette under a cloudy sky with a bright full moon.

Sepia-toned vintage view of a large Italian square with historic buildings, an ornate baroque church with a dome, frescoed façades with arcades, and on the right a monumental fountain crowned by Neptune holding a trident. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand in the open piazza. Printed caption text appears along the bottom border.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with two photographs: on the left, an exterior view of a white church with a tall spire set on a low hill with trees in the foreground; on the right, the interior of the same church, showing wooden pews, a pulpit, and an altar in a Gothic-style chancel. Text at the bottom identifies the church and conveys a Christmas and New Year greeting dated 1903–1904, signed by Elise and John Frogner.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small European riverside town. In the foreground is a calm river with reflections of trees and buildings. An old stone bridge crosses the river; part of it is roofed in wood, connecting to a round or polygonal stone gate tower with a steep tiled roof and arched gateway. Beside the tower is a cobbled street lined with modest two‑ to three‑story houses with shuttered windows and tiled roofs. The scene is quiet with no visible people or vehicles, giving a historic, early‑20th‑century atmosphere.

Colorized postcard view of a rural road lined with trees and a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground, with fields to the left. In the distance is a small town featuring a church with a tall spire and several tall, square medieval towers, likely part of a castle complex. The scene is calm and pastoral, with early 20th‑century buildings on the right side of the road. German text is printed at the top.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic stone fountain in strong contrast, shot from a low angle. In the foreground are curved basin steps with water, and a sculptural figure (likely a mythological creature or putto) from which water sprays upward. In the misty background stands a medieval or Gothic‑style civic building with crenellated roofline and a square tower topped by a small cross, suggesting a historic Italian piazza.

Sepia-toned studio photograph of a young woman and a young man posed in front of a painted city backdrop with a river and a large gothic-style church or cathedral. The woman wears a light-colored traditional dress and headscarf and carries a wicker basket with linens. The man wears a dark uniform with a cap and sword, saluting the woman. The background suggests a European cityscape but is clearly a painted set rather than an outdoor scene. No visible printed text appears on the image side.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a lake with people rowing small boats in the foreground, dense green trees behind the shore, and beyond them a panoramic view of a hilly city with red‑roofed buildings and church towers. Printed text at the top reads "GRAZ. Hilmteich mit Blick auf die Stadt." indicating a view of the city of Graz from the Hilmteich pond.

Colorized historic postcard showing a large neo‑Gothic church with a very tall spire and smaller side spires, surrounded by a landscaped park and low town buildings. The sky is a smooth gradient from light beige at the horizon to blue above. Printed German text at the top identifies the place as Hainichen and the church as the Trinity Church. Publisher and production notes are printed vertically along the left and right margins.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town at the edge of a hilly landscape with terraced vineyards. In the foreground are orchards and gardens bordered by low wooden fences, and a straight tree‑lined street with a few pedestrians and an early motor vehicle. Along the street stand large, ornate bourgeois villas with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the distant left on a hilltop is a prominent church or monastery complex; further right on another hill is a small tower. Terraces and vineyard strips cover the hillsides. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.

A museum-style postcard with two color photographs mounted on a cream background. The left photo shows the interior of a stone castle room with rough masonry walls, a small arched doorway, modern black floor lamps, and a large stone statue of a standing figure in one corner. The right photo is a close-up of a medieval-style stone statue of an armored knight or nobleman with a cape and shield, standing against the same kind of stone wall. At the top of the card there is printed and handwritten Finnish text indicating the castle and institution.

Colorized vintage view of a steep hillside with rocky cliffs and dense greenery, showing a funicular railway climbing up to a fortified hilltop complex. At the summit are walls, towers, and buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the center‑right stands a prominent clock tower. Handwritten notes run along the top margin, and printed caption text appears in blue near the top center.

A vintage multi‑view black‑and‑white postcard with scalloped edges. It shows several small photographs arranged around a larger central image of a modernist multi‑storey white building set among tall pine trees and landscaped grounds. Other views include swans on a lake, forested park scenes, a ruin or monument, a church tower, and various buildings that look like sanatoriums or resort facilities. In the center bottom, there is a cursive inscription in Latvian.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a fortified stone castle with crenellated walls and a tall rectangular tower, surrounded by trees and grassy fields. At the top left, red text reads "KARLOVAC  Stari grad". On the right side are red postage stamps with a stylized male figure and Cyrillic lettering, overprinted with a circular postmark.

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing the ruins of a large brick structure with arched windows and a semi‑circular apse, partly surrounded by trees and greenery. At the bottom, printed captions identify the view as the Valkhof ruins in Nijmegen, and a publisher's credit line appears along the lower edge.

Black‑and‑white historic postcard view of a small market square lined with multi‑storey shop buildings, with large painted advertisements on the façades. On the left, several stores bear the name "Oscar Reich" and other commercial signage. In the middle distance is a tall gabled Gothic-style hall-like building with a stepped façade and many small windows. To the right are older, fortress‑like houses and a small square with cobblestones. At the top in red print is the caption "Meissen. Kleinmarkt."

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, grand hotel complex set on a forested hillside above a town. The central building is multi‑storied with towers at each end and a steep, mansard‑style roof, surrounded by smaller villas and lush trees. At the bottom center of the image, handwritten‑style text reads "Karlsbad. Hotel Imperial". The scene suggests an early–20th‑century spa resort in a mountainous area.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a historic European town with multiple medieval stone towers and dense traditional houses with steep roofs. A large round tower with crenellations stands prominently on the left atop rocky ground, a tall square church or city‑gate tower with a pointed spire rises in the center, and another cylindrical tower that resembles a water tower stands on the right. The scene shows tightly packed buildings on a slope, small gardens, and narrow streets, suggesting an old fortified city.

A colorized historic postcard view of a large château or castle complex perched on a rocky outcrop above a small town with red‑tiled roofs, surrounded by dense trees and rolling farmland and hills in the background. At the top in red German text it reads "Gross-Meseritsch. Schloss des Grafen Franz Harrach."

Sepia-toned vintage postcard depicting a manor-like building with a hipped roof, dormer windows, and a small tower with a cupola and weather vane. The structure is set on a hillside with terraced vineyards or slopes in the background and a formal balustraded stairway and garden in the foreground. Printed red captions identify the scene and publisher: the main caption at the bottom right reads "Schloss Hoflößnitz," and smaller text at the lower left reads "4264 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."

An old monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a town with low, tiled-roof houses and narrow streets. In the background, on a hill, stands a fortified citadel and minarets of mosques, indicating an Ottoman-era urban landscape. Printed captions in French and Latin script identify the place as Uskub, with additional Ottoman/Turkish script at the top. The card is worn and spotted with age and bears a website watermark at the bottom.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with red printed caption at the top showing a hillside landscape with vineyards and trees in the foreground. In the middle distance stands a large villa‑like building, and behind it on the slope is a tall multi‑storey structure with balconies, towers and a central spire, labeled as the Bilz Naturheilanstalt. Smaller houses dot the hills on both sides.

Mounted on a herbarium sheet with pressed elm branches is a small sepia photographic postcard showing a riverside town with a bridge crossing the river, a compact cluster of houses on the slopes, and on the hilltop a large medieval castle and a prominent church tower. The lower-left corner of the postcard bears a printed caption. Surrounding the specimen are institutional labels from the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.

Black-and-white postcard showing a long, ornate Maya stone building standing on a rubble-covered platform. The facade is richly decorated with geometric patterns and sculpted elements. At the bottom right, Spanish text is printed identifying the structure and viewpoint.

A colored illustrated view of a busy seaport with many steamships and smaller boats in the harbor, quays, warehouses, palm trees, and multi‑story colonial style buildings along the waterfront. In the left foreground stands a tall statue on a pedestal labeled 'Monument de Lesseps.' Handwritten cursive text covers part of the lower and right sides. Printed captions identify the view as a general view of Port Said.

Colorized vintage view of a tree‑lined alley in a city park. Tall deciduous trees border a wide path where a few people in old-fashioned clothing stroll. In the background stands a white statue on a pedestal, partly framed by foliage. At the bottom edge, red printed text reads "Graz – Stadtpark‑Allee."

A black‑and‑white illustrated multi‑view postcard with decorative floral motifs and frames. At the top center is the caption "Helsning från Carlskrona." Surrounding this are several vignette drawings: a central cityscape with a tall clock tower standing above a rail tunnel or cutting, other civic buildings and a domed structure; a circular view of a straight street lined with ornate multistory buildings labeled "Ronnebygatan"; a triangular view of a star‑shaped fortress compound labeled "Kungsholms Fästning"; and a waterfront view of a low fortification with trees and buildings labeled "Kungsholms…". The images depict landmarks of the city of Karlskrona. There is small printer information along the left edge.

Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a Neo-Gothic church beside a small lake or pond, viewed from a tree-lined path with a fence and a distant horse-drawn carriage. The church is reflected in the water. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Stuttgart. Johanneskirche." with handwritten cursive notes along the lower and right margins.

Color postcard showing a wide river with excursion boats moored along a grassy promenade on the left bank. In the background a stone arched bridge crosses the river, and above the opposite bank rise wooded hills with the large ruins of a castle complex and a town of red-roofed buildings below it. The image has the typical white scalloped border of vintage postcards.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a tall, arched stone structure in ruins, likely part of a church or monastery. The architecture features rounded arches and brickwork, with an upper niche and openings suggesting a bell tower or façade. The card has a white border and printed captions along the bottom in multiple languages.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a central European town square with a large church featuring a tall clock tower and spire. Trees and a few town buildings surround the square, and in the distant background another large building or castle is visible on a hill. The caption at the bottom identifies the location as Frauenstein in the Saxon Ore Mountains and refers to the market square.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town with cobblestone streets curving between multi‑storey houses. In the background stands a large Gothic church with tall spires and a clock tower. In the foreground is a corner building with arched shopfronts and German writing on the façade. A few people, including a woman and a child, walk along the street, and a tram or carriage track runs through the scene. The overall look suggests an early‑20th‑century photograph reproduced as a postcard.

A monochrome postcard showing a large medieval cathedral complex with multiple tall towers. Two slender Gothic spires with pinnacles stand at the western end, while two more massive, rounded Romanesque towers with domed tops rise behind them. In front is a long building with a steep roof and rows of small windows. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style German text identifies the scene.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large round tower and adjoining walls of a castle complex. The tower has small windows and a conical roof, and the wall in front looks aged and partly damaged. An ornate arched gate with large wooden doors stands to the right, guarded by two uniformed soldiers. Several civilians walk along the cobbled street outside the walls. On the tower the words "SCHLOSS HART…FEL…" are visible, and there is a commercial signboard on the wall below.

Vintage black-and-white postcard showing a landscaped park with a curving gravel path bordered by a low wooden fence, dense trees and bushes, and a prominent monument or statue set on a pedestal in the middle distance. A person in early 20th‑century clothing walks along the path. Printed red caption text at the bottom identifies the scene and publisher, with the year 1906.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a townscape with a central square in the foreground, a few small houses, a tree with fencing around it, streetlights, and people standing near the base of the tree. In the background rises a large historic complex with a church-like tower and adjoining buildings on a hill. At the top in red script is the word "Dippoldiswalde." On the left margin there is vertically printed publisher information and a year.

Color-tinted historic street scene showing a broad avenue lined with multi‑story European-style buildings with shops and awnings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and ride in horse‑drawn carriages. In the distance stands a domed church. Printed titles in Cyrillic and Latin identify the city as Varna and the street as Preslavska (Rue Preslavska). The card shows aging and surface wear.

A black‑and‑white view of a hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense forest. The castle sits on a rocky cliff with steep rock faces in the foreground. The complex includes several large, simple-roofed buildings and towers with stepped gables and one slender spire, typical of Central European castles. Additional manor-style houses are visible along the ridge to the right. The sky is blank and overexposed. No visible caption or border text appears on the front.

Sepia-toned postcard depicting a large open square with horse-drawn carriages and people in early 20th‑century dress. In the background stands a long neoclassical palace-like building with an arched central entrance, identified at the bottom as the Abdin Palace in Cairo. Promotional text for a tourist agency in Port Said appears printed over the sky area.

A colorized historic postcard view of a European town square lined with multi‑story buildings featuring steep red roofs and ornate façades. In the foreground is a large square with café tables and umbrellas surrounding a monumental fountain or statue ensemble. In the background, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower with large clock faces, part of a fortified structure. The caption printed at the top left reads "GRAZ, Hauptplatz," indicating the main square of Graz.

Colorized historic postcard showing a grand corner building in an urban square. The building has ornate Neo‑Baroque / Secessionist architecture with a domed roof, elaborate window frames, and columns over the main entrance. Pedestrians walk around the square and a small kiosk or monument with a red roof is visible in the foreground. Printed captions at the top identify the subject and location.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small settlement nestled at the foot of terraced vineyard hills. A road with street lamps runs through the foreground, lined with modest houses and garden plots. On the right stands a larger manor‑like building with a decorative roof, and other farm or estate buildings nearby. The slopes behind are divided into many horizontal terraces, likely for wine cultivation. Red printed German text appears in the lower right, with a printer's line at the very bottom and a handwritten number in red ink at the top.

A colorized historic postcard view of a hilltop complex overlooking a town with red-roofed houses and a river valley in the background. Dominating the scene is a large Gothic cathedral with twin towers and adjacent castle-like buildings, all surrounded by greenery and old fortification walls. At the top left, printed in red script, is a caption identifying the location, and there is a small handwritten red inscription at the top right.

A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing an old European city street lined with brick townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart stands on the right side of the street. In the distance a tall church spire rises above the roofs. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the scene, and small publisher information appears at the lower left.

A monochrome illustrated postcard showing a large arched steel bridge spanning a wide river, with supporting concrete piers. On the right bank stands a multi‑story tower-like building on a wooded hill, with a flag on top. In the foreground, foliage and the river are visible. At the bottom, there is printed Dutch text identifying the scene as the new Waal bridge with the Belvédère in Nijmegen.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside or coastal scene with small houses among trees and several boats pulled up on the shore. In the background stands a large triangular-gabled stone ruin of a church or monastery. A person rows a small boat in the foreground water. In the upper left corner there is a circular emblem with text surrounding a stylized drawing of the same ruin. The caption "Pirita" appears below the image.

A tinted night‑view postcard showing a river curving through a town. On the left bank stands a skyline with a tall, narrow church spire and other historic buildings; on the right rises a high embankment or fortification wall with large multi‑story houses or a palace‑like structure at the top. Above the scene a bird (likely a dove) flies while carrying a small calendar page reading "Januar 1", suggesting a New Year greeting. The overall color tone is dark with a yellowish sky reflected in the river.

Colorized postcard view of a riverside town with a large historic castle complex and Gothic cathedral on a hill. A long white paddle steamer named "WETTIN" is in the foreground on the river. The castle with round tower and the twin-spired church dominate the skyline. Red-roofed houses line the riverbank. The words "Meissen" appear at the upper left, and "Kgl. Albrechtsburg u. Dom." at the upper right, with a red handwritten number in the top right corner.

A black-and-white postcard view of a rural church with a tall steeple, bare trees and wooden houses with fenced yards in the foreground. The church is the central subject, with simple Gothic-style windows and a steep roof. Printed text at the bottom identifies the church and publisher in Swedish.

Black‑and‑white street scene showing a large European square bustling with people, trams, and a military parade of uniformed soldiers marching with rifles. In the center stands an equestrian monument on a high pedestal. Around the square are grand multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs and clock towers, tree‑lined streets, ornate lampposts, and a kiosk covered with period advertisements in German. The clothing and vehicles suggest an early‑20th‑century setting.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing the archaeological ruins of a basilica with rows of stone columns and column bases leading toward the sea. The image is labeled at the top with the location and name of the site, indicating it is a view of the ruins of the Basilica of Saint Cyprian in Carthage.

A black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a view framed by three large arched columns, looking out over a broad piazza with a central baroque fountain and surrounding historic buildings. A church bell tower and another tower rise above the rooftops, and mountains are visible in the distant background. Handwritten-style text at the bottom identifies the scene as Trento and Piaz(z)a Vittorio Emanuele III, seen from the Duomo.

Sepia-toned postcard showing an elegant multi‑storey historicist corner building with ornate façades and domed corner turrets. In front of it stands a tall obelisk‑style war memorial topped with an eagle. The street scene includes several people walking and a horse‑drawn cart. A shop sign on the ground floor reads "SINGER G. NAHMASCHINEN – ACT. GES." The printed caption at the bottom identifies the view as a new war monument in Graz.

A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a colonial-style stone church with arched portico, heavy buttresses and two ornate bell towers. To the left stands a separate, simpler bell tower with two large arched openings. There is a stone cross on a pedestal in front of the church and a few people in early 20th‑century clothing walking or standing nearby. In the upper left corner, handwritten text identifies the building as the Church of Santo Domingo in Ayacucho.

Sepia-toned view of a large hilltop castle complex with a tall central tower rising above multiple terraced buildings, surrounded by dense forest. In the foreground a small river flows through a landscaped valley with paths, fences, and gardens along its banks. The scene is rural and tranquil. At the top of the image, printed in red German text, is the title of the view.

A black‑and‑white postcard view over leafy garden terraces and rooftops toward a large hilltop complex with tall Gothic spires and historic buildings. The scene shows the Burgberg in Meissen above the Elbe River, with the prominent twin-towered cathedral rising over the town. Printed white text appears at the bottom of the image.

A monochrome historic postcard showing a long Renaissance-style brick building with ornate statues between tall windows and round medallions along the upper façade. A cobblestone street runs in front of the structure, and a single person stands near the main entrance stairs. Printed at the top is the caption 'Stadhuis — Nijmegen.'

Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographic views of grand historic buildings, decorated with floral motifs and overlaid with dense handwritten script. The left image shows a large neo‑Renaissance opera house on a busy square with carriages and people (the Vienna State Opera). The right image shows a curved, ornate theater building with columns and statues (the Burgtheater). Printed captions in German identify the city as Wien and the buildings as imperial theaters.
