There is a handwritten date in the early 1900s on the right side and extensive cursive correspondence across the lower half.

A vintage illustrated postcard showing a busy European town square lined with tall historic buildings featuring gabled roofs and arcades. In the center stands a large fountain or monument surrounded by people and market stalls with umbrellas. In the background, on a hill, there is a clock tower overlooking the city. The scene is rendered in a detailed line drawing. At the bottom right, decorative script text reads "Graz, Hauptplatz," and a small imprint credits an atelier.

Colorized historic postcard view of a European city square labeled "Bismarckplatz" with multi‑story classical buildings, shop awnings, a central fountain and garden in the foreground, and a prominent baroque church tower in the background. The word "Graz" is printed at the top right and there is small handwriting and the number 776 at the lower right.

Black‑and‑white image of a large neo‑Romanesque / neo‑Gothic church with two tall octagonal towers topped by domes and crosses, and a third, more slender spire to the left. The nave has tall pointed‑arch windows with tracery and buttresses. In the foreground is a small landscaped square with trees and a polygonal fountain or monument crowned by a statue. A few pedestrians walk along the cobbled street surrounding the church. The image has the margins and wear typical of an old photographic postcard or plate.

A monochrome (sepia-toned) image showing a massive medieval stone structure, likely a round or polygonal tower attached to a larger fortification. The tower has thick rough stone walls, small narrow window slits, a high arched opening, and a steep conical tiled roof. The surrounding area appears to be an open yard with bare ground in the foreground and trees framing the right and upper edges. There is a narrow printed border typical of early 20th‑century postcards. No visible caption or other printing appears on the front.

Color-printed postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground crossed by iron bridges, lined with grand 19th‑century buildings and red‑roofed houses. Above the city rises a wooded hill with fortification walls and a notable clock tower structure. The caption area at the bottom reads the city and location name.

Vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a straight city street lined with multi‑story historic buildings. A small group of uniformed soldiers and a drummer walk down the center of the street, with a church tower visible in the distance. On the right side, a hanging sign advertises a guest garden and bowling alley. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street in Graz, named Lazarethgasse.

Colorized vintage view of a large European town square with historic multi-story buildings surrounding an open plaza. In the center stands an ornate monument with several statues and a staircase, surrounded by people and market stalls shaded by white umbrellas. A tram is visible on the right. Printed at the top is the caption 'Graz, Hauptplatz', and there is handwritten text with a date at the bottom margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a dramatic sunset scene over a river. In the foreground, a long passenger steamboat moves along the water. In the background, on a hill, there is a dark silhouette of a large complex with multiple spires and towers, strongly suggesting a historic cathedral and castle complex. Thick clouds are illuminated from behind by the setting sun, creating a high-contrast sky. A German caption appears at the bottom.

Colorized vintage street view of a European town. Tall multi‑story buildings with shutters line both sides of a broad street where a few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn cart are visible. In the distance, on a hillside, a fortified complex or castle rises above the town. The caption at the top reads "ROVERETO – S. Maria," and on the left façade a sign reads "PICCOLO ROVAZZI."

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a fortified gate and clock tower seen from a tree‑lined road. Pruned trees flank the road leading toward an arched entrance in a stone fortress wall. A tall clock tower with a pointed roof rises behind the wall. Several uniformed soldiers stand and walk along the right side of the road. The handwritten word "Belgrad" appears in the upper right corner.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded parliamentary chamber during a formal session. The room is grand, with high walls, balconies filled with spectators, and elaborate lamps. A large bust of a woman, symbolizing the Republic, is visible on the left wall. Dozens of suited men occupy curved benches, while a speaker stands at a central podium. The scene captures the reading of the proclamation of the Republic at the inaugural session of the Constituent Assembly.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a small octagonal stone chapel with a tower and weather vane, surrounded by tall trees. In the background there is a riverside view with boats and a promenade with white railings. Dutch captions are printed below and along the side, and a handwritten name appears on the right margin.

Colorized illustration of a Gothic cathedral with two tall, ornate towers and pointed spires dominating a small square. The church façade has intricate tracery, large arched windows, and a smaller entrance structure with a red roof in front. Surrounding the cathedral are old town buildings with red-tiled roofs. In the upper left corner appears a printed title in German.

Colorized historic postcard showing a grand Neo-Renaissance spa or palace-like building with two domed corner towers and a richly decorated central façade, set in a landscaped park with trees and walking paths. Two elegantly dressed figures stroll in the foreground. A broad road runs along the right side, with wooded hills rising behind the complex. Stylized red captions appear at the bottom, along with printer information.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a public square and garden framed by tall mountains. In the foreground is a large circular plaza with a monumental statue at its center, surrounded by paths and trees. In the background are several towers and historic buildings of a town nestled at the base of the mountains. The caption printed at the top identifies the scene as Piazza Dante with its monument and public garden in Trento.

Sepia-tone postcard showing a panoramic view of a European city area dominated by a large neo‑Gothic church with twin spires on a low hill. The church is surrounded by wooden fences, smaller wooden and stone houses, and some distant urban structures such as a water tower. Decorative corner elements frame the image. Printed caption text appears at the top left and along the bottom edge.

Sepia-toned historic street view showing a row of multi‑story residential and town buildings on the left and a wide street with pedestrians and people pushing handcarts. Trees line the right side of the street. In the distance a large church or civic building with a tall tower and dome rises above the rooftops. Printed caption text at the top right reads "Nossen i. Sa. — Bismarckstraße".

Black-and-white postcard showing a wooden church with a very tall, slender spire rising above trees and a surrounding churchyard with gravestones. On the left margin a vertical label reads "Karlskoga, Värml." and at the bottom right the handwritten caption identifies the church. The overall style suggests an early‑ to mid‑20th‑century photographic postcard.

A sepia-toned winter scene showing a snow-covered landscape with bare trees in the foreground and farm buildings on a gentle slope. On the hilltop in the background stand the ruins of a large medieval castle with several tall, broken towers and curtain walls. The composition and toning resemble an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A monochrome postcard showing a large medieval castle complex on a wooded hillside. The main building has steep gabled roofs punctuated with small dormer windows, thick stone walls, and a central tower with smaller turrets. Additional attached buildings and a half‑timbered structure are visible to the right. Handwritten-style captions appear along the bottom border.

Black‑and‑white photo of a multi‑arch stone bridge crossing a shallow, rocky river. The bridge has three large arches with masonry piers and a metal or concrete railing with decorative panels. People are walking across the bridge and a few cars are visible beneath and beyond it. On the far bank stand mid‑20th‑century apartment or town buildings with steep, tiled roofs and dormer windows, surrounded by leafy trees. The foreground shows rocks and gentle rapids in the river, framed by overhanging branches. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image side.

Colorized historic street scene showing a grand European square with ornate multi‑story buildings and towers on both sides, horse‑drawn carriages, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. The caption at the top reads "Budapest. Kígyótér. – Schlangenplatz." indicating a square in Budapest.

A black-and-white postcard view of a large Renaissance castle complex with an inner courtyard garden laid out in geometric flowerbeds and paths. The multi-story building has rows of shuttered windows, corner towers, and arcaded loggias along one side. A high defensive wall with battlements and a square tower runs along the right. At the bottom right border there is printed caption text identifying the place.

A vintage, monochrome postcard view taken from a high terrace with a pergola covered in vines, looking out over a city with a river running through the center. A woman stands at the railing, gazing over the rooftops and bridges. Stone steps lead up on the right. The printed caption at the top reads "Graz, Pergola gegen Süden."

Sepia-toned postcard view of a grand seafront palace complex situated on top of a high cliff above the sea. The large multi-storey building with a tower and flag stands to the right, with terraced gardens in front and a sparsely built coastline stretching to the left. Below the image there are captions in Cyrillic and French indicating the location and the building.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of a hilly valley settlement with scattered villas and farmhouses surrounded by forests and fields. On the left stands a prominent church-like complex on a hill, overlooking the village below. The scene is labeled with German text printed in red at the bottom margin, along with a publisher's credit and number.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand neo‑baroque theater building with a large central dome, statues on the roof, and a portico supported by tall columns. The building faces a broad, mostly empty street with a few pedestrians and a cyclist in front. Trees frame the scene on both sides. Printed caption text along the lower margin reads "Graz. Stadttheater".

Vintage monochrome (slightly hand‑tinted) postcard view of steep rocky cliffs with fortification walls and arches known as the Bock in Luxembourg City. At the top left stands a villa on the cliff edge; in the foreground a woman with an umbrella walks along a path beside a stone wall. On the right is a tall church spire rising above trees and rooftops. Printed red caption text across the top identifies the scene and publisher.

Black‑and‑white harbor scene showing boats moored along a quay beside a town. People walk on the cobblestone waterfront next to parked 1950s–1960s style cars. In the background rises a large neo‑Gothic church with a tall spire and rose window, dominating the skyline above older low‑rise buildings and a modernist block on the right. The overall look is of a northern European coastal town captured in mid‑20th century.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate, two‑storey building with arched windows and decorative roofline, fronted by a garden and a small pavilion or gazebo. The central pediment bears a clock and the name of the establishment. Below the image, printed text identifies the location as Stockholm and names the building Berns Salonger.

Black‑and‑white view across a river with moored steamships in the foreground. On the near ship the letters "DDSG" and "E.P. 30" are visible on the bow. Behind the ships, on a wooded hill, stands a very large, ornate palace-like complex with multiple domes and mansard roofs; a dense cityscape stretches along the riverbank and up the hills, with a distinct church tower and spires in the distance. The overall composition resembles an early 20th‑century cityscape postcard.

A colorized historic view over a European town with red-tiled roofs. Dominating the scene are a large church with twin towers and onion-shaped domes and, to the right, a fortified complex with round towers and a gabled building, resembling a castle. In the distance are flat fields under a blue sky. The printed captions read "Wurzen." at the upper left and "Dom u. Schloss." at the upper right.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a wooded hillside with terraced slopes, several small villas or pavilions, and a prominent round stone lookout tower with crenellations and a flag on top. The scene is rural and hilly, and printed captions in German appear at the bottom.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a waterfront city with many low buildings and several mosque minarets in the foreground, sailing ships and steamers on a wide strait, and hills with dense housing in the background. There is printed French and Latin‑script text along the bottom and handwritten cursive message across the lower part of the image, typical of early picture postcards.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Gothic cathedral with multiple tall spires rising from a castle‑like complex on a hill above a river. Below the hill are smaller town houses and riverside buildings, with boats moored along the embankment. The sky is mostly clear with a few clouds, and the photo has white, slightly scalloped borders typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards.

Black‑and‑white view of a small historic town square with a landscaped park in the foreground, featuring paths, lawns, flowerbeds, trimmed trees and a central lamp post. Behind the square stand two‑ and three‑storey plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. On the hillside above rise substantial stone fortifications with two prominent towers, one square and massive, the other taller and more slender, resembling a medieval castle complex. Partial German signage is visible on the leftmost building.

Sepia-toned postcard view framed by a large archway, looking onto an inner courtyard with the domed structure and minaret of a historic mosque. A solitary figure in traditional clothing stands in the foreground. At the bottom, caption text identifies the scene as a mosque in Cairo.

Black‑and‑white image of a broad, mostly empty town square bordered by 19th‑century multi‑story buildings. In the distance on a hill stands a large fortress‑like castle complex and a tall church tower with a baroque/early‑modern spire rising above tightly packed roofs. The foreground shows long shadows across the square, a few pedestrians, and a single ornate streetlamp. Some German signage is visible on the facades of the buildings around the square.

Sepia-toned panoramic view over a hilly town with dense trees and numerous houses and multi‑storey buildings on the ridge. A tall church with a pointed spire dominates the skyline to the right, with other historic-looking structures nearby. In the lower area are smaller houses and industrial buildings with smokestacks. The word "Leisnig." is printed in red at the top left, a handwritten number appears near the top center, and on the right edge in red is the publisher information and a number.

A colored panoramic view over a European town nestled in a wide valley surrounded by steep mountains with some snow on the peaks. In the foreground is a fortified complex with a round tower and crenellated walls, and the town spreads out with church steeples and multi‑story buildings. A curving road can be seen to the right. The card has a white border with red printed text at the bottom and along the left edge.

Colorized vintage view over a river flanked by tree‑lined embankments and grand historic buildings. Several bridges cross the river toward a steep hill with a fortified complex on top and a prominent clock tower (Uhrturm) on the slope. In the top-left corner there is printed red text reading "Grzs. Mur, Schloßberg." The scene is framed like a typical early 20th‑century city postcard.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a busy European city center with a curved street, tram tracks, and a public square filled with café tables and umbrellas. Multi‑story historic buildings line the street, with shop signs visible on the facades. In the background, a steep hill rises above the roofs, topped with fortifications and a tower. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text identifies the view as "Graz, Hauptplatz – Sackstrasse."

Colorized winter scene showing a large tree and bushes covered in snow along a winding path. In the background stands a prominent clock tower with a large round clock face bearing Roman numerals. A low wall lines the right side of the path, and a lamppost stands near the center. The sky is softly tinted yellow and blue, giving a sunset or sunrise impression.

An old monochrome postcard depicting a large castle complex with a central round tower topped by a lantern and dome, flanked by multi‑storey wings with steep gabled roofs and many small dormer windows. The façade looks worn and slightly dilapidated. Printed German captions in red at the top identify the location, and a small vertical inscription along the left edge gives the publisher and year.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a central European square with a large equestrian statue on a monumental pedestal, surrounded by several standing figures at its base. Behind it are ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with domed roofs, and on the left edge part of a large Gothic church façade is visible. A tall streetlamp stands near the statue. The image is framed in an oval on a plain background. At the bottom in Hungarian are printed captions indicating the location and identifying the statue of King Matthias.

Black‑and‑white image of a large church complex with a tall clock tower in the foreground. The tower is square, built of brick or rendered masonry, with arched openings for the belfry, two clock faces on one side, and a distinctive bulbous onion dome topped by a finial. Attached to the right is the nave and side chapel of the church, with steep tiled roofs and simple Baroque-style pilasters. A few small trees line a path in front of the building, suggesting a small town square or churchyard. There is no visible printed caption or border decoration on the front.

Black-and-white postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with a central pediment supported by tall Corinthian columns and wide steps in front. The façade is symmetrical with side wings, large windows, and decorative balustrades. There are a few people on the steps and ornate street lamps at the front. Caption text in Greek and French appears below the image.

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view of the old town of Meissen with the hilltop Schlossberg complex. Dominating the skyline are the twin spires of Meissen Cathedral and surrounding castle buildings, with densely packed historic houses and steep, narrow streets in the foreground. The title text is printed in red at the top.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a tree‑filled square with paths and people walking, surrounded by ornate late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings. A large, richly decorated corner building dominates the center background, and church or town‑hall‑like spires rise above the skyline. The scene looks down a main street running along the right side of the square. Printed caption text appears in Swedish at the bottom left.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing an ornate fountain with a tall sculpted column and a Roland statue holding a sword, standing in an octagonal basin in a cobblestone square. Behind it are multi‑story buildings with large shopfront windows and German signage, awnings over the sidewalks, and a streetlamp. Several pedestrians and a man walking a bicycle appear in the foreground. The lower margin bears printed captions indicating the location and fountain name.

Monochrome vintage postcard showing a grand Baroque-style fountain set against the facade of a palace with large Corinthian columns and rich sculptural decoration. The fountain features a central standing male figure in historical dress on a rocky base, surrounded by hunting dogs, game, and several other figures arranged on multiple levels, with water cascading into a circular basin in the foreground. The architecture behind has a domed roof, balustrades, and ornate reliefs.

A black‑and‑white postcard showing a river steamboat in the foreground and a large hilltop castle complex with massive walls and several wings in the background. Below the castle, small houses and riverside buildings line the bank. To the right, a prominent church with a tall, steep‑roofed nave and spire rises above the town. The image surface shows age‑related scratches and cracks, suggesting an early photographic print.

Black‑and‑white interior view of a grand, historic university library reading room. The room is rectangular with two stories of high bookcases lining the walls and an upper gallery with ornate metal railings running all around. Large arched openings and a glazed skylight illuminate the space from above. Long wooden reading tables with lamps are arranged in rows on the floor, and a statue or bust stands prominently at the far end. Printed captions in German are visible in the lower left and lower right corners.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a tree-lined open square with cobblestone paths and rows of traditional gabled houses enclosing a quiet courtyard. Church towers rise in the distant background. The caption at the bottom identifies the view as the Béguinage (Convent of Beguines) in Bruges.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene with a large ancient triumphal arch spanning a cobbled road. A tram runs on tracks beneath the arch, with several pedestrians around it; a uniformed boy or young man stands in the foreground. Surrounding the arch are early 20th‑century buildings. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, along with a faint round stamp mark.

A black‑and‑white historic street scene in a European city, showing a wide boulevard lined with multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with ornate facades and shops at street level. Horse‑drawn carriages, early trams, and many pedestrians fill the cobblestone street. In the far distance, a large arched façade closes the perspective, while on the right stands a tall, narrow building with a spired tower. The top of the image has a V‑shaped missing section, suggesting damage or cropping typical of an old postcard or glass negative reproduction.

A black-and-white image showing two women in fashionable 1960s attire, sitting at a round outdoor table by the water, writing postcards. The table and chairs are typical lightweight outdoor furniture. Behind them, there is an old stone bridge over a calm river or canal, leafy trees, a few other people sitting, and a historic-looking stone building partially visible on the right.

The postcard features a vintage illustration of a city street labeled 'VIA LARGA' with a prominent fountain in the foreground, adorned by classical statues and surrounded by historic European architecture. There is a wax seal, a clover, a small medallion, and handwritten script across the bottom half. Italian text is visible, along with the printed words 'Un Saluto da TRENTO' suggesting it is a greeting from Trento.

A sepia-toned vintage postcard image depicting a plaza with a monument at its center, surrounded by well-kept gardens, buildings, and mountains in the background. The prominent text in red identifies the location as Piazza Dante, with references to Hotel Trento and the railway station, indicating a central and notable urban area. There is handwriting at the bottom in Italian and a line of small text about reproduction rights.

Museum-issued Romanian postcard. The front reproduces a 19th‑century lithograph of Hanul lui Manuc (Manuc's Inn) in Bucharest: a large courtyard with arcaded wooden galleries and external stairs, several covered wagons, and people around a fire. The reverse has Romanian address fields, museum credits, a bilingual caption, and a printed price.

Illustrated postcard showing a sunlit town square with a large baroque fountain at its center, decorated with multiple statues and set on several circular steps. Behind it stand painted façades with arcades and many shuttered windows, a tall tree, and distant mountains. A few birds peck on the ground and a cloaked figure walks near the fountain. A handwritten message in Italian runs vertically along the right margin.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a grand neoclassical colonnade filled with people in early 20th‑century clothing strolling and sitting. The image looks down a long interior walkway lined with tall Corinthian columns and a coffered ceiling with hanging lamps. At the bottom, a caption in German identifies the place as the interior of the Mühlbrunnen colonnade in Karlsbad.

Vintage monochrome postcard showing a long waterfront palace complex along the Bosphorus, viewed from the water with a small rowboat in the foreground. The architecture is ornate, with neo-baroque and neo-classical facades directly on the shoreline. French caption text appears in red at the bottom and publisher information in small print along the lower edge.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a view of a historic castle courtyard and garden with stone columns in the foreground. Behind them stands a large fortified building with multiple windows and a rounded tower, part of the Castello del Buon Consiglio. In the distance are mountains and additional garden structures. Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin.

A vintage monochrome (blue-toned) postcard showing a panoramic cityscape with a prominent flat-topped hill bearing ancient ruins on the left, likely the Acropolis overlooking the city. Foreground includes urban buildings; on the right edge there is a dark silhouette of a tree. The photo is printed within a light border that contains handwritten cursive text along the vertical right side and left margin. The lower part has a faint circular stamp and the website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr'.

Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone village street lined with plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and wooden shutters. A woman and a small child walk in the middle of the street while chickens wander nearby. Trees and garden fences flank the road. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large medieval brick or stone castle complex with a high round tower and multiple gabled roofs, dominating the skyline.

Colorized historic postcard view of an ornate Baroque-style garden terrace with stone balustrades, arches, and decorative columns. In the foreground there is a round fountain with a sculptural group on a rock base. In the background, a monumental gate and railings stand above the terrace. On the right, a high pedestal carries a large bird-of-prey statue with spread wings (the Turul). Manicured flowerbeds and paths frame the scene. Printed captions in red at the top identify the place and city.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a formal procession of men in long overcoats, tailcoats and top hats walking in rows along a broad paved area in front of a large, ornate neoclassical building with rusticated lower stories and tall columns above. Some men carry canes; onlookers stand farther back. A large vertical flagpole or banner is visible at the right edge. The image has the look of an early‑20th‑century civic or diplomatic ceremony.

Colorized historic postcard showing ancient Doric columns of a ruined Greek temple in the foreground, with a large rocky hill and fortress area (Acrocorinth) rising behind. The top carries bilingual printed captions in French and Greek, and there is a website watermark at the bottom right.

Color postcard view of a landscaped park with benches, a decorative lamppost, and a large monument topped by a statue of a standing figure (Dante Alighieri). Trees and mountains form the backdrop, and a church or civic tower rises behind the monument. Printed red text at the top identifies the scene as the Dante Alighieri monument in Trento.

Vintage monochrome postcard with a small printed photograph on the left showing a massive stone convent-church complex on a hill, with a path and trees in the foreground. The right side is blank for writing. Printed captions beneath the image identify the site and location, and a vertical printer's credit appears along the left margin.

Sepia-toned postcard showing a formal stone terrace or steps lined with evenly spaced trees, leading toward a monumental area in the distance. The border has a scalloped edge typical of vintage postcards. At the bottom is a printed caption in Latvian identifying the location.

A colorized vintage postcard view of a long red-brick military complex with a tall central tower and crenellated walls, fronted by a tree‑lined street and iron railings. The structure appears fortress‑like and institutional. At the top left, printed in red, is the caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a small procession of men carrying large flags on a cobblestone street beside an iron fence and a park. One prominent flag bears a dark Nordic cross design. In the park stands a bust of a person on a pedestal with wreaths or floral tributes laid at its base. Townhouses and trees are visible in the background. A caption strip at the bottom center reads "2 oktober 1910", and a small archival mark in the lower left reads "Vk:2000:75".

A colorized vintage postcard showing a leafy garden scene on a hillside. In the foreground there is a large wooden terrace or pavilion raised on supports and covered with dense green vines, surrounded by trees. Behind it stands a light-colored building with a red-tiled roof on an elevated slope. Printed text at the bottom right identifies the location and publisher.

Black-and-white postcard view of a large brick railway station with striped masonry and several steep towers and gables. In front of the building is a small kiosk with signs, and a crowd of people waiting along the street. The caption at the bottom reads "Nijmegen, Station." The architecture and people's clothing suggest an early‑20th‑century European scene.

Black‑and‑white view of a European city square with a richly decorated octagonal fountain in the foreground. The fountain has a tall, ornate column topped by a standing armed figure and surrounded by small putti figures. The basin is stone and filled with water, with an inscription plaque on its side. Around the square are multi‑story historicist façades covered with large painted advertisements and shop signs in German, including a tobacco and cigars shop and other merchants. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk past, including a man with a bicycle and uniformed men, suggesting a bustling urban setting.

A monochrome vintage postcard showing a street scene in Bruges with Gothic-style buildings behind an iron fence. To the right is an ornate, chapel-like structure with pointed arches and tracery; in the center stands a larger historic mansion with turrets, known as the Gruuthuse, and in the foreground several women in long dresses walk along the street. Printed caption text appears at the top.

Two-sided postcard. Front: black‑and‑white photograph of a round medieval brick tower with crenellations and Gothic arched openings, surrounded by trees. Back: Romanian printed header naming the site, a 40 BANI brown‑green bear stamp reading "Posta R.P. ROMÎNĂ," circular postmarks, blue handwritten message and address to Bucharest.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European hill town. A winding path and fenced gardens lead up a slope covered with many flowering trees. On the hilltop stand dense rows of ornate late‑19th‑century houses and a prominent Gothic‑revival church with a tall spire. To the right, a large fortified complex or castle occupies the edge of a rocky cliff above the town. In the foreground are compact townhouses and a tall factory chimney. The sky is blank and there is no printed caption or writing visible.

An old monochrome postcard image depicting a large fortified complex with towers, crenellated walls, and a mix of medieval and Renaissance architectural elements. In the foreground are a few people, carts, and early motor vehicles on a wide road. Trees frame the scene, with mountains faintly visible in the background. At the top of the postcard is printed the caption: "Trento - Castello del Buon Consiglio."

A colorized historical postcard view of a cityscape dominated by a large Gothic church with a tall, sharp spire rising above older town walls and towers. In the foreground is a tree‑lined avenue leading toward a round defensive tower and city gate. The scene appears pastoral with scattered houses and greenery around the fortifications. Printed caption text in German is at the top left, and there are smaller printer's marks along the left and right margins plus some handwritten notes at the bottom right.

Color illustration of a European market square with outdoor stalls and white umbrellas around a central fountain topped by statues. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with red-tiled roofs and German-language shop signs. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a prominent clock tower with a steep roof and two large clock faces, connected to fortification walls and greenery.

Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large medieval castle complex with two tall, pointed-roof towers standing by a calm river, whose surface reflects the entire structure. The castle rises above tree‑covered slopes and a few smaller riverside buildings. In the foreground on the right are grassy banks and dense bushes with a tall tree, framing the view of the castle across the water. There is no visible printed caption or other text on the image side.

Black‑and‑white historic street scene showing a large ornate Renaissance-style brick building with many statues along its facade and tall windows; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand on a cobbled street with a horse‑drawn cart. In the distant background a tall church tower is visible. There is printed text at the bottom naming the city and building and handwritten cursive text across the sky and lower margin.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing a large medieval castle with high walls and a round tower flying a flag. The structure stands above a moat or deep ditch, with mountains visible in the hazy background. Trees partially frame the scene, and small figures can be seen near the base of the walls. Printed caption text in Italian appears along the bottom edge.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing the richly ornamented Gothic façade of a large cathedral. The view focuses on the central main portal with pointed arches, elaborate stone carvings, statues, and a large rose window above. Printed caption text appears below the image in French.

A monochrome postcard view of a grand historic villa or small castle with a tall pointed tower, sitting on a wooded hillside above a river or lake. A pontoon-style bridge or walkway crosses the water in the foreground, with reflections of the buildings and trees visible in the calm surface. Another large house stands further to the right atop the hill. At the top of the image, in red Gothic-style type, is the printed caption identifying the location.

Black‑and‑white image of a large medieval castle complex with two tall, slender towers and long slate roofs, standing on a wooded hill above a calm river or moat. Trees line the water's edge in the foreground, and the castle walls rise directly from the rocky slope. The style suggests a Central European fortress; no printed caption or border is visible on the image side.

A black-and-white postcard showing a wooded hill crowned with fortifications and buildings, including a domed tower in the center. The slope beneath is covered with dense trees and rocky outcrops. At the lower left border, a caption in German identifies the location.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a tram in the foreground and 3–4‑storey townhouses lining both sides of a broad cobbled street. In the background stands a large church or town‑hall tower with a layered, domed spire topped by a cross. The facades bear painted advertisements in German script. People are walking along the sidewalks and in the open square, which has a central lamppost.

Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small pond with reeds and ducks in the foreground, and multi‑storey residential and institutional buildings on the far bank. Behind them rises a tall brick tower with a distinctive pointed top. Trees frame the scene. In the bottom right corner, handwritten text identifies the place and photographer.

A black‑and‑white waterfront scene showing small rowing and sailing boats in a harbor, with a coastal city and mountains in the background. A prominent lighthouse stands on a pier to the right. Greek and French captions appear at the bottom of the image, and a web address watermark is visible across the lower right.

Colorized vintage postcard view of a decorative metal gazebo or kiosk in a lush city park. The structure has an ornate railing and columns, topped with a domed roof and finial. Surrounding it are trees, flowering bushes, benches, lampposts and a paved walkway. At the bottom, red printed text identifies the scene as a kiosk in Parque Seminario in Guayaquil, Ecuador.

Black‑and‑white view of a hillside with dense trees, terraced paths, and historic buildings. Dominating the scene is a square clocktower with large clock faces on at least two visible sides and a steep, shingled roof with wooden projections. Other fortification-like buildings stand further along the ridge. A small printed number "368" appears in the lower-left border.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large Gothic-style church with a tall tower rising above the tightly packed roofs of a historic town on a river. In the background, a stone bridge crosses the river and hills stretch into the distance. German captions at the top read "Pirna a. Elbe" on the left and "Blick vom Sonnenstein" on the right.

An illustrated cityscape showing a medieval walled town with red‑tiled roofs, round defensive towers, and several tall church spires rising above the skyline. A particularly high, slender spire dominates the right side, with telegraph or power lines crossing the sky in front. The foreground has green trees and a grassy slope leading up to the stone walls and towers. The image is drawn in a muted, early‑20th‑century illustration style and there is no visible printed text on the front.

A colorized panoramic view of a historic European town built on a hill above a river. In the foreground is a winding river bordered by rocky banks and greenery. Above it stand tightly packed houses with red-tiled roofs. On the hilltop rises a large fortified complex with long stone buildings and towers, alongside church spires and other medieval-looking structures. The sky is blue with scattered clouds. In the upper left corner, the word "Bautzen." is printed in red.

Black‑and‑white view of a large decorative fountain in a tree‑lined city park. The fountain has a tall central column with figures and an upper bowl, from which strong jets of water arc outward into a circular basin. Benches and flowerbeds surround the fountain, and a person in the foreground sits on a chair looking toward it. Printed white text at the bottom identifies the scene as a fountain in the city park of Graz and credits a local publisher.

A black‑and‑white view over a leafy city park with winding paths and a small pond in the foreground. Behind the trees stand several multi‑storey residential or institutional buildings. On the left rises a large Gothic church with a tall central tower and steeply pitched roofs. On the right, atop a hill, is a large, ornate castle‑like complex with multiple wings, domes, and towers, overlooking the town below. The scene suggests a historic European city landscape. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the front.

A monochrome winter scene showing a historic townscape with a large church or cathedral dominating the left side, featuring a tall tower with a spire. Snow covers the ground and rooftops of surrounding smaller buildings and houses. Leafless trees line the foreground, and the image has a wide expanse of white snow or frozen water at the bottom. Centered below the photograph on the white margin is the caption 'Strengnäs'.

Black-and-white view of a European town square with historic gabled houses and a church tower in the background. The buildings have steep tiled roofs and multiple dormer windows. Large painted shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including a prominent triangular-gabled building on the right with decorative garlands and reliefs, and multi-storey houses on the left with commercial storefronts at street level. A narrow lane runs between the central buildings toward the church tower. A few people and a cart are visible in the open cobbled square.

A color postcard showing a spring scene in a city park with many people relaxing on a green lawn under a large flowering tree. In the background rises a tall circular red-brick medieval tower with crenellations and a small spire on top, next to a water-filled moat and historic houses. The word "NIJMEGEN" is printed in white in the lower left corner.

Black‑and‑white view of a historic hilltop complex with a large Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires and an attached castle-like building above a riverside town. In the foreground a paddle steamer labeled "WETTIN" travels along a broad river, with smaller boats and quays on the near bank. At the foot of the hill are 19th‑century houses and industrial buildings, one with a sign on the roof. The overall style resembles an early 20th‑century photographic postcard.

A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard. The large left image shows a very tall concrete telecommunications tower rising above trees, with a series of stacked circular observation or technical decks near the top and a long segmented antenna mast. The right side is split into two interior views of a modernist restaurant or café inside the tower, featuring curved mezzanines, sweeping staircases, large panoramic windows, potted plants, and neatly arranged tables and chairs.

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a tall, round brick tower with decorative battlements and a conical roof, topped by a statue of a bird with outstretched wings. The tower stands on a circular base with a colonnaded gallery and is accompanied by a smaller domed turret. Bushes, trees, and a stone wall are visible in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the place and monument; small publisher information appears at the bottom.

Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town in a hilly rural landscape. In the foreground are fields, farm buildings, and industrial facilities with tall brick chimneys. A river and a stone bridge can be seen near textile‑factory‑like buildings. The middle of the image shows a dense cluster of townhouses and a church tower, and on a slight rise stands a castle‑like complex. At the top left of the image, the word "Zschopau" is printed in a cursive font, indicating the town's name.

Colorized vintage view of a large Romanesque cathedral facing an open piazza with a central ornate fountain and a horse-drawn carriage. The scene is surrounded by multi-story buildings with red-tiled roofs, set against a mountainous backdrop. At the top center of the image, red text reads "Trient - Trento." The composition and printing style are typical of early 20th‑century European postcards.

Black‑and‑white postcard view over a European city with dense historic buildings and tiled roofs. In the foreground is a busy street with pedestrians, trams, and early 20th‑century automobiles; shop signs are visible on the façades. In the background a steep, tree‑covered hill rises above the city, crowned by a prominent clock tower and fortification structures. At the lower right corner, the printed caption reads "Graz."

Sepia-toned postcard view framed by a dark arch, showing a cobblestoned courtyard with a central statue and large late‑Gothic/renaissance-style palace buildings. Decorative facades with steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, and ivy-covered walls are visible. German captions are printed on the image and below it. A red handwritten number appears in the upper right margin.

Color postcard-style illustration of a rural landscape with pine trees, farmhouses with red-tiled roofs and fenced paths. In the background on a wooded hill stands a large baroque pilgrimage church with two tall towers. In the foreground at right, a woman in traditional dress stands beside a wooden roadside shrine with a small religious image under a shingled roof. The caption at the top reads 'Maria Trost bei Graz.'.

A colored illustration of a European townscape viewed from an elevated position. In the foreground are small houses with red or brown tiled roofs, narrow streets, and a few pedestrians. Behind them is a belt of trees, and beyond that a hilltop complex with several towers and domes. Most prominent are two tall, narrow, identical church towers flanking a white façade in the center-left, and additional church or civic towers and a large greenish dome to the right. The style suggests an early‑20th‑century printed postcard.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a bird's‑eye northern view over a historic European city with dense low houses in the foreground and a prominent church with a very tall, slender spire rising above the old town in the background. Printed German text appears around the image, including a greeting from Reval and a caption indicating it is a northward bird's‑eye perspective.

Black‑and‑white postcard showing an opulent, elongated ceremonial hall with a richly patterned ceiling, tall arched wall panels covered in mosaics, and large windows on one side. At the far end stands a throne-like arrangement before a huge mosaic wall. The printing along the bottom edge identifies the location as Stockholm and names the hall "Gyllene Salen" (the Golden Hall).

A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town set in a river valley. In the foreground a river curves around a grassy area with rocks and trees along its banks. Behind it stands a row of modest, tightly packed houses with gabled roofs. Rising above the town on a hill is a large historic castle complex with multiple wings, towers, and fortified walls, as well as a tall church spire. Industrial chimneys are visible on the right side in the background. The whole scene suggests an old fortified city overlooking a small river, photographed from an elevated vantage point.

A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a European spa town square. The scene shows a sloping cobblestone street lined with tall historic buildings with shop signs, a decorative fountain or market well in the center, an ornate cast‑iron streetlamp, and to the right a richly carved colonnaded pavilion. Behind it rises a square tower on a hill, with wooded hills forming the background. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand around the square. At the bottom margin there is a German caption identifying the location.

Sepia-toned image showing a formally dressed aristocratic couple riding in an open horse-drawn carriage. The polished carriage lamps and wheels are prominent in the foreground. In the blurred background stands a large Baroque/neo-Baroque palace or official residence with mansard roof and many windows, giving a ceremonial, royal impression.

Black-and-white photograph of a large Gothic or Neo‑Gothic building with steep slate roofs, ornate gables, traceried windows, and a tall, slender spire. A richly decorated external stair‑tower or loggia with pointed arches and balconies rises on the right side of the facade. The scene appears to be a quiet courtyard or square in front of a historic civic or castle‑like structure. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.

A colorized panoramic view over the city of Graz, showing dense historic buildings with red and brown roofs surrounded by green hills. In the left foreground stands a prominent tower with a steep, reddish roof, rising above trees—this is the famous clock tower on the Schlossberg hill. Below the image, there is printed German text and a handwritten message in purple ink along the lower margin.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a harbor with calm blue water, sailing ships and steam vessels, and a fortified rocky hill crowned with walls and buildings. A waterfront town stretches along the base of the fortifications. Trees and small structures appear in the foreground. At the bottom left, printed text reads "Souvenir de Corfou," with publisher information in smaller print, and there is handwritten cursive text along the lower margin.

Vintage black-and-white streetscape showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story townhouses and a tall church or clock tower with a spire in the background. Several people, including children and a person pushing a cart, walk along the street. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the scene as Ritterstrasse in Torgau and the publisher's imprint.

Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a narrow canal cut between steep rocky walls. A metal truss bridge spans the canal at the top of the image with several small human figures standing on it. A boat is visible in the canal, and there is a narrow path or quay running along the left side. Handwritten-style captions appear at the bottom of the image, along with a small logo or mark.

A colorized historical postcard view of a stone bridge crossing a wide river and leading into a grand baroque cityscape. On the right side, a large church with tall spires and ornate towers dominates the scene, while a red-and-yellow electric tram and horse-drawn carriages cross the bridge. The buildings have red and green roofs and detailed façades. The sky is blue with light clouds. Printed captions at the top read the city name and the bridge name, with a handwritten number in red ink.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large historic building with a central tower and smaller corner turret, likely an inn or villa, set along a tree-lined road. The architecture has ornate windows, a veranda on the left side, and steps leading to an arched entrance. In the distant right background a tower-like structure is visible. At the top of the card, printed in red Gothic-style lettering, are the words identifying the location.

Color photograph of a large Orthodox church with multiple green domes topped with crosses, in a historicist / neo‑Byzantine style. The church stands on a busy urban square with several red‑and‑cream buses, an older black car, cyclists, and pedestrians. Trees line the street in front of the church under a clear blue sky. The image has the grain and color palette typical of mid‑20th‑century printed postcards.

Colorized vintage postcard showing a formal city park with circular flowerbeds and walking paths leading to a large neoclassical building with a central dome-like roof and grand portico. Long, tree‑lined boulevards extend to the left and right, bordered by ornate multi‑story buildings with mansard roofs. In the distant background are low hills and another tall church spire. There is a short handwritten message across the top margin.

A colorized vintage view of a broad urban square framed by historic multi‑story buildings, trees, and paths, backed by rocky hills and snowy mountains under a pink-and-blue sky. In the left foreground is a large monument in the center of a circular plaza; the right side shows several classical-style buildings facing the open square. At the top left, printed text reads "Trento  Piazza Dante," identifying the scene as Piazza Dante in Trento, with the surrounding Alpine landscape.

Black-and-white photograph showing the richly decorated interior of a historic church. The view is from the back of the nave looking toward the altar, with wooden pews in the foreground, a carved pulpit on the left, painted vaulted ceilings with elaborate floral and ornamental motifs, religious paintings on the walls, and a large crystal chandelier hanging in the center. At the bottom right, printed text in Swedish identifies the subject as the interior of Kungs Lena Church.

Colorized vintage postcard showing the ruins of a medieval stone castle surrounded by greenery. The ruined walls feature tall arched windows and a partially standing round tower. Printed text at the top identifies the site in German and Latvian.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque‑Renaissance palace complex bordering a broad paved square. Several ornate corner towers and a tall central spire rise above the roofline. In the foreground stands a large monument with an obelisk and sculptural figures. Small groups of people in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the square. The caption at the top reads in red Gothic script: "Dresden. Königl. Schloss." and a vertical imprint at the left margin shows the publisher information.

Colorized vintage view of a church and adjacent castle complex with round towers, red-tiled roofs, and baroque-style domes, surrounded by trees. The sky is lightly tinted blue and peach. German text at the top left reads the town name, and at the top right identifies the buildings as a castle and cathedral.

Color-tinted photograph of the interior of a large stone cathedral. The view shows a side aisle with high vaulted ceilings, arched openings, stone walls, and an ornate staircase along the wall. Religious furnishings and altars line the aisle, and a solitary robed figure stands in the distance. At the bottom margin, printed red text identifies the location.

Sepia-toned image showing a steep stone path leading up to a heavily fortified stone gate with battlements, towers, and thick defensive walls built into a rocky hillside. The scene depicts an old fortress entrance. At the bottom the image bears a caption indicating it is the gate of the fortress of Acrocorinth.

Colored illustrated postcard showing a walled religious complex with an ornate arched entrance gate in an Islamic architectural style, a central domed building with surrounding arcades, and a tall slender minaret. Trees and a garden fill the courtyard, and multi‑story houses appear in the background. At the top, multilingual captions label the scene; a faint central word seems to read a city name, and on the right the French text reads "SAINTE SOPHIE". Greek text appears on the left.

Multiview postcard titled "BURG STOLPEN" featuring an illustrated bird's‑eye plan of Stolpen Castle with numbered buildings and a legend in German on the upper part, plus three photographic views along the bottom: the fortress ruins and walls, a heraldic coat of arms set in stone, and striking columnar basalt formations associated with the castle hill.

Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over the old town of Bautzen, with dense historic buildings, steep tiled roofs, a large church with a tall spire in the center, and several round medieval defensive towers and walls in the foreground, partially obscured by trees. The word "Bautzen" is printed in red in the upper left corner on a blank sky background.

Vintage monochrome postcard depicting a historic two‑story house with a large patterned tile roof and several chimneys. The building façade has rectangular windows framed by pilasters and an arched central doorway. Above the entrance appears the sign of a museum. In the background are parts of neighboring houses and a street scene with a few people. Printed Hungarian text appears in the upper corners identifying the city and the building.

A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing the interior of a large Gothic cathedral. The view looks down the central nave toward the ornate main altar, with high ribbed vaults, tall clustered columns, side aisles, wooden pews, and a suspended crucifix. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the central aisle. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Trento and describes the scene as the interior of the cathedral (Duomo).

A colorized historic postcard view over a European town with medieval fortifications and church towers. In the foreground stands a large round stone tower on a square base, surrounded by red-roofed houses and greenery. An arched stone bridge or viaduct crosses a valley to the left, connecting to a fortified complex with multiple towers and walls. In the background, several tall church spires dominate the skyline. At the top center of the image, the caption reads "Blick auf Bautzen." A building in the mid-ground has the word "Restauration" on its facade.

Sepia-toned image showing a rocky, stepped stone platform carved into a hillside, with rough terrain surrounding it. A lone robed figure stands near the rock cut. The card has printed captions at the bottom in French and Greek identifying the site, and a website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' across the lower right.

A black-and-white postcard showing a large, classical-style two‑storey stone building behind a metal fence and gate. The facade has many evenly spaced windows and a central entrance with a pediment. Conifer trees and other vegetation stand in front, and tree branches frame the image from above. The word "LÄNSRESIDENS" is visible on the building, and a printed caption at the bottom left reads "Umeå. Länsresidenset."

A black‑and‑white postcard image showing a traditional wooden belfry and an adjacent stone church behind a low stone wall. Leafless and sparsely leaved trees partially obscure the buildings. The architecture is typical of historic Scandinavian rural churches, with a steeply pitched roof and simple arched windows. Printed caption text appears in the upper left, and an additional vertical strip of text is visible along the left margin.

A sepia-toned historic postcard showing an elegant Baroque/Rococo palace wing with ornate columns and statues, set within a landscaped garden. A round fountain stands prominently in the foreground, with curving pathways and trees framing the scene. Printed text at the top identifies the site.

Black‑and‑white landscape view of a small town along a river. On the left, steep rocky hills and dense trees descend toward clustered houses with pitched roofs. In the middle distance stand church spires and a tower on a hill. The river curves from the foreground on the right toward a bridge and the town center in the background. The caption printed in the upper right reads "Camburg a. Saale".

A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Gothic cathedral with twin ornate towers and a central entrance fronting an open square. Early 20th‑century cars and pedestrians are visible in the foreground. At the bottom margin, handwritten German text reads "Der Dom zu Meißen."

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow cobblestone street lined with old houses and stone walls in a historic European town. The street curves gently and leads toward taller multi‑story buildings with steep gabled roofs. On the hill above stands a large medieval complex with a steep roof and tower, and in the background a church or castle tower with a dome and spire is visible. The image has a white border with handwritten-style captions at the bottom.

Colorized view of medieval castle ruins on a wooded hill, with a tall round stone tower in the foreground and a larger ruined keep or tower behind trees. A stone wall runs along a grassy slope. At the top of the image there is printed German text identifying the place as Frauenstein in the Erzgebirge and mentioning ruins and a lookout tower.

A monochrome sketch-style postcard showing a hilly riverside landscape with small houses in the foreground and a church-like building on a hill in the background, topped by three large crosses. Trees surround the buildings. At the bottom margin, handwritten-style text labels the scene.

A vintage, monochrome postcard showing the ornate neoclassical facade of a theater building on a cobblestone square. The structure has large arched windows, Corinthian columns, and a central pediment with a coat of arms. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand in front of the entrance. Printed text at the top left reads "BRUGES – Le Théâtre."

A vintage monochrome postcard showing a park with curved paths, lawns, and a waterway. Dominating the scene is a round medieval brick tower (part of old city fortifications). In the background are town buildings and an arched railway bridge. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Kronenburgerpark. — NIJMEGEN." The left margin has vertical publisher text, and the upper right has handwritten text with a date.

Black‑and‑white postcard view showing a tree‑lined dirt path on the left overlooking a river valley and a historic hilltop complex with a cathedral-like church and castle buildings dominating the right side. A colorized historic postcard showing the ornate façade and terrace of the Grand Hotel Pupp with people in early‑20th‑century fashion strolling and sitting at cafe tables in front of the building. The hotel's name appears on the façade and the caption at the top reads "Karlsbad, Grand Hôtel Pupp." Additional small red text is printed vertically on the right margin and at the lower right corner.

Colorized view of a large European town square with a central monument and fountain, market stalls with umbrellas, a tram, and surrounding multi‑story buildings with red roofs and green shutters. In the background a steep hill rises with fortification walls and a prominent clock tower on top. The caption at the top reads "Graz-Hauptplatz," and shop signs in German are visible on the façades.

A sepia-toned panoramic photograph shows a European city nestled in a valley surrounded by hills and low mountains. Dense clusters of historic buildings, churches, and villas spread across the foreground and middle ground, while a wooded hill with a fortification or tower rises on the right. Snow‑capped mountains are faintly visible in the far distance. At the bottom margin of the image there is printed white text indicating the location and viewpoint.

Vintage sepia postcard view of a riverside scene with a tram in the foreground on curved tracks beside a cobblestone embankment. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the river. Albrechtsburg.'

Black‑and‑white view from a hillside lookout over a river bending through a European town. Nearby are church buildings with steeples and clustered town houses, all surrounded by trees and gentle hills in the distance.

A monochrome postcard showing a Gothic-style church with tall pointed-arch windows and a small tower with a spire on the left side. Colorized historical view of a tree‑lined public square with a tall sculptural monument in the foreground and rows of traditional European buildings behind it. A black‑and‑white postcard showing a dramatic sunset or dusk scene in Trento, with the silhouetted Monument to Dante in the foreground on a high pedestal, the figure pointing outward. A black-and-white historic postcard showing a large town square with horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. An old, tinted postcard depicting a massive stone castle complex with thick walls, corner towers, and small windows. The structure has a medieval appearance, with red-tiled roofs atop the towers. A monochrome vintage postcard showing the neoclassical façade of a large museum building with a long colonnade and central portico, set behind a tree‑filled square with pedestrians, carriages and early vehicles. Sepia-toned postcard showing a Byzantine-style brick church with domes and arched windows, surrounded by a simple fence and a few trees, with a townscape in the background. The lower margin contains captions in Greek and French and a small signature/mark of the printer.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined approach to a symmetrical building with a central arched gateway, clock, and small tower topped by a cupola. The façade is flanked by lower wings, and a few people stand near the entrance. Printed German text appears at the top.

Black‑and‑white view of a European hilltown with a large baroque/early modern castle‑like building on a wooded hill, topped by a short dome or cupola. Decorative vintage postcard with a colored illustration. Colorized vintage postcard showing a sandy open square or yard in a small town with wooden houses on both sides and a small octagonal pavilion-like structure in the center-right. A woman and children stand near a well or fountain. In the distant background, the tower of a larger church-like building rises above the roofs. Handwritten-style printed text in red appears at the top left of the image.

Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a large castle complex with a tall rectangular tower on the left, a long two-story residential wing with a steep tiled roof and dormer windows, and a partially visible ornate gabled structure on the right. Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large historic church with a tall clock tower and spire, bare winter trees in front, and several 1940s-style cars parked along the street. The caption at the bottom left reads "SÖDERTÄLJE Kyrkan", and a small serial number "54137" appears at the lower right.

Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a fortified brick complex with ramparts, a tower, and perimeter walls set behind an open grassy area. A black‑and‑white view of a grand spa town set in a forested valley. To the right are richly decorated façades of historicist buildings, a terrace with café tables, awnings, a fountain, and many elegantly dressed people strolling, suggesting an early‑20th‑century European resort atmosphere. A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a European city with a river or canal winding through the center, lined by trees and mid‑rise apartment blocks. In the distance, large bodies of water and low, forested land are visible, suggesting a coastal or lakeside city. There is no visible printed caption or text on the image.

Colorized historic postcard view of a lawn‑tennis court beside a high stone fortification wall. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on and around the court. In the background, beyond trees and bushes, rises a church with two tall spires. Flowerbeds occupy the foreground. The top left corner bears the caption "Reval" and the top right reads "Lawn-Tennisplatz und Karls-Kirche."

Black‑and‑white image of a large statue of a standing man in 18th‑century dress atop a tall pedestal in a landscaped park. Black‑and‑white view of a historic European market square. In the center stands a large Baroque/Neoclassical town hall with a steep roof and a central tower bearing a clock and a small cupola. To the right is a large Gothic church with a tall tower capped by an onion-shaped dome. Surrounding buildings are multi‑story townhouses typical of central European old towns.

Black‑and‑white winter scene showing a tall lattice radio mast or transmission tower rising above a snowy landscape. Conifer trees with snow on their branches frame the foreground. A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard showing three photographic scenes of a hilltop castle and cathedral complex above a river and old town. A vintage, black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town with dense historic buildings, churches with tall towers, and a central street lined with trees. Colorized vintage postcard view of a romantic, castle‑like complex beside a calm lake or moat with lush trees. Pointed towers and red-tiled roofs are reflected in the water. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a river valley and town bordered by hills or low mountains. A promenade or lookout terrace with a railing runs along the edge, with several people walking and a young girl in traditional-style clothing standing near the left side. At the bottom, there is a printed caption in German.

An illustrated vintage postcard framed with decorative Art Nouveau borders, showing a long Renaissance-style building with many windows and a clock tower rising above a red-tiled roof. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street in front. At the bottom is printed text in German identifying the scene, and a purple archival stamp with a handwritten year appears in the lower right corner.

Vintage sepia postcard showing a panoramic view over the River Danube in Budapest. In the foreground is a large suspension bridge spanning the river, with numerous boats and steamships on the water. An illustrated view of a large fortified palace or castle complex in a park-like setting at dusk. Trees and paths fill the foreground, and the sky is cloudy and dramatic, giving a romantic, painterly atmosphere.

A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy street scene in front of an ornate city gate with Renaissance architecture. The gate has a large central archway for traffic, two stories of windows supported by columns, balustrades with statues, and a steep roof topped by a tower and spires. Langgasser Tor." and there is additional small printing along the left edge and architectural Latin inscriptions above the arch.

A monochrome postcard showing an old European city square with a large, ornate Baroque/Neoclassical building dominating the center. On the left edge a richly decorated corner building with arcades frames the scene; in the background a tall church or town‑hall tower rises above a street of narrow houses.

A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a European town, showing dense blocks of multi‑story stone buildings, tree‑lined streets, and a prominent church with a tall spire in the middle distance. Some commercial signs are visible on building facades in the foreground.

Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Romanesque cathedral and adjacent civic buildings on a square. A colorized postcard showing a young girl in traditional dress standing in a blossoming orchard, with the large medieval clock tower on a hill behind her. Sepia-toned postcard showing a historic Italian square framed by a large arch in the foreground. Behind it rises a large Romanesque cathedral with a rose window, arcaded façade, and octagonal dome with a cross on top. To the left are old stone buildings with shuttered windows and a crenellated tower. Small figures of pedestrians and an early automobile appear in the square. Black‑and‑white postcard showing a frontal view of a large, rectangular neoclassical/art‑deco style building with tall arched windows and circular medallions above them. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge, including the name of the city and the art museum, a printer's mark, and collection information.

Black‑and‑white view of a European town square with a large ornate fountain in the foreground, topped by a standing statue and surrounded by sculpted lions and basins. Around the square are market stalls and people in early‑20th‑century dress. A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large stone hydroelectric power station building beside a fast‑flowing river or rapids. Tinted historic postcard view of a large monument in an open square, with a tall statue of a robed figure atop a multi-tiered pedestal adorned with reliefs and sculptural groups. A vintage, sepia-toned postcard showing a grand historic building with a large arched windowed façade and two symmetrical towers. The caption at the bottom left reads "Leipzig. Palmengarten".

A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a panoramic view over a town with low wooden and stone buildings, tree-lined streets, and a tall chimney and clocktower in the distance. The bottom margin contains printed and handwritten text, with the printed caption reading "Tampere-Tammerfors."

Sepia-toned postcard showing a large baroque hilltop church with twin onion-domed towers rising above a wooded hill. At the foot of the hill are several traditional gabled houses with tiled roofs. Black‑and‑white postcard view of an old European town street with cobblestones, historic houses and trees in the foreground. Elbe" on the left and "Freiheit und Dom" on the right.

A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a wide view of Piazza del Duomo in Trento, Italy. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large medieval hilltop castle surrounded by dense forest. The castle sits on a rocky outcrop above a valley, with multiple gabled roofs and a central tower. Vintage monochrome postcard showing a broad cobblestone square with a large two‑storey institutional building on the left and an ornate church with onion domes and a tall bell tower with crosses on the right. Black-and-white postcard view of a city square framed by multi-story historic buildings. In the distance, on a hill, stands a prominent clock tower. A few pedestrians are visible in the foreground.
